mi /ri sna lha11—— ci mi rī rdo ma tsho sgyu mi sde tsho〉 ༷ dri ri ༷༷dza shi bla'i phyo gyi/rmos ji tsho sgyu rabye wa /// —mo— —— — — ——ri ༵༷༷ho shā 1 7 ——6 0ci hūṃ dzwa kyi ri ༷pa 4)lotstshaḥ)chorwa tshe/chace4 4 shā rimi rdong — —112nelha sdo 'iX ji wa pa ndhu sno hro rnyazlo sta lta —2 dri/rmojeXzlo /riXrte rdorngo/rdoX — — dzha 44༷'i cho —༷༷ snyiṇḍihā nyurte )ljo bye rna tho cadroḥ rsā)3 caX 5bye zhe bye ༷ treX 1 sde/rdoX wawa/ sdo balha chosgro wa hūṃ
//gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/deb dang bo/bur sras ba rin chen dar lo nas brtsams/a skyes ma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang gis sbar du bskrun pa'o//2༷la

dkar chagagleng brjod/ /5le tshan dang po/ gnya' nang yul sbyi'i lo rgyus rags tsam gleng ba/ lha/1 yul ming / lha/2 'thob mi rigs byung ba'i yulalung sngon ma'i gras zhinayin pa/ 223 gnya' nang rdzong gi khyab tshad/ 244 mi 'bor 277 sa zhing gi rgya khyon/thon khyangs/ 28cu yul 1snangs kyi bkod pa/ 28le tshan gnyis pa/ gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi 〈snar/ 341 la phyi/ 372 bkra zhis sgang / 4/3 'phel rgyas gling dgoni pa/ 414 la zhing sgrol ma gsung phyon/ 447 mthong la 46ca rgyug khrod/ 47

7 bal po thong / 48/ e ka dzo ṭi'i pho brang / 520 sngo ra snang yul/ 521༷ bde chen steng / 5711 sbas yul padma tshal/ 5912 dpal lha'i dgon pa/ 647 paṇa ḍi/ 6414dga' ldan gling / 7717'gram gyi thub pa lha khang / 671cadagon pa gsar pa'i lha khang / 6717〈snal 〈sna sgang gi bka' 'gyur lha khang / 68le tshan gsum pa/ snung 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yul ljongs bcas kyi sgor/ 711 lha khang gsar pa/ 722 lha khang rnying pa/ 753 ma ṇi dung 'khor/ 75dzo ma ṇi 'degs mkhar/ 777 bka' 'gyur lha khang dang rgyal ba byams pa'i lha khang / 78tsu lha rwa/ 784

7 sras gu ru chos dbang gi mchod rten dang stong ra chen/ 79/ yul mi'i sdod khang gi sgor/ 790 sgo khang dang rtsa tshig che yo/ tsho/7 rgyal po sku lnga dang /chu 'khor ma ṇi/sde pa'i rdzing bcas kyi sgor/ 8311 ka ka gling gi rgyal sgo dang mchod rten/bu khrid ri mgo bcas kyi sgor/ 8512 g.yag rwa dang khral 'gel las khyangs/11 cadags kyi zhing nags dang mtha' mtshams 11nga tsho bcas kyi 〈snar/ tsho'o13 sa sna(ga gi tsha chu/ 88le tshan bzhi pa/ gnya' nang rdzong dang / gon po sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/ 901 rdzong dbon rim byung / 902 rten bzhengs pa dang zhor 'phros rgya bla ma'i sgor/ 1/3 dngul sdud pa/ 954 5 sgo/ 177 gon bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/ 97ca las drung gi 'khyar 'gan/ 987 11 khrims pa/ 11/ zung lag gi las 'gan/ 11

'a khyung zhu ma'i las 'gan/ /00la tshong 'dus zha ra'am shar po'i sgrig 'dzugs/ /0011 395 bcu pa/ 10112 lha 31 ba/ 10313 khral dang ñtsa lag 10414thong dpon rdzog grong dang mi ser dbar gyi rtsod rnyog sgor/ 106le tshan lnga pa/ gnya' nang yul mi'i gzhis spyod dang /zas bo|sa rje(da stangs 〈snar/ 1091 yul mi'i gzhis spyod/ 1092 rgyan gos/ ///3 'gram dang phyogs ga ma pa'i khyad choso/ /134 bud med kyi 'byug rdzas/ /147 sbyir btang za btung spyod stangs/ spro/5ca zhim zas/ /spro'o7 sngo tshal/ 127/ gling ga'i zhim zas/ /18'a rigs/ spro197 chang rag /207 za btung dang 'brel ba'i srol rgyun/ /lha/

12 li rag zangs gsum gyi thab chas /22le tshan drug pa/ snung 'dus pa'i 'tsho thabs sgor cung zad gleng ba/ /251 rong 'i /252 'grog pa'i tshong thog /273 'bras snung / /29rdzo bal po'i tshong khang dang sgrig 'dzugs/ /317 lug tshong / 133ca bal bod dngul ṭam gyi bed spyod dang /'garigs gzhal stod/ /347 'a11ga las/ /36rngu lag shes dang /'debs las sogs ngal rtsol gyi 'tsho ba/ /37cha gnya' nang 〈snad dang /'gram phyogs gsham bcas pa'i 'tsho thabs /39la sman pa dang /bzo pa/rdza mkhan sogs kyi skor/ 140le tshan bdun pa/ dbyar dgun ston dged bzhi'i nam dus so so dang bstun pa'i las rigs/ /451 dbyid ka /'debs las mgo 'dzugs/ 14/2 rang yul du log pa'i 'dab bya dang /rgya gar khams pa'i tshong thog 1423 dbyar kha/ zhing chu 'dren gtong / /43

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/4 sgo phyugs 'tsho skyong / /447 char 'beb dang chu rtsed/ /45ca ri skyes thing tog dang /sngo tshal/spe tog bcas pa'i sgor/ /457 ston ka/ bud thing 'tshol sgrug /46/ brnga bsdu sku gas lha na las kyi brel zing / ljo48ba sgog bya 'thur 'gran/ /507 tsher ma brnga ba dang /bcas 'thag byed tshul/ /spro/11 dgun kha/ bal po rnams rang yul du log ba dang /dgun tshong mgo 'dzugs byed pa/ /5212 bal las dang /bye1na chas 'tshem ba1sna 153tha gangs 'bab dang steng thog gi nyi ma/ 154le tshan brgyad pa/ thun yong ma yin pa'i yul skad dang /yul gzhas kyi 〈snar/ /spro'o1 skad yig skor/ /562 gzhas dang zhabs blo sbyi bshad/ 1573 gya tshom gyi zlu gzhas/ /60rdzo gtam snyan dar 'phyar/ 1647 〈sna chas mosna chas /77le tshan dgu pa/ rig gzhung khrab ston ru khag dang /bla ma ma ṇi ba/

dkar chagabon po/sgrung pa bcas kyi sgor/ /'o/1 rgya rtags pa/ 1682 rgyas gzhas/ /713 ral pa /704 glang 'khor ma ṇi ba/ 1717 bal yul gyi bon po/ 174ca bu chen pa/ /757 sgyung pa/ 177le tshan bcu pa/ nam dus so so dang bsdun pa'i phru gu'i rtsed sna/ 1781 nor chas/ /782 ab 'thor /113 spu blug 1714 rgyu rtsa/ 1807 cagab cug 181cu dbyu gu /8/7 dkyil mdzub 'a665 ba 181/ a bo mthe bong rog rog 1840 rgyal po'i gur khang / 1847 rgyal po rin po cher dgongs pa zhus nas log 'gro 185

7 snyag sgo bzhi/ 18512 rgya gu'i rgyan rgyag 1867 zhe dha ju/ 18714shur gro sgra res/ 18717'khyag shud/ /88mi rkang gcig pa dang zha ra/ 18817 sbyi ma'i rdo/ 1881/ ra bo zug po su par/ 189mi dbyags sgom ring zung gi 'gran bsdur/ /902༷ lce rtsal 'gran bsdur/ 191le tshan bcu gcig pa/ srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung brtsi zhu stangs skor/ /931 31 gsar/ 1932 cho 'phrul dus chen dang sngo las rgyan rgyag 20/3 sa ga zla ba'i dus chen dang /smyung gnas kyi sgor/ 2024 choso sgor/ 2047 ra hu lha gathegal/ 206ca lha yo 'khrab ston dang /gling ga'i spro skyid/ 2087 paṇa dzo ra ma'i dus chen/ lha/skye

/'phel rgyas gling gi dbang chog dang /'cham/ches chogi bcas kyi skor/ 2'bal po'i dus chen lham san ṅgātra/dzo ta ra 2lams snying dang /dmar mchod/ 247skar ma dzo kṣ-i/ 2812lha bab dus chen dang /dga' ldan lnga mchod/ 29thangan pa dgu 'dzoms dang /bzang po bcu 'dzoms/ 220le tshan bcu gnyis pa/bag ston dang /'das mchodi/nyi 'dzin la gdong len/'brum nad sngon 'gogagason 'dre'i gnod pa bzlog thabs bcas kyi sgor/ 22/1 bag ston lam 11'go 222 zun yong ma yin pa'i 'das mchod/ 2243nyi 'dzin la gdong len/ 2264'brum nad sngon 'dog 2277gson 'dre'i gnod pa bzlog thabs sri gnon dang gnas 'dren hom mchodi/ 228le tshan bcu gsum pa/tshong 'dus kyi slob grwa gsar rnying skor/ 231sgor 'dzin slob grwa khag gi skor/ 232rdo legs pa'i slob ga 232

3 sgyug kha dang /snag tsha bzo stangs/ 2334 zla re'i yig tshad dang /smyug lcag gi nyes pa/ 2347 gung gseng / 235ca snga dus kyi bod yig sbyong stangs/ 2377 gzhung 'dzugs slob grwa gsar pa'i sgor/ 237ji gzhung 'dzugs slob grwa'i byung rabs/ 239le tshan bcu bzhi pa/ dus 'gyur gyi rba rlabs/ 242mi gnya' nang du rgya mi thog mar 'byor ba/ 2422 bstan srung dmag mi'i rgyags phye gra sgrig 2443 nyen gasku1la/ 245le tshan bco lnga pa/ yul gyar mi tshe gsar pa'i bde sdug 2481 blos phyol/ 2482 dpa' bo dgon pa'i slob ga 250le tshan bcu drug pa/ slob grwa thor nas rgya gar du 'byor ba dang /drag po'i slob sbyong /ku lu lam bakhro'i gnya' nang brgya re(ga bcas kyi 〈snar/ 2571 slob grwa thor nas rgya gar du 'byor ba/ 2572 drag po'i 〈snab spyong / 2603 ku lu lam bze'i gnya' nang brgya sgog 'o/

le tshan bcu bdun pa/ 'jo wa la khel bzo gzhis/sta ri su li lam bzo/sud dzar lan ḍi'i gzhis chags bcas kyi sgor/ 281 'a11 wa la khel gzhis chags/ 2yo2 sta ri su li'i chu mdzod dang lam ba1 2643 sud dzor lan ḍi'i gzhis chags/ 266le tshan bco brgyad pa/ mi smon rang skyid kyi 'tsho ba dang /phyi nang shes skusnan/gzhung dmangs kyi sri zhu bcas kyi sgor/ 2691 mi smon rang skyid kyi 'tsho ba/ ༅712 phyi nang shes yon dang /gzhung dmangs kyi sri zhu/ 270le tshan bcu dgu pa/ byes 'kho da gnya' nang skyid sdug gi slor/ 2741 gnya' nang skyid sdug 2742 rig gzhung gces 'dzin/ 2773 'char 'phar rten bzhengs/ 278rdzo brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul/ 280le tshan nyi shu pa/ g.yer ma zhing sogs bal yul gyi sa mtshams 11nga gseb mi sna'i 〉(ra/ 292kha sgong dang po/ 3011 rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/'khe na 〈snan dpal 'a〈snar lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ 30313

2 rje btsun dwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/kun mkhyen jo nang tā ra na thas mdzad pa/ 319kha sgong gnyis pa/rwa chen lo tsur phyag bstod bdud sde 'joms pa lha yi gaṇḍi zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rdzong sar mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ 355mjug bsdu'i gtam tshig gsum nor bu ldog gcig 357'brel yod par khag gcig 371gnya' 'a/ma sa khra/ 409

gleng brjod/༄༄༄/ /mtshan dpes mdzes sku rta bdun dbang po 'dzam gling skusnangs la tā/ba//zab dbyangs gsung gi 'od rlabs 'gro bas 'gro ba'i mun pa sel//thugs rje'i drod kyis byams brtse'i lo tog dad ldan brgyud la 'phel//kun sgoms nam mkha'i nor bu bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor gus pas bstod//bsil ldan gangs ri'i mu khyud kyis mdzes pa'i//chol kha gsum zhes grags pa'i bod ljongs khyeni//lugs gnyis rdzogs ldan dpal la sbyor mdzod pa'i//mes dboni rnam gsum bka' drin rtag tu dran//stong dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i lam//gangs ri'i ljongs su thog mar gsal mdzad pa'i//mtsho skyes rdo rje zhi 'tsho la sogs pa'i//ris med skyes chen rnams la gus pas 'dud//'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro kun skyob mdzod pa'i//mthu ldan ma gcig srid gsum rgyal mosna dang //dregs dpon rdo rje grags ldan gtsor byas pa'i//

bod skyong lha srung rnams kyis zhis pa phyol//lo rgyus smra ba'i slobs pa ches dman kyang //'o rgyus dkon pa'i sa mtha' gang zhig gi/lo rgyus 'bri ba dgos pa cher mthong ste//lo rgyus gang rnyed yi ge'i gzugs su spel//zhes yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom ba dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ gang gleng bar bya ba ni srid zhi'i gtsug nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen bo mchog nas deng dus bod kyi sbyi tshogs gsar rnying 'pho 'gyur zhin tu chen bo 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/bod mi rnams nas rang gi mi tshe'i nang bde sdug myong tshor ji byung sgro skur sbangs pa'i lo rgyus rtsom bris dbo sa pa'i bka' slob nan tan stsal sku da pa ltar bod gangs can smongs kyi dbyas gtsang chol kha'i khongs su gtogs pa la stod gnya' nang ni/ bal bod sa mtshams dbar gyi tshong rwa che sgos dang / dor bod dmag 'thab kyi chings don bka' yol gnang yul sogs sa gnas gal 'gangs che ba'i thog snga dus gtan sdod bal po'i mi sna 'du 'dzoms che zhing / 'tsho gos lam srol gang ci gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos du ma dang ldan pa zhig yin rung / bod la dus 'gyur byung rjes lung pa'i gnas stangs dang yul mi'i 'tsho gos la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba ma zad/ tshong 'dus grong khyer stod smad so sor yod 16

gleng brjod/pa'i lha khang rnams dang / rdzong gi bsnyi gnas sgo khang / bal po rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i bzo bkod phul du byung ba'i ma ṇi 'degs mkhar lha khang gsum/nyin du chos lugs kyi lha khang sgom san sbran zhu ba sogs rtsa gtor zin pa'i thog /snga dus nas yod pa'i yul mi'i sdod khang phal cher shul med chags zin pa dang /rig gzhung dang 'brel ba'i srol rgyun bzang po rnams kyang nyams brlag song bar brten lo rgyus rags bsdus thig cis kyang dgos gal du mngon/ 'on kyang de snga yig cha gang yod gtor gyar zin pa'i thog /lo rgyus gsung rgyu yod pa'i rgan rabs rnams snga rjes rim 'das su song zhing / rang nyid las cung bgres pa rnams kyang da cha gos zhing 'khogs pa'i dus 'dir shes rmongs bdag lta bu zhig gis lhag bsam thol med ngal rtsol 'khur du blangs te/ thog mar yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus/bar du yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs chags tshul dang gzhis lugs goms srol gtso gyur 'tsho gos kyi gnas stangs/mthar 1070 lo mgo nas yul mi mang che ba btsan byol du gyar te 'tsho ba'i mdun lam gsar 'tshol bya dgos byung pa'i gnas tshul dang / da cha mi lo lnga bcu'i rjes yul mi sbyi byings rnams gar yod gang byed sogs rang gi mi che'i myong tshor dang sbyar te 'bri bkod bgyis par zhing gshegs zhang po rig 'dzin ldo rje lags dang /gcung bo blo bzang rgyal mtshan lags/gcung mo chos 17

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/sgron lags dang g.yu lo lags gtan zhal/ gcen po dkar chung lags/ a ce blo bzang chos sgron lags dang gcung po rnam rgyal sgrol ma gtan zhal/bsus tshang rnam rgyal rdo rje lags dang me tog dbyangs can lags/ gcen po lo lo bkra lhas rdo rje lags/ gcung po rang 'khor ngag dbang tshul khrims lags/ bkras khang rnam rgyal rdo rje lags/ zhang bo kun gling ngag dbang phun tshogs lags/ bsus tshang sangs rgyas tshe dbang lags/ gcung po lo lo ngag dbang chos 'phel lags/ gsang chos sku zhabs bkra shis rnam rgyal lags/ grong rogs klu khug 'chi med rdo rje lags/ mang 'brug sru mo rnam rgyal sgrol dkar lags/gnas 'og tshe dbang ldo rje lags/a cag g.yu sgron lags/rdo legs a jo bkra shis lags/a jo dar rgyas lags/'od bsam a jo dga' rabs lags/ chu thag a jo 'phrin las lags/ chu steng bkris lags/mkhar steng rnam chung lags/daskarton tshe skal bzang rgyal mtshan lags/a jo padma zangs mdog lags/ gnas dbyangs ngag dbang rnam rgyal lags/dngul bzo skal bzang sgrol ma lags/ chu steng bkra zhis rdo rje lags/ rdo legs padma lags/ srong btsan slob spyi byams pa phun tshogs lags/ dge slong blo bzang dpal ldan lags bcas nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gnang bar zugs rje che zhes rgyu yin/ji ltar dga' bzhi pa'i rnam thar nang / so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan 18

gleng brjod/bdag lta bu la bstan 'gror phan bde spel tshul gyi rtsom sgrig ni ga nas skusnang /dug gsum gyi 'khor lo bskor nas 'khor bar 'khyams tshul gyi lo rgyus ba1snad na khyi phag rnams la'ang rnam thar po ti 'o1ngas pa sku nga tshul gsal ba bzhin deb 'dir nya nyung mnyam bsres kyi gnas tshul mang dag zhig 'bri thal sgor ba phyogs gcig nas khyi phag gi rnam thar lta bu byab chung du mngon yang /gang bris pa'i lo rgyus zin bris rnams ngos rang gi mi thog 'di'i skabs su yig thog par skrun ma thub tshe/ shul med rtsa brlag 'gro rgyu nyag cig la brten lo rgyus col chung brjod tshig mi bde ba dang / dag cha nor 'khrul ji snyed yod srid kyang /gon rabs kyi ngag rgyun dang /rang gis myong thos/la rtse dbe mdzod khang dang /bod kyi nang bstan dpe tshogs lte gnas (1531166 77577513 23305106 khungs khu1) nas dpe deb g.yar skusnan byung rim la nyams zhib kyis phyogs sgrig zhus pa yin na/ bod kyi 'o1 rgyus nyams zhib la thugs khur skusnad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi dbyad gzhi'i rgyu char thugs phan gasku(sa pa dang / da lta 'tsho bzhugs gnya' nang yul mi dang / de dag gi ma 'ongs mi rgyud rnams nas rang gi pha mes kyi lo rgyus cung zad rtogs thub pa'i cha rkyen du 'gyur ba'i re ba zhu bzhin yod/lo rgyus 'bri rtsom byed yun ring bu yo bstan 'dzin sgrol dkar lags dang /bstan 'dzin snu sa 〈snan lags/ bstan 'dzin bde skyid lags bcas nas gang 19

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/ci'i mthun 'gyur thog bza' zla bsod nams rgyal mo lags nas zin bris snga rjes rkam bu ṭar nang gsog 'jog gnang ba dang / chos don drung che bye gzhong blo bzang tshul khrims lags nas gnya' nang gi sa khra bzo 'god gnang ba/ skyabs rje ra stod skyong lha rin po che dang mkhas dbang sku zhabs hor gtsang 'jigs med lags nas ma zin la thugs zhib kyis dag cha nor bcos dang zhus dag gtong rogs gnang ba bcas la zugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ la'i / spong/yangamang(zhungs nga brgyud la'i bya'i //nga〉8tu00ba775561bab05ba pa(10bdang gcung mosna nam mkha' cho sa lha na lags bcas nas mthun rkyen zhal 'debs gnang ba'i thog a ces rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin mkhas dbang sku zhabs bkra zhis tshe ring lags nas khungs ldan lo rgyus kha gnon dang par skrun rogs ram gnang ba bcas la zugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu bcas/ gnya' nang bur sras pa rin chen dar los/ phyi lo 2ཿjizla 12tshes1༷bod rgyal lo 2137zla 1༷tshes 12gong sa skyabs mgon chen por 'dzam gling zhi ba'i gzengs rtags phul ba'i dus chen nyin mjug tshang bar bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel//

le tshan dang po/gnya' nang yul spyi'i 'obyu rgyus rags tsam gleng ba/1)yul ming /gnya' nang zhes pa'i ming gi byung tshul ni/ri tshogs bdag glang po'i gnya' 'dra ba'i nang du chags pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas thog mar grong tsho'i ming la thogs pa dang / rjes su grong tsho'i ming la tshong 'dus dang / rdzong gi ming la gnya' nang zhes btags pa yin rung / mang po'i kha rgyun du gnya' lam zhes 'bod srol dar ba ma zad/ phyis su yig cha 'ga' shas kyi nang du'ang gnya' lam zhes 'bri bkod 'dug pa de yi 'grel bshad ni/ ri glang po che'i gnya' 'dra ba'i steng du lam chags pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yul ming gnya' lam thogs tshul sgod mkhan skusnad kyang khungs ldan yig cha mang che ba'i nang gnya' nang zhes 'khod 'dug2)'gro ba mi rigs byung ba'i yul lung sngon ma'i gras zhig yin pa'i sgor/sngon byon lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas pa mang pos/bod 'di yang rgya gar dang 'dra ba yul dang / mi rigs bskal pa nas byung zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ phyi 'e 21

gnya' nang 14ra 'das pa'i ba tsha rgyal khams pa/༄ ༄1074 lor nag chu'i sa khul du gna' bo'i mi rigs kyi shul lus ldo chas rnying pa rigs gnyis rnyed pa dang / de rjes gnya' nang dang / ding ri/ me togazhan tsha/ sbu greng / sum mdo/ rnam gling sogs kyi yul nas rdo chas rnying pa'i dus rabs kyi gna' rdzas ngo mtshar can rnam pa sna tshogs thig rnyed thub pa byung yod/ shul dngos de tshor dasad na dus tshod thad rdo chas rnying pa'i dus skabs dang / rdo chas gsar ma'i dus skabs/ zangs rdo mnyam spyod kyi dus skabs sogs lo ngo stong drag mang po'i gong du rong 'brog gnyis ma'i yul du mi rnams 'tsho zhing gnas par nges pa ni 'e1 rgyus rig pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa gcig mthun yin lugs dge che thub bstan phun tshogs kyis brtsams pa bod kyi lo rgyus sbyi don pad ma rwa ga'i ldi mig dang / bod ljongs mi mang dpe skrun khang nas par 'debs byas pa bod ljongs sbyi bshad kyi stod cha/dar thang sprul skus par skrun mdzod pa gna' rabs kyi wa da (sangakhu1khub 116༷ /ces pa'i dbyin yig deb ther so so'i nang gsal ba bzhin/ bod chol kha gsum gyi nang tshan dbus gtsang gi khongs su gtogs pa sngar gnya' nang glang yul zhes bya ba 'di yang gna' rdzas rtog zhib mkhas pa'i brtag dpud dgongs don bod kyi yul du 'gro ba mi rigs byung ba'i yul lung sngon ma'i gas zhig yin pa ma zad/ sngar chos rgyal hre nga btsan sgam po'i sku dus nas 22 bod yul ru chen lnga zhes pa drag po'i g.yul gyi sgrog gzhi gtso bor byas pa'i

gnya' nang yul sbyi'i 'o1 rgyus rags tsam theng ba/dbang 'dzin gyi sa khul chen po dbya ru dang / g.yo ru/ ru lag /sum pa'i ru bcas lnga byung ba'i khongs su'ang gnya' nang ni g.yas ru'i nang gi sde tshan zhig yin par gsal 'dug/de yang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston dang bod kyi lo rgyus spyi don bad ma rwa ga'i lde mig las/ dbya ru ni/ shar 'ol kha'i thug pa sbyan bdun/ (deng sang 'ol kha thong khongs )sgo rma la la brgyud/ (deng sang gtsang chab dang skyid chu'i bar gyi ri brgyud )nub gzhu ste mo/(snye rdzong khongs gzhu )byang brags kyi glang ma gur phub/dbus kyi tshad lha sa ra yo che/g.yo ru ni/ shar kong yul bris sna/ (deng sang kong bo nying khri rdzong khongs ) sgo sha zhug stag 〈sna/(mtsho sna rdzong khongs sha 'ug grong tsho )nub kha rag gangs rtse/(sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs kha rag sa khul ) byang rma la la brgyud/ dbus tshad yar klung khra 'brug(sne gdong rdzong khongs )g.yas ru ni/shar brags kyi glang ma gur phub/rdzo gnya' nang g.yag po'i sna/(deng sang gnya' nang thong khongs ) nub bye ma la dgu (ngam ring thong khongs bye ma la )byang sgri ti chu nag (lha ri rdzong khongs spyi sta kha ) /dbyas tshad zhags kyi zhong pa tshal/(rnam gling rdzong khongs zhong gzhong )ru lag ni/ shar 'jam na bkra/ 〈sna bal therdzo glang sna/ (bal bod sa mtshams )nub la kem g.yag mig/byang bye ma la lha na/dbus smad kyi dur pa sna/(deng sang sa skya rdzong khongs )23

sum pa'i ru ni/ shar gnye yul bum nag /sgo sri sta chu nag /nub yel zhabs sdings po che/ byang nags sgod gzi 'brang / dbus tshad rgya shod stag ba tshal bcas yin par gsal ba des na gzhi rgya che chung la ma stos par gnya' nang gi yul sde khag kyang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus g.yas ru'i khongs su 'phad pa gsal nges la brten yul sde chags snga ba'i gnas tshul tshod dpag byed thub pa yin/3)gnya' nang rdzong gi khyab tshad ni/phyi lo 163༷ lor dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab 'bangs dbyas gtsang dwags kong rong khag bcas kyi lcags stag zhib gzhung dam 'byar zhes pa'i deb gzhi gsar bsgrigs gnang pa'i zhal bshus deb chung zhig phyi lo 10/ lor mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang nas par btab byas pa de yi nang gsal ltar na/gzhung sger chos gsum gyi khral rigs bsdu sgrub zhu sgo gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i khongs su gnya' nang khyal gyi zhib gzhung bkod par/ 'gram gzhis 'og nas gzhung rgyug bud rnying phud pa'i dud lnga bcu tham pa/ tshong 'dus dang gyam gling / phu log g.yas g.yon bcas nas bud rnying phud pa'i rkang byed brgyad cu gya lnga dang bzhi cha gcig/tshong 'dus bzo pa'i gras dud bco brgyad/spyan dang /dwags/ stong thang / dgon gsar/ khung bu/ me zhing / gangs dkar/ lde ma phug24

gnya' nang yul sbyi'i lo rgyus rags tsam gleng ba//a po rog bcas nas khungs gsar chug dang bcas pa'i thog nas bud rnying phud pa'i gzhung rgyug sgrub rkang nyi shu phyed rtsa gnyis dang brgyad cha gciga'aphel gling chos gzhis bkra zhis sgang nas bud rnying phud pa'i rkang dgu la nyes sna'i 'don byed lnga sgrub/ bar tshig khul gtsang gdong dang / rdo dkar/ sngo lung / bkra zhis 'dzoms/ dar rgyas gling bcas nas gzhung rgyugs khungs gsar chug dang bcas nas bud rnying phud pa'i sgrub rkang nyi shu tham pa dang drug cha byed gsum nyer bzhi'i cha gcig sgrub/ yar slebs nas rus skyes dang /snag khra/ snang yul bcas nas bud rnying phud gzhung rgyugs khungs gsar chug dang bcas sgrub rkang byed bco lnga dang bzhi cha gcig /sngo ra bla ma'i mchod gzhis nor 'phel rkang gcig la sgrub 'don byed/ yar rgan 'og nas bud rnying phud gzhung rgyugs khungs gsar chug dang bcas sgrub rkang bcu gsum dang bcu gnyis cha gcig /'phel gling mchod gzhis bud rnying phud pa'i rkang brgyad la nyes sna'i 'don bzhi sgrub dgos ba bcas gtan 'khel yin/ lcags stag zla 11 tshes 0 la zhes 'khod 'dug /bud rnying zer ba ni yun ring stong par lus pa'i khang pa dang /sa zhing sogs la go dgos/ngos rang gi pha ma'i dran thog nas phyi lo 107 bar gyi khyab tshad ni/yongs grags su bal bod sa mtshams nas gnya' nang mthong la bar brtsi gi yod pa de'i khongs su rdzo ra dang / 'khor g.yag /be le lham dkar/rus skyed/25

snag khra/ snang yul/mdo dkar /du lung /la zhing /la zhing btsun ma'i dgon pa/yar slebs/bkra nyis 'dzoms/11 lung /rgyags/dar rgyas gling /gnas gsar/ gtsang gdong / me zhing / bkra nyis sgang /stong thang / ser mig /dbang byung sgar/ sgang sgar/ 'phel rgyas gling /tshogs/ lcang gling /rdzong /'od bsam/dwags/lhas dbang /gyab gling /nyag lung /phu 'ethog/dpal lha'i dgon pa/phug khrod/ snung 'dus/ skyid yo gzhung / phyogs gsham/ smug zam/ bde chen steng /lcal sna/ chu mig thang / spang / li zhing / mgo ser/ dgon ba gsar pa/ sde se snang /sgol bo sgang /la phyi/la phyi chos rwa dang zhing skyong bcas yin yang /phyis su rgya nag gzhung gis de snga'i shel dkar rdzong khongs nas dgu mtsho dang /nas lung /zur mtsho/1sna rong /sman khab stod smad sku gas sa cha gang 'tshams gnya' nang rdzong khongs su bcug ste da lta'i char sa cha'i rgya khyon sbyi le ngos stoms gru bzhi ma /ca/4 30yod pa dang /rdzong khongs su shang zer ba grangs 7dang /grong brdal 2grong tsho grangs 47yod par bshad 'dugal phyi chos rwa man chod bod sa rgya khyon mi chung ba zhig bal yul gzhung la rtsis sprod byas 'dug pa de yang / sku zhabs pi ṭar ob she rne ḍar gyi lo rgyus 11da nang 'o1 brgyad (23 zungs56khu'i bkra 132186 twaX 731ba71cing )ces pa'i nang / la phyi ni de snga bod kyi sa cha yin par bal bod gnyis phyogs nas sgod rgyun sku da pa ma zad/phyi 'etho 1027'o1ra rgya gar ba sa zig rgyag mkhan nas 26

bal gzhung gis ched du bton pa'i sa khra'i nang du'ang la phyi bod kyi sa khongs su yod kyang phyis su sa cha gang 'tshams rtsod gzhir gyur/phyi lo mi caX lor bal gzhung gis la phyi chos rwa'i nye 'khris su sa mtshams rdo rtags zhig khungs skyel drangs te/ mi ca2 lor rgya nag gzhung dang bal gzhung sku tshab zung sgrel sa zhib byas pa'i rjes su la phyi chos rwa man chod bal gzhung la rtsis sprod byas 'dug pa de ni skabs der rgya nag gzhung rang gi phyi 'brel srid byus kyi khe phan gtsor bzung byas te bod sar gyong gun btang ba zhig yin nges red/gzhung zhabs bgres sku1la sku zhabs grags bstan lags kyis brtsams deb le'u brgya pa'i nang du'ang rtse mgron ye shes lhun grub gnya' nang sgo rdzong bsgo bzhag ngo phebs skabs/ gnya' nang sho rwarngong gong rim phal yo ches ngo tshab btang ste sa mtshams sgor dang /sgo 'bab gang sar 'thus sgor gyis la phyi sgang lha khang gorṣa'i gzhung tshab nas sgo rgya byas skusnad stabs sgo zam bcags te sgo dbye gnang / de 'dral bal yul du ched phebs gnang bar bal yul gzhung gis sne len gzab rgyas zhus pa sku gas gang la gzhigs kyang la phyi ni 〈snad kyi khongs yin pa gsal po red/4)mi 'bor/dus 'gyur gong du mi 'bor ji yod rgan rabs rnams la 'dri rtsad zhus par 27

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/gsung rgyu med pa'i thog de lnga'i yig cha gnya' nang rdzong gi byed khra she bam mam 〈sna khra them gan dang dpe deb kyang rnyed sku na ma byung / phyi 'o( mi chub tham pa'i lor rgya gzhung nas mi grangs zhib bsher byas pa'i rtsa 'dzin yig cha'i nang / da lta'i rdzong khyon yongs la pho grangs 7473dang /yo grangs/tsu167bsgoms bod rigs 12༷3/dang /rgya rigs 347yod lugs gsal 'dug pa dang /yang de'i rjes su bton pa gzhis rtse'i lo rgyus rig gnas dbyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs deb chung nang mi grangs 14ཿ༷lhag tsam sku da ces bshad 'dug /'on kyang da lta'i char phyogs mtha' nas sku nga ba'i bod mi dang / rgya rigs mi 'bor che chags la brten khyon bsgoms mi 'bor 1caXlhag tsam yod tsod sgod kyin 'dug7)sa zhing gi rgya khyon dang /thon khungs/rdzong yongs la sa zhing rgya khyon lhag ṭar 1133༷༷༷ yod pa dang / 'gru rigs 'debs las byed bzhin pa lhag ṭar 3334༷ yin cing / de dag las thon khyangs 'bru nyon 200dzodang /snum can 71yin lugs gsal 'dugaca)yul ljongs kyi bkod pa/spyir gnya' nang khyon posnangs kyi sa cha ni/ hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud dkyil mtshams 28

gnya' nang yul sbyi'i 'o rgyus rags tsam theng ba/kyi sgo ngos su gnas zhing / gangs ri dang mtsho che chung sna tshogs thog sbang ljongs me tog gis khengs pa'i lung pa'i phu rnams la 'grog sa dang / lung gzhung nang dwangs bsil chu rgyun 'bab pa'i g.yas ga〈snan du sa zhing 'debs las kyis gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi grong tsho khag chags/ rong mtshams su zhing rigs sna tshogs kyi nags tshal bcas skusnad/ gangs ri grags che ba ni/la phyi'i tshe ring mched lnga dang /pho lha dgon chen/thi sha sbang ma/bya khyung / jo bo bha ma ri/ la phyi'i gangs kyi rwa ba bcas yin/ lha sha sbang ma'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las mi ṭar jiX4 yang na/phi ṭi 2ca307yin pa 'di ni 'dzam gling nang gangs ri mtho sgos bcu bzhi'i nang tshan zhig yin pa dang / gangs ri 'di'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ni rgyab mdun cha tshang bod kyi sa khongs su gtogs pa zhig red/'grul bzhud lam chen ri mgo grags che ba ni gnya' nang mthong la zhes pa rgyal sa lha sar 'gro lam mtho tshad ji ṭi 17༷cu yod pa de yin/tshong 'dus thu dang /bde chen steng rtsa/stag tshang rtsa/rdo dkar rtsa/dga' ldan gya/ skyid ra gya/ kha ru phya/ phyugs bzang phya/ ser phu/ zhing bzang phu/ bkra zhis 'dzoms phya/ mdzo rwa phu/ dar rgyas gling gya/ lding se phu/ bar chu phya/ thang smad rgyu/gtsang 'gram phya/las zhing phya/nags khra phu/sngo ra phu/'khor g.yag phya sogs 'brog sde chags sa'i ri lung khag la mtsho dang mtshe'u mang po yod/29

gnya' nang tsong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sa ming tho deb ces par gnya' nang rdzong gi sa khongs su yod pa'i mtsho che chung sna tshogs kyi gras su gong mtsho dang / da ra mtsho/dar rgyas gling phya mtsho/mtsho sman rgyal mo/sku gling mtsho/gangs spug mtsho/mtsho skam po/ mtsho nag /lung skyog mtsho/ dug mtsho/ 'o ma mtsho/ brag dmar mchod rten mtsho/kong mtsho/gangs gzhi mtsho/lung mo che mtsho/gnam bya mtsho/g.ya' ri mgor mtsho bcas kyi ming rnams 'khod 'dug pa ma zad/ la phyi'i bkra zhis tshe ring ma dang / mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma bcas pa'i bla mtsho kha dog ser bo dang / dmar bo/ mthing zhun/ mar gad kyi khya ba lta bu bcas ngo mtshar byin can rnams kyang gnya' nang dang rong shar gyi sa khongs su mjal rgyu yod/tshe ring mched lnga'i mtsho dang / da ra mtsho/ dar rgyas gling phu mtsho/ 'o ma mtsho bcas par 'o( ltar lha ldan rgyal khab nas mtsho rdzas sa bcud bum ba 'bul srol sku da/mtsho dang gangs ri khag nas chu bran lhung lhung 'bab pa'i g.yas g.yon du spang ljongs dang /su lu ba lu la sogs sdu zhim ldan pa'i zhing sna skyes pa'i thogaspang spos dang /ko byi la/dbang lag/dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu/bong dmar/dkar po chig thub/ yu mu thing / tang kun/ gangs lha me tog /skyer pa sogs nad 'joms pa'i sman rtswa sne grangs70lhag tsam skye/ri 'dabs su ri dwags gla

gnya' nang yul sbyi'i lo rgyus rags tsam gleng ba/ba dang / dgo ba/ gna' ba/ 'grong / dred yong / 'phyi ba/ sbyang ki/ khyi sbyang /gzig rwa pho/'phar ba/chu dred/gsa' mkhan sku gas sder chags ya mtshan can mang dag cig 'tsho gnas thub kyin yod/gong gsal lung tsho so so'i phu rnams kyi bkod pa sbyi dang / lhag par tshong 'dus kyi phu na yod pa'i sa cha brag po che dang / gzar lung / lu gu che mo/gtsug tshugs/ paṇa ḍi sogs kyi g.yas g.yon gangs ri dang / mtsho/ spang stongs/ rgyug chu bcas pa'i rang bzhin mdzes sdug ni brjod kyis mi langs pa zhig red/nub ngos su gser tsog ma dang / g.yu tsog ma/ dung tsog ma/ bka' blon sbal pa ra dza sogs mtho tshad 'i ṭi 21༷༷༷ brgal ba'i gangs ri rtse mo gnam gyi ka ba lta bu bcu phrag yod ba'i mu khyud sbyi dang / lhag par bya khyung gangs ri'i bzo dbyibs brjid nyams che ba'i thog mdun gyi da ra mtsho nas mtsho mjal ston pa sogs ngo mtshar che ba dang / g.yu yi gzhongs pa 'dra ba'i g.yas g.yon sbang ri dang / su lu la sogs pa'i me rtog ldan pa'i nags gseb nas rgyug chu lhung lhung du 'bab pa/ sa phyogs thams cad nas me tog dang sman bsangs kyi dri bsung 'gog med thul ba 'di 'dra'i rang bzhin mdzes sdug ni rgyal khab gzhan la dkon pa'i rang bzhin yin par bshad chog pa zhig red/ bgrod lam dang mgron khang sogs 'dzugs skrun yar rgyas 31

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/btang ste yul skor sgro 'chams byed yul du gyur pa yin na 'dzam gling mi snas lta sgor byed sa legs gas thig nges par du chags thub pa zhig red/snga dus tshong 'dus phu yi sa cha yongs rdzogs la dbyar kha'i ring rta drel dang 'bri g.yag gis khengs nas sdod/ rta drel la bed spyod med pa'i skabs lung pa'i phu der bzhag ste rtswa chu rang 'dod ltar za btung byas nas sdod par mtshams rer bdag po sku( skusnas gzan chag dang /mar khu sprod par 'gro skabs rang gi rta drel ma rnyed bar du lam khar mi gzhan gyi rta drel gang 'dra zhig thug kyang de dag bzhon nas 'a〈sna srol sku da/brag po che'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho nas mi ṭar 417 yang na mi ṭi 137ཿyin pa dang /da ra masnu'i mtha' 'a〈snar rgya khyedan la mi ṭar 433༷tham pa'am phi ṭi 142ཿdang /gting tshad la phi ṭi 13༷yod par bshad/gnya' nang khyon yongs nang gtsang po che ba ni snung 'dus phya chu dang / gnya' nang stod nas 'bab pa'i gtsang chu gnyis tshong 'dus grong tsho'i gsham du 'dzoms nas zhe 〈snags su rgyug par yul mis gtsang po zhes 'bod pa las dmigs bsal ming smos byed kyin med rung / yig cha re zung nang gtsang po de la bod chu dang /skabs re zung nang bum chu zhes 'khod 'dug/gtsang chu'i rtsa ba ni thi sha snang ma dang bya khyung gnyis kyis gtsos dar rgyas gling phya chu dang / lung mo che'i mtsho 'gram nas 'bab pa'i lding se rgyags chu sku gas nye 'khomar gangs 32

gnya' nang yul sbyi'i lo rgyus rags tsam gleng ba/ri khag la thug yod/ rgyugs tshad ring zung chu mgo zhi sha sbang ma nas bal yul brgal te rgya gar gyi bang snyal mtsho lag bar khyon ki lo mi ṭar 12༷7yod par bshad/chu 'di la bal po rnams kyis bal bod sa mtshams nas bha ra lha si grong khyer bar bod chu don bsgyur gyis 2sgo sheko si zhes dang /mu mthud sgo phyogs su rgyug pa'i ming la sun ko zhi zer ba de yi don ni gser gyi gtsang po zhes par go ba dang / rim bzhin chu chen gzhan dang 'dres nas rgya gar gyi sa char rgyug pa'i ming la 2a run zhes 'bod do//g.yu gcasnangs la//brag ri zil pa khrom khrom/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs sa//dkar yol ngang skya rog rog /gzhon gzhon khrung ma bkyag sa//g.yu gzhongs la//ri de g.yang rtswa'i ri la/ /sa la sman rtswa skyes song //sems can spu gra legs pa/ /g.yang rtswa'i ri la 'khor song //g.yu gzhongs la//sbas lung padma tshal la/ /padma'i pad sdong 'khyungs yod//pad sdong zhal kha phyes nas/ /'dzam gling 'od kyis khengs song //

le tshan gnyis pa/gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas li khag gi skor/spyir gnya' nang stod smad yongs rdzogs o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis zhabs bcag byin rlabs mdzad pa'i gnas zhig yin pa dang / bye brag 'phel rgyas gling dgon pa'i grod pa phyag dang / bkra this sgang / la phyi bcas ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rje btsun mi la ras pas sgrub pa nyams len dang chos 'khor rgya chen sgor ba'i gnas chen yongs grags yin pa smos med thog /gang gi nyi ma lta bu'i slob ma mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang / zla ba lta bu'i gung thang gi ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rgyu skar lta bu'i lcim lung gi ngan rdzong ston pa byang chub rgyal bo/rgyal khrom smad kyi ras pa zhi ba 'od/mdo bkra'i se ban ras pa/ gnye shang gi khyi ra ras pa/ mus kyi 'bri sgom ras pa/ rag ma'i ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs te zugs kyi sras brgyad/ gshen sgom ras pa/ glan sgom ras pa/mes sgom ras pa/rtsa phu ras pa/mkhar chung ras pa/rong chung ras pa/stag sgom ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug /jo sgom ras pa dar ma dbang byug /dam pa rgyag rtsa pa/li sgor ras pa/lo ston dge 'dun/skyo ston shākya gu na/'brel ston bkra zhis 'bar te nye ba'i sras bcu gsum/ mtsho lnga'i ras chung ma/ gnya' 34

nang gi sa le 'od/ gcung gi dpal dar 'bum/ lcam sa pe ta mgon skyid sogs sa lam gyi rtogs pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pho yo nyer lnga/ rdzi bo ras pa la sogs te skar phran lta bu'i gnas lugs rang zhal mthong ba'i rtogs ldan phyir mi ldog pa brgya/ rang byung gi sgom nyams bzang po 'khrungs pa gong 'phel du gyur cing lam drod thob pa'i skyes chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'jig rten 'di'i bya ba btang ba'i chos dang mthun nges kyi sgom chen pho yo lam sna zin pa stong rtsa gcig /chos 'brel thob pas ngan song gi lam rgyun chad pa'i gdul bya skal ldan skye wa phal pa rtsis las 'das pas grub pa nyams bzhes dkar phyogs dge ba'i las la brtson pa'i gnas chen yongs grags yin/gong bzhin sngo ra dang / bde chen steng / dga' ldan gling / tshong 'dus/ phyag khrod/ser phyag bal po ngong /mthong la/du lung /la zhing /rdzo ra bcas pa'ang bod 'bangs yongs la bka' drin gyi bdag nyid chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha dang /lha btsun byang chub 'od/paṇḍi ta gzhan la phan pa bzang po/ paṇḍi ta bīrya tsand+ra/ lo tsā ba chen po gung thang ba sogs jo bo rje thog mar bod la phebs dus kyi sku 'khor zhal slob sum cu rtsa lnga/rgya gar gyi pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ma gcig lab 〈snan/bal yul gyi bla ma zhi la bha dzo/ rgya gar gyi grub thob dharma bo dhi/ grub thob gtsang spyon he ru ka /rje btsun gzi brjid rgyal mtshan/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'brug bu ba 35

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bde chen dpal 'bar/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dwa lo rdo rje grags/ dge bsnyen dar ma 'od/ 'bring ston shākya ye/ khyung po 'od/ grub pa'i dbang phrug lcags zam pa thang rnye1nga rgyal 〈sna/ zha ma lcam dral/ rgyal ba rbestod tshang ba mabe|na bo ldo rje/ grub thob lha rgyan pa rin chen dpal/ rgod tshang pa chen po'i bu slob mkhan 11 bo char ba/bla ma bde legs rgyal mtshan/bla ma ba ri ba/bla ma choso sdings pa/ bla ma byang chub gling pa la skusnags sgom chen lnga brgya dang / mkhan bo bsam gtan la sogs pa'i dge bshes stong tshar/ gzhan yang tsā ri dang / ti se la sku gas gnas chen khag nas rbesnad tshang pa chen po'i cho sa zhur bcar ba ston sgom brgyad cu gya bzhi/grub pa'i dbang phyug stag rtse sku skye/bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rje rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje dang rje bsod nams lhun grub/rig 'dzin o rgyan 'gro 'dul sogs rtsangs ldo dmar pa'i gdung brgyud rim byon/rig 'dzin nyi zla klong gsal lam 'ja' lus snang stong rang grol/rigs mchog ldo rje bzhad pa/ kun mkhyen chos kyi dbang phyug/gar dbang 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ kuḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ rgyal sras padma 'jigs bral/chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa/ 'bri gung che tshang rje btsun bstan 'dzin chos kyi blo 〈snas/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa 7sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho/ dam pa chos dbyengs rdo rje/ zhwa dmar pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug/rgyal ba dben sa pa blo bzang don grub/yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal 36

mtshan/ bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pa/ mkhan chen dbang phyug shes rab/zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol sogs sngon byon skyes chen dam pa mang pos chos skor dang sgrub pa nyams len lhur bzhes gnang pa'i gnas chen yin pa ma zad/ nye ba'i char yang ris med skyes chen 'brug pa rin po che shes rab rdo rje dang / dpal lding dang 'phel rgyas gling dgon pa'i mkhan po rim byon/ rje 'khrul zhig sku gong ma dang rdza sprul ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nor bu/ skyabs rje gling dkar rin po che/ rtsib ri chu bzang rin po che/ khrid dpon rin po che/ nab bkra rin bo che/brag sbrul rin po che/'bri gung skyabs mgon che tshang rin bo che/seng grags rin po che/ skyabs rje 'khrul zhig zhwa sprul ngag dbang chos kyi blo gros sogs nas sgrub pa nyams bzhes dkar phyogs dge ba'i las la brtson pa'i yul ljongs zhig yin/ gnas bshad yongs rdzogs 'bri 'god bya rgyur yig tshogs che bar brten bkod ma dgos pa bgyis zhing / gal gnad che ba rnams ga ma gsal ltar bskasnad sku1da/1)la phyi ni/slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi zhabs kyis bcags zhing sha za'i mkha' 'a〈sna rnams dam la btags pa ma zad/ padma bka' thang gi le'u besna lnga pa'i nang / ma 'ongs sgrub gnas su lung bstan mdzad pa bzhin/ gasteng 'di na 37

'gran zla dang bral ba'i gnas chen gsum gyi nang nas yi dam bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsung gi gnas ngo mtshar 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i zhing khams/sngon byon mkhas grub du mas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs zhing /rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bsgor ba'i lte gnas su yongs grags bzhin/ skyabs mgon zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol gyis gnas kyi bstod pa phul ba'i nang /sgrub brgyud gong ma bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i sa/la phyi gangs kyi ra ba zhes/yongs su grags pa ngo mtshar che/ri rnams rtse mo gangs kyis mdzes/ na bun dngul mdog sked la 'khril/ gangs dang brag ri khong gseng na/ /chu rgyun lhung sgra sgrog bzhin 'bab/ ri bo she'u gsing spang gnong dran/ lus mdzes ri dwags bag phebs rtse/ dri zhim mdog mdzes me tog rtser/ byang ba 'dus nas glu dbyangs len/ lo 'dab mdzes pa'i ljon zhing khar/ 'dab chags bya yis skad snyan 'byin/ rang byung brag phug nyams dga' na/ lha dang ṭī ki sprin ltar 'du/ chos skyong srung mas bu bzhin skyong / ri brag rnams kyang lha sku 'dra/ /rang byon zhabs rjes mang bo snang / g.yas dang g.yon na nyi zla bzhin/ 'gro phan 'phel rgyas gling gis mdzes/ phu na la phyi'i 'grog pa dang /mda' na rong pa'i yon bdag mang / rtsi thog thing 'bras sngo tshod dang /chu shing la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzoms/'dre gdon dgra jag chom rkun sogs//mi 'dod nyer 'che'i ming yang med//mdor na nyams dga' rig pa dwangs/mkha' 38

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khagagi sgor/spyod dga' ba'i zhing dang mtshungs/ /chos mdzad yod na gnas 'di bsten/bsten dang dam pa'i lha chos 'ong / dad can yon bdag gnas 'di skor/ sgor dang las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag /'byor ldan yon bdag gnas 'di mchod//mchod dang mchog thun dngos grub 'thob/ /de skad brjod pas thos tshad kun//gnas 'dir brten nas 'tshang rgya thog/ces gsungs/la phyi'i gnas bshad rgyas pa ni 'bri gung ba chen po rje btsun bstan 'dzin chos kyi blo 〈snas kyis brtsams pa/ gsang lam sgrub pa'i gnas chen nyer bzhi'i ya gyal sgo da wa ri 'am/ 'grog la phyi gangs kyi rwa ba'i sngon byung gi tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi rab tu byed pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes pa'i nang /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje dang / ras chung rdo rje grags/rgyal ba ska( brag pa/la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mchan/gtsang ྅rten he ru ka la 31gas pa'i bzhugs gnas bdud 'dul phug mosna che/ ze phug sbas pa kun gsal/ lung bstan tshal chen phyag /sbas phyag skusnags pa du ma bzhugs pa'i gnas kyi balha da pa chigs su bcad pa nas mabobyu brtsams te la phyi sogs kyi phyag chen bzhi dang /rje btsun chen po'i sgrub chu/la phyi'i chos dwa dang /ras chen lha khang / bdud 'dul lha khang bcas pa'i rten gatsho'i mtshan tho sbyi dang / lhag par gnya' nang pa'i rten skal rje btsun gyi sku pur bdud 'dul phyag 39

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/gi sgor pha bong khyung gi sgo nga lta bu'i steng du zhus pa'i pur rdo la rang byung du phebs pa'i yi ge drug pa sogs nang rten rtsa che'i sgor dang / gnas kyi ngo mtshar bkod pa bye brag tu gsungs pa'i nang / sbyir lha dwa wa ri'i gnas khongs su 'du ba ni/ byang dpal mo dpal thang nas sgo bal po'i sa mtshams tshun/ nub tsum kun thang nas shar ding ri tshun gyi sa yul rnams yin la/ de rnams kyi lte ba ni la phyi nyid dang / de'i gnas kyi mthil du gyur pa ni chos 'byung thang rgyab ri dang bcas pa 'di kho na yin par dbang phyug mi la'i rnam thar gyis shes zhus bas de las gzhan du mi bzung ngo / /de ltar la phyi gnas mthil ni steng nam mkha' gru gsum/ 'og sa gru gsum/ bar chu gru gsum bcas te chos 'byung sum brtsegs kyi rnam pa la/ bdud 'dul phug mosna che dang / 'dab 'byar gyi rgyab ri 'di nyid phyi bem bo brag ri'i rnam pa mtho brjid nam mkhar bsnyegs pa la/ nang ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhas yas khang gi dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sbrul pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin du gnas 'di'i shar ri dkar bo 'bum ye la 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs/ sgo ri nag po 'bum ye la gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs/nub ri ser po 'bum ye la mkhyen rab 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lha tshogs rnams bzhugs par gsungs/ de la brten nas sgra bsgyur mar pas mi la la 40

bu khyod sgrub pa byed pa la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rna ba g.yon pa 'grog la phyi gangs kyi rwa ba zhes rigs gsum mgon po'i pho brang der song la sgrub pa gyis gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes sogs zhib phra mkhyen 'dod yod pa rnams kyis bo nga gsal la phyi'i gnas yig la gzigs par 'tshal/2)bkra zhis sgang /bkra zhis sgang du gshen rdor sa dang skyo ston shākya gu ṇa'i pha khang / rje btsun chen po'i gdung thal dang bur khang gi sa ldo la skyo ston shākya gu ṇa sogs rtsar ma ba rnams kyi dad rten du bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten thog tshad gnyis pa byin can dang / mgon khang bcas mjal rgyu 〈snad/ bkra zhis sgang nas ches mi 'gyangs pa'i sar ze le ma'i gangs ri'i nye 'dabs su yon bdag rtsar ma bas rje btsun phebs bsur bcar skabs zugs zhin tu mnyes nas gro khrab ste/pha bong la rje btsun gyi zhabs rjes gsal ba'i pha bong dkar leb ces pa ngo mtshar can zhig kyang mjal rgyu yod/3)'phel rgyas gling dbe|na pa/'phel rgyas gling ni bal 〈snad sa mtshams kyi dbesnan sde rtsa 'gang che ba zhig yin zhing / dgon pa de'i mtshan snyan yongs su grags pa gnya' nang grod pa phung

phug tu rje btsun chen po rang nyid kyis byin rlabs mdzad pa'i sku brnyan ha cang gi byin rlabs can dang /zhabs rjes/rje btsun ras chung pa'i sgrub phug sogs yod pa der sngon rje btsun dbang phyug mi la yab sras bzhugs pa'i rjes su sgrub ba po dang grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu ji snyed cig bzhugs kyang dge 'dun gyi sde ni ma byung /phyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang du skyid grong brag dkar rta so'i gdan sa rngog ston /ma blo bzang gis dgon pa btab cing mchod khang 'ga' zhig bzhengs nas mkha' 'a〈sna snyan brgyud kyi chos rgyun btsugs/ de nas lo mang song rjes grod rgyug ri bo dge ldan par bsgyur te mtshan dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling zhes btags/ dge 'dun gyi sde chen po btsugs nas skye 'gro'i mchod zhing dam par gyur/ phyi lo 1714 zhing rta lor 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku breng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mthertos zhabs bcags mdzad de/ wa da yul gyi sa cha du mar yal ba med pa'i zhabs rjes bzhag pa'i khongs su gnya' nang yul mi'i dad rten du'ang zhabs rjes zhig 'jog gnang mdzod pa'i nang rten ngo mtshar khyad par can zhig dus da lta'ang byes 'a〈snar gnya' nang 'phel rgyas gling dbesnan par mjal rgyu 'phad/dgon pa'i dbang chog dang 'cham gyi skor gsham du srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu stangs kyi le tshan nang 'khod yod/ blo da thug nas rgyang grags tsam gzhal ba'i shar 〈snags su a mosna gro ga bya 42

ba ras chung dbus bzhud kyi skabs rje btsun chen pos ras chung par tshod bgam phyir ras pa bdun du sprul pa'i sar zhabs rjes gcig kyang yod/ grod phyag ni rje btsun chen po'i sgrub gnas phug chen bzhi'i nang tshan zhig yin par grags che ba de yang rje btsun chen po'i rnam thar nang skyes bu ras chung pas/ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams tshogs gsog pa'i mig rkyen du sgrub gnas phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzong rnams dang / phug chen rnams kyi ngos 'dzin ming re gsungs par zhu zhus bas rje btsun chen pos/yongs su grags pa'i phyag chen bzhi ni/ gnya' nang gi grod pa thug dang / la phyi'i bdud 'dul phyag /brin gyi 'bri lce phyag/ti se'i dzu 'phrul phyag bcas yin/de rnams su bsgoms pa byung na dben la mthun rkyen 'dzom pa yang yod cing / brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'jug pa yin pas 1snams lhag gsungs sdusgo//'phel rgyas gling dgon par dus 'gyur ma byung tsam du dge 'dun zhal grangs7༷tsam yod cing /de skabs dge slong rtsa ma ba dang /dge slong bkra zhis sgang pa/dge slong mdo sgar ba/dge slong dngos grub chos bzang /dge slong spel ba/ dge slong ngag dbang grags pa/dge slong blo bzang bkra zhis/ dge slong rdo rje/dge slong bkra zhis/ dge slong byams pa bstan 'dzin/ dge slong byams pa dar rgyas/ dge slong dpal bzang / dge slong blo bzang dkon mchog zhu ba sogs gnya' nang yul mis mthong dang gus brtsi zhus pa'i dge 'dun mang bo byung yod/43

4)la zhing sgrol ma gsung byon/la zhing du sngon rje mi la ras pa la dad pa can gyi bon po gcig thi khar rang gi zas ce ra skal thob rje btsun yab sras la 'bul dbo sa kha chems bzhag pa ltar rje btsun dbon slob gdan 'dren zhus/bon bo de sngon gyi las kyis 'bu phra la ring ba zhig tu skyes pa bon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthong sar rje btsun gyis thar par 'dren pa'i shul la bla ma zhang dang mkhan chen dbang phyug shes rab sogs mkhas grub mang bos bsti gnas mdzad nas dgon pa phyag btab ste 'gro don rgya cher 'phel/ rten gyi gtso bor la zhing sgrol ma gsung byon zhes byin rlabs ngo mtshar can zhig dang /jo bo/thub pa tshul khrims ma/tshe lha rnam gsum/rigs gsum mgon po/mi khrug pa/rdo rje sems pa/rdo rje 'chang /zhang brtson 'grus grags pa gtso byas pa'i bla skya khag gcig /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang /dpal ldan lha 31 drel bcasnan ma 31gas kyis 1snag gnya' nang pa'i rten skal rje btsun gyi bur rdo la rang byung du phebs pa'i yi ge drug pa gsal ba'i nang rten byin can bcas mjal rgyu yod/ gsung rten gyi khongs su bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur dang / gsung 'bum sna tshogs bsdoms bris pod 7༷༷ tsam sku da pa'i khongs su gser bris glegs zhing rnams la sangs rgyas stong sku sogs rkos ris sgyu rtsal phul du byung ba mang po yod par grags/'byung ba'i gnod skyon gyis phyi'i rtsig ba zhig kyang nang du dpe cha brtsigs pa'i 44

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khagagaskor/rtsig pa zhig rgyu med par bshad/ dgon pa de'i g.yas ri dung mdog bo tā la dang / g.yon ri g.yu mdog g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing / 'bu grog ma tsam yang mi rnyed pa'i gnas ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa de yi rgyu na/ sring yo be ta'i sgrub phyag dang la zhing gi srung ma phya btsan bcas yod/sgrol ma gsung byon ni thog mar gser phu bal po rdzong zer ba'i sa char sbrul pa'i bal po bdun gyis bzhengs nas rdzong gi nye 'khris 'od zam du gdan 'dren zhus te/ rab gnas zhus pa'i skabs bal po bdun bo gcig gcig la thim nas/ mtha' ma de yang 1snal ma'i sku la thim pa'i skabs 〈snal ma sku bzhengs nas/ nga'i 'gro don la zhing du yod bas gnas der 'gro/ sa der chu dkon po yod gsungs te 'od zam nas chu thang khug gang bsnams/yar leb ar thang du phebs dus thang khyag kha sgor nas chu phyed ka sa cha der bo ba'i byin can chu rgyun da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ de nas la zhing du phebs te chu'i lhag ma bsgos pa las la zhing rtsa chu byung bar grags/bod la dus 'gyur byung rjes sgrol ma gsung byon ma dang / gnya' nang pa'i rten skal rje btsun gyi pur rdo la rang byung du phebs pa'i yi ge drug pa gsal ba'i nang rten byin can bcas bal yul nang gdan 'dren zhus te da lta gnya' nang 'phel rgyas gling dgon par bzhugs yod/45

7)mthong la ni/rje btsun mi la ras pa gnya' nang grod pa phyag na bzhugs pa'i dus nam zhig tho rangs kyi tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can de mngon sum du byon nas/ mi la ras pa mthong lar rgya gar gyi dam pa sangs rgyas 'byon zhing 'dug pas mjal du mi 'gro'am gsungs pa ltar/ rlung thun gcig bzung ste gnya' nang mthong lar byon pas/ la de'i nang na mar tshong pa 'ga' dang phrad pas/ rgya gar gyi dam pa sangs rgyas 'byon zhing 'dug gam gsungs pas/dam pa sangs rgyas ni ngo mi shes/ a rtsa ra gon po gcig sngo phyog ge mdang mgron khang na nyal 'dug zer/ 'di rnams kyis ngo ma shes par 'dug dgongs/ la khar phebs nas gzigs pas/ dam pa yang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyis rje btsun dang mjal bar bskul te/ mgron khang du gzims nas 'byon zhing 'dug pa gzigs te/ 'di la zag med kyi mngon shes yod zer ba brtag dgos snyam nas sku lus spe tog gi phung por sbrul nas bzhugs pas/dam pas sbyan mi gzigs par thal le gshegs sku nga bas/macani shes thogs med yod pa mi bden pa 'dra dgongs ba'i tshe/ dam pa zhal 'khor log ste/ me tog gi phung bo la zhabs tho brgyab ste/ kho re mi la ras pa lus me tog tu sprul nas bsdad pas mi chog par 'dug yar longs dang /khyod la do nub kyi tshe las med do/ /'chi grod kyi gdeng ci yod dam gsungs 46

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khagagaskor/pa'i tshe/ rje btsun har gyis bzhengs te/ 'chi grod gdeng tshad drug gi mgur gsungs pas dam pa zhin tu mnyes/ de nas dam pa sangs rgyas dang rje btsun mi la ras pa rnam gnyis kyis 'jag ma bdun re'i steng du sku bdun re bkod nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan du mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyi 'jag ma rnams cung zad mgo gug 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyis dam pa la/ 'o cag gnyis rlung bum ba can la ni khyad med/ bdag gi 'jag ma mgo gug ba ci lags gsungs bas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/〉( cag spangs 3snags kyi sku'on tan la khyad mi 'dug ste/ khyod bod du skyes pa'i khyad du 'dug /'o skol gnyis lta spyod gcig par 'dug pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i slob rgyud rnams kyang lta spyod gcig par yong bar 'dug gsungs pa sogs gtam ngo mtshar dang ldan pa mang po zhib phra mkhyen par 'dod na rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur la gzigs par zhu/ca)phyag khrod/stong 'dus grong khyer gyi nye 'khris gser gter ma zer ba'i ri 'dabs su chags pa'i dgon gnas phyag khrod ni/ mgon po phyag drug gi gnas byin can du grags/ ri khrod dang lha khang gi nye 'khris su zhing stag pa mang bo skyes nas yod pa de dag gcod bregs byas na srung mas bka' chad gtong bar bshad/47

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/la phyi'i gnas yig nang gsal phug khrod du sngon rje btsun mi la thog gcig tsam bzhugs/de nas btsun gzi brjid rgyal mtshan gyis dbe na pa phyag btab nas cher dar zhing /rjes su la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/'brug rgyu ba bde chen dpal 'bar/ rdor 'dzin rnam rgyal byang chub sogs lung rtogs kyi skusnan tan mnga' ba du ma'i bzhugs gnas zhin tu ngo mtshar chen po yin par grags/gnas 'di'i lha khang dang mgon khang sogs 'bri gung pas 'dzin pa'i dben gnas yin zhes 'khod 'dug /phyi lo 107'alor las 'gan thog sku da pa'i rgyug khrod kyi gnas 'dzin dpal 'byor zer ba la phyi nas bsgo gtong byas pa yin nges ma zad/ de'i gong du gnas 'dzin la phyi ba a khya nor bu zer ba zhig kyang byung 'dug pa bcas gang ltar la phyi'i chos dwa dang / phyag khrod gnyis ka 'bri gung pa'i khongs gtogs yin par 'dug7)bal po thong ni/dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling dgon pa'i kha sprod kyi ri rgyab tu yod/rje btsun mi la ras pa dang ras chung pa la sogs pa'i bu slob rnams dang bcas te gnya' nang grod pa bug na snying po don gyi chos 'khor bsgor zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ la stod na gu ru tshems chen/ding ri na dam pa sangs rgyas/bal po na ṭi la bha dzo/rgya gar na snyam gro dhi/ gnya' nang na mi la ras pa ste/ grub thob lnga dus 48

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi sgor/mtshungs pa las/grub thob zhi la bha ros/rgya gar nas bla ma dharma sgo dhi bal po thong du sbyan drangs nas chos 'khor bsgor zhing bzhugs pa'i sar rje btsun bu slob rnams kyang byon nas/ dharma sgo dhi dang rje btsun mi la ras pa gnyis khri gcig tu bzhugs te phan tshun mnyes pa'i gsung gleng gnang zhing / thi la lha dzo dang / ras chung rdo rje grags pa gtso byas pa'i gnya' nang gi nya ma rnams dang /skal ldan bal bod slothob ma mang por chos 'khor yang rgya che mdzod 'dug pa zhib cha rje btsun mi la ras pa dang ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i rnam thar la gzigs na mkhyen/ gong bzhin jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khor rnams thog mar bal po rdzong la chags phebs skabs lha btsun byang chub 'od rgyal blodzen rta pa gsum brgya tsam gyi bsu ba dang / bal po'i rgyal po'i skyel thung rta pa brgya/ paṇḍi ta gzhan la phan pa bzang po dang / paṇḍi ta bīrya tsand+ra/ lo tsā ba chen po gung thang ba sogs pa rab tu byung ba'i rta pa sum cu rtsa lnga bcas kyis bskor ba'i dbus na chibs rta cang shes mthong smon ngang pa gser ldan dang mtshungs pa de'i steng nas bla na med pa'i zhal 'dzum dang bcas sasgri ta'i gsung 'khrol ba sogs ngo mtshar mad byung gi lo rgyus zhib khra gsal ba 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i jo bo rje'i rnam thar lam yig chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bar gzigs na mkhyen cing / de dus bal po rdzong ni bal bod sa 49

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/mtshams yin par ngos 'dzin gnang 'dug pa de yang gong gsal rnam thar nang /bal po ljong phan chad sbyan ras gzigs kyi dngos kyi zhing ma yin pas zhi na gzhan gyi nor 'brel ba la snying rje med pa'i stobs kyis hab sha che ba dang /bal po rdzong tshun chad thugs rje chen po'i zhing yin pas (phyi mi 'grul pa zhig) rang gi khang bar thi yang snying rjes theg pa che bar byas te/gzhan gyi nor mi 'brel ba'i bsam pa bzang 〈sna byed pa sku(gas kyang 'kho da 'dugabal po rdzong ni sngar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs bod rje rim pas bzhugs sgar mdzad pa'i sa gnas gal chen yin par sems/ de yang mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis bsdu rug gnang ba tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi rgyal rabs yig cha'i nang /stag gi 'epha ste/phyi 'o( cu'aXl dbyar dus btsan po bal bo ru bzhugs zhing /dgun dus bsam yas kyi nye 'khor can sa khul 'a ga tshal du bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin lug lo ste/ lo lnga'i rjes su'ang dbyar bal po na bzhugs zhing /dgun brag dmar du gshegs/slar yang bya lo ste/lo gnyis kyi rjes su bal po na bzhugs zhing /dgun pho brang brag dmar gyi tshal ka na bzhugs/ yang bskyar lug lo ste/ lo bcu'i rjes su'ang dbyar kha bal po na bzhugs/ da dung mu mthud bya lo dang / phag lo/ byi lo/ yang bskyar lug 'o1/khyi 'o(/phag 'o( bcas par dbyar kha bal 〈snar bzhugs zhes gsal ba ma zad/ li yul nas thon pa'i rgyal rabs nang / khri lde gtsug btsan gyi khri lo 50

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi skor/'dren pa'i skabs su yang / rta'i lo la btsan po bal po na bzhugs sogs lan du mar gsal por 'khod pa de dbang du gzhig na sa gnas 'dir sngar bod kyi chos rgyal rim byon phyogs phebs kyi bzhugs sgar gnang ste/ ming la'ang bal po rdzong zhes thogs pa min nam snyam pa des na/ bod rje rim pas lo mang dbyar kha bal por bzhugs zhes pa'i sa cha ni/ gong gsal bal po rdzong zhes par go dgos pa las/ de min dbyar dus bal yul tsha ba'i yul du bzhugs nas dgun dus bsam yas kyi nye 'khor 'a kha tshal dang /brag dmar skusnags dbus su phebs don gnam gshis tsha grang gi cha nas rgyu mtshan ma mthong ba ma zad/ sa cha'i ming la'ang bal po rdzong zhes thogs par rgyu mtshan yod nges snyam/gnya' nang gi bal po rdzong zer ba ni dbyar dus bsil ba'i rang bzhin sa cha mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig yin pa dang /dgun dus gangs babs grang ngar che bas mi dang sgo phyugs sdod srol med/rje mi la'i rnam mgur nang /bal po thong gi nags gseb tu//dharma sgo dhi phyag phebs pas//mi la ras pa mjal du phyin/khong dharma sgo dhi sku bzhengs nas/ mi la nga la phyag byas pas/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin de skabs sa cha der thing nags kyang byung 'dug/ngos rang gi bsam par bal po rdzong ni/ bod rje srong btsan sgam po sogs chos rgyal rim pas dbyar dus bzhugs sgar gnang ste bal po'i yul phyogs la'ang dbang bsgyur mdzad 51

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams ba/pa'i thong gi gnas chen yin par 'dod kyang / dngos bden ji yin da dung zhib 'jug gnang dbo sa/ gnas der dus 'gyur ma byung tsam du bur sras pa khyim tshang gis dad sbyin zhus te/ stag lung mtshams pa rin po che zhu ba yun ring sku mtshams su bzhugs 'dug/)na ka dzo ṭi'i pho brang /bal po thong dang lhan tu nye ba ser phu zer ba'i sa char mtsho gnyis yod pa nas/gcig ni ma mo e ka dzo ṭi'i pho brang dngos yin par gsungs/ de yang bsangs dpe rnam dag chos sku ma'i brgyags brngan chen mo'i nang / yul ni bal yul ser phya naca e ka dza ṭi ral gcig ma: chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon po chibs: bsgos su snying dang gtor mas brngan: zhes gsungs/ brgyags brngan chen mo slob dbon padmas mdzad cing / brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i sked pa nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas gdan drangs par grags/ mtsho gnyis nas gong ma de ha cang tshub po yin pa dang / 'og ma des ma〉rto mjal yang 〈snan pa mang 〈snas mjal cadang sku(da par bshad/0)sngo ra snang yul zhes pa ni/mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i 'khrungs yul dang / rnam grol 52

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi sgor/tsangs rdo dmar ba'i gdung rabs snga phyi mang pos sgrub pa nyams len lhur bzhes gnang ba'i gnas chen zhig yin/ brag sne kun bzang chos 'phel gyis sbyar ba rnam grol rtsangs ldo dmar ba'i gdung rabs lo rgyus deb zer padma rā ga'i do zhal zhes pa'i nang /gnya' nang gi snang yul sngo ra dgon pa ni/phya na lha lha dbosnan chen zhes pa'i gangs ri chen 〈sna yul lha gnas pa zhig gis gnya' nang tshong 'dus kyi gya chu'i shar brgyud nas mnga' ris thong dga' mang yul kha la bar mi 'grul thub sa med pas bskor nas yod pa dang / pho lha dgon chen gyi nye 'dabs g.yas g.yon du rdza dang brag ri'i khrod du mkhas zhing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dwa lo tsā ba chen po'i sgrub gnas dwa lo phug dang / rnal 'byor ba chen po rdo dmar pa rje btsun dbang gi rgyal po dang / rje mkhas grub chen po rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sgrub gnas zlogs chen ri khrod kyi sgrub khang / de nas rgyang grags 'ga' zhig na rje bsdu da nams lhun grub kyi sgrub gnas bya phyag dmar bo zhes sgrub gnas byin can khag skusnad/dwa lo phug tu dwa lo tsā ba chen pos yi dam 'jigs byed sgrub pa'i skabs zhig na nyams rtogs cher ma byung bas thugs skyo nas snga dro bzhes thug sla po zhig mchod kyin bzhugs pas bzhes thug gi nang du 'jigs byed dngos su zhal gzigs byung skabs nyob ste dbu gyen du 'grengs pas brag las yi dam 'jigs byed kyi dbya dang /rwa ca'i rjes gsal ba mjal rgyu yod/53

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/sgrogs chen ri khrod nas rgyang grags kha shas chod pa'i gnas su rje bsod nams lhun grub kyi sgrub gnas bya phyag dmar po zhes pa de yod/der rje bsod nams lhun grub lhosgom sgrub la bzhugs pa'i skabs zhig bla ma sku bzhengs gnang bas dbu brag la khel nas gzigs pas brag them zan kham bcad pa ltar du bzhes te sbar brdzis gnang ba'i phyag rjes byung yod pa rdo dmar pa'i nang rten du yod pa dang /brag phyag gi phyag rjes kun gyis mjal rgyu yod/sgrub gnas der rdo dmar skyabs mchog skal bzang rgyal mtshan mchog kyang lha ma sgrub tu bzhugs gnang mdzad de nyams rtogs rgyas zhing bsam gtan 'phel ba'i gnas yin zhes gsungs nas bstod par mdzad cing / gnas de'i nye 'dabs byang shar phyogs su stag la dpon mo'i mkhar sngo ra bla brang gi bla ma snga thog pa khag gi bzhugs gnas gzim shag dang /mtha' skor du sa zhing phran bu skusnad pa zhig 'dug pa 'debs las dang /brnga bsdu bcas kyi skabs las rgyun du sdod mkhan med/phyis su bla brang dang /dgon gnas bcas tha chung zhes pa'i sa gnas kyi 'khris su gnas sgo gsar rgyag gnang yod/dgon gnas kyi rten gtso slob dpon chen po'i snang brnyan chen po gcig dang gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten che chung sna tshogs dang / mchod rdzas/ zhal thang dang zhal 'bag sogs spus dag rnying ma byin can gang legs bzhugs yod/yang sngo ra dgon gyi yan lag gyid chu dgon pa zhes gnya' nang yar leb 54

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi sgor/pa'i grong gi nub tu lung chung kha shar du ltas pa zhig na dgon pa chung chung zhig yod pa de'i gnas 'dzin sngo ra'i dgon pa nas res bsgor gnang ste bzhugs dgos yod pa dang / dkor khungs gnya' nang stod kyi yul grong rnams yin/dgon gnas der sman 'dam las bzhengs pa'i gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i snang brnyan zhig yod tshul bcas 'khod 'dug /rdo dmar pa'i gdung rabs dang sngo ra bla brang sogs kyi sgor lo rgyus rgyas pa mkhyen 'dod yod rigs nas rnam grol tsangs rdo dmar ba'i gdung rabs lo rgyus deb ther padma rā ga'i do zhal la gzigs par 'tshal/lo rgyus gzhan ni/ rwa ye shes seng ges mdzad pa mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun dwa lo tsā ba'i rnam par thar pa kun khyab snyan pa'i rnga sgra zhes pa'i nang /bka' gter mang po nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul par lung gis zin pa'i bla ma dwa chen 'di'i 'khrungs yul ni/ gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa zhes/ sman sna tshogs skye ba'i yul/yul la g.yang chags la stod lho'i cha/ste nam (gnya' nang ) glang yul zhes bya ba'i phu na 'grog dang / mda' na zhing 'dzom pa sa gtsang ba/lung gzhung na mar gangs chu 'bab pa/dge ba bcu tshang ba'i yul de yin la/ yab ni mi rabs bdun la sngags pa'i brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ dwa ston dkon mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba gsang sngags rnying ma la mkhas pa gcig dang / yum ni rdo rje dpal 'dzom zhes dung can ma'i rtags tshang ba gnyis la 55

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/sras lnga 'khrungs pa'i bar pa yin no zhes bkod 'dugadwa lo chen po sgo bal phyogs su lan gnyis byon nas phyir phebs rjes dbus gtsang khams gsum nas slob ma mang du 'dus/ gnya' nang du glang yul bdud 'dul lha khang gi gtsug lag khang phyag btab/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub mkhan stong brag brgal ba byung / zab lam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gdams pa la brten nas grub pa 〈snab pa'ang mtha' yas 〈snan pa sdudags be|nga gsal rnam thar la gzigs na mkhyen cas//10)bde chen steng /tshong 'dus grong khyer nas sgo phyogs su gom bgrod nyin zhag gcig gi sar rgyal ba rgothod tshang pa dang / grub thob tse( rgyan pa rin chen dpal skusnags sngon byon skyes chen dam pa mang pos sgrub pa nyams len dang chos 'khor bsgor ba'i gnas khyad par can bde chen steng zhes pa de yod/ de yang / rnal 'byor ba sangs rgyas dar po dang rgyal thang ba bde chen rdo rjes brtsams pa'i rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen po'i rnam thar mthong ba don ldan nor bu'i phreng ba zhes pa'i nang / de nas bde chen steng du byon pas/ nga 'dod pa'i gnas de 'di na 'duga'adi ni dge sbyor la 'bogs yong ba'i gnas yin te/ de yang gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba/ rtsi zhing nags tshal gyis 56

brgyan pa/ phya na gangs seng dkar mo gnam du marmong ba 'dra ba/ mdo phyag rgya snol ba 'dra ba/phyogs dang mtshams nas dgra med pa/sgo skyor ba/byang phyogs skyob pa 'dra ba/shar nub gnyis bo gzhol ba/nyi ma 'char snga ba/zhub 'phyis pa/dbyar bsil ba/ dgun dro ba/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang rdzas yod pa/ bar chad dkon pa/ chu bo'i rgyun la sngags kyi sgra 'byung ba/ be tog dkar dmar gyi gling yod pa/zhing smon pa sna tshogs skye ba/sman dri sna tshogs 'byungab/mdor na dge ltas thams cad tshang ba yin zhing / dag pa'i snang ba la bcom ldan 'das bde mchog gi lha tshogs su yod pa la bltas pa tsam gyis ting 'dzin rgyud la skye ba/rnam rtog rang shugs kyis 'gag cing du kha dang bral ba/ bde stong gi nyams rgyud 'byung ba/ skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dngos grub gnyis myur du thob pa'i gnas mchog de nyid/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnas chen zhig dang khyad par med pas/chos rje pa'i zhal nas/ kho bo gnas chen mang bor byin te/ 'di las byin rlabs che ba mi 'dug ces gsungs nas/ 'e1 gsum sku mtshams dam bo bzhugs/ de nas 'gro don mdzad/ de dus mkhan bo go char ba/ bla ma bde legs rgyal mtshan/bla ma ba ri ba/ bla ma choso sdings pa/ bla ma byang chub gling pa la sogs te sgom chen lnga brgya tsam la phyag rgya chen po'i khrid mdzad/ de tshar ba dang ston sgom dang dge bshes stong brag tsam tshogs pa la/ spong thag dang sems bskyed chen po mdzad pa'i rjes su nye gnas 'ga' zhig khrid nas 57

dga' ldan gling gi dben gnas su byon pa bcas zhib cha gong gsal rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen po'i rnam thar mjal na mkhyen thub/ bde chen steng dang tsā ri gnyis ni gnas kyi byin rlabs mnyam par grags pas/ bde chen steng mjal na tsā ri mjal ba dang khyad med par bshad do//gong bzhin grub thob chen po o rgyan rin chen dpal gyis gnya' nang du yun ring chos rje rgyal ba 'od tshang ba'i zhabs la gtugs nas bka' brgyud kyi chos 'khor mtha' dag ji lta ba bzhin thugs brgyud la 'khrungs rjes lam 'brang mang bo brgyud de bal yul dang / rgya gar/ skyes rgyan yul bcas par phebs nas snarsha5 mang du gsan/ phyir phebs nas la zhing pa'i mkhan 〈sna sku1ngas kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos dpal rgyal mtshan gyis mkho ba'i sku byad phul te/ gnya' nang na bzhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen skye bo'i tshogs du ma dang bcas pa smin cing grol bar mdzad/btsun ma gtsang gdong ma sogs kyis yo byad phul nas dga' ldan gling du chos rje rgod tshang ba'i sku sder bzhengs nas gnya' nang lung ba'i bde legs 'byung zhing / khyad par tshong 'dus pa dang dga' ldan gling pa'i bde skyid 'byung ba yin gsungs/ de'i dus su dga' ldan gling pa'i dge bshes su zhig pa byang dpal gyi dbon po bzhugs/ 'gram du dbu ma pa zhes pas chos rje 'od tshang bar zhal mang du gtong gi 'dug ces gsan nas/ sgom chen 'ga' zhig gis zhabs tog mdzad de byon nas phyi nang 58

gnya' nang thong khongs su yod ba'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi skor/gzhung lugs rnams la pham par mdzad pa dang / ma rung 'byung 〈sna byams pa'i stobs kyis btul/ bal po rdzong gi shar phyogs 'gal bo zhes bya ba'i ri khrod la bzhugs nas/bcom ldan 'das 'byung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal mngon gsum du gzigs pa sogs zhib phra mkhyen 'dod yod tshe grub chen rin po che nyid kyi slo ba ma bskusnad nams ca(da zer gyis brtsams pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa grub chen tse( rgyan pa'i rnam thar byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun zhes pa bod ljongs bod yig dpe snying dpe skrun khang nas par 'debs byas pa'i deb zer la gzigs par zhu/grub thob chen po o rgyan rin dpal de nyid ni lcags stag phyi lo 127 lor la stod na zlum du sku bltams zhing / mngon pa gong 'og dang /tshad ma sde bdun/ dbu ma/ dus 'khor bcas mkhas par sbyangs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'gran zla med pa'i grags pa 1snab pa bcas 31//11)sbas yul padma tshal/gnya' nang dang / gnya' nang gi sgo nub gangs la'i rgyab tu yod pa'i bal sa yol mo gnyis ni/ sbas lung yin par grags pa de yang / rgod tshang ba chen po'i rnam thar gyi mjug byang du rnal 'byor pa sangs rgyas dar po'i gsung brtsams nang /gling bzhi'i mchog gyur sgo yi 'dzam bu gling /gnas kyi mchogagyur la phyi'i

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gangs ri'i 'dabs/ yul la g.yang chags sbas yul gnya' nang gi /sa cha 'bur dod dben gnas rne lung 'dir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ dus gsum sems can kun gyi skyabs gcig bu/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i/ rnam thar legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba 'di/ zhes dang /dzo sprul ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nor bus mdzad pa/ gcod yul nyon mongs zhi byed kyi bka' gter bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar byin rlabs gter mtsho zhes par 'ang par dbe cha'i sgog ldeb 72 par ) rig 'dzin nyi zla klong gsal lam/ 'ja' lus snang stong rang grol gyi rnam thar phyogs bsdus mdzad pa'i nang / gnya' nang tshong 'dus kyi phu sgras yul padma tshal gyi byang sgo gangs ri sung bo bya khyung gi rtsa ba na/ ri glang chen 'gyings pa 'dra ba'i mdun na thug pa zhin tu yag pa cig 'dug par/ der bzhugs pa'i tho rang khar thugs nyams su mi smug bo gos nag po'i ber gyon dar thod nag bos bcings/ za 'og khra bo'i ske rags bcing pa zhig byung nas/ des rig 'dzin padma'i gter gnas sbas yul drug skyong ba'i gter bsrung yin/ khul 'dir mi rnams kyis dmar mchod dang me grib btang bar khyed kyi bsangs gser skyems kyis sangs pa thugs rje che/ da khyed la mgron zab po zhu ba yin zer ba dang nyams sad/ de nas bzung gnya' nang phu mda' bar gsum gyi zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa 'bul mkhan mang /skabs der rig 'dzin chos rgyal rdo rje'i mchog gi sbrul sku yum gyi lhums su 60

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi skor/bzhugs su gsol ba'i rtags rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung /de nas re zhig gnya' nang stod kyi bya phyag tu phebs nas bzhugs/rje nyid chung dus nas sbas yul zhig tu phebs nas sems can gyi don byed zhus pa zhig rig 'dzin padma mkhyen dgongs pa'i thugs gtad yang yang gtong ba mdzad pa'i dus bab lta bur/ sbas yul glang 'phreng gi shar sgo gnya' nang rtsa sgo la gtad pa sngon ma gcig gis phye nas mis 'grul byed/ dmag zing zhig gi skabs dmag mi rnams phyin nas/gnas de'i nor phyugs rnams ded nas yong /la rtsar 'byor pa na gter srung gi cho 'phrul gyis mi mang po zhi/ gnas lam 'gags te mi 'pha mang bo sdusang ba der phebs 'dod kyis lan gsum phebs kyang ma thar/slar sprel lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nyin gu ru tse( rgyan rje la gsol ba 'debs bzhin phebs pas/ phebs lam la 〈sna 'phrul sna tshogs byung yang the tshom ma mdzad par phebs te gnas mthil du phyag phebs/ padma'i sgub phug gong 'og sgrub chu/ zhabs rjes/ sku rjes sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mang po dang bcas gzigs pa'i lo rgyus zur du gsal/ gu ru'i sgrub phyag tu bzhugs/ tshogs mchodi bsangs gser skyems sogs dang /bod khams bde ba'i zugs smon che cher gnang / zugs 'ur ba'i mgur dbyangs su/ tshem ho/zhub phyogs orgyan zhing khams rang byas kyang / /rang lus 'dom gang gru bzhi na 'dug go/zhes pa nas mgo brtsams te mgur ma'i mtha' mjug tu/ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri 61

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bo rang byas kyang / /sbas yul padma tshal chen na 'dug go/sbas yul mi 'gyur rtags bdun rang byas kyang / phyag zhabs sku rjes sgrub phyag na 'dug go kho) ma ngo mtshar pad byung gi sgrub gnas/ /tshe sngon las smon rten 'brel gyis mjal byung //rang re mched grogs zhabs thozhig mdzod dang //mtha' dmag hor sog dmag dpung rnams dazlog cig /ces gsungs zhing gnas mthil thams cad la sku 'cham du phebs pas 'ja' 'od dang sdu bzang gis lung pa khengs/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas bzang bo byung zhes 'khod 'dugagong bzhin dza sbrul ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nor byas mdzod pa/ gong gsal phyag dper (sgog ldeb 04 par )rigs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa kun mkhyen choso kyi dbang phyug gi rnam thar nang / de nas rim par gnya' nang tshong 'dus su zhabs skusnar 'khotshed/ der zhag 'ga' bzhugs te zhabs 'kho ra rnams la sngar gyi lung don/ chos rgyal ldo rje'i sprul sku bltams pa'i sa gnya' nang du mtha' gangs ris bskor ba nags tshal dang spang gzhongs can/ brag phug khang pa gang rigs mtsho rdzing shug sdong gsum tsam yod pa'i sa 'tshol dgos gsungs/ yab rje zhabs g.yog zung bcas gnya' tshong gi shar sgo skyid ces pa'i phyogs su 'tshol bar phebs/ bzhugs gnas sgo ba yod rung / lung don bzhin ma byung / zhabs rim pa gnyis kyis rgod tshang zhes pa'i phyogs su'ang lung dang mthun pa ma rnyed/ shar chos ldan rtse bya bar bzhugs skabs zhabs 62

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi sgor/rim pa gnyis byang gi phyogs phu spe lhag zhes par phyin pas tshul dang mthun pa byung ste gnas tshul gsol bas/ gnya' nang tshong 'dus kyi phu/ sbas yul padma tshal gyi shar/glang sdong gi sgo/chu dbar dang khrod phyag gi nub/gangs ri khol bo bya khyung gi rtsa ba/ ri glang chen 'gying pa 'dra ba'i mdun/ phya lhag (phu log) du 'bod pa'i da lta spel lhag (dpal lha'i dgon pa ) zhes sa dgon 'di kho na yin gsungs/sa der padma tshal gyi lam yig tu sbas yul de'i nub sgo ri glang chen 'gyings 'dra'i mdun na padma nga yi sgrub phug yod/ gsungs pa der bzhugs gdan 'jags/ tshong 'dus gnas po dar po zer bas thog ma'i bsnyen bkur zhus pas rten 'brel che ba gyur/ der yum bcad rgya la bzhugs/zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu'i tshogs masnu da skabs yum gyi mngal nas a zhes lan lnga tsam gsungs pa kun gyis thos/ sngar mi dran pa'i ltas ngo mtshar mang po dang bcas sa lug zla dang po tshes gcig gi tho rangs bde bar btsas/yab rje rig 'dzin chen pos gtsos khams bod skyes chen mang po'i drung nas smin 〈snal gyi gdams pa rgya che dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga gang la'ang mabe| brtsams pa tsam gyis mkhyen par gyur pa sku gas skyes sbyang gi shes rab sus kyang 'gran pa'i yul las 'das/ dgung 'byu bcu gnyis par dbyas su phebs/ 7gong sa rgyal mcho ga lnga pa pho brang chen po po ta lar sku bcad rgya zhin tu dam pa'i gzim chung sgo drung du/ 'phyong rgyas dpal ri sprul sku dang lhan du gtsug rgyud thul/ mtshan

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyalakhams pa/chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin par stsal ba bcas mdzad 'phrin zhib pa rnam thar la gzigs na mkhyen/12)dpal lha'i dgon pa ni/gangs ri khol po bya khyung gi rtsa ba na sbas yul padma tshal gyi nub sgo ri glang chen 'gyings 'dra'i mdun du chags yod/dus 'gyur ma byung tsam du btsun ma zhal grangs nyi shu tsam bzhugs yod/dgon pa de ni 'phel rgyas gling gi dgon lag lta bu zhig yin zhing /rten gtso thub dbang dang /jo bo/spyan ras gzigs phyag lho nga spyan 〈snang /bde mchoge bcas kyi 〈snag/gsungs rten phyag dpe mang wa mjal rgyu yod/gnya' nang khyon yongs la khyim dud gcig gi nang du bya gsum skyes na bar pa de 'phel rgyas gling dgon pa'i grwa gral du 'dzul dgos pa dang /dar rgyas gling man chod du bu yo gsum skyes na bar ma de dpal lha'i dgon par 'dzul dbe sa kyin sku1da/ dar gling yan snu da kyi bu mopha bar ma rnams ni la zhing a de'i dgon bar 'dzul dgos pa'i lam srol yod/13)paṇa ḍi/dpal lha'i dgon pa nas tshong 'dus phu phyogs su le dbar 'ga' shas song ba'i sar paṇa ḍi zer ba'i mtshams khang zhig yod pa byin can du ngos 'dzin 64

byed/ sngar mkhas zhing grub pa'i skyes bya mang po sku mtshams su bzhugs par grags kyang mtshan zhu rgyu mi 'dug /nye ba'i char 'jigs med rgya mtsho zhu ba'i bya bral pa zhig gis yun ring bzhugs pa dang / de rjes tshong 'dus byang pa dang bur sras pa khyim tshang gnyis kyis dad sbyin zhus te/ paṇa ḍi dge slong zhu ba khams nas phebs ba'i mtshams pa zhig 'o1 mang sku mtshams su bzhugs/khong ni zhabs rim gyi cho gar mkhas zhing / mchod pa'i gtor ma sna tshogs dang / mdos thor bzhengs rgyu ha cang phyag rtsal bde bo yod par grags/ rig 'dzin nyi zla klong gsal gyi rnam thar nang / gnya' nang tshong 'dus kyi su sbas yul padma tshal gyi byang sgo gangs ri sung po bya khyung gi rtsa ba na/ ri glang chen 'gyings pa 'dra ba'i mdun na phug pa zhin tu yag pa cig 'dug gsungs pa paṇa ḍi min nam snyam pa zhib 'jug zhu rgyu dang / na thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i rnam thar nang / gnya' nang tshong 'dus kyi phu bde skyid 'byung gnas su g.yang chos pa gu ru'i lung zin rig 'dzin nyi zla klong gsal gyi rnam sbrul gar dbang 'phrin las rnam rgyal las/ gter ston gar dbang rdo rje snying po'i zab gter gsan bzhes gnang ba sku1gas gsal 'dug /sa 1snag rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu ni phyi lo 14༅/lor 'khrungs nas 1777lor gshegs pa de'i dbang du gzhigs na lo sum brgya nye ba'i gong du gnas de'i ming la bde skyid 'byung gnas su 'bod par snyam mo//65

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/14)dga' ldan gling /dga' ldan gling ni rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen pos phyag 'debs mdzad cing /gnya' nang du lo bcu bzhugs pa'i ring gdan sa 'dir chos 'khor rgya chen sgor bar grags/rgod tshang ba chen po'i rnam thar nang /bde chen steng du lo gsum sku mtshams dam po bzhugs pa'i rjes su nye gnas 'ga' zhig khrid nas dga' ldan gling gi dben gnas su byon/dbyar zla bzhi tsam sgrub pa la bzhugs/dbyar smad sngon gyi 'khor rnying pa ston pa legs mdzes bya ba dang / mkhan bo bsam gtan la sogs pa'i dge bshes mang po ri khrod nas byon/ gzhan yang tsā ri dang / ti se la sogs pa'i gnas chen 'khor nas yong ba'i ston sgom brgyad cu gya bzhi la ro stoms skor drug dang thabs lam snga thun gyi bshad pa yang mdzad pa sogs 'gro don 'phel/ 'on kyang rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen po gnya' nang nas seng ge gling du phebs thon mdzod pa'i rjes su sa g.yos chen bo byung nas gnya' nang pa'i khang pa thams cad zhig nas mi mang po gtib 'og tu sgor/dpal bde chen steng gi lam chad nas mtshor 'khyil/ dgon pa thams cad rud dang bab kyis zhig pa sogs rgod tshang pa chen po'i rnam thar nang gsal ba bzhin dus ngan de'i skabs dga' ldan gling gi gdan sa yang gyang gog tu gyur pa yin par 'dug/seng ge gling zer ba ni yol mo'i nang du yin pa dang /gnas der rje mi la ras pas kyang sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad 'dug66

gnya' nang rdzong khongs su yod pa'i rtsa che'i gnas chen khag gi sgor/17)'gram gyi thub pa lha khang /'gram grong tsho'i dkyil du yul mi rnams kyis phyag mchod zhu sa lha khang zhig yod pa de'i rten gtso rdo nag las bzhengs pa'i thub dbang gi sku brnyan zhin tu ngo mtshar can zhig sku da/ gon rabs rnams kyi gsung rgyun la gzhig na/ thub dbang gi sku de cho sa rje rgyal ba 3snad tshang pa chen pos rgya gar nas gdan zhu mdzod de 'gram du bzhugs zhag gnang pa'i skabs/nga'i 'gro don 'di ru yod ces gsungs byon pa ltar de rang du lha khang bzhengs par grags/ phyi 'o 1 cacanas mi cu dbar bod khyon yongs su rig gnas gsar brje'i dug rlangs phog pa'i skabs lha khang gi rten dngos gtor bzhig byas pas ma tshad/rin thang bral ba'i ston pa'i sku brnyan de hu ku ma zer ba'i g.yang gzar gyi chu la skyur ba'i sa cha der bdun gcig ring 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang phub pa kun gyis mig mthong byung 'dug14)dgon pa gsar pa'i lha khang /dgon pa gsar par yang gzhis dgon chung chung zhig yod pa'i rten gtsor gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan byon legs zhig yod/ grong tsho'i ming la dgon pa gsar pa zhes 11gas stangs la gzhig na/11ga mar dbo|na pa phyag btabs te rim bzhin grong tsho chags ba yin par sems/ dgon pa der sku gsung thugs 67

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bu tsha rgyal khams ba/rten dang dpe cha gang 'tshams bzhugs pa ma zad/ ris med bla ma rim byon gyis phyag mchod sgrub gnas gnang 'dug17)shetel wa sgang gi bka' 'gyur lha khang /sgol po sgang du'ang dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang gsar bzhengs bka' 'gyur lha khang zhig dang / ma ṇi dung 'khor zhig yod par yul mi rnams kyis phyag ma35da byed pa bcas theg//

le tshan gsum pa/tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang / lha khang gsar rnying / nye 'khor yul ljongs bcas kyi sgor/tshong 'dus zer ba'i grong tsho ni bal bod sa mtshams dang nye ba'i tshong dwa chen po zhig yin zhing / skal bzang dus bzang gi skabs su khyim mtshes bal yul nas rong pa dang / bal po/de bzhin bod kyi sa cha stod smad yongs nas tshong pa dang / zhing 'grog mi sna mang bo 'du 'dzoms kyis tshong 'thab thugs che byed par brten ming la tshong 'dus btags pa de yang mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel sgor bshad pa zhes pa'i nang /phyi lo miX77nas 12༷cabar bod sil bu'i dus dkyil du slebs skabs dpal 'a〈snar lam lugs rtsa ba'i cha nas chags zin pa ma zad/ zhing 'a〈snag 1snan skyed la bosnang 'phel che tsam byung ba dang / chabs cig lag shes bzo las/ tshong las kyang 'phel rgyas byung ste/stod mnga' ris kyi ding ri dang /gnya' nang / gtsang gi lha rtse tshong 'dus mgur yo bcas su tshong dwa chags mgo tshugs thing / zhes 'khod pa de dbang du gzhigs na/ grong khyer gyi ming la tsong 'dus thogs nas lo chig stong ma zin tsam 'das par nges zhing / gnya'

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/nang stod smad la rwa lo chen pos chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su tshong 'dus lding ma zhes kyang 'bod kyin yod 'dugazhing 'grog mi mang gi thon khungs zha mar thud gsum dang / 'bru rigs sna tshogs/ rong mtshams nas thon pa'i 'bras dang / zhing tog /mdor na ka ra bu ram sku gas zas sna 'dzoms pa'i 〈snang khyer 'khrug cha dod la gasku na nyams can zhig 〈snad pa de ni/ bal bod sa mtshams kyi grong brdal 'gram 'gag sgo nas lha sa'i phyogs su ki 'o mi ṭar 37gyi sar mtho tshad rgya mtsho nas mi /ra 37/༷tham pa'am/phi ṭi 124༷༷tham pa'i steng du chags yod/snga dus nas bzung gnya' nang rdzong gi bsti gnas yin pa'i grong khyer de phyi lo 167 lor dbyibs gzugs nas 'gru lta bu dkyil zheng che la mgo mjug phra ba zhig yod/skya zhabs mi ṭar ob thi ni ṭar gyi lo rgyus bod nang lo brgyad/ ces pa'i nang khong phyi lo 1071 lor tshong 'dus su phebs pa'i gzigs tshul du/ grong khyer der khang pa thog leb 12༷sgor yod pa dang /gzhi rgya skyid grong las chung yang tshong 'brel gyi cha nas gal 'gang che bar casas 'dzin byas ba dang / sa babs lha sa las phran bu ma1sna la/ gzhis rtse las dma' ba sku'id kyang gnam gzhis khyad par che rkyen lung pa'i nang nas ma gtogs 〈sna yag po smin thub kyin mi 'dug ces bris 'dug /'on kyang rgan rabs rnams kyi mkhyen rtogs 70
