snung 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yul smongs skor/la gzhigs na bod mi sgo them 242dang /bal rigs them grangs 40tsam yod par bshad/gtsang chu'i nye 'gram du brag rdo mang po yod pa'i sa char chags te rgyun du chu sgra che ba dang /dgun dus bod sa gzhan las gangs 'bab che ba sku da/cane kyang dbyar dus ni nye 'khor gang sar sbang dang / kha dog sna tshogs kyi me tog mang la rang byung ri skyes zhing tog dang /sngo tshal yang mang bo skye bzhin pa red/grong khyer gyi mgo nas mjug bar ka chu zer ba'i rgyugs chu chung ngu zhig yod par mi rnams kyis rdzo stod dang gyon chas 'khrud bzhal byed pa dang / ka chu'i g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i brag rdo khag la yul mi tshos gri dang zo ra la rno ngar bzo ba'i brdar rdo mang po yod/ grong stod du lu ma zer ba'i chu mig gnyis skusnad pa de dag nas 'thung chu 'or 'dren byed/ mtshams rer chu mig skam grabs byed pa'i skabs yul mi tshos bstan bzhig dang sbrags nas/ tshong 'dus rgya khrom che yang /lu ma gnyis las mi 'dug/chu chen gtsang bo a shes//lu ma'i skyobs grogs gnang dang / /zhes glu gzhas gtong srol yod/a shes sam dba' shes zer ba ni yul skad du sku mkhyen zhes pa'i zhu 'bod kyi tshig don zhig red/stong 'dus grong khyer nang yul mi sbyis bdag dbang byed pa'i lha khang gsar pa gnyis dang / rnying pa gcig /ma ṇi dung 'khor bzhi/ /ma ṇi 'degs 71

mkhar gsum/phyi chasnal pa'i lha khang gcig bcas sku1da pa gzham gsal/1)lha khang gsar pa ni/gnya' nang gi rdzong sdod pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis phyag btabs byas pa zhig red/ rten gyi gtso bor gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan stod khul du de las byon legs pa med ces zhu ba pho lha ba rang nyid kyi phyag bzo klu srin gyi kha bston du grags pa zhig dang / ma ṇi dung 'khor/ rdo leb zhig tu gu ru rin po che dang / bka' srung e ka dzo ṭi rang byon zhin tu ngo mtshar can gyi thog rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che bris ma bcas bzhugs yod/ rdzong dpon 'pho 'gyur gsar rnying rtsis sgrod rtsis len skabs lha khang gi sgod dpang 'phel rgyas gling dgon pa nas bya dgos pa dang / rten dngos kyi khongs su gu ru'i kha ṭaṃ ras 'thum zhig yod ba de ni ha cang rtsa 'gangs chen por brtsi srol yod par grags/lha khang de la snga yo ma ṇi lha khang zhes 'bod kyin yod 'dug pa de'i sgor la/ mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i mi dbang rtogs brjod kyi nang / pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas gnya' nang rdzong sdod du bsko gzhag gis sa gnas su 'byor te las don byas rjes kyi khongs su 'di ltar bris 'dug/de nas skabs lhag na mngone par dge ba'i bsam pa bzang bo 72

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yul rdzongs sgor/'di lta bu zhig 'khrungs te/ zang zing gi nor ni snying po med pa zhig yin pas/'di dag don 'phad par bya ba dang / lus can mtha' dag 'phags pa lag na pad mo'i zhing khams ri bo gru 'dzin du longs spyod par bya ba'i slad du snying bo yi ge drug pa'i 'khor chen bla na med pa zhig bskrun par bya'o snyam yo/ /de'i tshe yul de'i skye bo dge ba'i las la mos pa rnams kyis kyang mthun rkyen bsgrubs te tshags su tshud par byas so/ /de nyid bzhugs par 'os pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa gang du bya snyam du som nyi'i 'khyogs la 'chang ba'i tshe/ nub gcig rmi lam du ma ṇi'i 'khor 'o chen po bzhugs pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa ni/tshong 'dus kyi khang bzang (sgo khang ) dang ha cang mi ring ba na pha bong chen po rus sbal gyi dbyibs 'dra ba 'di kho na'i steng du gyis zhig ces mis pa ltar/pha 〈snang de yang sa bdag gdug pa can gnas par grags pa/ yul mi dag gis gsur la sogs pa dang / rgyud kyis mchod par byed pa dang zhin tu gnyan par byed pa'o zhes gleng ba zhig mchis na'ang ji mi snyam par rje bo dam pa rang nyid kyis rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho la gser skyems gtsang ma'i bud kyis mchod rjes/ 'bir ba dang / lcags gzong /tog rtse la sogs pa lag mtshon sna tshogs bzung ba dag gis pha bong de nyid kyi 'bar 'bur rnams phye mar gsil te khang bu brtsegs pa bskrun pa ma ṇi'i 'khor lo chen po bzhugs su gaskusnal te/ rten brten par bcas ba legs par grub pa na/ de la rab tu 73

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gnas pa'i cho ga mdzad pa po 'phel rgyas gling gi 'dus sde'i yongs 'dzin gyis mdzad de/ rin chen me tog sil ma'i char phab pa'i tshe ma ṇi'i khang bu brtsegs pa de'i 'dabs rol nas glo bur du chu ma lha ba'i 'dzum phreng g.yo ba zhig thon te mi'i gom pa nyer bzhi'i bar du gya gyur 'bab pa dang / khang bu brtsegs pa'i rtsig ngos su sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa srung ma dam can rgya mtsho sogs kyi snang brnyan ri mor 'khod par byas pa la/ dpal ldan 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma'i snang brnyan de ni ches cher 'bur du dod par gyur pa skusnags dge mtshan mtha' klas pa sgrerdzo btags zol ྅dar ma yin pa da lta'ang mngon sum du gtan la phebs par mchis pa las/ yul phyogs de'i skye bo mtha' dag gcig tu mos pa mi 'phrog pa'i gsos dam par gyur te/deng sang gi bar ngo mtshar ba'i gtam du gleng bar byed do/ /zhes gsal 'dugapho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas ni/phyi lo 171/lor gnya' nang rdzong sdod du bsgo gzhag byas yod pa ltar las don 'di ni pho lha skad grags thon pa'i las thabs dang po yin ba'i sgor rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pas brtsams sgrig rgyal rabs nang gsal ba de dbang du gzhigs na tshong 'dus kyi lha khang gsar pa zhu ba de phyi lo 171/nas/1722dbar phyag btab mdzad par nges zhing /lha khang de dang sbyar nas ma ṇi dung 'khor yod pa'i lha khang gzhan pa che legs zhig sku(da pa der shag rtsa'am bal rigs rnams kyis smyung gnas gtong 〈snal 74

yod/ lha khang de gnyis kyi rgyab tu 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i gzungs sngags yi ge drug ma'i lag 'kho ra brgya phrag 'ga' shas bang bsgrigs nas bzhengs zhing / sgor lam gyi mtha' 'khor la rtsig pa dang thog kheb phub nas spug thag ring po byas pa zhig kyang yod/2)lha khang rnying pa/grong smad du lha khang rnying pa zhu ba zhig yod pa de ni ha cang rtsa 'gangs chen bo yin par ngos 'dzin byed/ nang rten gyi khongs su zhabs rjes zhig yod pa de ni chos rje rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen po gnya' nang bde chen steng dang dga' ldan gling gnyis su lo ngo bcu bzhugs zhing dgon pa phyag btab ste/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun la sbang rtsa seng ge'i gling du gyon khar rdo la 'jim pa brdzis pa ltar zhabs rjes bzhag ste/de la gnya' nang pa rnams kyi yos pa'i rten bgyis gsungs pa de rang yin par 'dug /lha khang de'i dkon gnyer bde chen steng nas bsgo gtong byed srol yod/3)ma ṇi dung 'khor/lha khang gsar pa'i nye 'khris su bur sras pa dang byang pa khyim tshang gnyis kyis

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/yon bdag zhus te 'brug pa rin po che sku thog gong mas ma ṇi dung 'khor che legs phyogs bzhir kun dga' dwa ba so so'i nang ston pa shākya thub pa'i 'jim sku gtso 'khor dang /spyan ras gzigs stong tshar/mtha' 'khor 'du khang chabs sbrags gsar bzhengs mdzod ba de'i rgyun gtan mcho da thebs su khyim tshang gnyis thun yong nas lug nyos te/ sgo rong khyal du bogs mar btang nas tshong 'dus su lug mar 'beb pa dang / lo ltar sa zla'i nang rin po che'i zhal slob 'brug pa mang po mchod mjal du 'ong nas smyung gnas gtong sro la sku da/khong rnams kyi cho ga'i gdangs dbyangs zhin tu snyan po yod par yul mis dga' dad kyis bsnyen bkur yang gzab rgyas byed/tsum pa dge slong bsod nams phun tshogs kyis brtsams pa'i 'brug pa sku bo nga ma bla ma shes rab rdo rje 'am/ mtshan gzhan ngag dbang dpal bzang mchog gi rnam thar zin tho'i nang / sa sbrul 1 20 lor gnya' nang du lce lce pa sangs kyi nang du zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs nas mi mang la sdig spong dge sgrub kyi bka' slob dang bka' chos gnang / mchod sku na sbyin bdag gi 'brel ba byung / 'phel rgyas gling dgon par zugs rje chen po'i dbang dang lung khrid/gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dbang chen dang mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang khrid/lam rim bcas gnang /chu rta 1642'o ra dbyar kha slar gnya' nang du phebs nas ma ṇi dung 'khor gsar bzhengs mdzad/ mi mang la sangs rgyas sman bla/76

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yulaspyongs sgor/'jam dbyangs/ 'dzom lha bcas kyi dbang gnang / 'e rgan rnams la 'pho ba dang sems khrid bcas gnang 'duga'abrug pa rin po che sku gong ma 'di yis 'brug zhabs drung 'jigs med chos rgyal dang / dga' ldan ser kong rin po che sogs nas dbang lung khrid bcas gsan pa'i thog 'bras spungs su chos zhugs gnang ste dge bshes ang rim dang po'i mtshan rtags bzhes pa sogs chos lugs ris med nyams bzhes gnang mthar gnya' nang dang /sgyid grong /rong shar/bal sa tsum dang / 'byul mo/ sbas khungs sku gas su chos 'khor rgya che sgor ba dang chabs cig dbesnan pa gsar rgyag gnang ba sku(gas mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / lo rgyus zhib cha ni 'brug pa rin po che'i rnam thar la gzigs na mkhyen cas//4)ma ṇi 'degs mkhar/grong khyer nang ma ṇi 'degs mkhar zhes pa'i lha khang bzo dbyibs skyid grong 'phags pa lha khang dang bal yul rgyal sa'i lha khang 43 man kheb 'dra ba rgya phibs sum ldan mtha' 'khor ma ṇi lag 'khor gyis bsgor zhing steng thog rim pa so sor rlung shugs kyis 'gul nas snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa'i dril bu gral bstar bsgrigs pa gsum yod pa de dag ni/ grong stod du lha khang gsar pa dang

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams ba/gnas steng khyim tshang gi mdun du gcig dang / grong dkyil gtam bsgrags sgang zer ba'i sa char zhag rtsa skal bzang dang mkhar steng / dngul bzo rdo rje'i khyim tshang bcas pa'i mdun du gcig /grong smad du gnas 'og dang ko thang gnas po/ bur sras pa bcas pa'i khyim tshang gi mdun du gcig bcas bzo bkod thul du byung ba gsum yod par gtso che bal bo rnams kyis phyag mchod byed srol yod/7)bka' 'gyur lha khang dang rgyal ba byams pa'i lha khang /tshong 'dus grong khyer nang ka sgo ba khyim tshang nas gsar bzhengs 'dzin skyong byas pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i lha khang che legs mtha' 'a〈snar grwa shag sku1da pa zhig dang / bur sras pa khyim tshang nas gsar bzhengs bka' 'gyur lha khang /de bzhin rang rang gi khyim tshang nang mchod khang zur bzhengs byas pa mang po yod pa ltar/ mi mang nas tshes bzang dus bzang nam yin la yul spyi'i lha khang du phyag mchod zhu ba dang chabs cig sger 'dzin lha khang khag la'ang mchod 'bul zhu ba'i lam sgol yod/ca)lha rwa/〈snang tsho'i ga ma du lha rwa zhes bal po'i lha khang gser zangs kyi rgya thabs 78

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yulaljongs skor/sum ldan brjid nyams che ba zhig kyang yod/ lha rwa'i mdun du dril bu chen po mi tshad tsam gnyis dang / mtha' sgor mgron khang yod pa'i rten gtso skya seng bu lnga'i bar pa 'jigs sde'am hin du chos lugs kyi lha chen sgom san zhu bar bal po phyi ba rnams kyis dmar mchod 'bul yul zhin tu gnyan par grags pa zhig skusnad/7)sras gu ru chos dbang gi mchod rten dang stong ra chen/〈snang khyer nas sgo phyogs bal yul du 'asgra lam lte bar stong ra chen zhes gor bod dmag 'khrug skabs yul gnyis kyi dmag mi stong brag mang por 〈snag skyon byung ba'i sdig bshags ched ma ṇi rdo rtsig zheng la 'dom pa gcig dang phyed ka tsam dang /mtho tshad 'dom pa gnyis tsam/dkyus la 'dom pa brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam zhig yar lam mar lam gnyis kyi dkyil du gral bstar ha cang ring por bsgrigs nas yod pa'i gzham du sras gu ru chos dbang gi gdung rten byin can zhig kyang yod//)yul mi'i sdod khang gi sgor/gnya' nang rdzong gi bsti gnas sgo khang la khang thog bzhi dang / sger khang nyung shas zhig la 〈snag rtseg gsum sku1da pa las de min mang che ba gnyis brtsegs 79

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/dang rkyang brtsegs yin zhing /khyim tshang yongs rdzogs kyi khang pa'i thog zur so sor rang gi lo khams dang mthun pa'i dar zhing 'dzugs sa'i rdo rtsig gru bzhi can gyi lha tshugs dang / bsangs bum bcas kyi thog phyogs bzhi mtha' sgor zhing dum gral bstar bsgrigs te rtsig sgol yod/ zhing dum de dag bud zhing du bed gathe da ma byas par mi rabs mang 〈sna khang pa'i mdzes rgyan du bzhag pa zhig red/ khang pa che gras mang che bar dkar rags byug pa'i thog sgo dang sge'u khung so so'i mtha' la nag rtsi byug pa de dag la sham bu btags pa rlung gis lhab lhub tu g.yos nas brjid nyams chen po yod par dran/ gnod pa 'gog thabs yin tshul khang pa 'ga' shas kyi steng du thing gi pho mtshan chen po re gyang ldebs su btsugs nas yod pa 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog sel ba'i thabs lam zhig yin par 'dugadu lung dang / la zhing sogs gnya' nang stod kyi khang pa mang che bar dkar rag byug nas yod pa'i thog rtsig pa dkar po'i gyang ldebs su tshos gzhi sngo nag dang li wang gi sa zig mthug bo re g.yas g.yon du byug nas dkyil du tshad gzhi gcig gyur dkar po bzhag sgol 'dug pa de dag ni rigs gsum mgon po'i mtshon dod yin par bshad/ tshong 'dus yan chod kyi khang pa yongs rdzogs bod sa sbyi mtshungs khang thog sa 'dam leb leb yin pa dang / phyogs ga ma dang /la phyi/'gram/dgon pa gsar pa sku gas kyi sdod khyim ni pang thog 80

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yul rdzongs sgor/bkab pa'i zhing khang ngam/ rdo rtsig thog gnyis ma sha stag yin pas de snga 'og tu sgo phyugs 'dogs pa dang steng thog tu mi sdod pa red/6)sgo khang dang rtsa tshig che mosna/tshong 'dus grong tsho'i mgo stod du sgo khang zhes gnya' nang rdzong gi las khungs dang bzhugs zhag shar nub kyi mtha' sgor mdun du sgo rwa chen po yod pa der mi mang gi mdzad sgo tshogs yul byed/sgo khang gi bzo dbyebs ni gtan tshigs kha ru 'dra bar ba da/ thog mar dus rabs bcu bdun pa'am yang na de'i gong du gsar bzhengs byas pa zhig yin tshod 'dug /rdzong dpon pho lha ba'i skabs su mkhar rdzong de'i ming la tshong 'dus kyi khang bzang zhes 'bod kyin yod par 'dugakhang bzang de'i sgor rwa'i phyi la dar chen dang /g.yab sgom chen po'i nang du bod ljongs mi mang ser skya tshang mar skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags che phra ci la yang gnod 'tshe mi chog pa sogs kyi spang blang byed sgo'i sbug dam rtsa chig tshugs zung du bris pa zheng tshad 'dom gang lhag tsam dang dkyus la 'dom pa gcig dang khru gnyis tsam byas pa sku ngas grags su gnang ba snga rjes skusna sku ra gyang ldebs su sbyar nas bzhag 11la sku1da/de'i 'gram du sgrig khang zhes pa tshwa sgo dang / rten bzhengs pa/ a drung sogs gzhung gi mi sna'i mgron khang bcas yod/81

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/rgya khyon che la brjid nyams dod po yod kyang / sho khang der bod kyi lo rgyus nang blo 'gyod dang / ngo gnong dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig kyang byung yod/dga' bzhi pa'i rnam thar dang bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs nang gsal/ gor nge da dmag 'khrug skabs rgyal khab gnyis chings sgrig ched lha sa nas zhabs pad rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor dang / g.yu thog bkra zhis don grub gnyis kyi thog las bya skya ser bdun/chings rgyab dmag mi bcas tshong 'dus su 'byor te sgo khang du bzhugs pa'i skabs/ phyi lo 1701 zla ca tshes 27dgong dro nas grong khyer nang gorṣa'i mi sna khag gi gra sgrig byed mi yin tshul gor dmag mang bo rim 'byor dang / tshwa 'bras do len rong pa rnams nas de nub lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i dus chen yin pas/sgo khang gi ldo bcal du lha gsol 'khrab ston dang zhing rtsed sogs phul chog pa zhus smin ltar rong pa mang pos mtshan gang rnga brdungs/ 'bud bkrol skusnags rtsed sna mang po byas/ bka' mda' rnams kyang gzim chung rab gsal nas gzigs mo ra g.yeng ste bzhugs skabs/tshes 2jinam langs snga char bo ra dmag ja mi rdar nas bosnar 〈snags kyi bka' blosnan rnam par zhal rkelteg 'bul bar btang tshul dmag mi mang po sgo khang nang yong ste gzim chung so sor 'tshang 'dzul dang / 'khrab ston byed mi rong pa rnams kyang lam seng dmag mir gyur te sgo khang nang khengs zhing /phyi phyogs su yang phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas bo ra dmag gis ba〈snar te 82

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yul stongs sgor/bka' blon dga' g.yu gnyis dang / mda' dpon lcang lo can bcas gson bzung byas/ las bya dang / zhabs gras rnams nas re khang nang lag 'dzings byas par sgod drung sgog mkhar bas gtsos bka' mda'i zhabs gras sum cu so lnga bsad/ bcu sgor mas/ gor dmag brgya lhag bsad mas byas pas sgo khang steng sgod kyi nang tshang ma srin po'i grong khyer ltar khrag gi mtsho 'khyil zhing /mi ro'i mchod rten rtsegs pa'i khrod nas bka' blon gnyis dang mda' dpon zhags thag gis bsnams te gor dmag gis bsgor nas bal yul du 'khrid pa sogs bod phyogs la pham nyes chen po byung pa de lta bu'i ngan g.yo byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi sngon nas yod kyang bod phyogs kyi mgo 'khrid rnams nas shes rtogs ma thub par bslu brid 'og tshud cing / skabs de'i gor bod dmag 'khrug gi rjes su bod mi'i kha rgyun du/ ka la gi gu'i ki sgra thon pa dzang ga bha dur gorṣa'i dmag /ka la zhabs skyu ku yang ma thon ba glang mdzo grod bod pa'i dmag /ces pa'i gya tshom gyi gtam bshad kyang dar khyab byung 'dug /dzang ga bha dur 'khod stangs la bltas na phyis 1677 167ca gor bod dmag 'khrugs la bo dbesnas sam/1༷)rgyal po sku lnga dang /chu 'khor ma ṇi/sde pa'i rdzing bcas kyi sgor/sgo khang dang ches mi 'gyangs pa'i byang ngos su rgyal po sku lnga sogs yul mi

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/sbyi'i lha btsugs khag la kha dog lnga ldan gyi dar phreng dang / rang rang gi lo khams la bsdun pa'i dar ras smyug ma'i dar zhing la sgrerdzogs pa brgya phrag mang po btsugs nas yod/ gnya' nang pa'i yul lha ngo ma ni rgyal po sku lnga yin pa ltar yul sbyi'i lha gsol mdzad sgo sku lnga'i rten mkhar gyi mdun du zhu srol yod/ skyes lha dol rgyal yin pa'i skor bshad sgros yod pa ni khungs ldan min zhing / ci'i phyir zhes na gnya' nang gi yul sde ni chos rgyal sgong btsan sgam po'i sku dus nas yod pa zhig yin pa dang / dol rgyal byung nas lo grangs sum brgya tsam las phyin med pa kun shes red/ lha btsugs kyi nye 'khris su sde pa'i rdzing zhes mtha' skor du lcang ma yod pa'i gling ga zhig yod/ de'i g.yon phyogs su chu dgu sbug zer ba'i sa cha'i gsham du ma ṇi chu 'khor mang po lha khang chung chung re'i nang bang bsgrigs te btsugs nas yod pa skyon chag med pa'i skabs nyin mtshan bsdud nas 'khor/ chu dgu sdug gi steng du la rtog dang sde ma bcas kyi ri rtser dar chen mang po btsugs pa rgyang ring nas mthong rgyu yod/ ri de dag gi rgyab tu ri dwags gna' ba dang / gla ba sogs gu yangs bag phebs rang 'dod bzhin rgyu ba khyu tsho mang po mthong rgyu yod/ de dag gis yul mi mthong dus sgo khyi 'dris pa lta bu 'jigs snang mi byed pa dang / bal yul gyi rong mi mthong dus 'jigs 'drogs byed/ rong pa dang ri dwags bsad nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan ya bo sogs nas khyi ra rgyag tshe/snung 'dus kyi 84

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yul ljongs sgor/zha ra rnams nas srung 'gog byed pa'i lam srol bzang po yod/11)ka ka gling gi rgyal sgo dang /mchod rten/bu khrid ri mgo bcas kyi sgor/tshong 'dus nas bod dbus kyi phyogs su 'gro lam gtsang chu'i pha rol tu gzan 'thag chu 'khor steng 'og grong tsho gnyis dang / ka ka gling zhes 'grul pa bsu skyel byed sa kuṇḍi sgo bzhi'i mchod rten dang bcas yod pa de'i ri rtse bu khrid ri mgo zer bar dar chen mang po bang bsgrigs te btsugs pa rgyang thag ring po nas mthong /tshong 'dus pa'i kha rgyun la/ bu khrid ri mgo'i rtse la/ /rlung rta btsug tu phyin pa'i/zhwa mo lhag pas khyer na//phan po ga 'dra sku nga ngam//zhes ku re'i tshul du gzhas tshig bzos nas gtong srol yod/ri 'dir thing nags dang spang sogs gang yang ma skyes par rdo dang bye mas khengs nas yod/ can kyang ri gsham du khang gsar zer ba'i sa gnas su zhing kha mang po skusnad pa ma zad/ de snga dga' ldan gling gdan sa chags shul dang ri 〈snad bcas kyang sku1da/bu khrid ri mgo'i rgyab ngos byang phyogs su 'phel rgyas gling dgon pa dang /lcang gling / bkris 'dzoms/ bkris sgang / gtsang gdong / dar rgyas gling / yar leb/ la zhing / du lung sogs gnya' nang stod kyi grong tsho rnams bod chu'i g.yas gasku na du lung gzhung yas mas so sor chags nas sku da/ ka ka gling gi 85

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/rgyab tu yod pa'i gtsang chu'i pha rol tu 'brug dang / phug khrod/ gser gter ma/ skyid gong dang skyid 'og dam po che/ zhang chen klu mo/ bang gdan/ ka la gong dmar/ gdong yul/ sman dgu /tsha rag gya bcas kyi 'brog sa yod pa'i la rgyab tu la phyi yod/ gser gter ma zer ba'i ri brgyud du snga dus gser gyi gter kha yod pas ming du gser gter ma zhes chags par grags/ ri de'i gsham du 'khrug zam pa'i nye 'gram du 'brug rang byon zhig kyang mjal rgyu yod/12) g.yag rwa dang khral 'grel las khyangs/ 〈sna 〈snags kyi zhing nags dang mtha' mtshams grong tsho bcas kyi sgor/grong khyer gyi mtha' mjug tu lung tsho gzhan khag nas yong ba'i zhing 'grog snung rigs 'bab sa g.yag rwa zhes pa'i thang chen la dbyar dpyid ston gsum du rta drel dang / 'bri g.yag /ra lug bcas phyugs thog gi mnyam du sbra gur gyis khengs nas sdod/ sgo phyogs bal yul du 'gro lam ste bar khral 'grel las khungs thog gcig ma zhig 'byud/de nas le dbar gsum bzhi tsam gyi sa cha nas mabesna tshugs te mu mthud sgo phyogs su zhing rigs sna tshogs dang /smyug ma mang po yod pa'i nags tshal gyis ri klung khengs zhing / stag ma'i me tog gi dri bsung phyogs kun tu khyab pa 86

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yulasmongs skor/ni bod kyi rang byung khams kyi thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa'i cha shas thig yin/stag tshang dang /skyid mo gzhung /phyogs ga ma/lcal sna/smug zam/'gram bcas 〈snang gseb rim brgyud bal khro da sa mtshams rta le ma'i zam pa bar du 'grul lam zhin tu phra la gyen thur mang ba/ g.yang gzar 'jigs dngas che bar brten/ 'grul pa 'ga' shas kyis gnya' nang zhes pa'i tshab tu dmyal lam zhes bstan bzhig gi tshul du 'bod par grags/phyogs gsham gyi ri mgor bde chen steng gi dgon pa dang / ri khrod sgrub phyag/dur khrod rtsa chen bcas yod pa dang /'gram gyi ri mgor spang dang /mgo ser/ dgon pa gsar pa/ chu mig thang / sgo bo sgang bcas kyi grong tsho rnams chags nas yod/ phyis su rgya bal gzhung gnyis thun yong nas rta le ma'i zam par mdza' 〈snags zam pa zhes ming gsar pa zhig btags pa dang / bal yul rgyal sa nas 11da sa 'gram bar gyi lam chen la (shelab160 5136ga'i37)ar ni ko ha yi we zhes bal po'i rten bzhengs mkhas pa 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku dus su sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i nang rten dang rgya nag yon gong ma'i nang rten mang bo bzo bzhengs byed bo ar ni ko zhu ba'i dran rten du btags 'duga'agram ni sa khra'i thog gi 'bred thig rtselngadang /gzhung thig /7 'ganyis kyi stol mtshams su khel zhing sa bab mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las brtsis sbyi 87

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/khre nyis stong bzhi tsam zin/ dus 'gyur rjes su phyi lo 1072 lor thong rim pa'i grong brdal du bsgyur nas 'gram dang / shol po sgang la sogs pa de'i khongs su bcug 'dug /'gram grong brdal du yod pa'i gnya' nang 'gag sgo ni rgyal khab kyi rim pa dang po'i skam lam tshong 'dren gyi 'gag sgo gcig bu de yin zhes phyis su 'don spel byas pa'i yig char gsal 'duga'agram dang dgon pa gsar pa'am li zhing bcas ni sa bab dma' ba dang /char chu 'dzoms pa/ thing nags stug pa/ ri dwags gcan gzan dang / rtswa dang shing sna 'dzoms pa skusnags kyi dge mtshan ldan la/ dbyar kha char 'od tshugs pa'i skabs yul lung smug zhag gis dkrigs zhing / ri klung me tog gis khengs pa/ gcong rong zar mo'i khrod du bab chu lhung sgra snyan pa sogs rang byung gi mdzes chos du mas phyug pa sku(da/7)sa 'og gi tsha chu/bod khyon yongs su sa 'og tsha nus kyi mngon rtags chu mig brgya phrag mang bo yod pa'i nang tshan tsha chu nus pa dang ldan pa gcig ni phyogs ga ma grong tsho dang zhin tu nye ba gtsang chu'i pha rol gyi ri gsham brag gseb tu sa ngos nas rlangs pa 'phyur 'phyur byed bzhin pa zhig yod kyang / lung khug 'grim 'grul dka' bar brten bed spyod byed mkhan mang po med/'on kyang 'dzugs

tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi chags tshul dang /lha khang gsar rnying /nye 'khor yul ljongs skor/skrun yar rgyas btang na tsha chu brgal 'dod can gyi mi rnams la phan 1snags chen po yong nges red/ bod kyi chu tshan rnams kyis rus chag dang / pags nad/ grum nad sogs nad rigs mang por phan 'bras yong gin yod pa bcas skusna//

le tshan bzhi pa/gnya' nang rdzong dang /gon po sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/1)rdzong dbon rim byung /bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang dbu brnyes pa nas bzung gnya' nang du rdzong dpon dang /sgo ba snga rjes rim bsdud byung ba de dag gi khongs nas snyan grags che ba ni 〈sna lha ba bsdu'od nams 〈snabs rgyas yin pa dang / 7rgyal masnu ga sku phreng brgyad pa'i sku(ngas 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gnya' nang du phebs nas 'phel rgyas gling gtso gyur dad ldan mi mang la chos 'khor rgya cher sgor ba'i dus su rdzong dpon pad tshal ba zhu ba zhig byung 'dug /dga' bzhi pa'i rnam thar nang gsal gor bod dmag 'khrug gi zing cha che ba'i skabs gnya' sgo gtsang mda' dpon lcang lo can dang / de'i gong tsam du sde pa dbyas pa zhu ba zhig dang rgyal rtse sne stod pa zhu ba bcas snga rjes su byung 'dugaphyis su bsgos pa'i sgo pa'i gras su rnam dpon dang / 'o lon pa/ 'jun pa/rnam zur/ rta ra mdo ba/ dga' bzhi pa/ shel dkar gling pa/ bsam grub gling /smon skyid gling /lkog grong /zhwa sgab pa/mar lam pa/byang ngos pa/lha 'dul pa bcas dang /7gong sa 7sku breng bcu bzhi pa chen bo mchogo nas 107༷ 'ephar 90

gnya' nang thong dang /rgan bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/rgyal srid thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i rjes rdzong gzhis gzhung 'dzin bum pa gsib blug gi lam sgol gsar gtod gnang ste/thong dpon skya ser gnyis re bsgo gtong gnang rgyur gtan 'bebs kyis dang bo rtse drung ye shes lhun grub dang shod drung sgo mo gzhon tshang gnyis nas lo gsum las 'khur gnang / de rjes rtse drung tar khang zhabs sdod mkhyen rab bstan skyong dang sgod drung lding yon gnyis mngags bathongs gnang /khong gnyis ni dus 'gyur ma byung gong gi rdzong dpon tha ma yin zhing / rdzong gzhis gnyis kyi steng tshwa sho dang rten bzhengs pa/dngul sdud pa sku gas gzhung gi sku tshab gzhan khag kyang las don nges can thog mngags brdzong gnang zhin yod par mi mang nas skyel 'dren dang thab g.yog sogs khral rgyugs zhu dgos yod/2)rten bzhengs pa dang zhor 'phros rgya bla ma'i skor/rten bzhengs pas ni 'o1 gnangs 'char la bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum la dbu dkar na bza' dang mchod sgrin sna lnga stong tshar re 'bul dgos pa'i thog bod gzhung nas bal yul rgyal po la 'tshams rtags 'bul rgyu dang /bal snam tshwa bcas bal yul gyi thon thog dang brje res byed lam yod pas ma zad/ 7gong sa mchog gi ljags smin bzhes 'bras dang / pho brang po tā la dang nor bu gling ga /gtsug lag khang bcas pa'i gzim sgo dang sge'u khung gi khra 91

yol rgyu cha/ mdzod sgo khag la gnang sbyin kha btags rgya zam cob ras tsan dan dkar dmar dang na gi/dri bsangs/a ru/se rtog/spos dkar sogs kyi sman rdzas gtso gyur gzhung gi mkho thog sna tshogs sgrub 'bul dgos kyin yod/gnas 'og tshe dbang rdo rje lags su bka' 'dri zhus par khong gis 'grel brjod gnang don/ rten bzhengs pa sku 'khor bal yul rgyal sar phebs skabs bzhugs gnas dang / mal chas/ sa gdan/ me zhing / phebs 'khor/ sku srung bcas cha tshang bal yul gzhung nas go sgrig 'thus tshang gnang srol 'dug /pho brang sogs kyi khra yol dang / sham bu/ kha btags bcas ras cha'i thugs mkho rnams bal mo brgya brag gis ched mngags thag sgrun dus yun zla drug tsam 'gor gyin yod pa dang / lo ltar bal yul du 'thag skrun byed pa'i lam srol ni bal bza' khri btsun gyi sku dus nas dar rgyun yod par grags/rten bzhengs pa sku 'khor mtshams re skyid grong dang / mtshams re gnya' nang brgyud nas phebs kyin yod/ gnya' nang pa'i phyogs nas gnas 'og khyim tshang gis skad bsgyur zhu dgos par khral rkang gcig gi chag yangs yod pa ltar tshe dbang rdo rje lags nas skad bsgyur thengs 'ga' shas zhus 'dugabal yul nang las mjug bsgril nas phyir log skabs ljags smin bzhes 'bras dang /sman sna/ras cha sogs mi khal caXskyid grong dang /rdzoXganya' nang brgyud nas 'or 'dren byed/ gnya' skyid gnyis kyi sa mtshams bar do bo 92

gnya' nang rdzong dang /rgan bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/1༷༷re rtsis khyon mi khal 2༷༷tham pa'i skyel mi bal yul gzhung rkyang nas go sgrog byed pa ma zad/ snga dus rten bzhengs pa sku 'khor dang dngos thog yongs rdzogs sa mtshams bar skor srung bas skyel sgrol zhu 〈snal sku(da kyang / dus 'gyur gyi mtshams su rten bzhengs pa tha ma phyag nang ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi skabs mi khal 2༷༷tham pa bal gzhung gis go sgrig rgyu'i tshab tu dngul rkyang gnang ste/ do skyel mi 'gro go sgrig byed sgo cha tshang rang khongs nas 'gan len byed dgos byung 'dugamachod rten bya rung kha sgor gyi gnas 'dzin rgya bla mar bod gzhung nas 'pha re'i phogs thob bod tshwa pham ('bo las cung zad chung ba'i gzhal stod ) bdun re gnya' nang rdzong nas gnang 〈snal skusgod pa gasku la ras zhu sgo yul mir mngags nas mtshams re rten bzhengs pa'i sku chas kyi mnyam du mi gla zur du glas nas gtong 〈snal 'dugargya bla ma zhes pa'i ming ni/1677lor bsgo bzhag gnang pa'i gnas 'dzin ta yi po zhing (13190 561 baḥ) zhu ba rnying ma'i bla ma rgya rigs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis thogs 'dug khong 1673 'o ra bal yul nang gnas mjal du phebs te gor bod dmag 'khrug gi chings yig 'jog pa'i skabs skad sgyur gyi gras zhig yin pa dang /bod gzhung nas mchod rten bya rung kha sgor gyi gnas 'dzin du bsko bzhag gnang rjes bal rgyal dzaṅga bha dur ra na zhu bas gzigs 93

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/mthong chen po gnang ste/ rang nyid la chung ma'am btsun mo zur ma mang po skusnad pa de gas gcig gi bu mo mna' mar sbrad de mchod rten gyi mtha' 'khor dang yol yo sogs su sa cha rgya chen mchod rten gyi dkor khongs su stsal rgya rigs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas bal 〈sna rnams kyis ci na bla ma (zhu'i ba 67bam)zhes 'asngaphad mabesna tshugs 'dugargya bla ma ta yi po snang gshegs pa'i rjes su khong gi sras bhu dha badzra (75775373373)gnas 'dzin du ba〈sna bzhag stsal 'dug1070lo'i gnas 'dzin las thog rgya bla ma buzhe badzra (95 bkro 8pa/ 12)zhu ba de mi thog gsum pa yin zhing / khong gis bod mi skyabs bcol ba rnams la phan grogs gang sku nga gnang yod par ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dugadaga' bzhi pa'i rnam thar nang snga dus bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha sgor dang / 'phags pa zhing kun rnam gnyis kyi gnas 'dzin bod gzhung nas bsgo gtong gnang srol yod pa ltar phyi lo 1741 lor gor bod dmag 'khrug 'og bka' blon dga' bzhi pa'am rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor dang /g.yu thog bkris don grub can bal gzhung gi do dam 'og bzhugs pa'i skabs mchod rten bya rung kha sgor gyi sku mdun du lo mang gong bod gzhung gis brtsigs pa dga' ldan khang gsar zer ba rdza phag zhe gcig gi khang khyim che legs gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi lha khang dang bcas pa zhig yod pa'i sgor yang bris 'dug /sa 94

gnya' nang rdzong dang /rgan wa sku gas yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/phag gi khang pa che legs de ni ma bya rdzi ma'i lha khang gi mdun du yod/ dus phyis gnas 'dzin rgya bla ma'i ma khang yin pa dang / de'i g.yas su gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi lha khang zhig skusnad pa 2༷༷4'o ra bzhigs nas gsar bzhengs byas 'dug3)dngul sdud pa ni/phyi lo 1674zla 3tshes 1/nyin gor bod dbar chings yig don tshan bcu 'jog dgos byung ba'i 'bru don me lug 1767 lor gor bod dmag 'khrug sngon ma'i skabs rdzong sgo gnya' skyid rong gsum sgor ba'i blu rin lta bur bod nas bal bor 'e bstar bo ra ṭam sum 〈snang re gtan 'jigs 〈snad rgyu dang bod kyi sa cha beshang gsal the da 〈snags la rtsis 1snad bya rgyu sku gas 'kho da sku(da pa ltar/dor shugs chings dngul sprod dmigs stod khul du ma rtsa ṭam dkar zur 'dzugs skyed thog nas gor ṭam le bsgyur byas te ding ri dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon ngo tshab zhal ngo zhig dang las rogs nas bal yul du sprod par bskyod dgos pa de la zer gyin yod cing / chings dngul de dag 167ca nas bzung bod la dus 'gyur ma byung bar mi lo brgya lhag ring lo ltar sprod dgos byung zhing / dngul sdud pa cas las gnya' nang brgyud 'grul bzhud byed par bal yul du sa sna lam rgyus cha tshang tshong 'dus pas zhu dgos yod/ 95

bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs 'don thengs bcu bzhi pa'i nang / gor shugs chings dngul bsdu deb kyi kha byang du/ 'byung po kha 'gog byed du sgrod pa'i chings dngul ma 'grems bsdu gzhung 7 zhes 'khod skor gsal 'dug/dngul ṭam gyi grangs tshad thad gong gsal deb nang gsum stong gsal yang / tshong 'dus kyi rgan po tshe dbang rdo rje lags nas dngul sdud pa'i kha pa'i las 'khur zhu myong yod pa ltar khong gis gor /ma lnga stong re yod pa'i do po bzhi la khyon gor ṭam khri gnyis yin tshul gsungs kyin 'dug pa de ni gor ṭam rkyang pa min nam snyam/ besnar ṭam la rkyang pa dang /sbrags sam a lad ces rigs gnyis skusnad pa nas sbrags la sgomar gcig dang /rkyang par sgor byed mar ngos 'dzin byed/ mkhas dbang sku zhabs 〈 sna ha gran 27 10ba yarmukhrurngub gyisabris pa so ba la'iXs ba67071ba 'i 5177774 zhes pa'i nang du'ang chings dngul gyi grangs tshad bal sgor tshig khri yin pa 'khod 'dug4)tshwa sho ni/rgya khyab tu tshwa dang / bal/ pags rigs ja bcas kyi sgo khral bsdu dam byed mkhan la zer zhing / gnya' nang du sgo khral bsdu mkhan ni yan chod steng dkar nas yong sgol yod/yan steng tshwa she'i dmigs bsal las 'gan ni/bod stod 96

gnya' nang rdzong dang /rgan po sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/khul nas bal yul la 'gro ba'i tshwa dang / lug gi 'gag sgo'i tshong khral bsdu len byed rgyu de yin par 'dug7)gon bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs gnas stangs ni/grong tsho so so'i mi 'bor la gzhig pa'i bkod sgrig yod pa ltar dar rgyas gling sogs gnya' nang stod kyi grong tsho phal che bar rgan po re zung yod pa dang / sa mtshams 〈snang gseb khag gi ched du 'gram gzhis gnyer zer ba zhig bskosna 'dzugs kyis yul so so'i lta rtog gam khral 'ul skul 'ded rgan 'thus dang gzhis gnyer gyis byed srol yod/tshong 'dus kyi mi 'bor ni gtan sdod tho gzhung nang bod mi sgo them 242yod ba dang /bal rigs cwa lisi ko ṭi zhes them grangs rdzoX yod/de dag gi sgrig 'dzugs chags stangs rdzong dbon gnyis kyi 'og tu rgan 'thus bcu gnyis dang / las drung gcig sa pa gcig /zung lag zhes lan brda skyel mi bzhi/ dus chen khag la khrung zhu ma rgan pa gnyis dang gzhon pa gnyis bcas bzhi/sngo khrims do dam pa bzhi/gnya' nang sha ra zhes gzhon pa'i sgrig 'dzugs/tshes bcu pa'i sgrig 'dzugs/lha mo'i skyid sdug/bal bo sbyi ba'i sgrig 'dzugs/kha tshar ba'i smyung gnas skyid sdug /lha khang gsar rnying gi sku gnyer ngo las/97

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/yul mi sbyi ba'i phyugs brdzi gsum bcas yod/phyi lo 1670lor rgan 'thus kyi gras su rdo legs kun bzang dang /jo jo tshe ring rdo rje/ko gnas dngos grub ldo rje/gnas 'og tshe dbang rdo rje/bur sras pa ja dpon lags dang bu rig 'dzin su lcogs/ gnas steng jo lags nor rgyas/ ka sgo bkris/gnas mgon po/gnas dbyangs padma rdo rje/snung 'dus byang pa'am bsus tshang rnam rgyal the rje/ 55 khu ngag dbang dpal ldan nam bkras khang rnam rgyal rdo rje/mig dmar don grub bcas sku da pa de dag nas 'o ltar gon nge gnyis kyis bzhugs res zhes pa'i ming gnas 〈snag rnam kun las rigs sna tshogs kyi 'gan 'khur zhu dbosnas skusnad/ca)las drung gi 'khur 'gan ni/sgo khang du rdzong dpon gnyis la yig 'bri'i las rogs zhu dgos/ phyi lo 107 lo'i las thog las drung ko gnas dngos grub rdo rje dang /kha pa'i las 'gan gnas 'og tshe dbang rdo rje nas zhus yod/kha pa'i las 'gan gtso bo 3 rten bzhengs pa dang / dngul sdud pa sogs bal yul du 'gro ba'i skad bsgyur byed dgos/ lha khang gsar pa'i sku gnyer rdar pa'i 'phrin las dang / dge bshes lags zhu ba zhig yod/ yul spyi'i phyugs rdzi ni a jo dbang bo dang tshe sgrub bza' mi gnyis bcas mi gsum gyis byas te ston daphyid dbyar gsum 98

gnya' nang rdzong dang /rgan bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/du sgo phyugs yongs rdzogs ri mgor 'tsho ba'i lam srol yod/7)sngo khrims pa ni/rgyan rgyag gis bsgo 'dzugs byed/ las 'gan gtso bo zla re yul sa zhes khyim dud yongs nas zhal 'debs zhus te char chu dus su 'bab pa dang /nad mug khrug rtsod bzlog thabs ched pho mo rta ri dang / a ma spo ldog ma/ a ma phyag 'tshal sgrol ma zhes yul lha gnas pa'i brag phong chen po gsum la zla re gsol mchod byed pa dang / zhing chu 'dren gtong res pos go rim bsgrig rgyu/khyim tshang gang zhig gis rang gi bang rim min bzhin du zhing chu lkog khrid byas rigs dang / tshong pa'i g.yag dang lug /rta drel/ gtan sdod mi mang gi sgo phyugs sogs kyis zhing sar 'dzul nas lo tog za ba dang / rnyog rigs byung na rdzo khrims gtong rgyu/ gzhan yang tshong rigs khag nas zhal 'debs zhus te drug pa'i tshes bzhi dang / dga' ldan lnga mchod gnyis la tshes bcu dang / smyung gnas kyi rgyu gron gra sgrig zhu rgyu bcas yin/ tshes bcu'i grol ston nyin rgan po rnam pa'ang gdan zhu byas te gsol tshigs gzab rgyas 'bul srol yod//)zung lag gi las 'gan ni/grong khyer nang mi mang gi tshogs 'du bsgong tshogs dgos pa'i skabs bzhugs

res gon 'thus kyi ngag bkod ltar lan brda byed rgya de red/ das 'gyar ma ༄ ༄ ༄byung tsam du zung lag bu khrid dang /ming khra/dam chos bcas nas dud pa gnam slong do dgong sgo khang du 'dzoms shog gsung gi 'dug go/'dug go/zhes skad 'bod shugs che brgyab kyin grong khyer bsgor ba byed pa dran/3)khrung zhu ma'i las 'gan ni/gzhung 'brel mdzad sgo dang yul sbyi'i dus chen khag la rten 'brel gyi lam srol cha lag tshang ba'i sgo nas glu gzhas gtong bzhin pa'i ngang mchod chang 'degs 'bul zhu rgyu de yin zhing / dus 'gyur ma byung tsam gyi khyung zhu ma gon pa gnyis ni/ lding dpal yo dang sbang dbyangs can gnyis yin pa dang / gzhon pa gnyis ni bud med na gzhon rnams kyis 'khor res byed sgol yod/ a lcags dbyangs can dang dpal mosna gnyis nas gzhas dang zhabs dre khungs dag shes kyin sku da pa ltar khrung zhu ma gzhon pa snga rjes rim pa mang por slob khrid byas te ngos kyi pha ma'i mi thog gi tshong 'dus pa bud med mang pos gzhas dang zhabs sdus khungs ldan shes kyin sku1da par grags/10)tshong 'dus zha ra'am shar pho'i sgrig 'dzugs ni/spyoḥ bal bod dmag 'khrug gi rjes su byung ba zhig yin tshod red/las 'gan gtso

gnya' nang rdzong dang /rgan bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/bo lo ltar dngul sdud pa'i dngul ṭam do khal dang / rten bzhengs pa'i tshwa dang bal snam/sman sna sku gas bal yul bar skyel sgrol byed dbortes pa ma zad/slar bal yul nas bod gzhung gi mkho rdzas 'or 'dren gyi khral rgyugs byed dgos sku da/ gzhang khral de ni tshong 'das kyi skyes pa lo na bco brgyad yan chod nas ༄ ༄drug cu man chod la 'khris pa zhig red/ khe phan gcig nyid yod pa de ni/ sa mtshams 'gram nas stong 'dus bar gyi rgya bal tshong thog gang sku da tshong 'dus sha ra bas ma gtogs 'or 'dren mi chog pa dang / gal te gzhan pas 'or 'dren byed dgos na sha ra'i sgrig 'dzugs nas bka' 'khrol zhu dgos kyin yod/ sha ra rgan rabs rnams ni rgyun du kha 'grigs po dang / gcig phan gcig grogs kyi zhus pa chen po yin par grags/11)35sa bcu pa/tshong 'dus kyi tshes bcu pa rnams ni dpe cha klog 'don bzang po dang / mchod pa bzo bzhengs byed rgyur lag rtsal bde po/ yar ngo mar lnga'i tshes bcu'i tshogs 'khor sogs kyi zhal 'don dang / dung rgya rnga rol gyi gdangs dbyangs snyan po skusnad par grags/ sbyan ras gzigs yi ge drug ma'i gasku la 'debs sgrub thabs dang / dkon mchog sbyi 'dus kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin gter sbyin/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub bam/ byang gter cho go sbyi 'gro'i 101

re:rshadi 'ji 65 zug/bzugathagang/gnya' nang 'dus pa' bya rgya /sman thabs nor bu'i khra tshom sogs kyi nyams len cha lag tshang la brjod pa gtsang ba'i cho ga rgyas spros chen po 'di 'dra stod khul mi nag gi tshes bcu'i sgrig 'dzugs gzhan la med par bshad/tshes bcu pa'i rdo rje slob dpon de snga a jo mthu stobs zhu ba zhig byung ba dang / khong 'das pa'i rjes su rdo legs pa'i jo lags kun bzang nas gnang /rdo rje slob dpon khri 'don ma byas gong bsnyen pa mang po skyel dgos/ 177/g.yas gaskusnan gyi tshes bcu pa rgan gas su rdo legs kun bzang dang / gnas steng jo lags/ gnas 'og jo lags dgra 'dul/ ko gnas dngos grub rdo rje/gnas dbyangs padma rdo rje/gnas mgon po/spang gu ru/a jo zla zur/a jo tshe brtan/ chu 'og skal bzang / a jo ri log /'od bsam dga' rab/ phreng gon dben chung / a jo pa sangs bkris bcas pa'i thog phyis su rdo legs dbang rgyal dang / gnas 'og tshe dbang rdo rje/ bur sras pa rig 'dzin rdo rje sogs na gzhon 'ga' shas kyang 'dzul zhugs byas te khyon mi grangs bco brgyad tsam byung 'dugatshes bcu pa mang che ba ni cho ga 〈snal mtshams phran bu chang gis bzi nas chos kyi tshig don bgro gleng la dga' mos byed/rdo legs pa kun bzang nas rdo rje slob dpon ma gnang gong tshes bcu pa chang gis bzi nas mkhar rnga dung tshod 10lha ma shes par rnga pags hral pa dang tshogs mchod phul ba'i skabs 'khyar 'khyor

gnya' nang rdzong dang /gon po sku gas yal mi'i sgrig 'dzags/ra ra byed ba sogs dgod bro ba'i lo rgyus mang po sgod rgyu 'dug12)lha mo ba/gnya' nang pas lha mo bar ma ṇi ba zhes 'bod pa de ni 'khrab gzhung 'byungs rdzogs chos la bskul ba'i gnad don dang 'brel ba des yin par snyam/ tshong 'dus kyi lha mo ba'i 'khrab gzhung dge gon gtso bo chu thag pa'i a zhang gra pa dbang phyug gis byas te gzhan rnams la slob sbyong gang legs sprad skusnad par bshad/ phyi lo 1070 lor 'khrab gzhung dge gon tshe ring pa sangs dang /'khrab khyer dge rgan khyi ra'i 'gyur med/ de rjes dge gon 'ba' skyog phur bu bkris/tshogs mi zla ba bkris/pad ma skusgom skusnam/a khu zla ba/blo bzang skusnan tan/daskasnan mchog spang leb/rdo legs dben chung /casnad gsal snang pa 'jam dbyangs/ tshe sgrub/ chu thog tshe ring rdo rje/ 'ba' skyog bsod nams rgyal po/'ba' skyog tshe dbang / rnyed pa pa sangs/ zla ba bkris kyi bu ngag dbang ldo rje bcas yod/ 'khrab gzhung gi khongs su 'gro ba bzang mo dang / chos rgyal nor bzang / snang sa 'od 'bum/ dri med kun ldan bcas lo re nyin gsum ring 'khrab ston byed pa 'di'i sgor le tshan bcu gcig par gsal yod/ tshe ring pa sangs 'khrab gzhung hre nga mkhas bo skusnad pa dang / a khu 'ba' skyog ni 'khrab bzo dod po/khyi ra'i 'gyur med skad bzang mthon bo/zla ba bkris bstan bzhig sproX

tsha po/ chu thog pas yid 'phrog dang 'gro ba bzang mo'i chas gos gyon skabs bud med na gzhon gyi nyams 'gyur ldan ba/ blo bzang yon tan gyis spre'u 'khrab nas thang dkyil du zhing sdong ring po bzhi lnga mthud brgyab ste bslangs pa'i rtse mor 'dzegs nas/ lus rtsal sna tshogs kyi zhing rtsed la dpa' rtsal dod bo yod par yul mi tshos dga' bo byas pa dran/13)khral dang ñtsa lagatshong 'dus kyi khral ni/ gnas bo steng la khral rkang gnyis/ ko gnas la rkang gnyis/ gnas ca(ga la rkang gnyis/ ka lha 'am kha che gnas wabyur rkang gnyis/gnas dbyangs la rkang gnyis/ gnas mabesnan 〈sna la rkang gcig /bur sras pa'am tshe ring bu khrid la rkang gcig dang phyed/ rdo legs par rkang gcigathugs rje lha khang la rkang gcig /jo jo bar rkang gcig /kun gling rtsar rkang gcig/byang pa la rkang gcigakhral 'gag rnying par rkang byed/ldo legs dben chung la rkang gcig/'ba' skyog gnas bor rkang byed/khral dben chung rkang byed/'jo dpal 'dzoms rkang gcig /tshe ring rkang gcig /tsong pad ma rkang gcigardzong dga' ba rkang gcig dang bzhi cha gcig /lo lo rkang gcig /chu steng rkang gnyis/chu 'og rkang gnyis/chu thag a spe rkang gcig dang drug cha gcig/spen pa grung ril rkang gcig khyi ra dga' rab rkang phyed/ khyi ra 'gyur med rkang byed/104

gnya' nang rdzong dang /rgan bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/a ma nad rkang byed/ zhing srung ba rkang byed/ ji spen sgron rkang gcig /lhag pa sbas choso rkang phyed/ shag rtsa skal bzang rkang byed/ mkhar steng a nee rkang byed/rta mgrin dgu ri rkang gcig /sbya ri lhag pa rkang gcig /spang gu ru rkang gcigardo legs dbang rgyal rkang gcig/mkhar steng rkang gcig/mkhar steng spen chung rkang gcig /spang dbyangs can rkang gcig /chos 'dzin dbang yo rkang byed/ lce lce pa sangs rkang gcig /ngag dbang skal bzang rkang byed/ mang rgyal rug pa rkang gcig bcas kyi thog rjes su tshong rigs khag cig kyang gsar du bcug ste mang tshang lha dang / mang rnam rgyal sogs nas rkang phyed ka re 'khur dgos chags yod pa dang de thog khyim dud nyis brgya drug cu re gnyis sgor yod par rnam kun dud pa gnam slong zhes rdzong gi chu ma dang / gad pa sogs kyi khral rgyugs bya dgos pa ma zad/nyal cha dang /'gram skyel/tshogs skyel/rdzong skyel/thab gasku1ga/g.yag gasku1ga/rta skul/rta 11ga themags khral sna mang dag gatherto wa( tshong 'dus kyi khral pa rnams nas rgyugs dgos par rgan po las thog gnyis nas nyin tho bkod de/lo ltar lo tog bsdu 'god skabs rtsis rgyag ces gnya' nang stod dang / bar tshigs/ 'gram bcas pa'i mi 'thus rnams tshong 'dus su yong nas bdun gcig tsam rtsis rgyag byas rjes khral 'ul 'phar rgyug byas rigs la dngul gyi slog cha byed srol yod par tshong 'dus pa rnams kyis zlu gzhas bzos te/ /'du 'god rtsis rgyag zin song / /byung song kha 'thab tshar 105

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/song //gnya' nang stod pa'i rgan bo/brdzi khug khyer nas log song //zhes gtong srol dar 'dug /'on kyang 102༷ yas mas su rdzong dpon lkog grong dang 'bangs mi'i dbar rnyog rtsod byung rjes dngul gyi slog cha gang yod kha mchu'i 'gro gron gyi skyin tshab tu btang ste tshong 'dus pas khral 'ul 'phar rgyugs byas pa'i gun gsab mang tshogs la bgos 'grems bya rgyu byung mi 'dug14)rdzong dbon lkog grong dang mi ser dbar gyi rtsod rnyog skor/ri bo thos nas mi 'grang /rgya mtsho btungs nas mi ngoms pa'i dbe ltar/rdzong dpon lkog grong nas sngar med 'ul lag dang dpya khral 'phar ma gsar btod kyis mi mang nyam chung la ngal rtsol skul 'ded tshod med byas par khral pa mang therdogs nas bde sdug snyan gsan ji ltar zhus kyang / gsan bzhes gnang rgyu'i tshab tu re re bzhin nyes rdung gtong rkyang byas pas ma tshad/ nyin gcig tshong 'dus sha ra gon gras bzhi sgo khang du bkug nas/ 'khor mo che'i phyi sgo brgyab ste sngar lam bzhin nyes rdung gtong bzhin pa'i skabs zha ra ba byings gzhis bzod sgom ma thub par phyi sgo sta res bshags nas nang du 'dzul/ 'ur sgrog dang bcas lhan rgyas khang las khungs su 'tshangs te/ rgyal 〈sna tshe ring zer ba'i sha ra bas sde pa 〈snag 〈snang gi sba 〈snag nas bzung ste gdan khri las phabs nas sa la drud/ sgo khang du yod pa'i dpon g.yog tshang mar blo kha chims ba'i 106

gnya' nang rdzong dang /rgan bo sogs yul mi'i sgrig 'dzugs/nyes dung btang rjes phyir thon ma bcug par rgyal sgo brgyab nas srung bya byas kyang / de'i mtshan mor sde pa lkog grong shar gyi gsang spyod nas mchongs te/gnya' nang pa rgyal bo lag ril zer bas lam rgyus kyis gtsang chu brgal nas dwags grong tshor bros/ zla ba gcig gi rjes lha sar 'byor te mi mang gis ngo log byas tshul gong rim la snyan gsan zhus bsdun gnya' nang mi mang gi 'thus mi 'phral bcar dgos sgor lha sa nas gzhung gi 'gug rgya phebs/bka' dgongs bzhin gnas steng jo lags nor rgyas dang / bur sras pa'i bu bkris/ gnas 'og jo lags dgra 'dul bcas mi mang gi 'thus mi gsum g.yog bo chabs sbrags dza drags ngang thon/ lha sar 'byor nas bka' zhag tu snyan gsan zhus 'phral sngar gyi khrims srol gzhir bzung 'byor lcag phogakhrims zhib byed mgo tshugs nas dus yun gang 'tshams song rjes sde pa lkog grong skyid chur lcebs nas rang thi brgyab ste/ mi 'thus gsum gyod ya med par lha sar yun ring sdod dgos byung /'gro gron rdzogs nas bzhon rta dang ca dngos kyang btsong dgos byung mthar bur sras pa'i bu bkra zhis tshong dpon 'jam dbyangs kyis khrid nas sngon du phyir log byas/ 'thus mi gzhan gnyis dang g.yog po bcas du lung grong tsho bar gom bgrod kyis phyir log byed dgos pa'i dka' ngal byung 'dug kyang / gnya' nang gi khral pa rnams la lo gcig lhag tsam khral dang 'ul lag rgyugs ma dgos pa'i khe phan byung 'dug pa'i lo 107

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/rgyus 'di bzhin lo mang gong lo lo bkra zhis rdo rje lags su khong gi a ma tshe lhas gang dran du gsungs pa tshig thor bkod de gnang son byung ba bcas so//

le tshan lnga pa/gnya' nang yul mi'i gzhis spyod dang zas gos spyod stangs sgor/1)yul mi'i gzhis spyod/spyir gnya' nang gi mi rnams ni gzhis rgyud 'jam la chos dad che ba dang /rgyun du sems bag sgo la/ rang gi 'tsho thabs la brtson 'grus kyang mi sgod pa yod par grags/de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i mgur ma'i nang /yul gnya' nang lung nag zer lags kyang / /mi ni ma bcos sngon gyi mi//gtam ni ma bcos drang por smra/ /spyod pa ma bcos sgod sgod po/ /bza' btung gi zas la khong cag yangs/ nga rnal 'byor gyi shes pa de na bde/ /'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba de na nyung / /mnyam bzhag gi ting 'dzin de na 'phel/ /de phyir gnya' nang phyogs su 'gro//zhes gsungs pa ma zad/skyabs mgon zhabs dkar chen pos kyang la phyir le gsum bzhugs nas 'a〈sna don rgya che mdzad pa'i mthar dbyas gtsang du phebs khar yon bdag rnams la blang dor snying gtam dbyangs su blangs pa'i mgur ma'i nang /yul brin dang mtsho gzham gnya' nang pa'i//mi sgom chung sems dkar chos dad che/ mi ngas kyang la phyir sdod ring la/ /kun cang tshe blo kha choso la bsgyur//choso byed mkhan the po mang wabyu byung //de bsam na 109

skal pa bzang ngo snyam//nged yon mchod brtse gdang che ra song //zhag mang por ༄ ༄lhan du sdod pa lags/ /da 'gro khar 'bral glags mi phod rung / /mig mchi ma gtong bzhin 'bral dgos byung / /kun 'di bzhin brtse gdung ma 'gyur na/ /nga thag ring yul du song na yang / /dngos nyams dang mi lam gnas skabs su//dus da dung mjal 'o1 dad can tsho/ /phal che bas da nas mi mjal yang tshe phyi mar mjal ba'i 1snan lam 'debs/ /ngas 'a〈sna khar smras pa'i snying gtam 'di/ khyed kun gyis ma brjed sems la zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar sbyir gnya' nang yul mi rnams sems dkar 〈snam chung cho sa dad chen 〈sna yin pa dang / bye brag snung 'dus pa rnams ni rgyun gtan snang ba skyid la/ dran rgyu rgod cing / rang mnyam lhan du 'dzoms pa'i skabs phan tshun ming 'dogs byed res dang / ku re smra ba ni tshong 'dus pa rnams kyi thun yong ma yin pa'i khyad chos zhig yin pa ltar lung pa'i nang ming 'dogs sam/ ming ngan med pa'i mi ni ha lam gcig kyang med tshod red/ 'on kyang gon gas phal che ba ni sgrung dang /gtam dbe sogs sngar gyi lo rgyus sgod rgyur mkhas po yod pa de tshor lo na gzhon pa tshos dang po'i mi zhes gus zhen chen po byed/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bzang zhan ji ltar yang / skyes stobs kyi shes rab yangs zhing / pho mo su yin yang skad cha sgod mkhas bo dang / sbyang grung 'dzoms la thabs shes kyang gzab 110 po yin par grags/

gnya' nang yal mi'i gshes spyod dang zas gos spyod stongs sgor/༄lhag par bud med rnams ni blo gros che zhing 'pher sha yang dod po yod par brten/gnya' nang pa'i kha rgyun du/mang mkhan rug pa sha las zhim//tshong 'dus bu mo bu las lhag /ces sgod rgyun yod/ mang mkhan dang rug pa zer ba ni khul de'i ri skyes sngo tshal red/ 'ga' shas kyis gya tshom gyi tshul du/ mang mkhan rug pa sha las zhim/ /tshong 'dus bu mo bu las lhag /nya le byung na khyi las sdugaces kyang sgod rgyun skusnad/3)rgyan gos/gnya' nang pa spyi dang / lhag par tshong 'dus kyi mi rnams rgyun du gtsang sbra che la/ grung sha dod cing / rgyan gos thon gsar gyi rigs la do snang chen bo byed/gtsang dang 〈snad khul gyi yul mi sbyi mtshungs bud med rnams kyis lag pa g.yas la dung dkar ram yang na dung lhag zer ba dung gi cha shas re gyon pa dang /rna mchog la g.yu byur dpyang ba/mdun du pang gdan/rgyab la skod dkris zer ba'i rgyab gdan dang /rkang par 'ja' sgrig can gyi zom pa bcas gyon pa'i thog mang che bas skra'i lcang 'phar lhas ma gnyis su byas par kha dog sna mang gi skra zhug bsgar ba'i besnams 11la skudod/ gzab 1snas kyi skabs 'ga' shas kyis gtsang mo'i spa sgor dang / phyis su nyung shas kyis dbus mo'i sba zug zur gsum thog e kor dang sko phreng bcas gyon/sba phrug med pa tshos zhwa yo tshe ring 111

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams ba/skyib khebs gyon/ grong drag gi bud med phal che bas gser gyi ga'u bzo dbyibs gru bzhi thon rnying gi gras dang / 'ga' res lha sa nas gsar thon bzo dbyibs gru zur can gyi thog khams phyogs nas thon pa'i ga'u 'bu ril chung chung de 'dra dang / 'ga' zhig gis dngul gyi ga'u g.yu rnying gi khra tshom byas pa de 'dra yang gyon srol yod/ bud med mang che bas rang rang gi 'byor 'khos la gzhigs pas ske la gzi zhags dang / g.yu byur/ sgos shel sogs rin bo che sna tshogs kyi phreng zhags 'dogs/ gzab spros skabs 'byor ldan rnams kyis byu pa gos chen nam/ ther ma/ yang na snam bu sogs legs nyes sna tshogs thog gru rtse dang tshos mdog sna tshogs kyi 'bu ras 'og mjug bcas gyon/rkang par 'ja' tshon gyi bkrag mdangs ldan pa'i ko zom dkyus ma dang / lhas ma mthil gnyis ma bcas 〈snan/ dmigs bsal do snang byed 'os pa zhig la bud med tshos rang gi sbang gdan dang smad gyon gyi rigs la tshos gzhi ser bo ni sangs rgyas kyi na bza'i kha dog tu ngos 'dzin gyis gyon ma dgos pa gtso 'don byed/skyes pa rnams kyis kyang skra ring po lhas pa'i sne sar skra gzhug dmar po'am nag bo gang rang bsgar zhing /zhwa yo phying zhwa dang /lhags zhwa/tshe ring skyin ༄khebs/yang na skyes sus lhas pa bcas 〈snan/rna mcho ga g.yas la g.yu gasku1na 112 la a long 'dogs pa'i thog/gzab spros skabs gru rtse'i 'og mjug dang /phyu

gnya' nang yul mi'i gzhis spyod dang zas gos spyod stangs skor/pa gos chen/zer ma/shog gru/phyi la gos chen dang 'go snam byas pa'i lhags tshag /dbus snam shad ma dang / gnya' nang rang du bzos pa'i snam bu'i phyu pa/de bzhin shur ma dang / shur brdzun/ 'ja' rtse lan par bcas rang rang 'byor 'khos la gzhigs pas 〈snan pa dang / gnya' nang pas dor ma la skal snam zer ba de ni rkang rnam sgra zur chag pa min nam snyam/ a mdo'i nang du'ang dor ma la rkang snam zer/ sngar yin na skyes pa mang che bas bod dor zhes snam bu'i dor ma rta kha gzhag pa de gras dang / rgya dor zhes sked par gong ba byas pa'i mdun du lteb tshigs gcig brgyab nas sko rags 'ching srol yod/phyis su phyi rgyal nas thon pa'i gos thung pa thu lun (23100ba/ zhes pa de gras kyang gyoni/ske rags ni mang che ba bal dang tshon khra sna tshogs kyi sring skud las btags pa ko thags zer ba leb leb dang /'bu ras dmar po dang gru rtse/yang na ras dkyus ma gang rung gis bzos pa sogs bed spyod byed/ rkang par bod lham sna tshogs dang /'jur rta yu ring bcas kyi thog/bo po mang che bas rgyun du gnya' nang rang du bzos pa'i ko zom gyon pa dang / rting ma'i rko mthil rdol pa'i skabs krad pa zer ko ba'i lhan pa yang yang rgyag sgol yod/3)'gram dang 〈snags gzham pa'i khyad choso/mtha' mtshams 〈snang gseb 'gram dang /cadags ga ma/lcal sna/spang /dbo|na 113

pa gsar pa/sgol bo sgang bcas kyi yul mi'i gyon chas ni/skyes pa tshos snam bu dkar po mtha' lcags nag po btang pa'i stod gyon phi rda zer ba re dang /sked par gor gri gzer srol yod/ bud med tshos snam bu'i phyu pa'i thog stod thung khra khra gyon zhing gser dngul gang rung gi a long 'dogs pa/ skra lcang lo lhas nas skra gzhug brgyab pa'i 〈snag 'ga' shas kyis mabe| la ras khra yang 〈snan pa 31gas kyi khyad cholo sku1da/4)bud med kyi 'byug rdzas/bod kyi bud med rnams kyis gdong la stod ja zhes pa'i 'byug rdzas thug po zhig byug srol yod pa ltar gnya' nang stod dang tshong 'dus pa'i bud med re 'gas kyang dgun dus stod ja byug pa de ni phal cher grang ngar las srung skyob zha mdangs gaskusna ba'i thabs lam zhig yin par 'dug /'ga' shas kyis ya ma'i na tshar khag 'asnga gas byas nas mdzes cha yin khul gdong la tshon mdog sna tshogs kyi ko yol sbyar ba ma zad/ bud med dang dod tshe ba tshos deng dus kyi dkar dmar 'byug rdzas kyang bed spyod byed par tshong 'dus pas ming ma shes par dkar dkar dmar dmar zhes 'bod kyin yod/ 'byug rdzas dmar po ni mkhur tshos la ma gtogs mchu tor byug 〈snal mi skusnang / gzhan yang gon byis tshang mas we si lin zhes pa'i sha gasku sa 'byug rdzas thon gsar gyi rigs 114

gnya' nang yul mi'i gzhis spyod dang zas gos spyod stangs sgor/kyang bed spyod byed pa de dag gi ming la sgal sman zhes zer/7)spyir btang za btung spyod stangs/tshong 'dus pa'i rgyun zas ni/ snga dro ja bsrubs ma dang / ja ldur/ yang na thug lhag /nyin gung sbags/ dgong dro 'bras bcas yin zhing / rtsam pa sne khag 'ga' shas sku1da pa ni/ sran rtsam dang / nas rtsam/ nas 'bru'i bsre lhad med par sran ma rkyang pa'i rtsam pa ser snga ming la ser nyag zer ba bcas 'jam rtsub legs zhan so sor dbye 'byed kyis sgye mo'i nang gnyer tshang du 'jog pa dang / nyin re'i bza' spyod kyi rtsam phor che chung so so'i nang blugs nas 'jog gi red/ khyim dud ji 'dra jig yin rung rang rang gi 'byor 'khos la gzhigs te ja bag chung dang /rdza ril/ja sob gang rung gi ja bsrubs ma dang /nag thang la phor mar blugs nas nyin gang bar mtshams yod tshad 'thung ba'i goms 〈snal sku da/yul mi tshos 'bras btsos pa la za ma zer/ lung pa'i thon khungs yag 〈snas sran ma yin par brten mang che bas sran ma dang nas 'bru mnyam bsres kyis 'thag pa'i rtsam pa ser tshub tshub zhig za gi red/ nyam chung 'byor med rnams la 'bras dkon par brten mang che bas sgon ḍi zer ba khre dang /a sgom tsam pas g.yos zan zhig la sbags ma za tshod dang phyur rul/ yang na da ra 115

sogs kyi mnyam du sur pan mang tsam btab nas za gi red/ gnya' nang pas phyur rul la zho sha zer/ rgyun zas kha spos kyi ched du snga dor rtsam 'gam dang /nyin gung g.yos zan sgon ḍi dang / bag leb/ mtshams rer bag tsha mar khu bcas za ba dang /dgong dro grod spug gam/bag zug/yang na rtsam thugakhre thugamar nan rtsam pa'i thug pa/ de bzhin mar gan 'bru ril rdzog nas pags pa bshus te bkol ba'i thug pa thi long zer ba sogs la zug rdor blug nas za btung byed/ zug dor la zha dang / phyur ba/ 'o ṭi zer ba'i sran ma bangos pa bcas bed ྅rtod byed/'gram dang / resnal wabyu sgang / dbe|na pa gsar pa sdusags mtha' mtshams yul mi rnams kyis rnam kun rang gi thon khungs mar rkan dang /zho khog /pon chag gam/khre/bra therto sdusags las gasku1sa pa'i sgo na ḍi (gzan gong )tshal rigs sna tshogs dang zho sha'i sbags ma bsres nas za rgyur dga' bo byed/ca)zhim zas/lo gsar dang / chang sa sogs sgo skyid kyi dus ston nam yin la sha mar zud gsum gyis gtsos rgya thug /yog mog dang / ka bab zer ba'i lug sha'i sbags ma/ ming sha dang / rgyu ma bangos pa bcas kyi thog /hū g.yang rtse zer ba pad tshal bsnyal ba'i grang tshal dang / la thug brnyal ba'i grang tshal/ de bzhin 116

gnya' nang yul mi'i gzhis spyod dang zas gos spyod stangs sgor/gling bu zhu shur zer ba'i zhing tog dang /bhan ta zer ba ṭo ma ṭo 'dra ba'i tshal la sur pan btabs pa'i dmar 'dur 'dra min khag gnyis bzo gi red/ zhim zas rigs gcig la sgog pa dang /g.yer ma/go stod/btsong /pho ril/jim bu/ li shi/ zhing mngar sogs sman sna bsres nas ha cang dro ba che la dri ma yang zhim po yod par bod sa gzhan nas yong ba'i mi rnams kyis tshong 'dus pa'i za ma la bsngags ba1snad mang po byed/7)11 35'i//sbags dang gasku1sa zan gang thos kyang tshang mar spags 'ded sbags mar tsher bangos pa dang / da ra/ sha jug /phyu rul/ sha rjen dmar 'dur/ming / sran chung /sha khya 'khyag pa'i mig sgrig 31gas kyi mnyam du 〈sna tshal gyi spags ma 'awabyul 'bol lhug lhug byas nas za rgyu yod/zho gog dang / la phug /nyung ma/ btsong /pad tshal/shang rtse 'am pad gang gi lo ma bcas ni khyim dud so sos nye 'khor du btab pa'i sngo tshal dang / ma btab par rang bzhin gyis skyes pa'i sngo tshal ser sha dang /sha mo/yog ro 'am chu sha/za tshod/tsho lo/mang mkhan/rug pa/lu sgog /go las/khug mag/sbi sgri nang ka to le/kho dmar/ri sgogago stod/gro ma/sne'u/smyug phrug /'dzim bu/lcam pa lha sa/god po rdo long sogs sngo tshal mang po grong khyer gyi nye 'khor du sgrug rgyu yod par brten dbyar kha'i ring phru gu tshos 117

gnya' nang snung 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/ri skyes sngo tshal 'thog rgyur dga' po byed pa ma zad/ rgyal po ser tog pa sogs ri skyes zhing tog mang po sgrug rgyu yod pa'i skor le tshan bdun pa'i nang du gsal sku1da//)gling ga'i zhim zas/lha mo 'khrab ston dang / gling gar 'gro ba'i skabs khya ra zer ba'i bag leb rgyab ra dang / grod pa kha tsha/ glo ba bangos pa/zho khog kha tsha bcas bzo gi red/tsong 'dus pas zho khog kha tsha la sga sag zer/de bzhin sbru 〉la zer ba'i sran ma chu btsos brgyab pa snum nang sga ser skusnags sman sna chabs sbrags balnga sa te sba ci'i mnyam du khyer srol yod/bal yul dang zhin tu nye la/bal rigs mi nyung ba zhig gtan sdod bya bzhin yod par brten yul mi tshos bal po'i sto chas sran chung nag bo rma se zer ba dang / ser po rmu su 'am rgya gar bas rda li zer ba de gras/de bzhin the1ma 〈snal zhes mar kun rtsam par bu ram bsres nas tshal slang nang skam bangos kyis g.yos pa zhig dang / sā rdu zer ba mar kun rtsam pa bangos pa bcas kyi rong zas spyi dang / lhag par bal po'i spru ci/ de'i mnyam du slong nga bsdos pa ni zhim zas kyi khongs su brtsi gi red/ mtshams rer rma na 'bog zer ba mar khu'i mnyam du gaskusnas zan bye ma ka ra mang po btab pa rgya gar bas ha lu ba zer ba de 'dra yang zhim zas su brtsis te za srol yod/118

0)sha rigs/spyir btang sha mar gnyis ka 'grog bas tshong 'grem byed kyang / rgyun du grong khyer gyi mtha' la ya bo'am bshan pa khyim dud 'ga' shas sbra gur phub nas sdod pa de dag gis lug sha khog stod dang /khog smad gang dgos nyin re bzhin sgo 'gram du skyel tshong byed kyi red/ lung pa'i nang g.yag sha dang / lug sha ma gtogs ba glang dang / nya phag bya gsum gyi sha dang ri dwags gna' ba dang rgo ba sogs kyi sha rigs za srol med/ g.yag dang lug gi sha yang gsod pa'i nyin mo nyin sha red ces za srol med/ sngar yin na tshang mas bya sha dang phag sha la sgrug gro chen bo byed/ 'ga' res lha sar za khang du kha lag gi nang bya de'i rkang hug thon pa'i gnas tshul ha cang skyug gro dang ya mtshan du byas nas bshad pa dran/bshan pa'i rigs dang ri dwags kyi sha za mkhan la mthong chung byed pa'i goms gzhis yod/pha spre gon byang chub sems dpa' dang ma brag srin gnyis las chad pa'i mi rgyud zhig yin phyin rigs rus la khyad par med nges kyang /bod du sde dpon mi drag gi bu drug dang / bla ma'i gdung rgyud rnams rigs rus mtho bar ngos 'dzin byed pa ni/ mi rnams kyi dad pa dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rim la brten nas byung ba zhig yin pa dang / bshan par rigs ngan brtsi srol ni/chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku dus nas dar ba zhig yin pa 119

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/de yang padma bka' thang gi le'u gya gnyis pa'i nang / sems can gsod la bzhan pa'i ming du btags/ /sdig glar mgo byin mi yi khyu nas phud/ /gral du sgo rgyab skas ma'i 'og tu bzhag /zas su 'bags lhag sgom du skyogs zhabs byin/ kha bsrungs gos bsrungs kun gyis skyug blo blta/ /sdig mkhan yin zer ris su bcad nas bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar thog mar mi rnams kyis sdig pa'i las la 'dzems thon byed pa'i thabs lam du dmigs pa zhig yin pa las/rigs rus mtho dma' dbye 'byed gnang ba zhig min par snyam/7)chang ragaganya' nang stod smad bar gsum du nas 'gru dang /khre/a sgom rtsam pa/'bras bcas las chang legs zhan sna tshogs dang / chang las a rag kyang 'beb kyi red/ a rag mang che ba ni bha ra smi si zer ba'i bal po'i sa cha nas 'or 'dren byed/ bha ra sbi si nas thon pa'i a rag la zhing mngar sogs sman sna phran bu blugs nas dmar mdangs cung zad yod par mi tshos ha cang dga' po byed/btsos zin pa'i chang ni sga ri zer ba'i rdza ma chen po'i nang du 'jog khyim tshang 'ga' shas kyis chang gi rdza ma bang bsgrigs te gnyer tshang nang bzhag nas/dgos rim bzhin glum rdza ma'i nang nas bton te/ thang sgog zer ba'i smyug slas kyi 'tshag stod nang btsags rjes chang stod dkar reg gi nang 'jog srol 120

gnya' nang yul mi'i gzhis spyod dang zas gos spyod stangs sgor/yod/lo gcig bsnyal ba'i chang ni lo chang zhes nying khu'i ro bcud gar po yod pa dang / de bzhin zla bar bsnyal ba'i zla chang dang zla ba 'ga' shas bsnyal ba'i chang zhim bo 'bol 'bol lhag lhug yod pa ltar/phyogs mtha' nas yong ba'i zhing 'grog mi sna khag gis tshong 'dus pa'i 'bras chang sing ma la rtsa mthong chen po byed/ a sgom tsam pa las btsos pa'i chang gi sbang glum la pho dkrog pas dkrog nas lhag lo zer ba'i chang thug pa 'dra bo zhig bzo ba de ni sgom pa sel ba dang grod pa 'grang ba'i yon tan gnyis ldan la brten rgyun du las mi rnams kyis dga' bo byed/pho dkrog pa zer ba ni smyug ma khru gang tsam gyi sne gcig la ku ru kha bcug pa'i yo chas zhig red/ 'grul bzhud skabs mar bsres pa'i ja la pho dkrog pa rgyab nas ja srubs ma zhim po bzo thub pa'i khyad chos kyang yod/ yul mi tshos 'bras chang gi zlum ni mar khu'i nang bangos te za ba dang /rgyur ba dang rtsam pa bsres nas chang skol yang 'thung sgol yod/11)za btung dang 'brel ba'i sgol rgyun/zas za skabs thog mar gon rim nas mgo btsugs nas 'dren pa 'di ni pha ma dang rgan rabs la brtsi bkur yod pa'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig red/ rgan rabs la za ma dang / ja chang drang ba'i skabs lag pa gnyis kyis 'bul dgos pa dang / su la'ang ja chang phyi lag byas nas sdug mi rung / sder ma dang 121

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/chang gi dngul phor/ yang na dkar yol ma gtogs rgyun du za btung gi phor pa ni rang rang so sor gtan 'bebs yod pa ltar/ phan tshun mi brje ba ma zad/phyi nas yong ba'i mgron por nang mi'i phor pa'i nang ja chang drang srol med/ nang du phyi mi yong mkhan byung tshad kha stong pa phyir log ma btang par/dkar yol gtsang ma'i nang ja chang gang rung nges par du 'deg pa de yang gang 'thung byed mi rigs par rtsis nas phor pa gnyis gsum re khu/tshugs kyis drang srol yod/gon rabs rnams nas/gang 'thung ni dgra la'ang ma byed ces sgod kyi red/nang mi gang zhig yul phyogs gzhan du thon pa'i skabs/ thon khar ja chang bstegs nas 'thung 'phros kyi phor pa slar yang bkang nas 'jog grol de ni 'grul pa las don lam ltongs kyis phyir 'khor yong ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa zhig yin par 'dug khyim mtshes dang dga' nye gang zhig yul phyogs gzhan du bskyod nas phyir 'khor skabs dkar reg gi nang du 'bras chang sing ma'am/ khog snyir nang ja bsus ma bkang nas de'i mchu tor tshon mdog bkra ba'i ja shog dmar po'am ser po/ yang na ljang khya gang rang gis me ༄tog gi sul bzos nas bsgar te skyel res byed pa'i goms srol yod/12)li rag zangs gsum gyi thab chas/122 tshong 'dus pas dgong dro'i za ma ni/'char can nyi ma zhub rir bzhud mtshams

gnya' nang yul mi'i gzhis spyod dang zas gos spyod snangs skor/su bzas te sa rub kyi gong du sder ma dang sto snod rnams ka chu'i g.yas gasku na du 'khyud bzhal byed/'bras kyi za ma lag pa kho nas za ba las zur ma bed spyod mi byed pa de ni yul mi'i thun yong ma yin pa'i goms gzhis zhig red/lag pas zas na blo ba che ba skusnad par bshad/khyim dud tshang mas li las bzos pa'i sder ma nyar tshag byed pa dang / rgyun du zangs dang rag las bzos pa'i stod chas rdigs dang / ka to ra/ pog zangs/ khog snyir/ sder ma/ rag shan brgyab pa'i dkar reg /las mo sogs g.ya' phyis brgyab nas bang khri'i steng du 'od mdangs dang bcas bsgrigs nas 'jog rgyur ha cang dang dod byed/ thab rka'i rtsig ngos la'ang nag rtsi dang tshon ris sna tshogs kyi dkar yol chag jug sbyar nas mdzes cha ston pa'i thog nor bu me 'bar 'bur bris su yod pa bcas phyis bdar yang nas yang du byas te snum zhag dod po bzo gi red/ khyim dud mang che bas nang du chu mdzod zangs stod chen po re dang / de'i gzhogs gcig la zangs dang rag gi chu skyogs mang bo thag skud kyi thog bang bsgrigs te dpyang srol yod/ yon chab dang nang gi 'thung chu ni lu ma zer ba'i chu mig nas bcus dgos pa ltar chu len ma bu mosna na gzhon rnams chu zom rgyab tu khyer te mnyam du 'dzoms nas glu gzhas gtong rgyu dang phan tshun skad cha sgod rgyur dga' po byed pa bcas so//dbyas la 'bras gzhongs la//'bras de yam bu'i 'bras red/123

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa//yam bu rgyal sa'i 'bras red//'bras chang ming ma phabs sa//dga' ba'i gnya' nang tshong 'dus/ /chung 'dris sang nyin byon na//snying gtam da ring sgod dang / /'gro kha la mo'i snying gtam//mid pa 'chus rogs yin 'gro//(sngar bal yul rgyal sa na man ḍū'i ming la yam bu zer )

le tshan drug pa/tshong 'dus pa'i 'tsho thabs skor cung zad gleng ba/tshong 'dus grong khyer nang rgyal sa lha sa nas mngags pa'i rdzong gzhis sgo pa shar nub dang / bal gzhung sku tshab ḍi ṣṭha ngo las kyis gtsos rgyun sdod bal po'i tshong pa mang po sku da pa'i thog bal bod rgyal khab gnyis kyi sa cha yas mas gang sa na mi sna mang po 'du 'dzom bya bzhin yod par brten/ tshong khang dang phyi khrom mang bo yod pa dang / rnam kun chang dang glu gzhas dar khyab che bas mi rnams kyis 'khrug cha dod po yod par ngos 'dzin byed/ rgyun gtan yul mi'i 'tsho thabs rnam pa sna tshogs sku da pa'i khongs nas gal gnad che ba 'ga' zhig bska|da pa gsham gsal/1)rong ྾ /yul mi mang che ba zhing pa yin yang / bza' 'bru'i thon khungs 'deng nges med par nye 'khor gnya' nang stod kyi grong gseb khag dang bal yul gyi rong pa'i lo tog la re dgos par brten yul mi khral pa mang che bas rong tshong shugs che rgyag gin sku da/bal yul gyi mtha' mtshams grong gseb lco sne sgang dang /ta 125

to pā ni/g.yer ma zhing /gdung sna/sbag sgang /dpa' bo dgon pa/yang la sgor/'jur sbug /'bog can/ sa glang dga' ri/ thang zhing / mar me/an tha li/sgra thang tha li/stang tha li/sgom thang /bha ra lha si/rkang glang /chang thing /gha ti sogs kyi zhing pa rnams kyis rang gi thon khungs 'bras dang /spra ci/ gro/a sgom/a sgom sba ci/sbrang rtsi/bu ram/sur pan/li dang a mā/tsha lu ma/ngang lag sogs zhing tog gaskusnas pa bcas rgyab tu khyer te mi grangs brgya phrag mang po nyin bstar tshong 'dus su 'byor skabs thog mar khral 'grel las khungs nas sho pa'i las byed dang bzhugs res gon 'thus kyis zhib 'jug byas nas grong khyer nang gtong srol yod/khyim tshang so sor yong mkhan rong pa bzhi cha gcig gi tshong zog gang yod sgo khang du rtsis sprod dgos pa de dag gi rin 'bab yul thang dma' tshad thog bod tshwa 'jal sgrod byed/ rong pa sgo khang du khrid de tshong 'thab byas pa'i gyong gun gang yod khyim tshang so sos khyer dgos pa de ni slo khral lta bu red/ rong tshong gi khe phan ni ha cang chen po yin par brten mgo bde 'ga' res nyin byed kyi lam du mdun bsur bskyod de/ khyim tshang gzhan gyi rong pa rang khyim du 'gug thabs byed pa'i lam srol ngan pa zhig kyang dar sku da/sdong tshong ni gnya' nang rdzong la'ang yong 'bab che sgos zhig yin par grags/ gzhung zhabs bgres skyesal sku zhabs grags bstan lags kyis 126

brtsams deb le'u brgya pa zhes pa'i nang / rtse mgron ye shes lhun grub nas gsungs par gzhigs na/ khong gis gnya' nang sgo thong gnang pa'i skabs rong tshong gi sgo khral 'bab deb nang gsal gang yod thog me sbrel nas gsar du bal khral bsdus 'bab bsnan pas 'o1 re'i nang 'bras ltang brgya brag mang 〈sna dang / lug khral ṭam dkar sogs gzhung 'bul 'bab sgo gang legs yod pa dang /7gong sa chen po se 'bras dga' gsum la grwa bsgor mdzad chen dang /smon lam tshogs phebs mtshan rtags mdzad sgo'i bzhes tsha ming btags kyi bzhes 'bras gnya' nang sgo 'bab khe gtsang nas 'deng lhag byung skusgod pa sogs 'khod 'dug2)'brog pa'i tshong thogagong bzhin sgo rong dang /brag sne/las lung /stag rtse/rgyu ri/dgu mtsho/sman khab stod smad sogs nas 'grog rigs tshong pa mang po tsha ru sogs pags rigs dang sha mar zud gsum gyis gtsos tshwa dang / bul tog /phyur ba/ bal/ khu lu/rtsid pa/ rtsid thag /phying pa sogs tshong gang yod g.yag dang / mdzo/ ra lug bcas par bkal nas khyu tsho mang po tsho khag so sor 'byor te rang rang gi gnas tshang du sdod pa de yang bla brang pa rnams ko gnas dang /sgo rong ba rnams gnas 〉(ga /brag sne ba rnams gnas dbyangs/ sgab bzhi ba rnams gnas steng 127

bcas gtso therdzo gnas khag che ba rnams la gnas tshang byed pa dang / mang che ba ni g.yag ra zer ba'i thang chen du babs tshugs kyis sbra gur phub nas sdod par yul mi tshos sne len byed pa dang chabs cig khong tsho'i tshong thog dang rong mtshams kyi thon khyangs gnyis brje sgyur byed/ sku zhabs mi ṭar tse(ba zhi rne ṭar gyi bod nang lo brgyad/ ces pa'i deb kyi nang 'grog rigs rnams nas lo ltar tshwa khal 247༷las lhag pa gnya' nang du 'or 'dren byed pa de dag yul mis bal yul nang sun ko zhi chu brgyud lung gshongs kyi grong gseb khag la tshong 'grems bya bzhin skusnad par bshad 'dug /cani kyang gon rabs 'ga' zhas kyi dran lam ltar byas na/ nyung mthar 'epha rer tshwa khal sum khri tsam 'or 'dren byed kyin yod tshod 'dug/'brog pa rnams phyir log skabs tsong 'dus nas ka ra bu ram dang /ras cha sogs rang gi mkho chas tshong thog mang po nyo gi red/gnya' nang gi snung pa 'ga' res 'grog pa'i bal dang / ra pags/ g.yag gi rnga ma/ sbang spos skusnags sman rgyu'i rigs phyir 'dren gyis bal yul rgyal sar tshong sgyur byed kyi red/ tshong 'dus pa rnams ni grong gseb mi sna gzhan las mthong rgya che ba yod pa ltar 'grog rigs gtso gyur bod sa gzhan nas yong ba'i tshong pa dang / bal yul nas yong pa'i rang pa'i dbar tshong 'thab 'khrug cha dod la khe phan che bar brten phyi mi rnams kyis/ gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa/mi lus thengs gcig pa/ zhes kha gtsags ku re yang byed kyi red/128

tshong 'dus pa'i 'tsho thabs sgor cung zad theng ba/3)'bras snung /khyim dud nyung shas thig gis lha sar tshong 'brel byed pa de dag ni lung pa'i nang gi tshong pa che gras su ngos 'dzin byed/khong tshos bal yul nas mkho 'don byas pa'i 'bras ltang do bo stong phrag mang po dang / shel ka ra/ bye ma ka ra/ kha sur skam bo/ sgog bu sogs dngos thog mang po lha sar tshong sgyur gyis phyir log skabs rang gi mkho chas sku gsung rten dang / g.yu rtsi can gyi khog snyir/gri dang me mda' ring zung bcas kyi thog /tshong zog tu bod rang gi thon khungs snam chas dang / rta sga chas/ rgya nag gi thon thog gos chen dang dar gru/ ja bag chung skusnags casar 'dren byed/ lha sar gnya' 'bras zhes smothon lam chen mo'i bzhes thug gi rgyu cha med du mi rung ba de dag gnya' nang gi tshong pas tshong sgyur byas pa zhig yin yang /1 na khungs ni gnya' nang nas min par bal yul nas nang 'dren byas pa zhig red/ 'on kyang gnya' sgog zer ba'i shog bu ni gnya' nang rdzong kho ngas bal wabyud sa mtshams 'gram dang sbang / 〈snags ga ma/ bde chen steng /sgol bo sgang /bya sa/dgon pa gsar pa sogs kyi ri mgo'i nags gseb tu bzos pa zhig red / tshong 'dus kyi tshong pa che ba 'ga' shas la rta drel dang tshong g.yog kyang mang po yod/ bod nang dus 'gyur ma byung lo shas gong du tshong pa tshos rkang sga ri dang / sbag sbag sogs 'khrul chas kyang nang 'dren byed mgo tshugs te mtshams rer rkang sga ri re zung gnya' nang du'ang

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bzhig sgrig byas pa ngos rang gis mthong myong /phyi lo 1 2༷ nas 1070bar gnya' nang dang lha sa'i dbar tshong 'grul byed mkhan rnams ni/ bur sras pa'i tshong dbon 'jam dbyangs dang / khong gi mnyam khrid byas pa gon skal bzang dang bla ma rgyud pa'am ming ngo ma mi li dge 'dun yar 'phel/ skal bzang gi mnyam du sku1nga ba li thang bsus tshang kun dga' dngos grub/ bla ma rgyud pa'i mnyam du sku nga ba brag g.yab ngag dbang dpal ldan dang / 'ba' pa a khya shes rab bcas kyi thog phyis su ka sgo dang /rdo legs pa/gnas steng bu 'gyur med/tshe brtan rnam rgyal/mi nyag a khu klu sgrub/ bsod nams rdo rje/ tshe brtan rgyal bo/ bur sras pa rig 'dzin ldo rje/rdo legs dbang rgyal/ kun gling rtsa blo bzang dngos grub/ rang 'khor thogs med/tshe brtan rgyal pe / khyam bu ang nor bu/ dpal 'byor lags/ tshe sgrub/jo dar rgyas/dngul bzo pa lags/ te rje min shākya/ kun dzo lags/ dngul bze rwardo rje/ dngul bajosna rnam rgyal/ dkon ma〈snag tshe ring / skal bzang 'bar smon/ stobs lags sogs kyi thog ding ri nas yong ba grang ljon bu ming lags pha bu dang /lco lco ba bu ngag dbang bsam grub/pa ag yod/ding ri rgya chung ba/ ding ri ba rnam rgyal dkon mchog /lha sa nas ra sgreng bla brang gi tshong dpon sogs yul phyogs gzhan nas yong ba'i tshong rigs mang po rgyun sdod byed/130

tshong 'dus pa'i 'tsho thabs sgor cung zad gleng ba/4)bal po'i tshong khang dang sgrig 'dzugs/tshong 'dus grong khyer nang rgyun du bal po'i tshong khang mang po yod pa de tshor 'bras dang / gro zhib yang man/ sran chung rda li dmar nag /sman sna sku gas bza' bca'i rigs dang / ras cha dang gyon chas/ dar ras dang skud pa sna tshogs/ rgya tshos ram sogs tshos gsar/ mngar cha/ zangs dang rags kyi yo chas/ tha mag /mu zi/ yig chas sogs mdor na phru gu'i rtsed chas yan chod tshong rgyu yod/grong khyer nang bal po them grangs bzhi bcu yod par bshad kyang /tshong khang khyon bsgoms 2༷tsam las med/de dag gi khang bdag ko thang gnas bo dang /gnas bo steng khyim tshang gnyis ni gnas khag che ba gnyis dang / gnas 'og dang / gnas mosna dbyangs can/ gnas kha che 'am ka lho bcas pa'i khyim tshang rnams kyang bal po'i khang bdag yin pa bcas de dag gi spyi ming la gnas khag lnga zhes 'bod/ ko thang gnas po'i mi thog gong ma zhig gis gor bod dmag 'khrug skabs sa sna lam rgyus dmag casags zhabs zhu be| 'pher byas pa'i gzengs rtags su bod gzhung nas zhing ri grong tsho gzhis kur gsol ras gnang ste/mi ser skul 'ded dang bsdu 'god yong 'bab gang legs yod par grags/131

gnya' nang tshong 'dusapa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bal po'i tshong khang grags che ba rnams ni/ a san sol gyi a khu klu khug dang /a khya tha kā li/ bha ra smi si'i a khu bal po gsar pa jiṭa lāl miresi /a khya gha rne sha/ lco nee sgang gi a khu shākya tsand+ra jo ti/ gsang rka'i a khu pu ni rā ja/ a khu shrī wa ghu wa/ 'jur sdug pa dpar mi bkra nyis/ tang tha li'i tshe ring 〈snabs rgyal/ 55 khya he ra mān/ rgyal sa'i 65 khu bya 'o1nga ste ming 1du 6sgo ta mān/a khu sā zhu/a khu skurimiṇa lāl/rgyal sa'i a khu pā ju/ye rang gi dngul bzo pa lags/55 khya mayi la/cag khu 11 kul/55 khu 31 la/55 khu sga sta spen pa/khrig khya gu khya sna zhing /a khu shākya'i josnag bdaga.a khya bhu la ca 31gas kyi thog ḍi 3 zer ba'i gorṣa'i mgo gtso dang / gzhan yang bal bo de dag gi bu brgyud shag rtsa dang /yang rtsa zer ba sogs gtan sdod gorṣa'i mi khongs mang po yod/bal po'i mgo khrid gtso bo ḍi tā zhes pa gorṣa gzhung rkyang nas bsgo gtong byed pa de ni phyi lo 167ca lor bal bod gzhung gnyis dbar bzhag pa'i chings yig 'bru don bzhin bal yul gzhung gis bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa dang /gzhis rtse/ rgyal rtse/ bal 〈snad sa mtshams 'khel ba'i gnad sposad sa gnas gnya' nang dang / skyid grong sogs su bal gzhung gi bca' sdod sku tshab ched 'dzugs byas pa'i gras zhig yin zhing / sku tshab ḍi bla'i 'og tu tha kā li dang /mu khriya zer ba sogs bya spu gnon gyi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa'i thog /dus chen srung rtsi'i ched sbyi dngul dang / rten dngos mang po mnyam du bdag nyar byed/132

tshong 'dus pa'i 'tsho thabs skor cung zad theng gabal po nang khul rtsod rnyog byung ba'i skabs mgo khrid ḍi ṣṭha nas gorṣa lo ri zhes pa rgyug pa ring 〈sna gnyis kyi dbar bkyig thag gis bsdams nas nyes chad khyad mtshar zhig kyang gtong srol yod/ bal po rnams dbyar kha tshong 'dus su tshong 'thab byed pa dang / dgun dus zla ba gnyis gsum rang yul du phyir log byed/ kho tsho'i bza' zla phal che ba tshong 'dus kyi bud med yin yang /mang che bar bal yul du'ang bza' zla bu phrug sku da par bshad/7)lug tshong /bod zla brgyad pa nas dgu pa'i dbar bal yul du ma snying zer ba'i bal po'i dus chen (047 sa/dha sen dang /sta hār/(116yo)gnyis kyi dmar mchod dang sgo skyid lug tshong gi khe 'bab ni ha cang chen po yin par brten yul mi gang 'tshams zhig gis ston ka zla ba gnyis tsam ring lug tshong rgyag gin sku da pa de dag la sdig can zhes 〈snag bshad byed mkhan mang bo sku1da/ rgyal khab nas ra lug phyir gtong skabs gon 'thus rnams nas re re bzhin sku la brtag zhib kyis lo na ma son pa'i rigs bkag 'gog dam po byed pa dang / lug khral ma sbrad par lkog khrid byed dogs kyis mtshan sa gzan thag chu 'khor khyim dud gnyis nas lam gzhung gtsang chu'i zam rgyug phyir bsdu byas te/ sa shul du bzhugs res rgan 'thus kyi khyim tshang nas sgo pa'i sa tham rgyag srol 133

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/yod/bur sras pa bzhugs res rgan bo yin pa'i skabs ngos dang gcen mo tshe g.yu gnyis nas zam pa'i tshur sner sa tham rgyag par 'gro myong sku da/ca)bal bod dngul ṭam gyi bed spyod dang /'bru rigs gzhal stod/bod sa gzhan dang mi 'dra bar tshong 'dus grong khyer nang rgyun du bed spyod che sgos gor ṭam dang /gorṣa'i sgog lor/bod rang gi gser ṭam dang /dngul ṭam/zangs ṭam/ shog lor sogs rgyun mar 'gro rgyug byas yod/ 'on kyang rgya'i shog dngul ni/phyi lo mi caXbar 'gro rgyug rtsa ba nas byas med/bod dngul gyi ṭam na'i khongs su zangs las grub pa'i zho gang dang / zho gsum/casna lnga /skar ma/byed brgyad/kha gang bcas dang /dngul las grub pa'i ṭam ka dkar po dang / srang gang / srang gsum sgor mo/ bcu sgor bcas dang /grags can gser ṭam bcas kyi thog sgog 'o ra dngul srang lnga dang /srang bcu/srang nyer lnga/ srang brgya bcas 'gro rgyug byed/ dus 'gyur byung ba'i rjes su rgya mi'i dha yang zer ba'ang bed spyod byed mgo tshugs skusnad/ lha sar 'a〈sna mkhan dang / 'grog pa sogs bod kyi lung tsho gzhan nas yong ba'i tshong bas ma gtogs bod dngul brgya lor nyar tshag byed mkhan nyung shas red/ 1070lor bal bod dngul gyi dza thang gor ṭam gcig la srang do zho lnga byas/ bod kyi zangs ṭam zho gang ni/107 lo'i rjes su'ang sa mtshams sgos ci bal yul 134
