tsong 'dus pa'i 'tsho thabs skor cung zad theng ba/rgyal sa'i nang du'ang pad shag gcig la rtsis te yun ring 'gro rgyugs byed pa gsal bo dran/ da lta'i char yang yul sgor spro 'cham par dmigs pa'i tshong khang khag tu gong gsal bod ṭam mang che ba bal yul rang gi ṭam ka snying pa'i mnyam du nyo tshong byed mus ma zad/ ye rang dang mchod rten gyi dngul bzo ba rnams la dngul ting sku gas mchod chas nyo mngags byed skabs dngul rgyu dha yang dang / srang gsum sgor yo ji dgos skad cha 'dri srol dus da lta'ang gnas ye da/khyad mtshar zhig la tshong 'dus 〈snang khyer nang bza' 'bru skusgogs gzhal bya gang yod bod sa sbyi mtshungs kyi gzhal stod dang mi 'dra bar bre'i tshab tu gzan tog zer ba zhing gis bzos pa zhig dang / 'bo'i tshab tu pham zhes zangs stod gting kong zhig bed spyod byed/ che chung khod sgoms 'byung thabs su gzhal bya'i stod gyog gi mthil du la cha sbyar nas gzhung gi tham ka rgyag hre la 'dugagazan tog gi che chung ni bre las chung ba dang bal po'i rma na zer ba'i gzhal stod las cung che ba sku da/ pham zer ba de yang 'bo las chung zhing bal po'i pa sta las cung che ba yod/ mar dang bal sogs kyi ljid tshad ni shang zer ba'i nyag ga la 'degs pa dang / gser dngul sogs rin po che'i rigs srang la 'degs srol yod/ snam bu dang thag pa nyo tshong byed dus 'dom pa 135

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/dang /khru tshad len nas rtsis rgyag byed pa dang /ras cha nyo tshong byed dus ras kyi kha zheng la 'jal nas/ kha gcig dang / kha gnyis/ kha gsum zhes rtsis rgyag byed srol yod/7)'asdusag las/gnya' nang khyon yongs la 'grog las rkyang pa'i 'tsho ba dar 'phel byung mi 'dug /tshong 'dus nang bur sras par 'bri g.yag nyis brgya tsam dang / ka sgo bar nyis brgya lhag tsam yod pa de dag tshong 'dus phu dang slo rong bcas par 'tsho skyong byed/ gnas steng bu 'gyur med nas kyang skabs zhig 'bri g.yag mang po bdag dbang byas 'dug kyang / sa dga' thong bogs mar blangs te mi ser skul 'ded dang bsdu 'god yong 'bab che bar brten rjes su tshong bsgyur byas 'dug/de min gnag nor yod mkhan ni 'phel log rdo rje phun tshogs dang gzhung pa/ gtsang gdong byang pa/ 'phel rgyas gling dgon pa bcas kyi thog gnya' nang stod du dar rgyas gling dang / bkris sgang / yar leb/ du lung / bkra this 'dzoms/la zhing sogs kyi grong pa mang che bas zhing las kyi thog tu 'bri g.yag dang / nye 'khor la ra lug khyon che nyar tshags byed/ chu 'khor steng 'og grong pa gnyis nas kyang sgo phyugs gang 'tshams nyar tshags byed/gong bzhin phyogs gsham dang /'gram/la phyi/dbesnan pa gsar pa bcas kyi 136

yul mis kyang ba dang mdzo yo mang po nyar tshags byed/tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi nang khyim tshang mang che bas rang rang 'byor 'khos la gzhigs pas mdzo yo dang / ba phyugs gnyis nas bdun brgyad bar sgo 'gram du nyar tshags byed kyi red/ khyim dud 'ga' shas nas bya yo dang / bal po khag gcig gis han se zer ba'i khyim bya ngang pa'am bya gag mchu to leb leb/ rkang pa zung zung / sder mo yongs rdzogs phan tshun sbrel cing / kong dong gi 'khyil chu btsog pa'i nang rkyal rgyag rgyur dga' ba'i bya rigs kyang 'tsho skyong byed kyi red//)lag shes dang /'debs las sogs ngal rtsol gyi 'tsho ba/bal po dang khams rigs tshong pa ma yin pa'i yul mi sbyi byings kyis sa zhing 'debs las byed/ gnam gzhis tsha grang la bsdun nas 'o1 rer 'debs las thengs gcig ma gtogs med pa de la sran ma dang /gro/nas/bad kha bcas kyi thog khyim dud so sos nye 'khor du zho khog dang /la phyag/nyung ma/bad tshal bcas 'debs 11la sku da/'debs las dang brnga bsdu byed stangs zhib cha nam dus so po'i las rigs zhes pa'i sde tshan la gzigs na mkhyen/tshong 'dus kyi yul mi 'ga' shas kyis dgun dus bal yul nas 'bras dang / ras cha/ sa snum sogs tshong thog 'or 'dren gyi bdal gla rgyug pa dang /tsār kha'i ring zhing las/ston ka bud zhing 'tshol sgrug gi ngal rtsolabyed/137

lcags stag zhib gzhung dam 'byar nang tshong 'dus bzo pa'i gras dud bco brgyad ces 'khod pa bzhin sngar gtan sdod bzo pa mang po byung 'dug kyang ngos rang gis shes ba ltar byas na yul mi'i khongs su 'tshem po ba dang / zhing bzo ba/rum thag/dngul bzo/rdo bzo/dkrug pa/mnyed pa/bal ma/tha ga ma sku gas lag shes kyi thog nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan gang 'tsham skusnad pa las bswāte pa gtan 1snad byed mkhan mang wa med par snyam/dus 'gyur ma byung tsam du zhing bzo'i khongs su lhag pa don grub dang /zhing bzo tshe brtan/ chu 'og skal bzang /zla ba zla zur bcas pa'i thog em rje kun bzang yang zhing bakhro'i las rigs sbyi dang / ar po'i bkod byus/ lhag par rkos ris la zhin tu mkhas par grags/ spyir btang lung pa 'khrug cha dod la phyi phyogs nas tshong pa mang bo 'du 'dzoms byed par brten grong khyer stod smad bar gsum du chang btsongs nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan mang po yod/ phyi nas yong ba'i zhing 'brog tshong pa rnams nas tshong 'dus kyi 'bras chang la rtsa mthong chen the1 byed/'tshem bakhro'i gras su rang 'khor dbya mdzod dang / tshe ring nor bu/ a zhang spen pa/zla ba bkris/tshe rgyal/ dpal 'byor/lo lo don grub/lo lo rgyal bo/rang 'khor thogs med/pa sangs bkris/bu lags sogs yod/dus 'gyur ma byung tsam du a zhang spen pa dang bu lags kyis bal yul nas 'tshem po'i 138

'khrul chas 'khor lo nyos te/ sgal gyi tshem bu zhes gyon chas 'tshem rgyu khong rnams la sprod rgyur dga' bo byas/rum thag mkhas pa grum ze pa sangs/thag ma dang bal ma/ zhing chu 'dren mkhan sogs mi gla mang po pha drug gtso gyur nye 'khor grong gseb nas yong srol yod/pha drug pa las mi rnams ni rang yul gyi sa zhing 'debs las grub 'bral tshar kha'i ring gnya' nang du lag shes rgyugs par yong ba dang /ston dus phyir log gis ston las grub mtshams slar yang dgun kha'i ring gnya' nang du yong nas bal las dang thag las sogs kyi mi glar rgyugs kyin yod/de gras mang che ba bud med na gzhon yin pa ltar gzhas dang zhabs bro mkhas bo yod par ngos 'dzin byed/pha drug pa'i bud med mang po tshong 'dus su yang yang yong ba'i mtha' mar gnyen sgrig byas te gtan sdod byed mkhan mang po yod/3)gnya' nang stod dang /'gram phyogs gsham bcas pa'i 'tsho thabs/gnya' nang stod kyi yul mi mang che ba zhing pa yin zhing / nas 'bru dang / sran ma/ pad khang sogs thon skyed gang legs la brten 'thu lhag ji yod dang snam nag sogs tshong 'dus par tshong bsgyur byed/ 'gram dang / phyogs gsham/dbo|na pa gsar pa skusnags mtha' mtshams kyi 〈snang gseb khag la casna kho ga dang mar nan phran bu las de min sa zhing gi thon khyangs dman par brten rgyun 139

gtan 'tsho gos lag shes dang tshong zog 'or 'dren gyi bdal gla rgyugs kyi yod/ tshong 'dus pa'i mkho thog dar zhing dang / dar chen/ ka gdung / 'phyag thing /sle bo/bu gzeb/thang thog/ja mdong /'o zom mam bzo lag/gzeb ma/zho mdong / chu zom/ chang stod ka reg /bod thog /ko ba bcas gong gsal mtha' mtshams 〈snang gseb khag nas phor 'dren gyis tshong bsgyur byed pa ma zad/sgo nga dang /rdzo tshal smyug thug/'bras ka gling bcas kho tsos tshong 'grems byed/miX)sman pa dang /bzo pa/rdza mkhan sogs kyi sgor/gnya' nang khul du dus 'gyur ma byung gong sman pa nyung shas zhig yod pa de dag ni/rdzo lung nam rje dang /'khor yag nam rje /ka sgo'i nam rje kun bzang bcas pa'i thog /mtshams rer sman pa re zung ding ri dang / ku ra/ mtsho sgo sogs nas kyang bsu 'byor byed/ lcags bzo dang rdza mkhan gyi rigs ni lung pa gzhan nas yong ste dbyar kha'i ring bzo pas so nams yo chas dang / sto stod sbyar gtug byed pa'i thog gri dang zor ra/ sgo lcags sogs tsag cig dgos mkho rnams bzo tshong byed pa dang / rdza mkhan rnams kyis khog nyir dang me khog /chang stod/ sto stod sogs rdza ma che chung sna tshogs bong bur bkal te sa thag ring po nas yong ste tshong sgyur byed pa bcas so//140

le tshan bdun pa/dbyar dgun ston dpyed bzhi'i nam dus so so dang bsnun pa'i las rigs/1)dpyid ka /'debs las mgo 'dzugs/dgun dus kyi grang ngar yol nas dbyid ka shar mtshams lo tog 'debs las kyi gra sgrig byed/ thog mar khyim tshang so so'i gsang spyod dang / gad snyigs kyi chags rwa nas lud dang / ba phyugs kyi lci ba sogs 'or 'dren byas te sa zhing la lud bsres rgyag rgyu mgo 'dzugs byed/ de nas bdun gnyis tsam rjes zhing sa rdzo slog byas nas 'gru son 'debs skabs khyim tshang 'ga' shas kyis mas glang dang mas mdzo rnams la dwa rgyan yang gaskusnags sgol skusnad/ gnya' zhing gcig la mdzo dang / g.yag /glang skusnags yos phyugs gnyis re cha sbrel byed pa las ya gcig dang mi dang rta drel gyis 'then nas mi rmo ba ma zad/ skyes pas ma gtogs bud med kyis rmo srol med/ 'on kyang zhing la sa bon gtor ba'i las ka ni bud med rnams kyis ma gtogs skyes pas byed srol med/ zhing pa tshos spyir btang sa rko ba dang / slog pa/ 'dul ba sogs kyi ched du lag cha sbyag ma dang / tog rtse/'jor sogs bed spyod byed kyi red/ zhing la son 'bru btab nas nyin shas smo41

ga 'a nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyalakhams pa/rjes sngon chu gtong ba dang / derjesazhing chu gtong sgo char 'od dang bsdun gyi red/2)rangayul du log pa'i 'dabs bya dang /rgya gar khams pa'i tshong zogazhing khar ljang pa 〈sna bsil skyes pa dang dus mtshungs rgya gar khams pa zhes pa'i tshong rigs rnams bod du phyir log gis tshong 'dus grong khyer nang phyi khrom mang po ston gyi red/ rgya gar khams pa rnams ni tshong las don gnyer ched dgun dus bal yul brgyud rgya gar du bskyod de dbyar kha bod la phyir log byed/ yar mar tshong 'dus su bdun phrag 'ga' shas re bsdad de tshong zog bkram gyi red/ tshong 'dus kyi phru gu tshos kho tsho'i bong bur lkog bzhon bya rgyur dga' mosnas chen bo byas te/sga med par bca na nas mtshams rer rkub la rta shu thon pa'i ma kha gasdu sa ma thub par nyin shas gom pa thad kur rgyug rgyur dka' ngal sku1nga gin yod/ gnya' nang gi rgya gar khams pa grags che ba ni/ drang bzo choso bzang dang /padma tshe dbang /mig dmar/pa nor bu/a nee chog pa/nor bu rkang ring / tshe ring sgrol ma/rdo rje/a lce lha phal/'od zam tshe ring thun tshogs/bstan ldan/tshe don bcas yin/rgya gar khams pa rnams dpyid ka bod du phyir log byed pa ji bzhin bya long gis gathengs 'dabs chags khag gcig kyang gnya' nang gi mkha' lam brgyud 142

dbyar dgun ston dbyid bzhi'i nam dus so so dang bsdun pa'i las rigagako long ko long zer gyin lam sne khrid mkhan sngon bgrod gcig gi mjug tu byings rnams mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ji bzhin 'phur sding gis phyir log byed pa de dus mi rnams la dpyid dpal shar ba'i sgo snang chen bo skye ba ma zad/khya byug dang / skya khra/ bu pu khya shud sogs kyang rang yul du 'khor nas spang ljongs dang / lcang gseb/ brag thog sku gas nas skad snyan lhang lhang sgrog pa de skabs sa sgog rdo slog byas na grog ma sogs 'bu mang po'i tshe srog la gnod par brten sdig bzhags kyi ched gon byis su yin yang lam seng kha nas ma ṇi bgrang ba ma zad/smyung gnas la sdod rgyur do snang chen bo byed kyi red/3)dbyar kha/ zhing chu 'dren gtong /dbyar kha'i ring ri rgyud yongs rdzogs spang rtsa sngon pos khyab cing / sna mang me tog gi 'dzum zhal dgod pa'i khrod du bya rigs sna tshogs kyi dbyangs snyan sgrog pa dang / tshon ris bkrag mdangs ldan pa'i phye leb mang po rang dbang gis 'bur lding byed pa sogs yid sems 'gugs pa'i rang byung khams kyi mdzes sdug gi tshor ba myong bzhin du mi la la ni gling bsgor du skyod/ la la ni zhing kha'i nang yur ma rgyag pa zhes lo tog gi nang du 'dres nas skyes pa'i rtswa ngan 'thog rgyur brel zing byed/ la la ni sngo las pa bzhis bkod khyab byas pa gzhir bzung rang rang gi res mos dus tshod dang bstun nas zhing khar yur bu 143

bzos te/ zhing chu 'dren gtong byed pa sogs las mar brel ba byed pa ma zad/le tshan drug pa'i nang gsal rong pa dang 'grog pa sogs yul phyogs gzhan nas sku nga ba'i mi sna khag la tshong 'thab shugs che byed/ gnam gnyis legs pa'i skabs 〈snags 'brel che ba'i rgan gzhon tsho khag so sor gur dang bya g.yab phub nas ri 'dabs sbang ljongs kyi ngos su g.yang gtong zhes pa'i dbyar skyid gtong sgol yang dar khyab chen po yod/4)sgo phyugs 'tsho skyong /dbyar kha'i ring sgo phyugs yongs rdzogs yul mi sbyi pa'i phyugs brdzi gsum gyis ri mgor 'tsho skyong byed/ rtsa kha bzang ba'i skabs ba mo 'tsho ba zhes 'o ma ma zhos gong du skya rengs dang po'i mtshams su bu brug rnams kyis ded nas nye 'khor du 'tsho skyong byed/ de skabs phru gu tshos gtong rdzar zhes thang khyag gi nang du sbags dang / mar kun sba ci/ sur pan tsha bo bsres pa'i sgon ḍi sogs rang khyim nas gang khyer snod gcig tu spungs te mnyam za mnyam thung byas rjes rtsed mo sna tshogs rtsed nas snang ba skyid po byed/ skabs rer nam mkhar glog 'khyugs nas 'brug skad kyi 'ur sgra chen po bsgrags pa'i skabs zu gu tshos/ dbyar shar ro/ dgun yol lo/ nged tsho'i ba la be'u skye rgyu yod/ ma khyer zhig ces skad shugs chen bo rgyag pa'i sgol rgyun yod/spro44

dbyar dgun ston dbyid bzhi'i nam dus so so dang ba na pa'i las rigs/7)char 'beb dang chu rtsed/lung pa'i nang dbyar kha chu dkon bo chags te/ ston nyes 'byung nyen skabs bla ma dang dge 'dun gdan 'dren zhus te chos 'khor spang ldan zer ba'i sa char dbu gur phub nas rten khrus yul khrus dang klu bsangs klu gtor gtong ba sogs char 'bebs kyi sgrub bzhag chen po tshugs srol yod/ de dus grong khyer nang du'ang mi mang phan tshun chu sho'i rtsed sa brtse bzhin yod pa ltar/ pho gzhon rnams mnyam rub kyis bud med na gzhon rnams la chu stor ba dang /rkang lag nas 'jus te ka chu'i nang du bcug ba 31gas sems gnag dang brnyas brko mang du byed/ bud med rnams kyis khrus gzhong nang chu khyer te khug kyog dang / yang na steng 1snag sge khyang gi 'khris su gab nas 〈sna gcasnan rnams la chu bsgos pa sogs 'phrul bshad byed/ mdor na phru gu rnams kyis kyang sdug ma las bzos pa'i chu mda' khyer nas chu rtsed mang po brtse ba de ni rgya gar gyi ho li zer ba'i dus chen dang 'dra mtshungs yod/ca)ri skyes zhing tog dang /sngo tshal/me tog bcas ba'i sgor/tshong 'dus kyi bru gu tshos dbyar kha gnam gzhis skyid pa'i skabs phan tshun ri 'dabs su rang bzhin gyis skyes pa'i zhing 'bras rgyal po ser tog dang / rin bad/lcang 'bras zhim zhim/smin ci 'o1ga/ib chung ma/rta ra/nag mo krang krang /145

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gang shar ma/ zhu zhu dkar tog /gnya' lo sogs 'thu ba dang / de bzhin sbang rgyan me tog se shen sgog to dang / shel dam 'brug pa/ mgo bo che/ khug chos/sangs rgyas dkar tog sku1gas rang 'dod bzhin bsgrugs te/ la las mgul rgyan do bzhal bzo ba dang / la las sba thug bzo ba'i thog gong du le tshan lnga pa'i nang gsal rang bzhin gyis skyes pa'i sngo tshal go sgod dang khu mag /lcam pa lha mo sogs kyang grong khyer gyi nye 'khor du skyes nas yod pa phru gu tshos bsgrugs nas khyim tshang so sor sbags ma 'bol 'bol lhug lhug za rgyu skusgrod/ri skyes 〈sna tshal gyi ming rnams zhib phra le tshan lnga pa'i nang gzigs na mkhyen/dbyar kha mtshams rer zhing khar bskyod de sran ma'i gang bu dang / nyung ma sogs kyang lkog za byed/ lkog za byed sa mang che ba ni khang gsar zer ba'i sa char yin pa der zhing bdag chu steng pa'i mi ngo bstan 'dzin glen pa zer bas mthong dus rgya gu rnams 'ur rdo khyer nas 'ded kyin yod/7)ston ka /bud zhing 'tshol sgrugadabyar mjug gam ston ka mgo 'dzugs kyi skabs su/ dgun thag ring por 'deng pa'i bud zhing sgrug mgo tshugs kyi red/ pho gzhon rnams kyis gor gri dang sta re/ bud med rnams kyis thor ra sogs lag cha gang yod nyin re bzhin ka chu'i g.yas g.yon rdo ril gyi brdar kha'i thog rno ngar bton te/ sgo phyogs 146

dbyar dgun ston dged bzhi'i nam dus so so dang ba na pa'i las rigs/kyi nags gseb nas zhing sna gcod bregs byas pa'i 'khur po bzo lta legs zhing / mgo mjug 'khos ka stoms la/ zhing gi bcad kha skya seng seng byas pa re re khyer nas bang sgrigs te phyir log byed dus/ bud zhing sgrug rtsal dod pa dang khur shed che ba rnams kyi khur po ni bzo lta yag la bong tshad kyang ha cang chen po yod par mi rnams yid smon byed pa'i thog rang nyid kyang khengs spob byed/lung pa'i nang rgyun du bud zhing gi ched du ba phyugs kyi lci ba khang pa'i gyang ldebs su bskams nas gasdumag 'a1snag byed pa dang /lha na ka ri 'dabs nas sa dang rtswa gnyis mnyam bsres su skusnad pa'i spang gog yang mang po bkog nas dgun dus spang me gtong rgyur gsog 'jog byed/ba phyugs kyi lci ba dang ra lug gi ril ma skam bo me zhing du 'bud srol dar khyab che bar brten khyim dud so sos rang gi ba phyugs kyi lci ba gyang ldebs su skam pa ma zad/〈sna phyugs med pa'i khyim dud kyi bu zug rnams nas g.yas g.yon ri mgo dang lam steng du btang pa'i lci ba rnams 'tshang ga zhig zhig byas nas sgrug gi red/ston ka ni ri'i sgang du lci ba ser skam zer ba dri ma med pa khyon che sle po'i nang bsgrugs nas nang du 'or 'dren byed kyi red/ grong khyer nang phru gu 'ga' res 'bri g.yag gam ba phyugs kyi rnga ma gnam la bkyag pa mthong dus/ btang song ngo zhes skad brgyab nas de'i rjes su bskyod cing lci ba sgrug gi red/ de ltar skad 'bod byed don ni lci ba de rang nyid la bdag tshul 147

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/brda sprod byas pa zhig yin pa ltar/ dang po sus mthong nas skad 'bod byed pa de rang gis sgrug pa las gzhan rnams kyis 'tshang ga rgyag srol med//)brnga bsdu sogs ston las kyi brel zing /sbang ljang khya g.yu lo me tog de/ 'bras ste ma smin dus yal te 'gro/ zer ba bzhin zhing la ste ma ldem ldem byed pa'i dus su ri lung phyogs gang sar rtswa zhing thams cad kha dog ser por 'gyur zhing /'ur sgra ldan pa'i lhags pa grang shur rgyag mgo tshugs bstun bya 'o1nga gis gtsos pas 'dabs chags rnams kyang rong mtshams su gnas spo byed/ de dus btsas ma brnga rgyu sogs ston las mgo tshugs te mi rnams ha cang brel ba chen po byed/ grong pa sa zhing rgya che 'phad ba rnams nas mi gla mang po bsgrigs dgos smos med thog /sa rgya chen po med pa rnams nas kyang phan tshun res pos kyis mnyam rub byed/btsas ma brnga rgyu dus thog ma tshar ba'i skabs mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od mdangs la bsten nas brnga ba skusnags snga langs phyi nyal byed dgos/ zhing pa rnams la dbyid ka sad kyis khyer ba'i sdug bsngal/ dbyar stod char pa mi 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal/ ston kha ste ma smin pa'i skabs su slo bur ser bas bcom dogs kyi sdug bsngal/ da dung brngas zin pa'i btsas ma rnams rul skyon 'byung dogs kyi sdug bsngal che bar brten zhing kha'i steng du ka li zer ba'i rtswa 148

dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi'i nam dus so so dang ba na pa'i las rigs/'bungs bzos te 'jog pa dang / de nas ston thog g.yul khar 'or 'dren byed pa'i skabs las mi'i rgyab dang / mdzo g.yag /rta drel sogs la'ang bkal 'ded byed/ste ma bdung pa'i skabs pho sna g.yas gaskusgon ru bsgrigs nas rgyag 'phen zer ba'i dbyug pa bzhu ba dang / de bzhin ba glang dang rta drel sogs kyang ste ma dkyil ba'i steng du khyu 'ded kyis phyugs chag byed/ 'gru dang rtswa gnyis dbye ba 'byed pa'i skabs thog mar rgyab ra dang / kha gla 'am sbar mo zer ba'i thing gi yo byad kyis rtswa 'byangs gnam la 'phyar ba dang / de nas 'bru dang rtswa snyigs slo ma'i nang blugs te lhags pa'i shugs tshad dang bsdun gyin gnam la 'phyar gyi red/ las rim sku1 sor pho gzhon dang yo gzhon rnams phan tshun glu gzhas gtong res byed pa sku gas ha cang snang ba skyid pas lus kyi ngal dub la tshor snang mi yong ba ma zad/ khyim tshang so so nas ja chang dang / bza' chas skyel ba rnams ngal gso'i bar mtshams su sgor sgor byas nas bza' btung gis phan tshun skad cha 'od pa dang ku re smra ba sogs kyang byed/ gon byis su yin rung mtshan mo g.yul kha srung ba'i ched mal zan khyer nas rtswa 'bungs kyi nang nyal rgyur dga' po byed pa de ni/ sru gu rnams la rtswa rkang cha bsgrigs nas lhas ma sna tshogs bsla ba dang / rtswa spungs nang phan tshun gab res yib res kyis rtsed mo rtse rgyu yod pa'i go skabs dang / na gzhon rnams 149

gnya' nang tsong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/la rang gi dga' grogs gzhib thug byed pa'i go skabs bzang sgos zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed/0)thog bya 'phur 'gran/tshong 'dus su ston ka lo tog brnga ba'i skabs rdzong dpon ngo las dang rgan 'thus rnams kyis gtsos rgan byis mang bos sgog bya gtong rgyur dga' po byed/gnya' nang du sgog bya gtong srol ni lha sa dang bal yul gnyis phyogs nas dar ba zhig yin bzo 'dug /tshong 'dus pa tshos thog bya la/ nas pa ta zer ba de ni bal skad yin pa dang / ga〈snang ba'i skabs rgan byis tshang mas skud pa blosnad/mgor rdo bzhus zer ba sogs dbyas skad mang po brgyab kyi red/thog bya 'phyar 'gran gyis phan tshun skud pa gcod res bya srol yang dar khyab chen bo yod/ rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi ched du shel hrug zhib mor rdzog pa gro zhib kyi skyo mag nang bsres te skud par byug nas 'gran bsdur gyis gzhan gyi sgog bya'i skud pa bcad pa'i skabs/ btang sku da do ces skad shugs chen bo brgyab pa dang chabs cig phru gu mang po skud pa chad pa'i shog bya'i rjes su 'brangs nas/skud pa lag par dkris te gsog 'jog byed pa dang sgog bya thob thabs byed/ de skabs mtshams rer skud par skye mag gi mnyam du shel phyug byug nas sku da pa sha la zug nas phru gu'i lag pa khrag ral tu gtong ba de 'dra yang yong gin yod/ 150

dbyar dgun ston dbyed bzhi'i nam dus so so dang bstun pa'i las rigs/1༷)tsher ma brnga ba dang /bsdo 'thag byed tshul/〈snan las kyi rjes su g.yas ga'aphan ri 'dabs nas brag sha zer ba brag la skyes pa'i zhing sna dang / tsher ma bcad nas/ dgun thag ring po 'deng pa'i 'gru gzan brngo 'thag byed/ tsher ma brnga ba'i skabs ko ba'i lag shub ring po cha re gyon nas rno ngar ldan pa'i thor ba bed spyod byed/ 'or 'dren skabs rgyab tu ko gdan gyon srol yod/ tshong 'dus grong smad kyi yos bsdo sa ni/ mgron khang gis mtha' sgor 〈snad pa'i bal po'i mchod khang lha dwa zer ba'i zur gcig la khang pa thab ka chen po gnyis yod cig bed spyod byed/grong stod kyi yos bsdo sa ni/ sgo khang gi nye 'khris su gong mtshungs thab ka chen po gnyis yod pa'i khang pa zhig yod/ yos bangos pa'i skabs bud zhing tsher ma dang / ra lug gi ril ma skam wabyu 'bud pa de dag las mee lce lhab lhab du 'bar ba ha cang ngar shugs chen po yod/ yos bango rgyu'i las kur nyams myong dgos pa las/ mi su byung gis brngo rgyu khag po red/ slang ngar bye ma bsregs pa'i nang du 'bru blug nas/ 'tshig sgra tshag tshag zer ba'i skabs slang nga'i zur nas skam pa gnyis kyis bzung ste/ bru dang bye ma gnam la 'phyar dgos pa dang /de nas tshag snod nang du blug ste dbye 'byed byed/phru gu rnams yos bsdo sar 'gro dus sran yos dang / nas yos gang rung am brag rgyangs nas ster 〈snal bzang bo skusnad/ bangos zin pa'i skusnas rnams 151

gnya' nang snang 'dus ba'i bya tsha rgyal khamasapa/skye li nang du blugasatechu'akhor la khyer gyi red/tshong 'dus su chu 'khor steng sgod gnyis yodabaltar rang rang gi dga' nye su che'i sar 'thag gi red/ rtsam pa 'thagaparasu bskyod rung mgo lus yongs rdzogs tsam pas dkar rkyang bajotres te las mjug ma sgril bar nyin mtshan sbrel nas skya tshub tshub byas te sdod kyi red/11) dgun kha/ bal po rnams rang yul du log pa dang / dgun tshong mgo 'dzugs byed pa/dgun dus dngos ni dga' ldan lnga mchod nas mgo 'dzugs byed/ de nas nyin shas rjes bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes shar gnya' nang pa'i 41 gsar zin mtshams bal po skusnangs rdzogs rang rang gi lung par phyir 'phag byed pa ma zad/yul mi mang po bal yul du gnas mjal dang dgun tshong gi ched du 'aspo srol po da/ tshong 'dus 〈snang khyer nas gtan sdod mi sna phyogs bskyod skabs dga' nye yin min la ma stos par phru gu rnams kyis ka ka gling dang / la rdzas so sor skyel rdzong byas te dngul slong bya sgol yod/ 'grul pa tshos phru gu rnams bang bsgrigs te bzhag nas ṭam 'gyed brgyab rjes casna gang dang skar ma 31gas ṭam ka sbar 31 gang tsam gnam la 〈snar nas/ tshang ga zhig zhig byas nas sgrug bcug gi red/rgya gu la ṭam 'gyed rgyag srol ni 'grul bzhud 152

dbyar dgun ston dbyid bzhi'i nam dus so so dang bsdun pa'i las rigs/lam sgong yong ba'i re 'dun la brten nas dar ba zhig red/ bal po rnams phyogs thon skabs bal po'i lugs srol ltar/ lo ṭa zer ba'i chu bum gyi nang du chu blug nas 'jog par 'grul pas rtags rten bzang por brtsis nas de'i nang dngul ṭam blug srol yod/ de ni bod mi rnams kyis rang nyid sdod khang nas las don ched phyir bskye da skabs lam du chu dang / thab zhing / 'o ma sku(gas khengs pa'i 1snad chas khyer nas sku1nga mkhan dang 'phrad tshe lam rtags bzang po yin par ngos 'dzin gyis las don 'grub pa'i yid ches byed pa de dang 'dra mtshungs red/yul mi gang 'tshams zhig gis dgun dus bal yul nas 'bras dang /ras cha/sa snum sogs tshong thog 'or 'dren byed/12)bal las dang /(1na chas 'tshem ba1sna/gnya' nang khul du dgun dus gnam gnyis grang ngar che tsam yin rung / zhing las skusnags phyi phyogs kyi las grel med par brten zla shas ring khel thag dang / 〈snan chas bcasna 'tshem gyi las ka byed 〈snal skusnad/ khyim tshang mang che bas bal las byed mkhan bud med dang 'tshem 〈sna ba mi lag bsgrigs dbo sa sku1da/mi lag yongs rdzogs khang pa'i dkyil du me btang pa'i mtha' 'khor du bsdad nas rang rang gi las ka byed pa dang chabs cig phan tshun sgrung sgod res dang 153

mdza' glu len rgyur dga' mas kyis las rtsol la dka' ngal mi mngon pa'i khar dus tshod gar 'gro mi shes par ha cang snang ba skyid po byed pa ma zad/mtshams rer 'og phan tshun byas nas/lde'u 'am gab tshig gi dri ba dri lan byed sgol yang dar rgyun chen bo yong /13)gangs 'bab dang steng thog gi nyi ma/bod sa gzhan dang mi 'dra bar tshong 'dus su gangs 'bab ha cang chen po yod pa ltar/kha ba nyin mtshan gnyis tsam rgyab dus khang pa 'ga' zhas la 〈sna phye sa med par sge khung nas thon te sgo 'gram gyi gangs gtsang ma bzo dgos kyi yod/thog rdib mi sgor ba'i ched khang thog nas kha ba yang yang 'phyag dgos/ dgun dus khyim dud so so'i khang thog nas kha ba g.yugs te grong khyer gyi lam gzhung khag la kha ba gangs ri lta bu mang 〈sna chags nas 'grul bzhud skabs yar 'dzegs mar babs byed dgos sku da/ 'on kyang gangs babs thag chod mtshams nyi ma yag po ston gyin 'phad pa ltar mi rnams khang thog tu mgo 'khyud pa dang / ko gdan dang btsugs gdan thog bsdad nas zhig sgrug pa/ skra shad pa/ snum byug pa sogs byed/ tshong 'dus pas skra shad la khrug shad zer/bud med la phru gu btsas dus ma bu gnyis rkar khang thog tu nyi ma'i nang snum gyi 'byug pa yang yang byed pa de dus za btung la lta rtogs ma byas na pho rog 154

dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi'i nam dus so so dang bsnun pa'i las rigs/gis khyer nyen yod/tshong 'dus kyi pho rog ni skad sbyor che la sbyang grung dod pas za btung rku khyer bya rgyur ham rtsal dod po yod/yul skad du pho rog la sga rog zer/ phru gu dmar 'byar bu gzeb nang nyi mar bstan nas bzhag dus pho rog las srung dgos/ bu gzeb zer ba ni smyug ma las bzos pa'i sgam stod gru bzhi zhig yod pa de gras 'ga' shas la phru gu'i mgo 'jog sar nyi skyob ras yol bsgar sa'i spa sgor yang bzo gi red/ phru gu gnyid snyal pa'i skabs bu gzeb gasku1 'gul byed/sgyu grosnag la sbyir btang bsun snang byed kyang /mtshams rer khang pa'i steng du babs nas/ ko long / ko long zhes skad rgyag dus grog skad brgyab kyi 'dug zer nas dga' po byed kyi red/ bo rog gis grog skad brgyab pa ni zas nor 'ong ba'i rtags rten du brtsi srol yod pa bcas so//

cas zurgan bab)da pa/thun yong ma yin pa'i yul skad dang /yul gzhas kyi sgor/1)skad yig 〈(ra/lung pa'i nang gon 'thus dang /tshes bcu pa/grwa btsun/slob phrug sogs kyis gtsos bod yig shes mkhan mi nyung ba yod pa ltar/ rgyun du sbyi sger las don brjed tho 'god rgyu dang nang khul gan rgya 'jog rgyu/ gtong yig sogs bod sgog kho na'i thog 'bri srol yod/ bal bod yul gnyis kyi sa mtshams tshong rwa'i spong khyer zhig yin par brten bal skad dang / rne pā li gnyis ka shes mkhan mang po yod kyang / phyi lo 1077 bar gnya' nang pa'i khongs su dbyin ji dang /rgya mi'i skad yig shes mkhan ni gcig kyang med/tshong 'dus pa'i yul skad ni stod khyal gyi yul skad gzhan dang mi 'dra bar ming tshig mang por bal skad mnyam bsres 'phad pa dber na/yi rtse la glang glad dang / yu med lham la gla gam/ ṭam ka la ḍi ba/ rtsed chas po 'o la sbang gha ri/re ga bya la nas pa ta/zhing stosnag ke la'am ngang lag la gcasang le/ma mā la 65ba/bal po'i se'u'am oruḍa la/ ām/zho khog la/ lhan ldog zer/ lha sar yang yang 'gro mkhan nyung shas kyis dbus skad brgyab pa de rigs la skad kyog 156

dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi'i nam dus so so dang bsnun ba'i las rigs/rgyag gi 'dug zer ba dang / 'ga' shas kyis lha sa mig gis ma mthong par dbus skad thar thor rgyag mkhan yod pa de tshor zhag ma'i sgang gi skad kyog ces 'phya smod byed kyi red/ shag ma'i sgang zer ba ni grong khyer dang gtsang chu'i dbar lha sa'i lam phyogs kyi sa cha'i ming zhig red/rgyun du bla ma dang sprul sku/sde pa gzhung gi mi sna/ dge gon sogs gon rabs la skad cha sgod dus zhe sa zhu ba'i lam srol yod/ rang nyid la bdag ces 'bod pa ni/ gzhan la bstod pa'i ched rang gnyid dma' sa bzung ba'i tha snyad cig red/2)gzhas dang zhabs 11 sbyi bshad/gnya' nang pa'i gzhas dang zhabs blo ni ches rnying nyams dod la snyan 'jebs ldan zhing / gzhas tshig mang por dbus skad kyang mnyam bsres yod pa ma zad/skabs dus sku so'i bod dbus kyi chab srid gnad don gsal ba sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mang bo tshang yod/ gor bod dmag 'khrug byung rjes bad ga gling zer ba'i zhabs gro dang gzhas sna 'ga' shas dar ba de dag ni khyim mtshes bal po'i rig gzhung dang 'brel ba chags skusnad pa bcas gang ltar lo ngo brgya phrag 'ga' shas nang dar ba'i gnya' nang pa'i gzhas dang zhabs bro khag la thun yong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mang po skusnad nges red/rgan rabs khag gcig gis lha sar dga' mosnas byed pa'i stodatshanazhas mang 157

che ba thog mar gnya' nang nas dar ba red zer ba de ni lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi thog dngos 'brel min nam snyam/ gna' snga mo'i lo rgyus shes rtog med rung dus rabs nyi shu pa'i mgo stod du gnya' nang nas gnas spos wa lung dgra 'dul skusnags mosnal cha mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis lha sa 〈snang khyer nang stesnad phyogs kyi gzhas sna btang par/ lha sa bas dga' yos chen po byas te sgo skyid yod tshad la mgron 'bod byas par grags/ rjes su lha sa rol cha tshogs pa'i dge gon a jo rnam rgyal ko stong gis dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dang a jo bsod 〈snabs sku(gas 〈snad gzhas dang / nang ma'i gzhas kyi gdangs dang gzhas chig mang po gsar du rtsom sgrig byas pa yongs grags yin zhing / deng skabs bod mi'i sbyi tshogs nang skad grags yod pa'i stod gzhas brag stod dkar po dang /gnya' nang mthong la/a khro'i bde/gnas bzang pe /'jug la/bla brang gsar pa/dga' ldan shar rtse byang rtse sku gas kyi 〈snag ma'i gzhas tshig dang sgra gdangs rnams dus da lta'ang nyams brlag tu ma seteng par gnya' nang yul mi rgan gas rnams la gtong rgyu yothod pa de dbang du gzhigs na stod gzhas de dag thog mar gnya' nang nas dar ba red ces pa'i gsung 'gros la rgyu mtshan ldan par sems/tshong 'dus ni stod khul gyi sa cha gzhan dang mi 'dra bar 'khrug cha dod la deng dus kyi 'gyur 'gros chen bo yod pa'i grong khyer zhig yin pa ltar/ phyi lo 158

zun yong ma yin pa'i yul skad dang /yul gzhas kyi sgor/1077 tsam nas khyim tshang 'ga' shas kyis lde mig bcus te gtong rgyu skusgod pa'i skad par dang / skam glog bed spyod kyis rlung 'phrin nyan sgam nyar tshag gis gsar 'gyur nyan pa dang rol gzhas sna tshogs gtong ba ma zad/bal bo gsar pa'am jidaṭa bha dur sheresiṣṭha zer bas sge'u khung nas rgyangs bsgrags btsugs te yul mi sbyi byings la'ang rol gzhas nyan rgyu yod pa dran/ lha sar 'gro myong yod pa'i na gzhon mang bos skad dpar nas 'khrug gzhas btang ste zhabs bro brgyab pa dang dbus phyogs kyi gzhas sna mang po btang ba dus mtshungs bstan 'dzin nor rgyas kyis gangs ri jo mo glang mar 'dzegs pa'i gzings bstod du nyam ro bstan 'dzin shar pa le/ tsa re'o hi sngal cu cu ri/7zhes pa'i nee shā li'i rol gzhas sgra 'dzin 'khor lo gsar thon byung ba de yang yul mi tshos sbyangs nas she pā li'i skad kyi thog gtong srol dar khyab chen po byung yod/gnya' nang khye na sku(ngas la lha mo dang rgyal gzhas 'khrab 〈snan la ma gtogs yul gzhas byings gzhi'i mnyam du sgra snyan gtong ba las/ rnga dung srol med pa de ni stod khyal sa gnas gzhan khag la'ang sbyi mtshungs yin bzo 'dug /phyis su btsan byol sbyi tshogs nang stod phyogs kyi sgor gzhas 'khrab pa'i skabs rnga dung pa'i lugs srol zhig yod pa de ni/ 1070 lo'i rjes su dar khyab byung ba yin cing /de yang / dang po dus 'gyur byung rjes bod du 'khor 159

lam bzo mgo tshugs te lung tsho stod smad so so nas na gzhon brgya phrag mang por ngal rtsol skul 'ded skabs dgong dro las mtshams bzhag rjes sgor gzhas 'khyabadus sgra snyan med par ldog sgra sgrig pa'i ched rnga rdung dgos byung ba dang / gong bzhin rgya gar nang btsan phyol du yong nas hi ma cal mnga' sde'i ku lu'i lung gzhung nang lam bakhro'i skabs su'ang thog mar 'tsho gos dka' ngal che bas sgra snyan gyi cha rkyen ma 'dzoms par gong bzhin rnga rdung dgos byung ba rjes su hre la rgyun lta bu chags pa 'di la gon rabs 'ga' shas kyis mosnas mthun gnang gi mi 'dug pa zhor 'phros su bris so//3)gya tshom gyi glu gzhas/gzhas sna 'ga' zhig ni mang snubs kyi 'tsho ba dang / mi sna phan tshun gyi 'brel lam la brten nas gsar rtsom byas pa dper na/ dbyar dpyid ston gsum du lung tsho gzhan khag nas yong pa'i tshong pa dang tshong 'dus kyi bud med na gzhon dbar mdza' brtse'i 'grel ba chags te phyir 'o ga skabs 'bral mi phod pa dang /slar gnya' nang du yong dus tshong 'dus kyi bud med re 'gas dga' bsu zhu bar yul mis gya tshom gyi glu gzhas bzos pa dus da lta'ang gtong bzhin pa ba/shaca/ ba/the/bzhu//snung 'dus ka ka gling la/ /g.yag pa'i tshwa khal rog rog160

rgyan yong ma yin pa'i yulaskad dang yul gzhas kyi sgor//byams pa sku1da 'a〈sna bsam nas/khrung la ye ga rgyab sku1da//ye ga gcig gis ma tshad//ye ga gsum brtsegs rog rog/byams pa phebs rgyu med par/ /ye ga nyi mas bzhus skusnang /zhes dang / gong bzhin lha sa nas bod gzhung gis bsgo brdzong gnang pa'i rdzong dpon rim pa'i las byed rnams kyang gnya' nang du sdod pa'i dus yun dga' sgre'i ngang 'da' bar byas te/ phyir log skabs blo yid ma bde bar phyir bltas yang nas yang du byed pa de dag la'ang yul mis gya tshom gyi zlu gzhas bzos nas gtong rgyun dar khyab byung ba dber na/ phyi lo 171/ nas 1723dbar pho lha ba bseted nams stobs rgyas nas gnya' nang rdzong dpon byas te phyir log skabs yul mi sbyi dang / lhag par mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba yod pa'i gzhon nu ma rnams kyi tog tu gyur pa/mtshar sdug gi ri mo mngon par bkra ba bsdudad skyid sku(gas bud med mdzes ma rnams dang 'bral mi 〈snad pa'i dka' ngal byung bar/ mi rnams kyis gsham gsal glu gzhas bzos nas btang pa de ni dus da lta'ang bod mi khyon yongs kyi sbyi tshogs nang dar khyab che la/ rol gzhas rnying khungs skad grags che ba'i gras la 1dus 'dzin byed/ gzhas chig nang mi pos phyir bltas slog gis zer ba'i mi pho ni/ mi dbang pho lhar go dgos kyang / phyi lo 2༷༷ lor lha sa nas gsar thon bod kyi gna' bo'i glu gar sgyu rtsal srol rgyun stod gzhas zhes pa'i glog brnyan 'od sder nang / 17/ji161

lor gorṣas bod ljongs sa gnas su btsan 'dzul byung ba dang / skabs der rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'gyor gnya' nang du phebs bzhugs skabs snying grogs zhig byung zhing / rjes su khong de nas kha bral te thon skabs khong gnyis nyacang yid phreng po byung bar brten gnya' nang mthong la nas phyi bltas yang yang slog pas de'i don dang sbyar nas/ rta phos phyi bltas slog gis zhes dang /phyi de gos chen lacags nag ces skusnags las snying sdug des kyang rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyi skabs de'i chas gos sogs kyang yid la dun pa'i tshul bstan pa lta bu'o zhes bris 'dug /cane kyang gor bod dmag 'khrug skabs rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor sogs bod phyogs kyi dpon rigs rnams gnya' nang du sgod dal bzhugs longs med par gonās btsan khrid byas pa'i lo rgyus gong du 'khod gsal bzhin thog ma'i gzhas tshig ni pho lha bar go dgos pa gsal po red/pho lha bar gnya' nang du snying grogs byung ba'i sgor mi dbang rtogs brjod la gzigs na mkhyen rgyu/des na mjug gi 'khrug gzhas chig phreng 'di dag rjes su gsar brtsams byas pa zhig yin par 'dod do///gnya' nang ma1sgrong la'i rtse nas//rta 〈snas phyir bltas blosnag byung //rta pho bden pa yod do//chag gi za 'phro lus bzhag/gnya' nang ma1snang la'i rtse nas//mi ye sa phyir bltas blo ga gis/162

thun yong ma yin pa'i yul skad dang /yul gzhas kyi skor//mi pho bden pa yod do//snying gi ze'u 'gru lus bzhag/srol rgyun stod gzhas zhes pa'i nang /gnya' nang mthong la'i rtse nas//rta phos byi bltas slog byung /rta pho zugs khag mi 'dug/phyag gi za 'gro lus song /gcasnan gathe(na tshur la gsan dang //mi 11sa thugs bsam bzhes nas//rta po'i srab mda' glod dang /'alnga/ba/ ba/zhathag/rgya yig shes nas yong yod//bod yig shes nas yong yod/phyag smyug dwangs bzang dbang po//dbu skra'i gseng la zer yod/phyi de gos chen lcags nag/nang de lu gu'i tsha ru/de 'dra'i na bza' bzhes mkhan//rdo ring sras chung sku zhabs/zhes dang / gong bzhin tshong 'dus kyi bud med dang bal po'i tshong pa'i dbar mdza' 'brel byung ba'i sgor la'ang gya tshom gyi gzhas sna mang bo skusnad pa de gras re zung gsham gsal ltar gtong gi red//dbyangs can bzhag na snying rje//dbyangs can khrid na ngo tsha//dbyangs can sba khug nang gi/g.yang ṭam yin gro gas byas na/zhes dang //thog bdag rgya la byon na/mnyam du khrid rogs gnang dang /163

/mnyam du mi khrid gsungs na//sems rten 'jog rogs gnang dang / zhes pa lta bya'o//4)gtam snyan dar 'phyar/7rgyal ba'i gser khri mnga' gasku la dang / rgyal srid zugs 'gan bzhes pa'i mdzad lham skusnags rgyal khab kyi dus chen khag la gtam snyan dar 'phyar zhes yul mi mnyam 'dzom gyi gzhas sna'i 'khrab ston rgya che byed hre la skusnad/ ngos rang gi dran thog tu gtam snyan dar 'phyar gyi dus ston thengs gcig byas pa de ni/7gong sa 7sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po 'phags yul du ston ba shākya thub pa 7sku mya ngan las 'das nas mi lo 27༷༷ 'khor ba'i dus ston gyi tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyur gyis lha ldan rgyal khab tu phyir zhabs sor 'khod pa'i dga' ston srung brtsi byas pa zhig yin zhing / skabs der tshong 'dus pa'i dmangs khrod kyi gzhas sna'i mnyam du gzhon pa 'ga' shas kyis phyi mi'i sku tshab mtshon casnad rgya gar ba dang / rgya mi/ dbyin ji/ bal therto/ 'brug pa/ 'bras ljongs pa/ 11ga bo/ kha che sdumags mi rigs sna tshogs kyi chas gos 〈snan nas lung pa so so'i lam lugs kyi phyag 'bul zhu ba dang / sgor gzhas kyi nang du zhugs te 'khrab ston sna tshogs byed pa'i srol rgyun ni ljid nyams chen bo yod par dran/164

zun yong ma yin pa'i yu spru skad dang /yul gzhas kyi skor/gtam snyan dar 'phyar gyi sgor dang gzhas tshig khag gcig 7rgyal ba skal bzang rgya masnu'i sku dus su byung 'dug pa dper na/gnas bzang khams gsum dbang 'dus/ /mi pho khams gsum dbang 'dus/ khams gsum dbang du 'dus nas/ /bod la bstan pa dar rgyas song zer ba ni/ gnya' nang gi rdzong dpon byas pa'i rjes su jun gar bar 'thab rgol gyis g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i mi dbang pho lha bskusnad nams stobs rgyas la yul mi tshos lar zhen gyis bstod bsngags byas pa zhig yin pa dang /gtsang la dga' ba dbyas la skyid pa/yang srid khri la byon song /sangs rgyas khri la byon nas/gtam snyan dar 'phyar yod do//zer ba ni dbus gtsang gnyis 'khrug rtsod kyis bsam tshul mi mthun pa'i dus skabs su/ 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i yang srid li thang nas phebs te/rtsod med sbyi yos byung bar dga' spre'i rnam pa bstan pa zhig yin pa bcas so//gtam snyan dar 'phyar gyi gzhas chig1/bya gcig yin na bsam byung //byi'u gcig yin na bsam byung //gnas bzang yid la 'khor ba'i/khang byi'u yin na bsam byung //gnas bzang khams gsum dbang 'dus//mi pho khams gsum dbang 'dus/khams gsum dbang du 'dus nas/bod la bstan pa dar song /165

/sangs rgyas khri la byon nas//gtam snyan dar 'phyar yod do//2bo brang dmar po'i grib bsil//lcang gseb shar la phog song //da lo lcang gseb shar la//yar rgyas yong pa yod do///gtsang la dga' ba dbyas la skyid pa//yang srid khri la byon song //sbas lung pad ma'i tshal la/padma'i pad sdong bzhengs yod//pad sdong zhal kha phye nas/'dzom gling 'od kyis khengs song //gtsang la dga' ba dbus la skyid pa//yang srid khri la byon song / zhes pa sta bya'o//7)the chas mo chas/tshong 'dus su lo gnyis re'i mtshams dbyar ka gnam gzhis skyid dus grong khyer stod smad so sor snga rjes res mos kyis pho chas mo chas zer ba'i dus ston chen po byed/de skabs gzhon pa gang 'tshams kyis bud med kyi chas gos dang / bud med 'ga' shas kyis khyo ga'i gyon chas gyon zhing / byings gzhis rang rang gi chas gosnas gzab mchor dang bcas gzhas sna mang po 'khrab ston byed pa ni grong khyer stod smad dbar 'gran bsdur lta bu zhig yin zhing /stod smad so so'i khyim tshang yongs rdzogs nas 'khrab ston go sgrig byed sgo gang cir do snang chen pos rkang 'gro lag 'don mnyam rub byed/ dus 'gyur ma byung tsam 166

thun yong ma yin pa'i yul skad dang /yul gzhas kyi sgor/du grong stod kyi gzhas dbon a jo zla ba zla zur dang / bud med kyi khongs nas ka 'go ba'i spun sbas mgo mtshams gcod zer ba gnyis dang / grong smad kyi gzhas dbon lo lo bkra nyis dang / bud med kyi khongs nas zugs rje lha khang gi tshe ring sgrol ma bcas yin/ sgra snyan gtong mkhan mang po yod pa'i khongs nas mkhas sgos ni a jo dkon mchog sbang leb zer ba zhig yod pa khong ni rol cha'i sgyu rtsal ha cang mkhas po yin par grags/ gzhas sna 'khrab ston che ba'i skabs mtshan mo'i dus su'ang 'phu ldir sa bzhu gsum bzhi dkyil du khri cog gi steng du bzhag nas mtshan 'khyongs 'khrab sgol dar rgyun byung yod pa bcas so//

le tshan dgu pa/rig gzhung 'khrab ston ru khag dang /bla ma ma ṇi ba/bon po/sgrung pa bcas kyi sgor/1)rgya rtags pa/stod khul 'byung ba'i gnod skyon dang ston nyes byung ba'i skabs gcig la gcig lan dang / bcu la bcu lan zhes 〈snang gseb phan tshun gcig phan gcig grogs byed srol yod pa ltar mtshams rer sman stod dang /gling pa/ding ri sdu gas nas rgya rtags sam/ rgyags ba〈snag pa zhes pa'i 'khrab lho na pa tsho khag snga rjes nas tshong 'dus su sgo khang gi sgo ra dang / grong khyer stod smad kyi sa cha 'du 'gag che sar 'khrab ston byed pa'i srol rgyun yod/ rang gi lung par ston nyes god chags byung nas rgyags 'tshol ched yong par brten tshang mas 'bru dang tsam pa sogs gnang sbyin gang thub spyod kyin yod kyang / rgyags ba〈snag pa'i gzhas sna'i kho ngas su a tsa ra zhes pa 'ga' shas nas khyim tshang so sor sgo slong byed bar yag po ma byas na/ kho tshos rtsam khug phyi nang slog ba dang brdab pa sku gas 'arāsnad pa ma khengs pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan tshe/ ltas ngan du brtsi bas 'bru gzan gya nom spyod kyi red/ 'on kyang khyim tshang 'ga' res 168

rig gzhung 'khrab ston ru khag dang /bla ma ma ṇi ba/bon bo/sgrung pa bcas kyi skor/gnang sbyin sprod zhor chang la sur pan btab nas sprod pa dang /gdong la rtsi nag byug nas gtong srol yang yod/ ltad mo'i khongs su dgra sha btub pa zhes pho gzhon rnams kyis dpa' rtsal gyi dpe mtshon rtswa ljang dang sa sbrel ba'i spang gog gi steng du zha khog brtsegs nas bzhag pa mi re ngo res rol gzhas dang bstun nas dpa' dam gnam la 'phyar te zhu thengs gcig la btub dgos/'ga' shas kyis sha btub pas ma tshad/ spang gog kyang dum bur btub cing /la las ni sbang gog dum bur btub rgyu phar bzhag zha'i cha shas tsam yang btub ma thub par kha skyengs byed pa sogs gang ltar ltad mo chen bo skusnad par dran/2)basprethag ba/zhathe//sgo rong ba dang / byang phu ba/ sgo gzhung ba sogs mtshams rer rgyas gzhas 'khrab ston byed mkhan yang sku(nga srol yod/ rgyas gzhas zer ba ni bod kyi gzhas chen rnying khongs zhig yin pa ltar ha cang bajid nyams che la ltad sa'ang chen po yod/ a pa rgad po zer ba 'khrab khyer mkhas bas ru sne khrid de/gzhogs g.yas nas mgo la sog zhwa gyon zhing / rna ba g.yon par sog byil/rkang par lham 'ja' chen/ skod par mda' gzhu dang dpa' dam 'dogs/ lag g.yas par lcag tshan khyer la/ g.yon mar lcags thub gyon pa'i pho gzhon dum 169

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gcig dang / gzhogs gaskusnan nas rgyan gos gzab mchor sbras pa'i bud med sgor zhig bcas pho mo nyi shu nas bzhi bcu bar gyis rnga rol gyi sgra gdangs dang bsdun nas nyin 'khyongs 'khrab ston byed/ kho tsho'i 'khrab ston gyi khongs su a ma gon mosna zer ba skyes pa mosna chas 〈snan pa bstan bzhig tsha 〈sna zhig gis bzhad gad mang po slong srol 'dug3)ral pa/rang gi pha yul nas gyar te/ 'tsho ba slong mor bsten nas rgyal khams skor mkhan ral pa pho yo lnga drug byas pa'i tsho khag re zung lo bstar yong nas sa cha 'du 'gag che sa khag la 'khrab ston byed/ gnya' nang pas kho tshor (rdang gzhang nga ) zhes 'bod pa de ni rnga dang gzhang gi sgra la brten nas btags pa zhig yin tshod 'dug khams phyogs nas yong ba'i ral pa de tshos rnga dang gzhang dkrogs pa'i sgra la brten nas lus rtsal sna tshogs kyi gar stabs dang / blo zhin tu 'khrug bo 'khrab pa ma zad/mi wang gi mnyam du snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i 'ba' gzhas mang po gtong gin yod ba yul mi na gzhon rnams kyis shes thabs byas te rang khyal du dar khyab byung yod/ ral pa'i zhabs dre'i nang mi re re byas te 'phag chen dang /'phag chung /mgo mjug ldog te lag pa btsugs nas 'gro ba sogs sger so so'i 'khrab rtsal ngom pa dang / bstan bzhig thod 170

rig gzhung 'khrab ston ru khag dang /bla ma ma ṇi ba/bon bo/sgrung pa bcas kyi skor/res byed pa sogs dmigs bsal khyad chos can gyi ltad yo mang po yod pas mi rnams kyis dga' bo byed/ ral pa rnams kyis lcang lo ring po bzhag te mgo g.yug pa'i 'khrab khyer dang / de bzhin blo pa'i rnga chung gi bzo dbyebs dang dung stangs sogs ni ko ri ya'i (501 pa)rig gzhung dang ha cang 'dra bo sku1da pa ltar phan tshun 'brel ba sku1da med nyams zhib byas na snyam mo1//4)glang 'khor ma ṇi ba/glang 'khor ram gla 'khor ma ṇi ba zhes lha mo 'khrab ston gyis slong mo rgyag mkhan tsho khag gcig losna ltar tsong 'dus su skusnang nas/'khrab gzhung gi cha shas ngon pa dang lus rtsal rnam grangs mang po 'khrab ston byed pa'i khongs su mi gnyis kyis ral gri ring bo kha phyogs gnam la bstan nas 'jus pa'i steng la gcig gis rkang rjen du gom bgrod byed pa dang / slar yang yu ba sa la btsugs pa'i gri rtser rang gi sto ba bzhag kyang /rkang mthil dang grod pa gnyis la rma shul tsam yang mi bzo ba'i khyad chos can gyi rtsed yo dang / shin tu lci ba'i rdo zhig pho gzhon gnyis gsum gyis mnyam du bkyag nas gan rkyal du nyal pa'i skye bo zhig gi pho ba'i steng du bzhag pa der lcags thos bzhus nas/rdo chen dum bur btang yang mi de'i lus khams la gnod skyetshen gang yang med pa'i ltad mo zhin tu ngo mtshar can zhig ston srol 'dug 171

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyus khams pa/sbyir btang gcung ri bo che ba'i lha mo ba rnams kyis 'khrab yul do rwa'i dkyil na khri phyog gi steng du grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i sku brnyan zhig 'jog srol yod rung / glang 'khor ba rnams kyis de'i tshab tu pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan zhig bzhugs gsol zhus pa'i mdun du rdo chen po zhig gi steng ral gri gnyis bzhag nas thog mar phrin bcol byed/ sku brnyan de ni dam pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi shang mtshal las bzhengs pa ha cang byin can char rlung dang gnam ngan 'gog gin yod pa ma zad/ha cang 'jigs dngangs che ba'i gri dang rdo yi rtsed sa de 'dras kyang lus la gnod skyon mi yong ba ni grub thob chen po'i gzung sngags bzlas nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btabs pa'i nus mthu yin par grags/ 'khrab ston gyi rjes su dum bur btang pa'i rdo rgyug rnams mi mang la byin rten du bgos sbyod byed/ tshong 'dus pa rnams kyis gri dang rdo yi rtsed po de dag ngo mtshar chen por ngos 'dzin byed kyang lha mo'i 'khrab khyer sgyu rtsal zhan par brten/ glang 'khor gyi ma ṇi ba dang chu drug pa'i dzo ma ni thabs chag red ces gya tshom byed kyin yod par grags/ chu drug ni ding ri khul gyi grong gseb zhig red/bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha sgor gyi nye 'dabs dpal gyi ding ri glang 'khor byang sems kun dga' gling dgon pa'i dbya bla dbang 'dus lags kyis thugs rgyus ltar na/ gong gsal pho ba rdo gzhag dang ral gri'i rtsed sna 'di 172

rig gzhung 'khrab ston ru khag dang /bla ma ma ṇi ba/bon bo/sgrung pa bcas kyi sgor/dag glang 'khor dgon pa'i srol rgyun byin can zhig yin zhing / dgon pa dang chos gzhis 'bras spungs kyi khongs gtogs la brten 'o ltar khral 'jal dgos pa'i dka' ngal che/ skabs zhig la 'bras spungs dgon pa'i sku tshab kyis 'khrab ston 'di 'bras spungs su gzigs 'bul gyis khral chag zhus na bka' 'khrol thob nges yin tshul gsung pa ltar/ glang 'khor sku gnyer sde pa gzhis ka dang /gra ri pad ma/nam rje thun tshogs/khong gi bu nor rgyas/sde pa'i nor bu bzang po sogs mi thog gong ma'i 'khrab ston mi 'gro gang 'tshams lha sar ngo bcar zhus/ rnam kun gri rtsed dang pho ba rdo gzhag gi rtsed sna khag ngon pa 'khrab ston gyi mjug tu nyi ma nub rir bzhud par 'dom gang tsam gyi dus skabs su mabesna 'dzugs byed 11la sku1da pa ltar skabs der nam mkhar bya rbesnad sding na gri dang tho bas lus la gnod skyon yong gi med par yid ches kyis rgya gar ba'i skad 'dra ba'i kha 'don gzung sngags skad shugs chen pos 'don pa dang chabs cig 'phags chen rgyab nas ngar thugs che ru gtong ba dang / stod hreng du rang gis rang la rta lcag bzhus pa sogs byed/'bras spungs su 'khrab ston byed pa'i nyin dang thog bya rgod lam seng ma 'khor par gri rtsed dus thog mgo 'dzugs ma thub par sems tshabs chen bo byung 'dug /'on kyang nyi ma nub rir ma bzhud tsam du bya rgod mang po nam mkhar 'khor bas ma tshad/dgon pa'i sde yangs kyi nang du'ang bya rgod gnyis lding sgor rgyab pa kun gyis 173

mig mthong byung rjes gzigs 'bul lam sgongs byung ste glang 'khor dgon par khral chag thob pa'i lo rgyus ni gong gsal mi 'gro rnams dang skabs der ltad mo'i khongs su bcar ba zhing gshegs ding ri tsho dpon dang zhal ngo stobs lags sdu gas la'ang zhib phra gsung rgyu sku nga zhes 'grel bshad gnang gi 'dug pa bcas so//7)bal yul gyi bon po/dbyar kha bal yul gyi mtha' mtshams 11nga gseb khag nas rta mang dang / gu rung sogs bon dang nang chos gnyis kur dad pa dag snang yod pa'i mi sna tsho khag so sor tshong 'dus phu yi da ra mtsho dang / bya khyung gangs ri mchod mjal du yong mkhan mang bo yod/rong pa de dag ru bsgrigs nas 'gro ba'i bang rim gyi dkyil du bon po re gnyis ras dkar po'i gyon chas rkub sul mang po yod ba re dang /ske nas lag 'og g.yas g.yon la rta drel gyi ling shang gnyis re khram kha brgyab ste 〈snan zhing / lag gasku1na du rnga chung khyer ba g.yas pas bdung ste 'khrab kyin 'gro ba de dag gi rnga sgra dang bsdun nas bang rim nang yod pa'i gnas sgor ba pho yo yongs nas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur tu/ gsol bon bo gsol/gsol lo gsol lo/gsol lo bon po/gsol lo gsol lo/bon po brgya dang brgyad kyi nang nas/'o ra'i bon bo gsol lo/gsol lo/zhes 174

rig gzhung 'khrab ston ru khag dang /bla ma ma ṇi ba/bon lha/sgrung ba bcas kyi sgor/glu gzhas gtong bzhin pa'i ngang 'grul bskyod byed srol de ni ches snyan zhing snang ba skyid po yod par dran no//ca)bu chen pa/tshong 'dus 〈snang khyer nang bu chen pa zhes pa bla ma ma ṇi ba chos bshad byed mkhan mang bo yod/rnam kun bu chen pa rnams rang rang so sor grong khyer gyi sa cha stod smad gang rung du mthong rgyu yod kyang sa zla'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin tshang ma sa gnas 'du 'gag che sa ko thang gnas po'i sgo 'gram du 'dzoms te thog mar gur g.yab thub nas zhal thang dang mchod pa bshams pa'i rjes su dung dkar bus nas chos brda gtong ba dang / de nas mi rnams 'dzom mgo tshugs dus skyabs 'a〈sna dang maṇḍal gyis sngon bsus te/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs sdu1gas thang bshad byed/ bu chen pa rnams kyis dmyal khams bcasna brgyad dang /'gro ba bzang mo/dri med kun ldan/snang sa 'od 'bum/ gzugs kyi nyi ma/rgyal bza' bal bza'/ khye'u padma 'od 'bar/nor bzang /dge slong ma dpal yo sogs kyi rnam thar thang ka so so'i ri yo ngo sgod byed bzhin du snyan 'jebs 'gyur khug ldan pa'i skad gdangs kyi thog nas 'grel bshad rgyag skabs mi rnams yid dbang rab tu 'phrog cing / khong tsho'i mtha' 'khor du nyan mkhan gon gzhon pho yo mang po phal cher nyin gang sdod pa de dag gis 175

mtshams rer bu chen pa'i mnyam du gzungs sngags yig drug sogs kha 'don gdangs dbyangs snyan 'jebs ngang 'don pa dang /sgrung gtam skyo po yod dus sems 'gul thebs nas mig chu mnyam gtong byed pa/ skyid pa'i lo rgyus sgod skabs dga' sgo 'phel nas bzhad gad 'ur chil du sgrog pa sogs dga' sdug gi tshor ba mnyam myong byed pa'i srol rgyun de ni phyogs gcig nas ya rabs snarshas kyi bslab bya bzang 〈sna spel thabs dang / 〈snags gzhan nas spretshe sems skyed 'phel byed rgyu'i gzhi rtsa zhig kyang yin pa ltar/ mi rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim nas ja chang khyer nas bu chen pa'i sgrung gtam nyan rgyur dga' yos chen po byed pa ma zad/'ga' zhig gis bu chen par gnas tshang g.yar ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis za btung 'dzad med mkho sprod byed/ bu chen pas thang bshad byas par brten nas yi ge 'bri klog mi shes pa rnams kyis kyang chos dang rig gzhung / gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus mang po shes rtogs thub kyin yod pa ltar gnya' nang du'ang mi rabs gon pa'i khongs su mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang po dang / snang sa 'od 'bum/ chos rgyal nor bzang sogs kyi rtogs brjod ngag thog nas shod rgyu yod mkhan mang po yod/gnya' nang khul gyi bu chen pa grags che ba ni/sgo rong nas yin pa bu chen ba sangs dang tshe ring bkra zhis spun gnyis/ ding ri rtsa skor ba bu chen 'gyur med/bu chen nor rgyas dang khong gi bu yo/bu chen dbang phyug pha bu gnyis/rdog gcod 176

rig gzhung 'khrab ston ru khag dang /bla ma ma ṇi ba/bon po/sgrung pa bcas kyi skor/nas yin pa bu chen mig longs ba thang bshad rgyag rgyur zhin tu nas mkhas pa cig skusnad pa bcas la mi rnams kyis dga' po byed/ bu chen ba sangs la'ang bu yo tshe ring sgrol ma zer ba zhig yod pa thang bshad rgyag rgyur mkhas po yod par grags/ sngar bod du bu chen nam bla ma ma ṇi ba pho mo mang po grong nas grong du bskyo da de ma ṇi skul ba dang las dge ba byas na 'bras bu bde ba dang / sdig pa byas na 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong dgos pa sogs kyi thang bsgod rgyag srol bzang po de dag da cha gzhis byes bod mi'i sbyi tshogs nang nyin mo'i rgyu skar ltar dkon bo chags pa 'di ni ha cang phangs po yin par snyam yo//7)sgrung pa/gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dpe klog mkhan dang /sgrung klu len pa'i srol rgyun ni bod kyi zhing 'brog sa khul gang sar dar khyab chen po yod pa ltar/ dbyar dpyid ston gsum gyi ring gnya' nang du'ang khams phyogs nas yong ba'i a co ba 'ga' shas kyis sgrung zhwa gyon pa'am lag tu khyer nas gling sgrung sgod mkhan mang po yod/ sgrung pa de dag la khyim dud re zung gis sgo 'gram du ko gdan thog bzhag ste sgrung nyan nas za btung gya nom sprod pa las/ bla ma ma ṇi ba lta bu nyan mkhan mi tshogs chen po med pa ma zad/ gling sgrung sgod nyan mang po byas na lha srung la phog zug 'gro yi yod pa'i bshad sgros kyang yod pa bcas so//

le tshan bcu pa/nam dus so so dang bstun pa'i phru gu'i rtsed sna/bod rgyal yongs nang byis pa rnams kyi gzhis spyod dang 'tshams pa'i rtsed sna dang glu gzhas mang po yod pa bzhin gnya' nang khul du'ang mi rabs nas mi rabs bar dar rgyun byung ba'i phru gu'i rtsed rigs mang bo yod/ phru gu tshos rgyun du grong khyer nang yib res zhes byis pa gcig gab nas gzhan dag gis 'tshol ba'i rtsed yo dang / yar zas mar zas/ gser gyi sgo yo sogs gna' dus nas dar ba'i rtsed mo sna tshogs brtse ba'i goms srol yod pa'i khongs nas rang gis gang shes bska(da pa ga ma gsal/1)swādor chas/rtsed yo 'dir bu po rnams kyis nang gi rmo phyo dang a ma yin khul nang las byed tshul dang / bu rnams kyis pha bu tshong la 'a11 khul byed pa sdu gas gtam brjod lta bu'i 'khrab ston byed/

nam dus so so dang ba na pa'i rgya gu'i rtsed sna/2)ab 'thor/bya sa phal che bas ab rdo'am ab 'thor rtsed rgyur dga' po byed/ab 'thor rgyag stangs ni gru gu gnyis gsum gang rung mnyam du rdo ril chung chung 'ga' zhig yar sgrug mar bzhag byed pa'i lag rtsal 'don pa'i rtsed sna zhig red/lag pas 55ba 'a11ra rgyag pa dang chabs cig kha nas gzhas gshesang dbo|sa/gzhas kyi chig 'a〈snas la bsdun nas 65ba 'a11ra rgyag stangs de yang las sla ba nas dka' ba'i bar rim bzhin 'gro dgos/ ab 'thor rgyag skabs sngon la snga rting sus byed thag gcod byed/ snga rting thag chod byung mtshams sngon la rtsed mkhan des ab 'thor len mi thub pa'i skabs su rtsed mtshams bzhag nas rjes ma des brtse dgos/ de ltar phan tshun res mos byas nas rtsed rim thar ma thon bar brtse dgos/ gnya' nang du ab 'thor rgyag pa'i skabs bu mo tsho'i kha nas/ sbangs rdo 'phang nas sbang rdo sgril shog /da ga zhus shog zer ba sogs dbus skad mang po brgyab pa de dbang du gzhigs na khul 'dir ab 'thor rgyag srol thog mar lha sa nas dar ba zhig yin bzo 'dug3)spu blugabu rnams kyis spu blug gam spungs blug zer ba phru gu gnyis sam bzhi lnga gang rung mnyam du 'dzoms te/ mi re ngo re nas bsdus pa'i ṭam ka sbar mo'i nang 179

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/khyer nas/ bang rim res mos kyis gom pa drug bdun tsam gyi 'gyangs tshad sar i khyang sgor sgor drus pa zhig gi nang du sdug thabs byas nas/'dzul zin pa rnams thob pa smos med thog da dung sa la thor ba'i ṭam ka gcig la sbrags rdo 'phang dbo sa/ sbrags rdo de ṭam ka gzhan la ma reg par 'ben la phog na/ sa steng du yod pa'i ṭam ka yongs rdzogs thob thub pa dang / gal te gzhan la reg na reg sa'i grangs 'bor la gzhigs pa'i nyes pa kha bston brgyab dgos pa'i rgyan rtsed 'di la tshang mas dga' po byed kyi red/rtse yo 'di la lha sa bas 'bo li zer gyin 'dug4)rgyu rtsa/gong bzhin zu gu gnyis sam bzhi lnga gang rung mnyam du 'dzoms te/ res yos bzhin rgu rtsa zer ba tshon ris sna tshogs kyi shel rdo'am shel ril sbar yo gang re sa la bkrams nas/ bong tshad gcig gyur gyi shel ril gcig lag gnyis sa thog tu bzhag ste mdzub mo'i dbar 'jus nas shel ril gzhan la gzhu dgos pa'i rtsed po zhig yod/ de 'dra'i rtsed 'gran skabs phru gu 'ga' zhig gis rgyang thag ring po nas 'phen pa'i shel rdo tshag sgra dang bcas 'ben la phog thub pa'i sbyang rtsal chen po yong / rtsed yo 'di bal yul nas dar ram shā/ca//180

7)ab cugaganya' nang pas ab cug la slong rdog zer ba de ni ra lug gi pus tshigs rus chung zhig yin zhing / phru gu tshos slong rdog gi rus chung gru bzhi de'i steng 'og dang /rgyab mdun gyi bzo dbyibs so sor rta dang /ra/lug/bong bu bcas sems can mi 'dra ba bzhi dang / shar nub 〈sna byang ༷ gas mtshams kyi dbye ba byas te/ phru gu gnyis sam/ gsum bzhi gang rung mnyam du rtsed srol yod/65ba cug la snu'i masnga ga sna khyordogs byug pa dang /'ga' shas kyis mabo| mjug brdar nas snying rje po bzo gi red/ skyon chag med pa'i ab cug dang brdar ma legs pa'i gas la nyis slong zhes rin thang nyis ldab rtsi rgyu red/tsa)dbyu gubu rnams kyis e gu'am dbyu gu zer ba'i rgyug rtsed cig rtsed kyi red/ dbyu gu ni bal yul nas dar ba'i dbyug rtsed cig yin par brten rtsed dus/ zhe ko dus/stan yo/tsār/pan co/tsha nas mar la shud gro zhes ni pa li'i skad kyi thog nas thob grangs gsog gi red/7)dkyil mdzub 'tshol ba/phru gu gnyis sam gsum bzhi gang rung mnyam du 'dzoms nas/ gcig 181

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/gis rang gi lag pa gcig gi mdzub mo lnga'i rtse yo ma gtogs mthong rgyu med par bkab rjes phru gu re re bzhin dkyil mdzub gar yod 'tshol du bcug nas/ 'tshol thub mkhan rnams rgyal kha 1snab pa dang / 'acordol mi thub mkhan de dag pham par rtsis te/ thob mkhan gyis pham mkhan de'i dkyil mdzub bzung dgos/ pham mkhan des nga'i mdzug mo gtong rogs zhes zhu ba 'then pa nas mgo tshugs te khong gnyis dbar dri ba sdus lan 'di ltar byed/1 thob mkhan/mdzub yo btang na brngan pa ga re ster gyi yin/2 pham mkhan/gser ster gyi yin/3 thob mkhan/gser gang du yod/4 pham mkhan/gser sba khyag nang du sku da/7 thob mkhan/sba khug gang du sku da/ca pham mkhan/sba khug rkyal pa'i nang du sku(da/7 1snab mkhan/rkyal pa gang du sku da// pham mkhan/rkyal pa rtsi rtsis zas sdu nga /'a thob mkhan/rtsi rtsi gang du yod/1༷ pham mkhan/rtsi rtsi i khung nang du 'dzul song /11 thob mkhan/i khung ga par yod/182

nam dus so so dang bstun pa'i zu gu'i rtsed sna/12 pham mkhan/i khung rtswa yis 'gag song /13 1snab mkhan/rtswa ga par sku1da/14 pham mkhan/rnamadzo mos zos song /17 thob mkhan/mdzo sa gang du yod/mi pham mkhan/ma11 mo la brgyab sdumang /17 thob mkhan/la gang du yod/1/ pham mkhan/la gangs kyis mnan sku nga /1 thob mkhan/gangs ga par yod/2༷ pham mkhan/gangs nyi mas bzhus skusnang /21 thob mkhan/nyi ma ga par skusnad/22 pham mkhan/nyi ma sbyin pas bsgribs skusnang /23 thob mkhan/sbyin pa gang du yod/24 pham mkhan/sbyin pa zin ma thub song /nga dang khyod rang mi dgos/bya rgod gcig gis kyang zin thub pa mi 'dug/ces brjod pa dang sbrags rang gi dkyil mdzub shugs brgyab ste 'then rjes rtsed mo mtshams 'jog byed pa'am yang na bskyar du gung mdzub 'tshol res byed/

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa//)a bo mthe bong rog rogami rgan pa zhig gis phru gu gang zhig gi lag pa'i mdzub mo re re bzhin bzung nas/ 1) a bo mthe bong rog rog 2) mdzub gus skyo mag ldag mkhan/3) gser gyi chigs khebs 〈snan mkhan/4) dathosnan mcho ga la mchodi pa 'bul mkhan zhes mdzub mopha sgom pa bzhi la ho rim bzhin 'grel bshad byas rjes/mtha' ma mtheb chung de lag mthil gnyis kyi dbar la bzhag nas/ mi byed dgu byed byed mkhan 'di red ces skad ngan ma sgor bar yar sgril mar sgril byed pa de la bru gu tshos dga' bo byed/ gzhan yang a tsha dzo ma tsha gi 'dug gas zer ba sogs lag rtsed sna tshogs yod kyang yig rdzob che bas 'dir ma bkod/0)rgyal po'i gur khang /bru gu gnyis cha sbrel nas/ gcig gis rang gi lag pa gnyis na'i mjub sa lnga so sor phreng thag las ring tsam gyi skud pa phar 'then tshur 'then byas te/pa tre lta bu bzo dbyibs gru bzhi nar yo zhig bzos par gru gu gzhan pa des dkyil nas bzung ste/ yar gnam la 'then nas rgyal po'i gur khang dang / mar 'og tu 'then nas khron pa gting lug bcas dbyibs gzugs khag gnyis bzos pa'i rjes su rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi mdzub mo bzhi'i steng du blangs te/184

dpal be'u rtse drug can zhig bzos/ de nas slar yang phru gu dang po de'i lag par blangs te phru gu snyal sa'i bu gzeb dang / bong bu'i rna cog bcas bzo gi red/1༷)rgyal po rin bo cher dgongs pa zhus nas log 'gro/phru gu gcig rkyang pas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub yor skud pa g.yogs nas re re bzhin mdud pa brgyab ba'i rjes su rgyal pos gtong gis/ gtong gis/ zer nas mdzum po tha chung gi mdun gyi skud pa'i sne po nas thengs gnyis 'then pa dang /btsun mos mi gtong /mi gtong /zer nas rgyab kyi skud pa nas thengs gnyis tsam 'then pa'i rjes su mthe bong la dkris pa'i skud pa dkrol te/ 7rgyal bo rin po che la dgongs ba zhus nas log 'gro zhes zer gyin mdzub sa byings gzhir gasku gas pa'i skud pa rnams mdud ba dkrol ma dgos par 'then thub pa'i khyad chos mig 'phrul ltar ston gyi red/11)stag 1( bzhi/rdo leb kyi thog sa dkar gyis thig mang bo brgyab pa gru bzhi'i steng du/ gcan gzan stag gi masnun byed chu rdo dmar po che ba bzhi dang /ra lug masnun rtags rde'u chung chung dkar po nyi shu bkrams te/stag gis lug re re'i steng du rgyangs

mchonges brgyab nas za thabs byed pa dang / lug rnams kyis mnyam du bsnad nas stag 'gro sa med par 'gog thabs byed/ stag gis lug re re'i steng du mchongs pa las/gnyis mnyam gzhib yod pa'i steng du mchongs mi chog ba'i rtsed mo 'di la gon byis tshang mas dga' po byed kyi red/12)phru gu'i rgyan rgyagaphru gu phan tshun rgyan brgyab pa'i skabs/ su thob rtsod med thag gcod 'phang pa'i ched du/ sngar yin na phru gu gnyis sam gsum bzhi gang rung 'dzoms nas/gcig gi kha nas/rta/lug/sbrel/bya/khyi/phag/byi ba/glang /stag/sku1sa/'brug/sbrul zhes skyor gyin phru gu re re'i brang khog tu mdzub mo btsugs nas sbrul zer ba'i mtha' tshig gang du khel ba de la rgyan thob ngos 'dzin byed pa skusgogs ya rabs kyi bslab bya dang shes bya'i tshig don bzang po sna mang skusnad 'dug kyang phyis su de dag gi tshab tu/ ༷a mas 'don pa'i 'don la mar/65 zhang rgan gyi mar phyur/tal la ta la 'di mān/gsum kha la bzhur/ zhes zer gyin dzibazhur zer ba'i mtha' tshig gang du khel ba de la rgyan thob par ngos 'dzin byed/ tshong 'dus pas mi blo gros can la sgyudi man zer ba de ni bal skad red/186

7)ye dha ju/phru gu 'ga' shas gral sgor sgor byas nas sa la bsdad de rkang pa nang du rkyangs pa'i thog/gcig gis phru gu re re'i rkang par mdzub mo 'dzugs bzhin kha nas/ye dha ju/ dha ju e ma thing ka 'khor lo/ a hi le pa kur zhes skad shugs chen po brgyab pa'i tshig gi mtha' ma gang du khel ba de sgor bar ngos 'dzin byed pa'i rtsed sa 'di ni bal po'i bu rgyag rnams las shes te dar rgyun byung ba zhig red/14)shur gro sba res/phru gu rnams tsho khag gnyis su gyes te/ gcig gis gab nas sdod pa dang /gzhan pa de tshos ra lug gi lhas ra'am/ tshal zhing gi mtha' bsgor rdo rtsig dang / sa steng rdo leb gang rung gi 'og tu sol ba nag pos shur rtags yig phreng lta bu bang bsgrigs nas bris te sbas 'jog byas pa gab mkhan tshos btsal te bsub rtags brgyab dgos/ma rnyed pa rnams re re bzhin grangs ka brgyab ste/ grangs 'bor che ba'i tsho khag de rgyal kha thob par ngos 'dzin byed/shur bris grangs bsher yang yang byas par brten nas phru gu tshos grangs ka 'bum gcig bar las sla por shes thub pa'i dge mtshan sku da/ gnya' nang pas rtsed yo de la shur gro sba res zer 187

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bu tsha rgyalakhams pa/17)'khyag shud/gru gu tshos dgun kha gangs babs che ba'i skabs ri mgo nas bgyid lugs mi 'dra ba'i gangs shud dang /'khyag shud sna tshogs gtong gi red/'ga' shas kyis g.yag gi rwa co bsgrugs nas cha bsgrigs nyis sprel bzos pa'i steng du bzhon te lag gnyis kyis rwa rtser 'jus nas 'khug shud gtong srol yod/14)rkang gcig pa dang zha ra/dgun kha gnam ngan bstan de gangs lhags 'tshub 'tshub byed pa'i skabs rang khyim dang 'dris che'i khyim dud khag nas mar kun rtsam pa bslangs nas zug pa bkol te mnyam 'thung byed pa dang / khang pa 'og thog che gras kyi nang rtsed yo sna tshogs rtsed nas dus tshod gar 'gro mi shes pa'i skyid bo byed/ rtsed mosna mang che ba ni rkang gcig pa dang zha ra zhes mig gnyis ka lham sgre gas kyis bkab pa'i phru gu gcig gis lag yug brgyab ste gzhan rnams 'tshol dbesnas pa dang / 'tshol dgos pa'i phru gu byings gzhi'i rkang pa gnyis ka lham sgrogs kyis bsnams pa lag pas bzung thub na sgal par khya tshur re snun chog17)sbyi ma'i ldo/gong bzhin sbyi ma'i rdo gcig ces gru gu gcig gis a ma byas nas sbyi rdo 188

nam dus so so dang bstun pa'i rgya gu'i rtsed sna/sbas nas bzhag pa gzhan pa tshos 'tshol dbesnas pa dang / a ma des sbyi ma'i rdo de a mas 'tshol dgos sam zhes yang nas yang du 'dri bar byed/ sus rnyed pa de rgyal kha thob par ngos 'dzin gyis gzhan la nyes pa gtong ba dang /ma rnyed na a ma byed mkhan la rgyal kha 〈snab par casas 'dzin byas te byings gzhis nyes pa khur dbo sa/gzhan yang me blosnang ba dang /sbyang gis be'u 'tshol ba/thag mchong /theb pad rgyag pa sogs phru gu'i rtsed sna mang po yod/ dus 'gyur ma byung tsam du phru gu tshos zhing las bzos pa'i gri rtsed dang / 'bar rdzas thon gsar sgog sbag g.yug res byed ba ma zad/ grong khyer stod smad so skusnar sgog khag byas te 'thab nas stod la pham nyes byung ba'i skabs smad kyi phru gu tshos stod sdod rul pa 'jigs so ṭa ṭwāṃ ṭan/ zer nas skad 'bod byed pa dang / smad la pham gun byung dus stod phrug tshos gong bzhin smad sdod rul pa 'jigs so ṭa ṭwāṃ ṭan zhes skad 'bod byed/ṭa ṭwāṃ ṭan zer ba ni nee pā le'i skad brda yin tshod 'dug16)ra bo zug po su ngar/khyad mtshar zhig la phru gu rgyag res sgor ba'i skabs gon byis 'ga' shas kyis ma byed ma lta zer ba'i slob ston byed rgyu med pa'i khar/ ra bo thug bo su ngar ngar/ mar yin na gzhu/ lcags yin na ngar/ zhes zer gyin rdo leb gcig

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/la mchil ma btab ste dkyil du bzhag pa de la phru gu su zhig gis rkang pa sngon du bzhag pa de ni blo khog che bar ngos 'dzin gyis ngar sha dang /khong khro slong srol ngan pa zhig kyang yod/phyi lo 107/ dang 107 so sor gnya' nang pa'i rgya gu tshos bal yul rgyal sa'i nang srid don shog khag kong re se zer ba langs mgo tshugs pa de dag gi lad zlos byas te/nee bul kong re se/dzin dha lhad/stan sar kār/pānaca sar kār/ mur dha bhad/ zhes don du nee pāl kong re se thog khag rgyal gyur cigadapal lnga ldan dang gsum ldan gyi srid dbang 'jigs gyur cig ces skad 'bod kyis ru bsgrigs nas 'gro ba sogs ya mtshan can gyi rtsed rigs sna tshogs dar ba de dag lung pa'i nang phyi'i rgyal khab kyi gnas tshul la do snang gis shes rtogs phran bu yosnad ba'i gnas stangs mtshone par snyam/1 )dbyags sgom ring zung gi 'gran bsdur/phru gu 'ga' shas mnyam du 'dzoms nas dbyags thag ring thung blta ba'i ched du/ sde pa'i lha khang che mo la/ phyag yo brgya dang brgyad cu skusnad/ gcig 'phur nas rdi ri ri/ gnyis 'phur nas rdi ri ri/ gsum 'phur nas rdi ri ri/ zhes dbyags thengs gcig la grangs ka gang mang skyor ba'i 'gran bsdur byed/dbugs sbyong gi tshig gzhi gzhan zhig kyang skusnad pa de ni/ bla brang thog kha'i 190

snang la/ka to ra nyi shu rtsa gcig yod/de dbyags thengs gcig la bgrang thub na/zhi dmyal ba'i yul la ngan song myong dgos med/ ka to ra gcig /ka to ra gnyis/ka to ra gsum ces grangs nyer gcig bar dbyags thengs gcig la skyor srol yang yod/gnya' nang pas phug ron la phug mo 'am sbug yo zer/rig pa 'phel ba dang / tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi dbugs sgom mchog tu gyur pa ni/bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal 'o(//nyes a ra pa dza na rtswa/rtswa/rtswa/zhes a ra pa tsa skyor nas dbyags sgom ring thung blta ba'i lam srol yang sku da/20)lce rtsal 'gran bsdur/gong bzhin smra lce bde po dang / sgra dag po yong ba'i ched du phru gu 'ga' shas mnyam du 'dzoms pa'i thog gsham gsal ba1snad tshig rnams grangs ka gang mang kha nas myur 'don byas te/ sus sgra dag pa dang ngag skyor bde ba de rgyal ba dang / gces skad sgor ba dang ngag 'don ma thub mkhan la tshang mas 'phya dmod byed srol yod/1 lha sa'i rtswa skya rtswa/2 rgyal rtse'i skyog lcags skyog3 ra'i ra gog hril hril/lug gi ra gog leb leb/191
drod yo so

le tshan bcu gcig pa/srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu stangs skor/1)'e1 gsar/gnya' nang pa'i lo gsar ni/ bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nyin srung brtsi byed/ 'byung rtsis lugs ltar phru gu skyes pa'i lo khams ngos 'dzin gyi dbye mtshams kyang bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la skusnar gnas byed par brten mnga' ris skor gsum dang /sgo 'brug /'bras ljongs/bal po'i sa mthar gnas sdod bod rigs nas bod zla bcu gcig par lo gsar dga' ston byed babs 'di la gzhigs na/ sngar dus bod yongs kyi lo gsar ni bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la spyi mtshungs min nam snyam pa dngos khang blo sgru sa chos dar nas brtsams pa'i dbul po'i nor rdzas sam phal pa'i mthong tshul zhes pa'i nang gsal bkod byas pa bzhin lo mgo ngo ma ni bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig rang la yin par ngos 'dzin byed pa ma zad/ dgun nyi yang dus tshes 'di rang la 'o ga pa bcas gnya' nang pas bod zla bcu gcig par lo gsar srung brtsi byed sgol la rgyu mtshan yang dag yod par snyam/ gong bzhin mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas 'don spel byas pa bod kyi dmangs srol 193

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gces btus zer ba'i nang du'ang lo gsar gtong srol thad yul srol goms gshis mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis dus tshod mi 'dra ba yod pa dper na/ kong po khul dang stod mnga' ris spu greng rdzong sogs la bod zla bcu gcig par gtong ba dang / lha sa man chod chu shar thong gi khongs sogs dbus gtsang gi sa khul mang po zhig la bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang so nam lo gsar zer ba de gtong sro la chags/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang hor gong ma se chen rgyal poyis bod khri sgor bcu gsum gyi ches mtho'i 'gan dbang yod tshad sa skya 'a〈sna mabo na chos rgyal 'phags par phul nas rgya bod mi rigs bar gyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / chos lugs bcas kyi 'brel ba gong 'phel gtong skabs rgya nag gi hang le zla ba dang po dang bod zla dang po mthun par brten zla dang po'i tshe gcig nyin khyab che sgos kyi lo gsar gtong srol chags te gang ltar bod khyon yongs kyi lo gsar gcig gyur zhig med lugs 'khod 'dug /can kyang bod khri sgor bcu gsum sa skya 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags par phul mkhan ni kub la'i khang yin pa las jing gir min la/skabs de'i 'brel ba yang yon sog po dang bod kyi dbar du byung ba las rgya bod kyi 'brel ba min/ gong ma se chen gyi lo rgyus dung dkar tshig mdzod kyi sgog grangs 743 nas 744 bar dang / lo gsar gyi lo rgyus kyang gong gsal chig mdzod kyi 〈snag grangs 1777bcas 31 skusnar gzigs pa 'tshal/194

srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu stangs skor/bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes shar gyi nam dus ni gnam gzhis grang ngar che tsam yin rung / zhing las kyi brel 'tshub med par mi rnams lus sems cung zad dal bar brten lo gsar gtong rgyur dga' spro dang dang dod chen pos sngon tshud nas khang mig re re bzhin gad bdar gtsang sbra zhib tshags byed/thab tshang dang du khung / gdung ma sogs la lo gcig gi du dreg chags yod ba rnams gtsang 'phyag byas nas khang pa'i ka gdung dang rtsig ldebs bcas par bkris rtags brgyad sogs gro zhib kyi dkar rtags ri yo dang / thab kyi nye 'khris su me lha gsol zhes pa'i yi ge/chu zangs chen mo'i 'khris su chu lha gsol zhes pa'i yi ge khag rtsam pas dkar rtags 'then nas 'bri ba ma zad/sgo dang sge'u khung la sham bu sgo yol gsar pa dang / thog steng du dar lcog khang pa'i mdun du dar chen 'dzugs rgyu bcas kyi dar phyog che chung rim pa gra sgrig byed/gnya' nang pa'i kha rgyun la/ gnam gang la mabesna bkrus na tshes gcig la mgo 'the ga zer ba ltar/ dgu thug gi nyin mo'am yang na de'i nyin ma sngon mar rgan gzhon tshang mas skra 'khru ba sku gas gtsang sbra gang gzab byed pa dang / zhwa mo sdusags rgyan gos la'ang spags phyis brgyab nas gra sgrog 'thus tshang byed kyi red/nyi shu dgu ni/ bod kyi dmangs grol gces btus nang gsal ba bzhin lo gcig gi 'gal rkyen sel bar dmigs nas glud rdzong bya rgyu sogs byed sgo gal 'gangs che bar ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar de nyin nang mi rnams phyogs 195

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/bskyod ma dgos pa gtso 'don gyis nang du tshang 'dzoms thub thabs byed/tshong 'dus pa'i dgu thug ni bag ril tsam min par nas 'bru brdungs nas pags pa bshus te mnyen po bzos pa bag thug gi mnyam du sgol gyi red/bod khyon yongs kyi sa gnas sbyi mtshungs dgu thug gi nang thug rdor sha dang /la phugaphyur ba/gro ma/sngo tshal sogs blug nas sgol ba ma zad/de nyin mi'i bsam pa dang spyodad tshul bzang ngan mtshon byed bag ril che tsam byas pa'i nang rdo dang / bal/ sur pan/ sol nag /sran ma/ dkar yol chag hrug sogs mtshon rdzas sna tshogs bcug cing mnyam du sgol nas gra sgrig grub mtshams nang mi rgan gzhon rim bzhin rgyan bosnas gzab mchomar dang bcas bzhugs gral du 'khod pa'i gsham du rdza khog chag hrug gi nang du gro zhib rjen pas mi'i gzugs brnyan gyi glud cig bzos pa'i mdun du ja ro dang / sbang ma sogs zas kyi snyigs ro/ nang mi tshang mas lag gnyis su zan gyi chang bu re bzung ste so so'i sbyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i bar la dril phyis byed bzhin du kha nas/ lus kyi na tsha dang / sems kyi sdug bsngal/ lo gcig zla ba bcu gnyis/zhag ma sum brgya drug cu'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ bgegs rigs stong drag brgyad cu sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad glud ngan khyod kyis khyer zhig zer ba sogs brjod mthar chang bu la gos kyi sne dzar dang sbar btsir btang nas lag rjes bzhag pa de la thu lud btab ste glud kyi mtha' 196

srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu stangs sgor/sgor du skyur ba sogs byed cing /bzhugs gral du 'khod pa'i nang mi rnams la dang po gsol ja dang de rjes dgu thug 'degs kyi red/ thug pa thengs dang po blug rjes so so'i phor pa'i nang nas mtshon don bzang ngan gang thon pa rnams snga rjes rim bzhin 〈snag bsher byas bstun rgan rabs rnams nas 'grel bshad brgyab ste ha cang dgod bro po yong / thug thengs rjes ma der bza' 'gro phran bu bzhag nas glud kyi rdza khog nang du blug dgos pa dang / de ltar byed sgo mjug sgril mtshams su glud rdzong byed cing / de dus mi gcig gis dpal 'bar zhes smyug ma'i rtse mor ras snam byug par me sbar nas khyer ba dang / mi gzhan gyis glud khyer nas 'be ba'i rjes su bud med gcig gis phyag ma brgyab ba dang / nang mi gzhan rnams kyis bzlog pa yang rdeb srol sku1da/ glud 'gong khyer tshar ba'i rjes su phyi sgo dam por gnon dgos pa dang / glud rdzongs su 'gro mkhan rnams nas nang du phyi lta mi byed cing / glud 'gong skyur sa ni lam kha gsum 'dzoms thig nges par du dgos pa dang / skyur sa der bod mda' rgyag srol yod kyang / phyis su 'ga' shas kyis sla jus lta bur thung mda' dang thog sgrag sogs kyang rgyag srol dar skusnad/gnam gang / gnam gang gi nyin mo ni de bas kyang brel ba che ba'i dus zhig yin/ lo gsar gyi rten 'brel gtso bo gro so phye mar dang gro ma 'bras bsil/ lo phud/ chang phud/ kha zas kyi sder kha/ lug mgo /ja sbag dang mar 197

gnya' nang snung 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/grod ril/ bur zhing sogs zhing 'bras skam rlon sna tshogs gzhan yang mchod yon sne lnga la sogs pa bsgrig dgos pa ma zad/ rin thang can gyi dkar yol bkyags kheb rang 'grig dang /dngul phor che chung sna tshogs kyi thog khang mig so sor kha gdan gsar pa 'ding ba sogs rang rang 'byor 'khos la gzhigs pa'i gra sgrig phun sum tshogs pa byed kyi red/tshes gcig/tshes gcig 〉tegs pa snga langs kyis rgyan gos gzab masnumar gyis brgyan te rang rang gi khyim du phye mar chang phud/ gro thug /chang rtsol/ spo ma 'bras bsil sogs rten 'brel mdzad sgo gang gzab byed pa de dag grub bstun rgan 'thus bcu gnyis yod pa rnams sgo khang gi lhan rgyas sgang zer ba'i tshogs khang du rdzong dpon skya ser gnyis kyi sar lug mgo re dang mjal dar bcas khyer nas mnyam bcar zhu dgos/ skabs der khrung zhu ma bzhi nas kyang rgyan bosnas gzab mchophar dang bcas mcho da chang btegs nas khrung glu 'bul srol yod/ de nyin grong rogs dga' nye yin min la ma stos par phan tshun rnam 'gyur bzang po ston pa dang / nang phan tshun bye mar 'degs pa'i skabs bod sa sbyi mtshungs bkra zhis bde legs phun sun tshogs/ a ma bag blo sku khams bzang zhes pa'i zhis brjod kyang byed/nyin gung tsam du tshong 'dus kyi sha ra zhes pa'i gzhon pa rnams nas rten 'brel mtshon dod du/ brdal sgo 'am rdo sgor zhes pa'i rtsed 'gran byed/ldo sgor 198

srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu snyangs sgor/ni sbyor btang zhing pa'i sbyi tshogs nang dar khyab che ba'i snga mo'i rtsed mo zhig red/ de ni rtsed sar zhugs pa'i pho gzhon rnams gral bsgrigs pa'i mdun phyogs nas gom pa bco lnga tsam gyi rgyang tshad la mtha' skor du rdo phung gzhu dbyibs su bsgrigs pa'i dkyil du g.yag gi rwa co btsugs nas de la ljid tshad rgya ma gsum bzhi tsam gyi rdo zhig lag pa kun du bkan pa'i tshul gyis g.yag ru der bzhu dgos yod/gnad du khel nas g.yag ru thor na rab dang /g.yag rur phog nas thog na 'bring / zur du khel nas kyog tsam byas na zhan par ngos 'dzin byed/gal te g.yag rur rtsa ba nyid nas ma phog na de bas kyang zhan pa ste/ tshang mas gad mo dgad yong zhes rgan rabs rnam pa'i sgod sgros su 'dug pa ma zad/ bod kyi dmangs grol gces bsdus dbe deb nang du'ang gsal 'dugatshong 'dus pas lo gsar tshes gcig gi gung chigs skabs mi rer lug mgo byed bshags re nges par du 'gyog gi red/ tshes gnyis nas bzung dga' nye sbyi dang / lhag par bal rigs tshong pa rnams la gsol ston rgya che bshams kyin yod pa ltar rnam kun dang mi 'dra bar kha lag nang sgog pa dang /sga ser/g.yer ma/go stod/bstong /pho ril/rdzim bu/li thi/thing mngar sogs sman sna mang bo rgyag srol yod/ tshes gsum nyin khyim dud yongs rdzogs nas rang rang gi khang thog tu lha gsol dar 'dzugs byed pa ma zad/ grong stod du 199

gnya' nang tsong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/rgyal po sku lnga'i lha btsugs yod sar mi mang 'du 'dzoms kyis gsol mchod gzab rgyas byed/ lha gsol grub pa'i rjes su dngos gzhi'i lo gsar rdzogs par ngos 'dzin byed kyang mang che bas da dung bdun phrag gnyis kyi ring zugs spro rgyun mthud gtong gi red/so nam pa'i lo gsar dang rgyal po lo gsar/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa so nam pa'i lo gsar tshes gcig nyin rten 'brel gyi sa bcad mi stong tsam du snga dro chang skol dang / gsol ja bzhes 'bras 'degs 'bul zhu ba las de min mdzad sgo che rigs gang yang mi byed/bod zla 1tshes 1ni rgyal po lo gsar zhes yongs grags kyi dus chen la brten snga dro rgan 'thus rnams sgo khang du mnyam bcar gyis rdzong dpon rnam gnyis la mjal dar 'bul ba dang / tshes gnyis nas bzhi bar rdzong gis rgan 'thus rnam pa dang /tshong rigs la gsol chigs gnang gi red/de skabs sgo khang gi chu ma dang /gad pa/gnya' nang sha ra bcas nas rdzong gi sgo ra'i nang zhabs bro 'khrab pa dang / sgo khang nas kyang kho tshor gnang sbyin dang kha zas smug zung che thag chod lnga re gnang ba ma zad/ tshes gsum gyi nyin tshong 'dus mi mang la'ang 'bras thug gi ston yo gtong grol yod par khyim dud re nas nyung mthar mi re ngo bcar byed/ 'bras thug 'thung mkhan mang che ba ni phru gu yin pa ltar 'ga' shas kyis las ka byed mkhan tshor rdor blug shog /rdor blug sgog ces skad shugs chen bo rgyag gi red/ dor 200

sgol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu stangs skor/zhes pa ni zha dang phyur ba sogs kyi thug rdor la zer/ rgyal bo lo gsar tshes gsum nyin rdzong gi phyi sgor dar chen zhin tu ring po zhig yod pa de la stong 'dus kyi sha ra rnams nas dar lcog gsar pa btags nas sku bzhengs te lha gsol byas rjes sgo khang nang khong tshor chang dang / bzhes spro/ lug mgo bcas gnang srol yod/gnya' nang pas lo gsar bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nyin bya grol 'di ni zla ba gcig snga snur byas pa lta bu zhig yin par brten 'ga' res ku re'i tshul du rdzogs lo'i lo gsar zer/ srung brtsi byed dus mi 'dra ba byung stangs la rgyu mtshan sgod tshul sna tshogs 'dug kyang yig rdzob che bas 'dir 'bri bkod zhus med pa bcas so//2)cho 'phrul dus chen dang sngo las rgyan rgyagabod zla 1tshes 17cho 'phrul dus chen la lha khang gsar par tshes bcu'i cho ga gzab rgyas tshogs pa dang /bod zla gsum pa'i nang rdzo las rgyan rgyag ces mi mang rnams grong stod du rgyal po sku lnga'i lha btsugs yod sar 'dzom ste/dgra lha dbang stesnad kyi sku gzugs zhal 'bag dang na bza' gasku la pa phyag g.yas par mda' dang / gasku(na par gzhu bsnams nas bzhengs pa zhig btsugs/ mtha' 'khor du mchod gnas dang gon po sku gas bzhugs gral du jiXspro
