gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/'khod nas rgyags brngan lha bsangs btang rjes rgyan sho g.yugs te khyim tshang bzhi la sngo las do dam pa'i las 'gan bsgo gzhag byed pa'i mdzad sgo 'dir khrung zhu ma rnams kyis rgyan gos gzab mchor dang bcas gon po rnams dang sngo las do dam pa gsar rnying bcas par mchod chang btegs nas khrung glu 'bul ba dang zhabs bro sne khag 'ga' shas rgyag srol skusnad/sngo las pa'i las 'gan ni gong du le tshan bzhi pa'i nang 'khod zin pa ltar 'dir bskyar bzlos bya rgyu min/3)sa ga zla ba'i das chen dang /spyang gnas kyi sgor/ra ༄tres ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nas smyung gnas mgo 'dzugs byed/tshong 'dus grong khyer nang bod mi rnams kyis srung gnas gtong ba ji bzhin gtan sdod bal rigs zhag rtsa zer ba'i skyid sdug nas kyang smyung gnas cha bzhi re lo bstar gtong sre la yod pa mtshams rer 'gran bsdur lta bu yang snang ba ma zad/gsham du 'brug pa tsho khag gcig gis kyang ma ṇi dung 'khor gyi mtha' 'khor tshogs khang du smyung gnas gtong srol yod pa ltar/ yul mi tshos smyung gnas tshogs sa'i lha khang khag gsum la mchod 'bul byed pa dang / cho ga'i bar mtshams so sor smyung gnas pa rnams gling sgor du bskyod de/ chos sgor spang 20ji gdan zer ba'i ri 'dabs nas mi rnams chos la skul ba'i ched dung dang rgya

sgol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsa zhu stongs sgor/gling snyan 'jebs ldan pa snga rjes rim pa gtong srol yod/ smyung gnas su zhugs mi rgan gras rnams nas 'bu ras sem thang dmar lnga re dbung pa g.yon steng nas g.yas 'og tu gyon dkris byed pa dang / cung gzhon pa rnams nas de'i tshab tu ske rag dmar bo re gong bzhin gyon srol yod pa de ni gzan gyi mtshon dod yin par snyam/sa zla'i tshes 17 mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po sku bltams pa dang /ma3rngon par sangs rgyas pa/ sku mya ngan las 'das pa bcas kyi dus chen gsum 'dzoms nyin yul mi sbyi pa'i lha khang gsar rnying dang / ma ṇi 'degs mkhar gsum gyis gtsos sger khyim so so'i mchod khang che khag la phyag mchod byed pa ma zad/ rgan byis mang bo tsho khag tsho khag byas nas gling bsgor la 'gro srol yod/ ston dpyid dbyar gsum dang lhag par sa zla'i dus chen skabs grong khyer nang gnas bsgor ba gcod gtong mkhan dang / 'bras dkar sogs slong mo ba rgyun chad med par dud tshang so sor sgo slong byed par mi rnams kyis snying rje dang dge rtsar bsam nas rang rang 'khos dpag la gzhigs te bza' btung sbyin pa gtong ba dang / sa zla'i ring dge sdig gang byas 'bum 'gyur yin par ngos 'dzin gyis zha khrims bsdams te dkar skyong byed/ lhag par tshes bco lnga'i nyin srin bus kyang sha spangs pa'i ngag rgyun la gzhigs te mang che bas sha mi za ba'i thog /ra lug sogs kyi srog bsru byas 203

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/te tshe thar gtong srol yang yod/'o ltar dus chen khag dang bstun nas sde pa gzhung gi bka' 'brel char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi ba sogs gzhung dmangs kyi bde don zhabs rim sgrub sgo'i khongs mi mang nas sgrol ma dang / rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan/gu ru'i gasku la 'debs/gzhan yang ma ṇi sku gas bgrang gaskusnag zhu dgos pa ltar/ sa zla'i nang khyim dud yod tshad nas mi re sho khang ngam lha khang gsar pa'i sgo 'gram du 'dzoms te kha 'don 'ur 'don byed dgos/ de skabs mi re'i lag par sgog bu re bgos sprod byas pa'i steng du bzhugs res gon 'thus kyis 'byor rtags the'u re brgyab srol yod/ las 'pher mang che bar khom lcogs thub kyi med par brten kha 'don byed sar 'char can phru gu mang bo 'du 'dzoms byed/ gzung sngags gsar pa bgrang gsog dgos pa'i skabs lha khang gsar pa'i daskasnan gnyer dge bshes lags zhu bas chig 'bru re re bzhin rjes bzlos byed bcug gi yod/ spyi rim grangs gsog zhu bar rgya gu btang chog pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas yi ge 'bri klog shes min la ma stos par tshong 'dus pa rgan byis tshang mar kha 'don yag bo 'don rgyu yod/4)chos skor/bod zla lnga pa'i gza' tshes gang 'os shig la chos bsgor zhes pa'i dus ston 204

chen po byed/ de nyin thog mar gnas khag lnga'i mi 'gro nas 'phyar dar sngon po dang / dkar po/ dmar po/ ser po/ ljang khu bcas kha dog lnga ldan dgung la 'phyar bzhin pas 〈snan bsus te/ mi mang brgya brag 'ga' shas kyis 7 rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin bo che dang / gsung 'bum sna tshogs rgyab tu 'khur zhing /lag par kha dog lnga ldan gyi mda' dar re 'chang nas snga rjes go rim bzhin ru bstar bsgrigs te/ gling sgor du bskyod pa'i bang rim gyi dkyil du gzhon pa bzhis btegs pa'i ston pa shākya thub pa'i sku brnyan bzhugs 〈snam nang bzhugs su gsol ba zhig dung rgya rnga rol dang /spos snes bsus te gdan zhu byed pa de ni dbus gtsang khul 'ong sgor zer ba zhing pa'i dus ston dang 'dra zhing / 'di'i nyin grong khyer stod smad kyi rgan byis yongs rdzogs rgyan gos gzab mchor dang bcas gling bsgor du bskyod de kha nas phywa khug sgog /g.yang khug sgog ces skad 'bod byed bzhin pa'i ngang mda' dar gyis g.yab sa byed/lam byed chos skor spang ldan zhes par 'byor skabs rang rang gi khyim tshang nas ja chang dang / sba slom zhes pa'i zhim mngar ldan pa'i kha zas sna tshogs skyel 'dren byed pa tsho khag tsho khag byas te za btung byas rjes tshes bcu ba rnams nas phyogs mtshams sdurdzo skusnar sku gsung thugs rten la rten 'khrus dang / sa zhing gis gtso byas pa'i yul phyogs kun tu yul 'khrus dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha srung yul lha gzhi bdag bcas par 'phrin skul byas rjes 〈snang 205

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/khyer la kha phyogs te dung dang rgya gling 'bud pa'i srol rgyun yod/de nas mi mang gi khrod nas 〈sna mo 'ga' shas kyis gzhas sna gsum tsam 'khrab pa de dag grub bstun mu mthud gling bsgor gyi lam snar 'jug /phyed yol chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la sde pa'i rdzing zhes pa'i gling kur phebs te slar yang 'phrin bcol gnang ba'i rjes su gsol ja bzhes tog dang mchod chang 'degs res byas te/dgong dro nyi ma nub rir ma nub bar gzhas dang zhabs bro brgyab nas sdod/ de mtshams mi rgan phal che ba chang gis bzi nas khur 'khyor ngang 〈snang khyer du 'byor nye'i mtshams su 〈snang sdod mi mang rnams nas phebs lam gyi g.yas g.yon du ru bsgrigs nas bsangs dud phul ba dang / ser phreng ru bstar nang yod pa'i tshes bcu ba sogs kyi phyu pa dang ska rags kyi sne sa nas phar 'then tshur 'then gyis phyu pa'i bzo blta bzhig nas ma phud tsam bzo ba sogs rtsed mo yang rtsed srol yod/ thub dbang rin po che'i sku brnyan lha khang du gdan zhu byas pa'i rjes su dngos gzhi'i mdzod sgo rdzogs kyin yod kyang mi mang rnams ni da dung tsho khag so sor yun ring gzhas dang zhabs gro brgyab nas dga' zle'i ngang dus 'da' bar byed do//7)ra hu lha gsol/bod zla 7tshes 1༷la slar yang tshes bcu dang /tshes 14nyin mi mang rnams 206

sgol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu skangs sgor/la rdzong skal zhes ra hu lha gsol gyi gra sgrig zhu mi khral rkang re nas mi re 'gro dgos yod pa ltar/ tshong 'dus phu yi bya khyung gangs ri'i nye 'dabs su da ra mtsho'i ri mgor klung rta dar phreng bsgrengs 'dzugs zhu rgyu dang /nyin gung gsol tshigs gra sgrig zhu mi sngon thon thog/tshes 17'dzam gling spyi bsangs dang /gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rjes bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad dam la btags pa'i dus chen thun sang ma yin pa'i nyin skya rengs dang bor rdzong dpon gnyis dang / gon 'thus bcu gnyis rdzong gi zhabs gras lnga drug bcas khyon rta pa nyi shu rtsa grangs zhig na bza' gzab mchasnar dang bcas phebs 〈snan gyis da ra mtshor 'byor mtshams yul lha gzhi bdag klu dang bcas par bsangs mchod kyi cho gas 〈snan bsus te lha ldan rgyal khab nas ched stsal mtsho rdzas bum pa mtsho nang du 'bul skabs mtshams rer mtsho mjal yang ston gyin skusnad par grags/de nas gangs ri'i nye 'khris ri mgor phebs te dar phreng bsgrengs 'dzugs kyis bsangs gasku la gzab rgyas gnang rjes nyin gung gasdurdzol tshigs gnang ste sgod bzhugs gnang sgol yod/bya khyung gangs ri'i 'og gi brag ri'i logs su dar chen dang / khog snyir/ me phor sogs kyi gzugs brnyan rang byon sna tshogs zhig gsal por mjal rgyu sku da/ gasku la chigs grub mtshams chibs 1snag rta rgyugs skosnar ba thengs gsum tsam brgyab ste mar lam phar chu brgal nas phu log brgyud phyir phebs gnang ste rdzong gi nye 'khris su 'byor ba'i 207

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/skabs khrung zhu ma bzhis phebs bsu'i phye mar bteg pa bzhes rim rta rgyugs kyis sgo khang du phebs/ skabs der mi mang ltad mo lta mkhan ni tshang ka thig shig yong gi red/ sgo khang gi rgyal sgo'i 'khris su chibs rta 'ju mkhan gzhon pa re re sgug nas sdod pa de dag gis chibs rta rnams rtsis len byas rjes rdzong dpon ngo las dang rgan 'thus rnams sgo khang du lhan rgyas sgang zer ba'i tshogs khang du phebs/ der gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / khrung zhu mas mchod chang 'degs 'bul zhus bsdun 'khor mo che zer ba'i sgo ra'i nang lha mo bas ngon pa'i sa 'dul zhes pa'i gzhas thud kyang 'bul gyi red/ ra hu lha gsol dang / 'o1 gsar sku gas mdzod sgo che khag la gon 'thus rnam pas phyu pa bo sa chen dang / zhwa 'bog ser po/ rna rgyan sog byil/skod par rgya gri phor shub/ yod mkhan cesas gzi g.yu'i breng zhags bcas bsnams pa ma zad/khrung zhu ma rgan pa gnyis nas kyang byu pa gos chen dang de'i thog steng rtseg dang 'bu ras lem thang 'dra ba'i lteb gyon/de bzhin sba phrug zur gsum dang /'ja' tshon ldan pa'i zom lham mthil gnyis ma bcas 〈snan 〈snal skusnad//ca)lha mo 'khrab ston dang /gling ga'i spro skyid/ra hu lha gsol grub nas nyin gsum rjes sde pa'i rdzing zhes mtha' sgor lcang mas bsgor ba'i gling ga zhig yod pa der lha mo bas nyin dang por 'gro ba 208

bzang mo dang / gnyis par nor bzang / gsum par snang sa 'am sdu med kun ldan bcas 'khrab ston byed pa de ni mi mang gi gling ga'i dus tshod skyid sgos zhig red/ skabs der mi mang rnams sgo skyid gtong ba dang / gling ga'i mtha' sgor du lcang ma'i grib bsil 'og bsdad nas lha mor lta dus phan tshun slo ma'i nang zhim zas sna tshogs kyi zhal rtog gtong res byed/ mang che bas sba ci'i mnyam du shel ka ra ting sgor ma dang /rta skusna ma/sbags chang /bu ram bsgar ma/srang gang bag leb/ sbrang sbu ril zer ba bu ram las bzos pa'i mngar cha/dga' zag zer ba'i zho khog kha tsha/ spu 〉la zer ba sran ma snum btsos la sur pan dang sman sna brgyab pa/ mngar cha ldan pa'i bag leb khu ra/ sha mar thud gsum dang phyu ra/ bal po'i spe ra zer ba'i bag leb mngar mo dang / smi si ku ṭi dang ji ril sna tshogs/gzhan yang mar khya dang snam la btsos pa'i bal bod kha zas sna khyordogs khyer nas gzab gzab byed par brten/ rgan byis tshang mas dga' spro chen po byed/ lha mo'i skabs gling ga'i g.yas g.yon du ras gur nang tsho khag so sor zur du 'dzoms nas dga' ba'i gzhas dang / skyid pa'i zhabs gro/ snyan pa'i gtam bshad byas nas sdod mkhan yang mang po sku da/ lha mo'i 'khrab ston mjug sgril nyin rdzong nas ja sgam dang /mar grod ril/'bras ltang /nas dang gro do po bcas bsgrigs pa'i steng dngul rdo tshad mi nyung ba'i sgog chag bcas gnang sbyin yang rgya chen 〈sna gnang 11la sku(da/209

7)paṇa dzo ra ma'i dus chen/tshong 'dus grong khyer nang ye rang paṇa dza ra ma dang / sang ko paṇa dza ra ma zhes dus ston khag gnyis srung brtsi zhu srol yod/ ye rang paṇa dzo ra ma bod zla catshes /dang /sang ko paṇa dza ra ma bod zla catshes 2/nyin srung brtsi byed/dus chen 'di'i nyin bal po rnams gling bsgor du bskyod pa dang / bal skad thog kha 'don gdangs dbyangs ring po 'then nas lha khang yongs rdzogs la phyag mchod byas mthar gtam bsgrags sgang du sku da pa'i ma ṇi 'degs mkhar dang /ko thang gnas po'i mdun du yod pa'i ma ṇi 'degs mkhar so sor 'dzoms nas zhing 'bras sna tshogs dang / spu phyis sba ci zer ba'i 'bras yos/ bur shing sogs zhing 'bras skam rlon sna tshogs mdun du spungs nas tshogs mchod rgya che 'bul ba'i skabs ting zhag las che tsam gyi bal sdug daskrusnal ba dang sbag ting zer ba'i rnga chung bdung ste/nyi ma zhub rir ma bzhud bar du 'ur tshogs byas pa'i mtha' mar paṇa dzo ra ma'i bzhes bes zer ba 'bras phye las ba1snas pa'i kha zas snam btsos a long sgor sgor dang /rgya gar ba dang bal pos khir zer ba'i sna( ma'i 'bras thag mngar mo bcas bsham 〈(la sposad/ cas thug ni bkra shis ༄pa'i zas su ngos 'dzin byed/ dus chen 'di dag nang chos dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig red/ bod zla drug pa hril po'i nang bal po rnams snga dro 'char can 210 gtam bsgrags sgang gi ma ṇi 'degs mkhar lha khang du 'dzoms te/bal sbrug

srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu stangs sgor/dang /ldum sdum zer ba'i rnga chen rnga chung /de bzhin wa wing zer ba mdzub gnon sbud byings/ (sbyad pa'i rlung thugs kyis sgra snyan po 'byin pa'i sgam chung ) bcas kyi rol cha dang mnyam du gdangs dbyangs snyan 'thebs ldan pa'i kha 'don yun ring byed/bod zla drug pa'i tshes 17nyin bal po rnams rta la bzhon nas da ra mtsho mjal bar bskyod pa dang / bram ze'i rus khongs su gtogs pa rnams kyis dza ṇa pur ṇi zhes pa'i tshangs skud gsar brje byed/ bod zla cu tshes 3༷nyin dpal lha'i dgon par mchod mjal du bskyod nas btsun ma tshogs yongs la stod zung re dang /dngul 'gyed 'bul srol yod pa bcas so///)'phel rgyas gling gi dbang chog dang /'cham/tshes chog bcas kyi sgor/bod zla drug pa'i nang chos 'khor dus chen skabs rdzo las pa bzhis tshong 'das 〈snang khyer spyi pa'i tshes bca rgyas pa bo sgrig zha ba dang das mtshangs kha ra ra ra ra ra tshar ba rnams kyis kyang smyung gnas cha gnyis gtong 〈snal sku da/ skabs der 'phel rgyas gling dgon par dbang chog ces chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo chen po tshugs pa de yang bod zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gnyis par sbyin bsreg dang /tshes bcu gsum dang bcu bzhi gnyis la 'cham/ tshes batherdzo lnga la ma mosna che ba zhes gnas ma〈snag 〈snad pa phug nas rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i sku brnyan gdan 'dren zhus te/ bkris sgang pas gtso byas dgon pa'i gzhung gi yul mi rnams 211

the jidi zung 85gnya' nang 'dus pa' bya rgyal khams pa/kyis gzhas dang zhabs bro mang bo rgyag srol yod/rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i sku brnyan 'di ni slob ma rnams kyis dad rten zhus pa'i ngor rje btsun nyid kyis shangs mtshal dang sku mtshal zhal chab sdudags 'jim pa dang sbyar ba'i rgyu byas nas ras chung pa'i phyag bzo las grub pa'i thog rje btsun rang gis rab gnas gnang ba ha cang byin rlabs che ba yin par grags//'phel rgyas gling gi 'cham ni byin chags po dang rnying nyams dod bo yod pa ma zad/ rin thang bral ba'i zhal 'bag dang rgyan gzhi sku gas gos chen rnying pa'i 'cham gos rnams kyang byin can ngo mtshar chen po yin par bshad/'cham le'u bco lnga tsam yod pa'i khongs su chos rgyal yab yum gnyis dang / mgon po/ lha mo/ lcam sring / tshangs pa/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ zha ba gnyis/dur bdag gnyis/a cadra gnyis/spre'u gnyis/bya seng gnyis/ha shang sku 'khor/ zhwa nag brgyad/ rdo rje gro lod bcas pa'i thog dbang chen ltad mo che ba'i skabs gar pa dang / glang chen bcas kyang yod/ dbang chog gi skabs su gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum nas rgyan gos gzab mchor ldan pa'i mi tshogs chen po 'dzoms te dgon par phyag mchod dang dge 'dun bar sku 'gyed 'bul rgyus mtshon yun ring ma thug pa'i gnyen nye thug phrad kyis phan tshun dga' ba'i gleng sal byed pa dang / gar 'cham la lta ba'i skabs bzhes tog 212 sogs za btung gtong res byed/nyin re'i mdzad sgo grol mtshams dgon pa'i

srol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsa zhu stangs sgor/shag tshang so sos sbyin bdag rnams la gsol mgron gtong srol yod/gong bzhin bod zla bdun pa'i nang slar yang tshes chog tshugs pa'i skabs mi rnams 'tshang ka zhig zhig byas nas bsnyen bkur zhu bar bcar 〈snal skusnad/ston mtshams lo tog bsdu ba'i skabs dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa yongs rdzogs gnya' nang stod smad so sor bsod stoms su phebs kyin yod/khong rnams tshong 'dus su phebs skabs lha khang gsar par bzhugs te/ me zhing dang chab chu sogs thugs mkho gang 'phad yul mis mthun 'gyur zhu ba ma zad/ bzhugs rgyun ring khyim tshang skusna so'i 'khos dpag la gzhigs pas 'ga' res dge 'dun brgyad grar mang ja dang / 'ga' res nyin 'khyongs/ yang 'ga' res tshogs yongs la mang ja dang / nyin 'khyongs bsnyen bkur dang sku 'gyed gya nom 'bul gyi red/0)bal po'i dus chen snyim san ngatra/(dzo ta ra )bod zla bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i g.yas gaskusnan du slar yang bal po rnams kyis sgom san ja ta ra zhes pa'i dus ston rgya che byed pa 'di ni hin du chos lugs kyi yin zhing / tshong 'dus grong khyer gyi lho ngos su lha rwa 'am/ lham san sa na zhes pa'i lha khang rgya mibs sum brtsegs can zhig 'phad pa'i rten gtso skya seng bu lnga'i bar pa 'jigs sde'am sgom san zhu ba gser zangs las 213

gnya' nang snung 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bzhengs pa'i bzhugs sgom nang gzhon pa bzhi'i dpung pas btegs te ru bstar sgrig nas gdan zhu byed/ ru bstar gyi dkyil du snyim san gyi sku dang /mdun rgyab gnyis su bal po rgan byis mang pos sbag rding zer ba'i rnga dang bal sbug sku gas da〈snal nas blo nga khyer la ba〉snar ba byas rjes slar rang gnas lha dwar gdan zhu byas nas sngar yin na ra lug 3༷ skor dang / rjes su srog gcod nyung du btang ste ra lug 17 tsam dang bya de sogs dmar mchod byas mthar bal po'i sgo dzi zer ba sba ji dang /sha/sngo tshal/sran ma sna tshogs bcas kyi gsol ston dang chang rag rgya che bshams srol yod/ kha rgyun du rtag par bal po'i 'o1 gsar zer ba bzhin bal po rnams nas grub mtha' phyi nang gnyis ma'i dus chen gcig mjug gnyis mthud du srung brtsi byas nas gsol ston yang yang bshams srol dar rgyun yod pa yig rdzob che bas re re bzhin bkod med/10)mas snying dang /dmar mchodi/bod zla 7tshes 10la lha khang gsar par tshes bcu dang /bod zla /tshes 1༷nyin mas snying zhes pa'i bal po'i dus chen srung brtsi'i ched ra lug phyir tshong bya bzhin yod pa de dag gi ched du dmigs bsal tshes bcu 'phar ma gtong gin yod/mas snying che chung gnyis kyi skabs tsong 'dus su bal yul dang bod 214

sgol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsa zhu stangs skor/sa yas mas nas mi sna mang po 'du 'dzoms kyis tshong 'thab dang / rgyan rtsed byed pa sogs ha cang 'khrug cha dod po yod/skabs der phyi khrom mang ba'i thog za khang 'dzugs mkhan yang 'ga' shas sku(da/zhib phra gong du 'khod pa bzhin snga dus bal po sogs khyim mtshes rgyal khab kyi mi ser mang po gtan sdod byas par brten mas rnying che chung gnyis sam/ rda sa yan dang / ti hār zer ba'i bal po'i dus chen srung brtsi byed yun ring lung pa'i nang dmar mchod dar khyab che ba ma zad/ bal yul rgyal sar bshas tshong ched ra lug stong phrag mang bo phyir brdzong byed pa las ngan tshabs cher brten/ chos lugs ris med kyi bla chen mang pos snga rjes bkag 'gog gnang pa dber na skyabs mgon zhabs dkar ba'i rnam thar nang / sna tshogs zhes pa chu pho rta yi lor (1622) khrums zla'i tshes bzang por nged dpon slob mang bo dang bcas te/ gnya' nang grod pa phug gi dgon pa 'phel rgyas gling du 'ong /mkhan rin bo che dang dge 'dun pa rnams mjal/dgon pa'i 'du khang gi steng du gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo ri dwags pho sa bcas pa btsugs/ nang du dngul srang brgya lhag gi dngul kong bzhag /'gyed mang ja btang nas zhabs tog byas/ de nas gnya' nang tshong 'dus su song nas bal bod kun la tshe dbang bskur chos bshad pas/bal po'i tsong pa mang bos 'epha re bzhin ra lug bya pho skusnags sems can sum brgya res lha la dmar mchothod byed 215

pa bcad nas dkar mchod du bsgyur/ bzhan pa phal cher gyis srog mi gcod pa'i dam bca' phul/dngul rdo tshad bcu gcig gis lug stong brag gcig gi srog blu byas/de'i lo rong du lug 'ded rgyu med pa byung /lug rnams dgon pa 'phel rgyas gling gi 'aXthog tu tshe thar byas nas bzhag /bal rnams dge 'dun pa'i mthun rkyen gdan sogs byas/ dngul rdo tshad dgu yis bod nas snam phrug ther ma sku gas grwa chas nyos te/ grwa btsun gos med rnams la byin/ de nas yar skusnang la zhing 〈snal ma gsung 〈snan mjal/mchodi 'bul byas smodzin lam btab/du lung 'ba' ro sogs gnya' nang stod kyi phyug po rnams kyis ra lug mi gaskusnad pa'i dam bca' phul/ sems can 〈snang phrag mang po'i 11ga skye ba byas/gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi blo kha chos la bsgyur te yul khams chos kyis dkar por btang nas/zur tsho nas lung du song / zhes gsal 'dugaphyis su'ang 'brug pa rin po che sku gas bla ma skyes chen mang pos dmar mchod bkag 'gog thog lug tshong gi nyes skyon gsungs nas bshas tshong mtshams 'jog byed mkhan dang /bshas lug tshe thar gtong mkhan mang po byung 'dug 'brug pa rin po che'i rnam thar nang / dgung grangs ca4 zhing phag 1037 lo'i ston kha slar gnya' nang du phebs nas bzhugs/rdzong zhwa sgab pas sbyin bdag zhus te gnya' nang 'gram dang /tshong 'dus/ 'khor g.yag /ding ri bcas nas mi grangs khri brgal ba la thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / 'opha 216

sgol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsi zhu stangs sgor/der grong pa re nas lug gnyis re tshe thar dang / nya stong brgyad gsum la sha chang sgog pa sbangs mkhan mi nyis stong tsam byung /sbyin bdag gtso bo bur sras pa tshong dpon 'jam dbyangs dang /gtsang gdong byang pa/lha dga'/byang pa'i a ce rta mgrin/tshong 'dus byang pa/rdo legs pa/ka sgo/'khor g.yag a khya nor bzang / gnya' nang a khya shākya/ bkris sgang a khu pa sangs/rdzong zhwa sgab pa'i g.yog stobs rgyas/sgo rong bla med dbang phyug sogs kyis gtso mdzad rin po cher 'bul dngos tshang ma gcig tu bsgoms te sems can chung bar lug khri dang / che ba 'bri g.yag nyis stong tsam tshe thar gtong gnang mdzad 'dug pa ma zad/ lug tshong 'gog rgyu'i ched du 'brug pa zhal slob blo bzang 'od zer dang /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gnyis bal yul du brdzangs te las ka mthar 'khyongs nee bod gzhung gnyis nas chog mchan bka' yig thob/ lug tshong bzhi cha gsum bkag thub pa byung / zhes 'khod 'dug/skyabs mgon zhabs dkar ba dang 'grug pa rin po che rnam gnyis nas lug tshong gi nyes skyon gsungs pa la brten nas lo ltar bal po'i dus chen skabs tshong 'dus pa khyim dud 'ga' res ra lug gang mang nyos nas tshe thar btang pa'i sgal par tshos gsar dmar po byug nas/ khyu tsho byas te gnya' nang stod phyogs su ra lug gzhan gyi mnyam du 'jog rgyur phyir slog byed pa'i srol rgyun bzang po dar 'phel byung yod/217

gnya' nang snung 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bal po'i dus chen rda sa yan gyi skabs su/rong pa'i bya de dang /bal po'i nyan se zer ba'i bya gag /de bzhin bod pa'i lug stong phrag mang bo srog gcod bya bzhin yod pa ltar/thod rgyun la nyin gcig bya de gcig dang /nyan se gcigalug gcig bcas mnyam du 'dzoms/ bya des rang gi rgyun gtan skad gdangs thog rong skad nang / ko ko ri korda sa yan ka nyiyile two/ (rda sa yan ga dus red ) ces dris par/ nyan se des rang gi rgyun gtan skad gdangs thog bal skad nang /dag dag nag/ka nee kun sku(/ka nee kun 31/ sang nyin gnangs nyin/ sang nyin gnangs nyin zhes lan 'debs byas/de go dus lug sems pa 〈sna nas thesgod skad nang /'bas/'bas/chag sgo langs skusnang 'bas 'bas zer bzhin mgo gug nas bsdad par bshad pa 'di ni gnya' nang pa'i kha rgyun du yod ba'i gtam zhig yin pa zhor 'phros su bris so//11)skar ma dzo kṣ-i/therdzod zla bdun pa'i gnam gang nas brgyad pa'i tshes pa gnyis kyi bar/ nam mkhar skar ma dzo 6zer ba'i rgyu skar 'char gyin yod pa 'di'i 'od zer phog tshad kyi chu tshang ma sman chur gyur pas na/bod kyi chab zhugs dus chen zer ba'i srol rgyun 'di nas byung ba zhig yin pa ltar dus tshod 'di'i ring tshong 'dus pa rnams nas gur dang /bya g.yab/sem thang /ja chang /za chas sna tshogs khyer te 218

sgol rgyun sna tshogs kyi dus chen srung rtsa zhu stangs skor/chu dgu sbug dang / sde pa'i rdzing sogs su nyal gzan dang gyon chas 'khrud bshal byed pa dang chabs cig chu'i nang 'dzul nas skar ma ṛ kṣ-i gdugs pa ma zad/ rang rang gi dga' nye tsho khag tsho khag tu byas nas phag nyin zhes pa'i spro skyid kyang gtong srol dar khyab chen po yod/ skabs der phru gu rnams kyis kyang chos 'khor srung ldan dang 'dzim bu'i brag phug sogs su g.yang gtong zhes pa'i spro skyid gtong gi red/12)lha bab dus chen dang /dga' ldan lnga mchod/wa da zla 'tshes 22la lha bab dus chen gyi ches bcu dang phyag mchophad/bod zla miXtshes 24dang /27so sor slar yang dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo'i tshes bcu zab rgyas gtong srol yod/ lnga mchod chen mo'i dgong dro sgo khang gi rtse thog nas tshes bcu pas dung dang rgya gling gi snyan brda btang ba'i rjes grong khyer gyi khyim dud yongs nas khang pa'i rtse thog dang / sge khung / phyi sgo sogs su mchod me gral bstar bsgrigs nas dus gcig tu 'bul ba dang / phru gu rnams kyis lag tu sgos me khyer nas dmigs brtse ma gdangs dbyangs dang bcas 'don gyin grong khyer nang bsgor ba byed/ dga' ldan lnga mchod kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos cig ni/ khyim tshang 〈snangs rdzogs kyis chil lu brdungs nas mar khyar bzhus te mcho da me 'bul dang / chil lu'i mchod me 219

phul ba'i shul lhag la rtsam pa bsres nas/ ha cang zhag chil che ba'i sbags g.yos te za sgol yang yod/ spyir btang tshong 'dus pa'i tshes bcu ni bod zla gnyis pa dang / gsum pa/ bcu gcig pa/ bcu gnyis pa bcas bzhi la ma gtogs de byings zla ba brgyad la 'gan 'khur 'khor res byas te gtong srol yod/13)ngan ba dgu 'dzoms dang /bzang bo bcu 'dzoms/bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug nyin phyed nas bdun nyin phyed bar ngan pa dgu 'dzoms zhes pa'i yongs grags kyi dus tshes de yin pa ltar/ mi rnams kyis khyed ngan pa dgu 'dzoms na nga bzang po bcu 'dzoms yod ces sgod kyin pe da pa ma zad/ de nyin las mgo gsar pa rtsom pa dang / phyogs la 'grul bskyod byed pa sku gas sbangs nas/ rang gi 'khos 'byor la gzhigs te dga' nye blo dkar rnams phan tshun mgron 'bod dang 'brel khyim tshang so so'i nang zhi 'jam bde sgod kyi thog nas sgro skyid gzab rgyas gtong srol yod pa ltar gnya' nang du'ang spro skyid gtong srol dar khyab chen po yod pa bcas so//

le tshan bcu gnyis pa/bag ston dang /'das mchod/nyi 'dzin la gdong len/'brum nad sngon 'gogagason 'dre'i gnod pa bzlog thabs bcas kyi skor/1)bag rnye(na lam 11la/bod kyi sa cha stod smad gang sar dar khyab yod pa ji bzhin gnya' nang khyal du'ang mna' ma gcig la mag pa bu spun gnyis gsum mnyam mthun byed pa dang /de bzhin skyes pa gcig gis bud med gnyis sam/gsum gyi mnyam du sdod mkhan re zung yod pa de dag ni rang rang gi 'dod mos yin pa las sus kyang btsan dbang gtong mkhan med/ rgya gar dang bal yul sogs khyim mtshes rgyal khab mang po'i nang / khyim tshang gang zhig la bu med na mi rabs chad dogs sems ngal chen po byed pa ma zad/ bu mo mna' mar 'gro dus rgyu nor mang po ster sprod byed pa'i srol ngan dar rgyun che bas pha mar dka' ngal tshad med myong dgos yod cing / 'on kyang bod du bu yo mna' mar 'gro ba'i ster sgo pha ma'i 'dod yos las/chang sa'i gong du mag pa'i nang mi'i mnyam du rin gong bsgrig pa lta bu byed srol med/ lhag par bu tsha med pa'i khyim tshang nas nang du mag pa len srol bzang po skusnad pa de ni/ padma bka' thang du rgyal

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis chos khrims bsnams pa'i le'u'i nang / bu med pa rnams bu mor go mag bsus: zhes gsungs pa bzhin nang du mag pa bsu ba'i lam srol bzang po de ni sngar chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku dus nas dar spel gnang ba zhig yin par 'dugastod khul du bu mo mna' mar 'gro ba'i skabs 'dod mos sku da min la ma ltos par nang nas thon 'dod ma byas par 'ga' shas ni gzhon pa gsum bzhis mnyam rub kyis rgyab tu khyer nas skyel rdzong byed srol yang yod/ bu yo mna' mar 'gro ba'i skabs mchi ma gtong ba dang skad 'bod kyis ngu ba ni rang gi pha ma bzhag ste mi tshang gsar pa zhig gi nang la 'gro dgos byung ba de yis yin par bshad/ chang sa rgyas bsdus dang mdzad sgo'i lam lugs mang po skusnad/rgyas pa'i skabs mna' ma dang ster sgo skyel mi rta hrag bsgrigs te yong dus rgyan gos gzab mchor ldan pa'i bsu ba dang po dang / gnyis pa/ gsum pa bcas so sor bsu skyel gnyis phyogs nas yo la zhes pa'i bag bshad gdangs dbyangs dang bcas gtong res byed cing /de skabs phye mar dang /khang pa'i sgo/ skas 'dzegs/ rten gtso/ nang gi ka ba/ bu dang bu yo/ ja chang sogs la'ang bstod pa dang bshad pa rgyag srol dar khyab chen po yod/ rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i skabs gnyen dpon ka gdong seng ge grags pa zer ba zhig gis mna' ma la mda' dar 'dzugs rgyu dang / bag gral bsgrigs pa'i skabs 222

bag ston dang /'das mchod/nyi 'dzin la gdong len/'thum nad sngon 'dog sgor/mna' ma bag gasku(ga dang bcas pa kha btags kyis sne nas drangs te bag bshad yo la gtong bzhin pa'i ngang bsu ba byed pa ma zad/ chang sa'i ring sgrigs lam do dam pa'i las 'gan yang 'khur ba de ni ka gdong seng ge grags pa'i thun yong ma yin pa'i byed sgo zhig yin par bshad/ khyim tshang 'ga' zhig gis mna' ma dang mag pa gnyis kyi khyim tshang dbar gnyen yig bzhag ste mdzad sgo'i sar skad gsang mthon pos klog srol sku da/ snga dus bag 〈snan skabs dge 'dun pa rnams mna' mas mjal sar bzhugs 〈snal mi 'dugamang che bas chang sa dngos gzhi dang /grol ston/nang tshigs sgor mo bcas sgro skyid nyin grangs 'ga' shas gtong ba dang / zla gcig tsam gyi rjes slar mna' ma'i nang du lha bkrerdzol zhes pa'i thugs spre'i ched dga' nye tshang ma mgron 'bod byed/ spyir btang lha bkrol gyi mdzad sgo ni bu mo'i nang gi lha srung la lha bsangs gser skyems dang / bu mo'i lag pa nas snyan zhal phul te rang gi khyim gyi lha srung tshor dgongs khrol zhu ba'i don zhig yin pa de'i dgos pa ni/bu mo'i rjes su 'breng nas gnod 'tshe mi gtong ba'i ched du yin par 'dugachang sa sogs sgro skyed gtong ba'i skabs dgong mo'i gsol tshigs grub mtshams gasku(la rgyab yin zhes masnumad chang dwangs ma dngul gyi khrung 〈snar chen bo re bteg srol yod/ khrung zhu ma bud med gnyis gsum gyis g.yas g.yon 223

nas thongatshugs mtha' skyel skabs ma 'thung na/'ga' shas kyis khab btsugs byed/ zugs sgo nam yin la dgong dro mdzad sgo grol nas sku mgron rnams phyir log skabs mi gnyis kyis sngon du sa bzhu 'khyer ba'i mjug tu pho sa mang pos ra bzi khyar khyor rnams skyor te glu gzhas gtong bzhin pa'i ngang khyim tshang skusna so'i sgo 'gram du 'phyor mtshams slar yang chang rag bkyag nas zhabs 〈sna rgyag pa sku gas ha lam mtshan 'khyomang sku ma〈snan phebs skyel zhus ma tshar bar sdod pa'i goms srol yod/2)thun yong ma yin pa'i 'das mchod/mi thi byung ba'i skabs 'chi khar byin rten sbang nas ba'i nang du blug pa dang /nad pa'i rna mchog gi 'khris su skad thugs chen pos sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/rje btsun sgrol ma sogs kyi mtshan smos nas de dag sgom dgos pa'i 'bod skul byed/ 'das tshar ba'i rjes su 'pho ba zhu rgyu dang /thung po'i 'khris su smon lam 'don mkhan gdan zhu/mgyogs bsngo 'bul stangs/ sbyang rten zhu phyogs/ rtsis skor bya rgyu sogs bod sa sbyi mtshungs ltar yin yang / dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ni/ gzhin po'i phung po skyel khar nang mi dga' nye khag nas skyel chang zhes pa zhig byed sgol skusgod/ de skabs gzhin por khyed rang chags chags thogs thogs med par kha zug rgyugs thig224

bag ston dang /'das mchod/nyi 'dzin la gdong len/'thum nad sngon 'gog sgor/shul lus nang mi dang dga' nye ltos bcas la sems khral bya dgos med/khyed rang gi rjes su phyag dang mchod 'bul gzhi rgya gang che bgyid chog /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams su thug skusnang zhes skusnags zer gyin pha ma 'am rgan gas yin na phyag 'tshal ba dang phebs skyel kha btags 'bul 11la sku1da/ de min kha btags gasku(gas pa las phyag mi 'tshal/ phung bor dbang rdzas rigs lnga dang /stod snye yang sgron srol yod/nang nas thon pa'i skabs phyi ma'i lam dkar por 'gro ba'i mtshon rtags su phyang por kha btags dang ras dkar po sgrog pa'i sne sa rtogs ldan gyis bzung nas kha 'don dang ḍa dril dkrol bzhin pa'i ngang thon gyi red/tshong 'dus pa tshor sngar dur sa khag gsum tsam yod/ grong pa mang che bas 'phel rgyas gling gi steng du shu yo ri zer bar rta drel thog skyel 'dren gyis bya gtor byed pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis lhas dbang zer ba'i sa char bya gtor byed/ de min sla byus kyis lcags sa zer bar skyel/ phung po bskyal tshar ba'i rjes su nyin zhas ring tshe 'das de'i nam rgyun gyi phor pa'am sder ma'i nang zas skal 'jog pa dang / zhag zhe dgu bar rdza khog dmar po'i nang nyin bstar ting zhag gi sgra dang bcas tsha bsur gtong srol yod/ zhag zhe dgu'i bar mgo mi bkru la/ zhe dgu rdzogs mtshams gzhi nas skra bkru zhing dngos gzhi'i mya ngan sangs pa la ngos 'dzin byed/ lung pa'i nang mi zhi byung ba'i skabs dga' 225

nye gtsos pas khyim mtshes rnams nas glu gzhas gtong ba sogs sgro skyid mi byed/ khyim mtshes kyi ba phyugs thi yang zhag gsum mya ngan zhes tshang mas mya ngan gyi rnam 'gyur mnyam ston byed/ 'das po'am 'das mo'i khyim tshang nas bdun tshigs gsum pa dang / bzhi pa/ bzhi bcu zhe dgu so sor 'bras tshogs chen bo 'bor chen bzhengs nas tshogs mchod grub mtshams grong khyer nang dud pa gnam gtong skusnad tshad la skyel srol sku da pa de la sgo tshogs zer/'bras kyi sgo tshogs gtong ba'i skabs khyim mtshes dang dga' nye yod tshad kyis las rogs mnyam rub byed pa'i lugs srol bzang po yod/ lo gcig 'khor ba'i nyin nang mi nye 'brel dang mthun phyogs rnams la mgron 'bod byas te/ lo mchod tshogs 'khor dang gsol ston ba mas pa ma zad/de nyin chang rag kyang bteg nas spro skyid lta bu zhig gtong srol yod pa ni/ nang mi'i sems nad kyi mya ngan rtsa sangs su gyur pa'i mtshon don yin pa bcas so//3)nyi 'dzin la gdong len/yul mi rnams ni sbyir btang chos dad dang mnyam du rnam rtog kyang che bas mtshams re nyi 'dzin byung ba'i skabs gon byis yongs rdzogs khang pa'i phyir thon nas/ la la ni sems la dngangs tshabs chen pos ngang ma ṇi bgrang ba dang / la la ni sa snum gyi lcags ṭin stong pa dang sto snod ha yang sogs lag 226

bag ston dang /'das mchod/nyi 'dzin la gdong len/'brum nad sngon 'gog sgor/tu gang thob bdungs nas ki sgra chen po dang shu rgyag pa sogs byed pa ma zad/ya nga snying rje med par khyi la ber rgyug gzhus nas skad ngan rgyag tu bcug pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis mchod me'i du dreg bsags pa'i shel sgo chag hrug lag lheb tsam re gnam la 'phyar nas nyi 'dzin che chung la bltas nas nyi ma 'jigs snang gis 'dar gyin 'dug zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis 'khrus gzhong chu yis bkang ste/ de'i nang 'char ba'i nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan gyi che chung la bltas nas ha las nyon thor gyi skad cha sgod pa sogs grong khyer 'ur sgras khengs nas sdod kyin yod/ mi rnams kyis shu skad rgyag pa dang 'ur sgrogs chen po byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nyi 'dzin gyi gza' la 'jigs snang bskul te/ nyi ma glod grol gtong ba'i re ba bton pa zhig yin pa dang /dngangs tshabs chen pos ma ṇi bgrang don ni/de nyin phan yon brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur yod pa'i sgod rgyun yod do//4)'brum nad sngon 'gogabod sa sbyi dang lhag par stod khul du sman bcos kyi mthun rkyen ha cang tha zhan yin rung / nad yams khyab brdal mi 'gro ba'i sngon 'gog ched mtshams rer gzhung nas bcos thabs gnang srol yod pa dper na ngos rang lo drug la son pa'i skabs sgo khang du 'brum nad sngon 'gog gi 'brum sman gzed par bskyod

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/pa zhig gsal po dran gyi 'dug/nad rim sngon 'gog gi sman bcos ched phru gu mang po bang bsgrigs nas bsdad 'dug pa re re bzhin lag pa nas 'jus te/'brum 'dzugs gtsag bu steb gri rno po zhig gis dpung pa'i nye 'khris su lag pa'i sha bshags nas rma kha'i nang 'brum sman sna tha 'dra ba ser tshub tshub cig sdug gin 'dug /ngos rang gi bang rim slobs mtshams lteb gri de khrus nas phran bu mer sreg btang sethong / skabs der gnya' nang gi rjong dpon byang ngos pa yin pa dang / 'brum nad sngon 'gog gi sman bcos de gnyer pa nor bu tshe ring ngam stong 'dus pas ming ngan gnyer pa nyag to zhu bas gnang gin 'dug /lo 'ga' shas kyi sngon du lung pa'i nang lha 'brum gyi nad rim byung ste/1043chu lug lo'i snga rjes su byis pa mang por 'brum nad 'go nas/ma rjes 'brum shul che chung sna tshogs yod pa de tshor tshong 'dus pas chag dkar dang /chag dkar ma zer ba de ni bal skad bde spyod byas pa zhig red 'dug7) gson 'dre'i gnod pa bzlog thabs sri gnon dang gnas 'dren hom ma35da/phyi lo 1077dang /177catsam la lung pa'i nang mi zhi mang po byung bar brten spo ra nas rnam grol rtsangs rdo dmar ba'i gdung 'dzin bla ma bkris rgyal mtshan sku 'khor tshong 'dus su gdan zhu byas te zhabs rim gzhi rgya chen po 228

bag ston dang /'das mchod/nyi 'dzin la gdong len/'brum nad sngon 'gog sgor/byas pa dang /khyim tshang mang bos khang pa'i phyi 'o(gas su lam kha gsum mdo'i sar sri gnon gcig mjug gnyis mthud du byas thing / sri langs pa ni gdon 'dre'i rigs zhig gis rkyen ngan bar chad gtong ba la zer gyin yod pa dang /de'i bzlog thabs sri gnon zhes pa ni gnod byed gdon gzugs kyi rnam pa sa dong gru gsum gyi nang du sba gnon gyi cho ga la zer/ skabs der lung pa'i nang mi mang por gdon 'drer thug nas gar song cha med du gyur pa dang / la la ni chur mchongs pa sogs ltas ngan mang po byung zhing /mtshams rer mtshan sa nag khung nang sol ba gdung shing zer ba'i mi ma yin nag po chung chung zhig thug ste/ blo bur zhing sdong ltar ring bo chags nas lam kha bkag gin yod snud 'di 'dra byung ba'i rjes su mthong mkhan su yin yang lam seng na ba dang 'chi ba sogs yong gin yod pa dang / mtshams rer lam kha sum 'dzoms kyi sa cha 'ga' zhas la gson 'dre tshogs nas me phung 'bar ba dang /ku co 'don pa sogs ltas ngan sna tshogs mthong thos byung ba'i gnas tshul bshad sgros dar khyab byung ba de dag gi bzlog thabs su rdzo ra'i bla ma bkris rgyal mtshan rin bo che sku 'khor nas/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi sgo nas drag po'i sbyin sreg dang /gnas 'dren hom mchod/ sri zlog sogs zhabs rim rgya che gnang ba dran/mtshams rer sa skya nas dam la btags pa'i 'ba' mo'am gasku na 'dre sgor ba red ces mi rnams mtshan sa 'grul bskyod bya rgyur 'jigs snang byed pa 229

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/dang / bshad 'gug med pa'i skud pa mthong na sgrug rgyu med par bshad/ 'ga' shas kyis sde pa gzhung gis bkrams pa'i barshasnad khyab dpe cha bklags nas sa skya'i 'ba' mo sgor ba'i gnas tshul bshad pa dang bzlog thabs gzungs sngags grangs gsog byed pa ma zad/ rgyun du mi zhi byung khongs nas 'di dang 'di skyes 'dug/de dang de chags 'dug ces shod rgyu yang mang bo byung yod/mi rabs mang po'i goms gshis thun yong ma yin pa gcig ni phru gu ngu ba'i skabs kha blosag ma bsdad na ug pa (zhug pa )slebs kyi red ces 'jigs snang skul srol yod/ yul skad du gdon 'dre la ug pa zer/ nyi ma zhub pa'i rjes su phru gu dmar 'byar nang gi phyi la khrid dus sna rtser dreg pa byugs kyi red/ de ltar byas na gnod pa bzlog gin yod pa'i yid ches byed pa ma zad/ bla ma rnams kyi drung nas srung mdud dang / bdug pa/ srung 'khor sogs zhus nas gyon srol yod pa bcas so//

le tshan bcu gsum pa/tshong 'dus kyi slob grwa gsar rnying sgor/1)sger 'dzin 1snab grwa khag gi 〈snar/phyi lo 1077 lo'i snga rjes su tshong 'dus grong khyer nang slob grwa chung chung khag bzhi yod pa de dag gi dge gon ni rdzong dpon rtse mgron ye shes lhun grub dang /rdo legs ba'i jo lags kun bzang / mig dmar don grub lags/ nam rje kun bzang bcas nas gnang sku da/ skabs der nam rje kun bzang nas bod dngul brgya lor rdzun ma bzo 'don byas pa red ces khrims zhib byung ste sgo khang du do dam byas yod kyang / slob phrug tshos mu mthud 'bri klog sbyong brdar gyis sgo khang du sbyang zhing khyer nas nam rje lags su yi ge ston pa dang / khong gis bcos rgyag pa mthong myong yod/ nam rje kun bzang ni ha cang gi shes pa bkra la lag rtsal che bar grags zhing / ri sa bris rtsal dang / zhing rkos rgyag rgyur yang zhin tu mkhas wa yin pa ma zad/sngags brgyab ste snga da ṭam dang bal ṭam gnyis cog rtse'i steng du langs te gdong 'thab byed du bcug pa sogs mig 'phrul sne mang 〈snan pa'i dmigs bsal gyi man ngag mang 〈sna shes par thu/ba/thag/ 231

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bod yig slob grwa dang cha mtshungs bal po'i bu phrug khag cig gis kyang nee pā li'i skad yig slob sbyong ched sger 'dzin slob grwar bskyod pa'i dge gon gcig ni a khya lham sa ghu wa tsa zer bas byas/ khong gi slob phrug khongs su bu ni ra dze'i bu phun tshogs dang / a khu tshe ring stobs rgyas kyi bu bkris/ a khya sā zhu'i bu dkon mchog/dngul bakhro'i bu rnam rgyal dkar lu bcas byung 'dug pa ma zad/ a khya ki ri zhi na lal zer bas kyang ni pā li'i yi ge slob khrid byed kyin yod pa'i dge phrug mkhar steng 'chi med dang / rnam chung / klu khug 'chi med rdo rje sogs rgya gu 'ga' shas byung yod/a khya klu khug ni bur sras pa dang ko thang gnas po'i khyim mtshes yin pa ltar/'chi med rdo rje'i nang du ni pā li'i skad yig rang sbyong byed sar yang yang bskyod de mnyam gzhib byas rkyen ko gnas nor bu rgya mtsho dang ngos gnyis nas nee pā li'i ka kha lam rab dang grangs ka brgya bar shes thub pa gsal 11ra dran/2)rdo legs pa'i slob grwa/phyi lo 1077 lor rdo legs pa'i slob grwa'i nang khyon bsdoms slob drug bcu tsam yod pa'i khongs chu bdag a de'i bu blo bzang phun tshogs dang / sru mo rnam rgyal sgrol dkar gyi bu sa ngag dbang sgrol dkar/ byang pa'i bu po bsod nams rgyal mosna/ zhing bzo tshe brtan gyi bu rgyal mtshan/ bkris 'dzoms sgromam 232

dkar ngag dbang chos can/thugs rje lha khang gi blo bzang rdo rje/chu 'og bkris rgyal mtshan/ phran bur sras pa rin chen dar 'o1/ dbo na pa gsar pa shes rab bzang po bcas yod/ slob phrug rnams nyin ltar snga dro nam langs la 'dzoms te gang blo mas gtsos kha 'don dang / byis pa dag yig /dgu zla bcas skad gsang mthon pos mnyam du skyor dgos pa de dag grub rjes zhog jar ma bskyod bar du klog dbe klog 'don byed dgos kyin yod/slob grwa che chung ji 'dra zhig yin rung sgrig zhugs kyi cha rkyen du dbyal phyug gam pho mo'i dbye 'byed med pa ma zad/ dge rgan la zugs rje legs 'bul phyag rtags 'bul srol tsam las slob yon ni 'bul dgos med cing / slob phrug rnams nas rgyun du rang gi dge gon la dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po pha ma lta bu'i drin can du ngos 'dzin gyis gus brtsi zhu ba ji bzhin dge gon gyis kyang slob phrug rnams rang gi bu phrug lta bu'i gces skyong byed pa'i ya rabs lugs srol bzang po ni sngar bod kyi slob grwa'i thun yong ma yin pa'i khyad chos zhig red/3)smyug kha dang /snag tsha ba1sna stangs/sngar bod kyi slob grwar smyug kha slob drug skusna sos bzo dbesnas pa smos ci/ zig rkyal dang tshig snag kyang rang gis bzo dgos zhing / slob thug tshos smyug ma 233

dkyus ma dang / si sogs las smyug kha bzo ba'i thog gro ril mer bsregs btang ba'i tshig mar phyur khya bsres nas sbyang zhing thog 'bri rgyu'i tshig snag dang /snag skyogs nang bzhu mar gyi du ba bsags pa'i dreg pa dang mchod de'i me tog gi mnyam du bye ma ka ra phran bu bsres bar snag rgyug rwa co zhig gis yun ring dbyar pa'am snur nas sgog thog 'bri rgyu'i snag tsha nag po bcas bzo ba ma zad/ ko phyug chu la bsgol nas 'dur 'dur yag bo bzos te sbyar rtsi ko sbyin yang bzo gi red/4)zla re'i yig tshad dang /smyug lcag gi nyes pa/slob grwa mang che bar zla rer yig tshad thengs re gtong bzhin yod pa de ni yig gzugs kho na las klog 'don dang dag cha sogs kyi rgyugs sprod dgos kyin med/ rgan lags kyis yig tshad zhib 'jug byas rjes ang ki bang rim ltar ru bsgrigs bcug ste/ang dang pos gnyis pa nas 'go 'dzugs te mtha' ma bar smyug lcag re re bzhu chog pa dang / de nas gnyis pa gsum pa bcas bang rim bzhin rang rang gi gsham du yod ba yongs rdzogs la smyug lcag re re bzhu ru bcug mthar rkub sdod la slob grogs bzhu sa med par brten/ mar sgogs stong pa skam bo zhig la bzhu dgos pa de ni skad sgra che bas ngo tsha kha skyengs chen po yod/ 234

tshong 'dus kyi slob grwa gsar rnying skor/lam lugs 'di dag phyogs gcig nas gdug rtsub che ba yang / slob besnags gang zhig gis smyug lcag tsha bo gzhu dus gzhan pa tshos lan slog thub thabs su slob sbyong la 'bad brtson byed pa'i khyad chos yod nges red/7)gung gseng /slob grwa khag la tshes bzang dus bzang la ma galta gas res gza' spen pa nyi ma'i gung gseng gtong 〈snal med/ 'on kyang ston las skabs mtshams rer rgan lags kyi gzim shag gi rtswa rwa'i nang rtswa bcag bcag byed par gtong gin sku(da/ de skabs rkang lag gis rtswa skam po bcag bcag mnan mnan byed pa ma zad/ rtswa spungs kyi nang du gab res yib res dang / yar 'dzigs mar mchongs byed rgyu'i go skabs thob par brten phru gu tshos rtswa rar 'gro rgyur dga' po byed/ gong bzhin dpyid ka zhing kha 'debs pa'i skabs sa zhing la son 'gru bsgos pa'i steng du sa g.yogs nas 'khos snyoms bzo ba'i ched sha lu rgyag pa zhes mas mdzo gnyis kyi mganya' zhing la sbrags pa'i zhing snyeb kyi steng du nga tsho slob phrug rnams res mas kyis bzhon nas 'drud bcug pa de dag ni gung gseng las lhag pa'i skyid snang che ba yong gin yod/

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/ca)snga dus kyi bod yig sbyong stangs/sngar gnya' nang khul du bod yig slob srol ni tshan rig dang mthun pa'i thabs lam zab po min rung / deng dus rgya gar dang bal yul nang rang re'i slob grwa khag la bod yig slob stangs skas them ma 'dzegs par steng thog tu slebs 'dra'i ngang tshul 'di 'dra min par go rim dang 'char gzhi nges can gyi thog nas mang gzhi sra brtan slob srol yod/ de yang / 1 sgyu gu 'ju stangs dang / 2sbyang zhing thog skam dras rgyag stangs/3dbyangs bzhi dang ka kha 'bri klog4ya btags ra btags dang / la btags bcas pa'i 'bri blo ga ya btags zhabs kyu dang / ra btags zhabs kyu/ la btags zhabs kyu bcas pa 'bri tā ga cu ra mabo la mabo sa mabesna bcas pa'i 'bri 〈snag 7 ba1snad gzhi chigs bcad gang rung thog tshugs ring 'bri klog / mu mthud sbyang zhing thog tshugs zung yig gzugs sbyong brdar/ 0 sbyang zhing thog tshugs ma 'khyug 'bri stangs/1༷ 'di mtshams sgog thog tu phab nas tshugs zung dang / tshugs ma 'khyuga'akhyug yig bcas slob pa dang chabs cig snyan sum dang / dag cha bcas snga rjes go rim ma 'dzol bar slob 'khrid byed srol bzang po yod/ slob grwa tshang mar snga dro 'char can kha 'don gyi mnyam du byis pa dag yig dang dgu zla skyor 'don dgos kyin yod/ tshugs thung 'bri 'go btsugs dus zhar zhor ka bshad sna tshogs dang / gzhung gi bka' rgya/ sger so so'i chod gan sogs yig 236

tshong 'dus kyi slob grwa gsar rnying skor/gzugs tshad ldan lta dper sprad de 'bri ru bcug nas lo bzhi lnga'i nang bod yig tshad ldan chags thub/ lta dbe gal che'i rigs la rgyab tu gro zhib kyi skyo 'dur byugs nas ras khra'i rgyab sha brgyab ste nyar tshags yag po byed rgyur dang dod chen po byed kyi red/7)gzhung 'dzugs slob grwa gsar pa'i skor/phyi lo 107/ lor gnya' nang gi rdzong dbon tar khang zhabs sdod mkhyen rab bstan skyong dang /shod drung lding yon gnyis kyi skabs tshong 'dus su gzhung gis slob grwa che ba zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang / gtso 'gan rdzong dpon tar khang bas gnang ba'i thog rgyun du dge rgan gzhon pa'i 'gan 'khur rdzong zhabs dpal ldan lags skusnags nas byas pa ma zad/ rdo legs pa'i jo lags kun bzang dang /ko gnas dngos grub rdo rje/bur sras pa rigs 'dzin rdo rje bcas gsum la'ang dge rgan gyi ming gnas gnang / zla re'i yig tshad btang ba'i rjes slob zug rnams ang rim gzhir bzung ru bstar bsgrigs te sgo khang nas grong khyer gyi gzhung lam brgyud khong gsum la yig tshad sbyan bstar zhu bar 'gro sgol yod pa de skabs slob grwa'i nang yi ge rtse phud dang rkub sdod su yin bang rim nas gsal po shes thub par brten gral mabo ra skusgod pa rnams sgobs pa byed pa dang /gral mjug tu yod pa rnams ngo tsha kha skyengs byed/237

gnya' nang tsong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/phyi lo 107 lor nga tsho khyon bsdoms slob phrug74yod pa'i ming tho gang dran gsham gsal ltar yin/1 a khya ngag dbang dpal ldan nam bkras khang rnam rgyal 〉te rje dang / 2 rnam rgyal sgrol ma/3skal bzang g.yu sgron/4tshong 'dus byang pa'am bsus tshang sangs rgyas tshe dbang dang / 7 bskusnad nams rgyal mosna/ ca kun gling rtse ngag dbang phun tshogs/ 7 gnas steng bskusnad nams tshe ring / / mang 'brug bkra zhis phun tshogs/'amakhar steng rnam chung /1༷ko gnas nor bu rgya mtsho/17klu khyag 'chi med rdo rje/12jo jo ngag dbang rdo rje/13khrol rnying dkon mchog rang sgrol/14thu ra dga' rabs ngag dbang rdo rje/ 17 bur sras pa rin chen dar lo/1cathugs rje lha khang blo bzang rdo rje/17chu 'og bkra zhis rgyal mtshan/1/dngul bzo rnam rgyal ka lu/ 10 dngul bzo bsam grub/ 2༷ rang 'khor blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ 21 rang 'khor ngag dbang tshul khrims/ 22 zhing bzo tshe brtan gyi bkra nyis rgyal mtshan/23mdzu kha drug pa'i thub bstan/24bal khrom tshe ring stobs rgyas kyi bu bkra shis/ 27 mang 'brug ngag dbang sgrol dkar/2 spen pa grung ril gyi bu pa sangs rdo rje/27 zhag rtsa skal bzang gi bu bkra zhis/ 2/ rdzong dga' rnam rgyal/ 2 thong dpon sding yon pa'i sras tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang /30sras mo 'chi med sgrol dkar/31sras yo rig 'dzin chos sgron/ 32 spo rong pa sangs rnam rgyal/ 33 yar leb sba ro skal bzang phun 238

tshong 'dus kyi slob grwa gsar rnying skor/tshogs/mdzosgo rong bkris tshe ring /37sgom dkar ngag dbang chos can/3camang 'jug mthu stobs/37mang 'brug blo bzang tshe dbang /3/ma la'i bsod nams rgyun tshogs/mi chang ma chos 'dzoms kyi bu bkra zhis rgyal mtshan/rdzoXbya longs tshe ring sgrol ma'i bu bsod nams don grub/41du lung gong po'i bu skusnan tan bcas pa'i thog da dung 'ga' shas dran gasku ma thub bas chad pa rnams la bzod gsol zhu rgyu//)gzhung 'dzugs slob grwa'i byung rabs/rdzong dpon nas gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i slob grwa 'di bzhin 7gong sa 7sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog nas bod ljongs chos srid gnyis rka'i gnas tshul gzhi rtsar bzung ste dus bstun bcos bsgyur gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang ba'i 'bru don lag len du bstar ba zhig yin par 'dug 7gong sa ma35ga nas legs bathershas las khungs gsar 'dzugs gnang ste snga 'a11sa legs bcos phyag bzhes gnang rgyu'i sgor zhing rta lor lha zhol gnyis la rtsa tshig dang / rgya khyab rdzong gzhis tshang mar bkod rgya don tshan lnga 'khod pa zhig gnang ba'i don tshan bzhi pa'i nang mnga' khul so sor bu phrug rnams la lugs gnyis kyi blang dor 'byed pa'i mig lta bu yi ge 'bri klog 'pher ba'i slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis rang rang blo dang 'tsham pa'i yig rtsis slob sbyong 239

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gang thub dgos rgyu de ltar yang / mi ser la 'phar brdab mi 'byung ched dge gon dang / slob phrug rnams la sto phogs 'deng nges dang yig chas sogs sgrod thub ba'i 'bab dmigs zur du thabs shes go sgrig gzab 'bungs dgos rgyu zhes phebs ba 'di'i sgor zhib cha bod kyi srod don rgyal rabs nang gsal 'dugardzong dpon mkhyen rab bstan skyong ni deng dus kyi bsam blo gtong phyogs la dga' pos yod mkhan zhig yin pa ltar slob phrug tshor lus rtsal dang rkang rtsed sgo lo yang bslabs te/slob phrug gon pa mang po rkang rtsed sgo lor dbyings zhugs nas 〈snad 〈snan cha bsgrigs nas 〈snan/'ga' shas kyis 〈snad 〈snan gyi rgyab tu ras dmar po btub nas(ltar khang /zhes pa'i yi ge sbyar yang /de ni nor ba red ces med bar bzos/ nga tsho'i dge rgan tar khang zhabs sdod pa yin par song 'ga' shas kyis lha sa'i tar khang slob grwa'i yan lag lta bur ngos 'dzin yang byas/ nga tshos mtshams rer ja mngar mo'i rgyan bzhag nas 〈sna 'pha 'gran bsdur byed kyin yod/ thengs gcig sbang ra ma zer ba'i thang du rdzong dpon gnyis kyi gzigs rtog 'og tshong 'dus kyi gon 'thus bcu gcig dang / slob zug bcu gcig rkang rtsed po lo 'gran bsdur gyis su sgor ba yin na sgro skyid kyi 'gro gron gtong rgyu byas kyang rtsed 'gran skabs rtsod rnyog byung ste thugs sgro gtong rgyu byung med/ sgo khang du slob grwa gsar 'dzugs byas pa 'dis lung pa'i 240

tshong 'dus kyi slob grwa gsar rnying sgor/nang phru gu mang che bas yig rtsis shes pas ma tshad sbyang grung dod po dang /gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten la do snang che ru 'gro ba'i dge mtshan yang byung yod pa bcas 37//

le tshan bcu bzhi pa/dus 'gyur gyi rba rlabs/1)gnya' nang du rgya mi thog mar 'byor ba/phyi lo 1 77 lor rgya mi zhi drag brgya sgor zhig gnya' nang du yong nas lam thig brgyab pa dang / ri lung gang sar rgyang shel khyer te so nyul nyams zhib byas ba'i thog /snga dgong lus rtsal dang sbo lo brtse zhing / nyin gung tshal zhing nang ngal rtsol byas te rgya la phyag dang /og son/slong la phug/lan gong bad tshal sogs sngar med tshal rigs sna tshogs 'debs 'go btsugs/ mi mang la gnya' gnon gdug rtsub byas yod med ma shes kyang /rgya mi khyi sha za mkhan/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo zhes tshang mas zhe 'khon dang 'jigs snang chen po byas par dran/skabs der slob phrug tshos rgya mis sa zig rgyag pa'i smyug si mang po bsgrugs nas smyu gur bed spyod byas/ 'ga' res dgos mkho yod min la ma stos par sa thig rgyag pa'i smyug ma rnams phyir 'don char bsregs byed mkhan yang byung yod/skabs der 'bras dang gro zhib sogs kyi yul thang shugs cher 'phar ba las mi mang gi gnas stangs sngar rgyun rang 'jags su gnas par brten/242

dus 'gyur gyi rlabs/tshong pa rnams kyis stong thugs che ru btang nas 'tsho gos yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bzhin pa'i thog/a khya ngag dbang dpal ldan dang /rdo legs pa/byang pa'i mag pa bsod nams rdo rje sogs 'ga' shas kyis lha sa dang bal yul la dpe bltas te sdod khang spus dag gsar rgyag byas/ gnas steng bu 'gyur med nas sbyin bdag zhus te/ lha khang gsar pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas rgya bskyed dang gsar skrun gyi las don la brel zing che ba'i skabs zhig la tshong 'dus su yod pa'i rgya mi rnams lha sar phyir bsdu byas te/ yul mi rnams ha cang dga' bo byas kyang /phyi lo 177 lo'i rgyal po lo gsar grub rjes nyin gcig glo bur rgya gar rgyal yongs rlung 'phrin las khang gi bod skad sde tshan nas/ bod nang rgya che'i mi mang gis ngo rgol gyen langs byas par rgya dmag nas drag gnon byas pa dang / 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog rgya gar du chibs kha bsgyur te/ lam khar snyun gzhi bzhes tshul dza drag gi gnas tshul rgyang bsrings byas rkyen mi rnams kyi sems la dngangs tshabs chen po byung yang / nyin shas rjes rgya gar du zhabs 'khod gnang ba'i gtam bzang go thos byung ste re zhig blo bder gyur/ lha sar mi mang gyen langs kyi skabs rdo legs pa'i bu 'jam dbyangs dang / bu bkris/ bla ma rgyud pa'i bu rgyal mtshan skusnags tshong 'dus pa gang 'tshams thig nas sbyar yig tshugs thung 'bri rogs byas pa dang / gyen langs khrom sgor nang dngos su zhugs/ rdo 243

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/legs pa'i bu 'jam dbyangs la rgya dmag gi spe sgrogs phog nas rkyen 'das su song ba'i gnas tshul gnya' nang du 'byor bar nang mi dga' nye stos bcas blo yul du mi sgong ba'i sems pham dang mya ngan byed dgos byung yod/2)bstan srung dmag mi'i rgyags phye gra sgrigaphyi lo 1070lo mgor bstan srung dang blangs dmag sgar nas/drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs sra brtan skusnad pa dang /dpa' mdzangs snying stobs chen pos chos med rgya dmar kla klor rgol 'dzing shugs cher byas pa'i gnas tshul dril bsgrags yig cha gling gi sgrung dpe 'dra ba'i dpe zung snga rjes 'grems spel byas pa de gras gnya' nang du'ang 'byor te/mi rnams kyi sems la re ba chen po byung nas khams rigs gtso gyur grong drag rnams tshogs 'du tshogs te/ lung pa'i nang go lag ji yod mngon med rob rtsis byas pa'i thog bstan srung dang blangs dmag rgyag gi ched du 'bras ltang brgya tham pa'i zhal 'debs bsdus nas/mi 'thus lcang gling blo ri chos mdzad dang / mi nyag a khya klu sgrub gnyis rdzo kha'i phyogs su mngags rdzong byas kyang khong gnyis ding rir 'byor dus khul de'i sa cha yongs rdzogs rgya dmag la sgor zin pa dang / dpal mdzangs snying stobs ldan pa'i ding ri dmag sgar gyi brgya dpon rta mgrin tshe ring yang glo bur 'dzin bzung gis dmar gsod btang ba sogs mi snyan pa'i gnas tshul mang dag ji44

dus 'gyur gyi rlabs/shes tshor gyis phyir log bya dgos byung /ding ri ca dang dmag sgar ni/ phyi lo 1702 lor btsugs pa zhig yin pa dang / de lnga'i sgrig gzhir dmag mi lnga brgya yod pa'i las 'gan gtso bo ding ri sa khul bca' srung dang gor kṣa'i dmag mi bod du 'dzul na 'gog srung byed rgyu yin yang / 1077 lor bod gzhung gi nor srid la dka' ngal 'phrad par bsnyad de dmag mi mang che ba rang yul du phyir slordzog btang ba dang / rgyun du dmag sgar du sdod mkhan mda' tshab gcig dang / brgya dpon gcig /sding dbon lnga/dmag mi nyung shas bcas khyon bsdoms mi nyi shu sgor las med cing /rang 11ga btang ba'i dmag mi rnams dmag 'khrug byung tshe 'bral mar mnyam 'dzoms dgos rgyu'i gtan 'bebs yod pa dang /go mtshon rnams shel dkar thong dang /lha rtse rdzong gnyis la bsdus 'jog gnang ste/1670lor rgyal khab dang mi mang la dzo drag dgos gal byung ba'i skabs bed tshuphad gang yang byung med pa de ni rgya mi'i ngan byus lam sgongs sku nga ba la ram 'degs lta bur gyur pa zhig red/3)nyen g.yol/ding rir brgya dpon rta mgrin tshe ring bkrongs pa'i rjes su rgya dmag mang po gnya' nang gi phyogs su yong gin yod pa dang / go mtshon yod pa'i khams 245

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/rigs yongs rdzogs 'dzin bzung bya rgyu yin tshul dkrog gtam zhig tshong 'dus grong khyer nang lhags te/ li thang kun dga' dngos grub khyim dud dang /brag g.yab ngag dbang dpal ldan khyim dud/ mi nyag klu sgrub/ 'ba' pa shes rab pha bu/ bur sras pa rig 'dzin rdo rje sogs khams pa'i khyim dud che khag dang / de dag gi bu tsha/ gzhan yang yul 〈snags gzhan nas sku1nga ba'i khams rigs khag cig glo bur gros byol gyis re zhig bal yul sa mtshams dang nye ba'i ri 'dabs dgon pa gsar pa zhes pa'i grong gseb tu bsdad/ skabs der gnya' nang du rgya dmag 'gyor med kyang / rdzong dpon mkhyen rab bstan skyong dang / sgod drung lding yon gnyis nas 7rgyal ba rin bo che log spyod pas btsan 'khrid byas pa snga rjes la ma ltos par bod nang phyir phebs gnang rgyu yin pa ma zad/ bod mi'i 'tsho gos dang / bla ma dgon pa sogs kyi gnas stangs la 'gyur ba gang yang 'gro rgyu min pa'i dril bsgrags byas pa ma zad/mi mang bros byol du 'gro dogs kyis rdzong zhabs drung yig lags dang /chos rgyal lags/ dpal ldan lags/ padma lags 31gas nas mtshan 31 bal yul du 'gro ba'i lam gzhung 'gog srung byed pa dang / mtshams rer me mda' 'phangs nas 'jigs snang bskul/ tshong 'dus kyi khams rigs rnams gros byol du sdod ma dgos par phyir log byas na yag po yin pa'i slob gso'i brda lan spyod pa'i ched rdo legs pa'i jo lags kun bzang dang /246

dus 'gyur gyi ba rlabs/bur sras pa'i ja dpon lags gnyis dgon pa gsar par ched rdzong byas kyang / khong gnyis sa mtshams su 'byor nas phan tshun skad cha bshad pa'i gnad don snying por/ khams rigs rnams phyir log bya rgyu lta ci/ khong rang gnyis kyang ring min gros phyol du yong rgyu'i nang gros bshams te/tshong 'dus su phyir log rjes rdzong dpon gnyis la khams rigs rnams gang mgyogs phyir log yong rgyu yin pa'i 'dra chags kyi gnas snyan zhus 'dug/skabs der ngos rang dang tshong 'dus pa'i bu phrug mang po mu mthud sgo khang du slob grwar 'gro bzhin pa bcas skusna//

le tshan bco lnga pa/yul gyar mi tshe gsar pa'i bde sdug1)sdu sa 〈snal/bod rgyal yongs nang zing 'khrug gi dzo drag gnas stangs je zhan je sdug tu gyur rjes gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi yul mi mang po snga rjes rim par bal yul nang skyabs bcol du 'byor/ sa mtshams thag nyer song rin thang che ba'i rgyu nor gang yod rang rang so so dang mi gla mang bos rgyab 'khyar 'or 'dren byas par brten sa mtshams su khral sar sngog bsher skabs gser dngul rgyan gos dang / lhag par tshong 'dus byang pa dang / ngag dbang dpal ldan/ rdo legs pa/ ka sgo ba semags tshong pa che khag gis mnyam khyer gor ṭam rnying pa stong sgam mang po'i thog bal po'i shog lor lcags sgam bkang ba snga rjes mthong dus bal gzhung mi sna dang yul mi rnams ha las nyon thor gyi snyir grags kyang byung sku da/lo gnyis ring sa mtshams kyi grong gseb li bang dang / sto sne sgang / chu khya 'am ta to pa ni/ g.yer ma zhing / sprug sgang / dpa' bo dgon pa/ yang la sgor/'jur spug/grogs mo can cal/sa glang dga' ri/thang zhing /mar me/an tha 248

li/sgra thang tha li/stang tha li/sgo bo sgang sogs su yul mir gnas tshang g.yar nas bsdad/ lung pa'i skad brda ma 'grod pa dang goms gzhis shes rtogs med pa'i dka' ngal ma byung yang / gnam gzhis tsha grang ma mthun ba dang /'ga' shas la 'tsho bo sa mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i thog sman bcos med pa'i dka' ngal chen po byung yod/bod nas mnyam khyer rum gdan dang / mal gzan sogs dngos thog rim tshong bya dgos gyur pa smos med thog /mdor na chu stod dang sto stod zangs chas yan chod lco sne sgang du a khya shag rtsar pham tshong byed dgos byung yod/sa mtshams su sdod rgyun ring nyams chung 'ga' shas kyis khab dang /la cha/dzim bu/grod zum tshil lu/rdo tha'i lo ma sogs khyer te grong gseb khag tu ri skor rgyab nas gro dang / mar kun sogs 'bru gzan dang brje bsgyur byas nas 'tsho ba bskyal ba dang / 'ga' shas yul mi'i zhing las lag gaskusgog byed dgos byung yod/ rgya dogs pas 'bung / bod re bas 'phung zer ba bzhin gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum nas yong ba'i bod mi rnams ring min rang yul du phyir log thub pa'i re ba chen po byas te/ lo ngo 'ga' shas sa mtshams grong gseb khag tu sdod rgyun ring pho po gon gzhon mang bo nad mnar sman bcos med par dus min 'das grongs god chags chen po byung yod/phyi 'o( mi ca1 'o1 mgor gong gsal grong gseb khag tu skusgod pa'i bod mi

rnams 'jur lhug tu tshogs 'du 'tshogs te/ rang gzhung la snyan zhu bris nas bkras khang a khya ngag dbang dpal ldan dang / bur sras pa'i ja dpon lags sbyos kyi skye byed / rnam gnyis mi mang gi 'thus mi'i ngo bor bal yul rgyal sar bod gzhung don gcod khang du ngo bcar zhus/ mi mang gi bde sdug snyan gsan zhib lhug zhus 'bras don gcod khang nas gzigs skyong gnang ba'i lo rgyus ba/shas/ ba/thega'i//2)dpa' bo dgon pa'i slob grwa/sa mtshams su yod pa'i bod phrug rnams kyi ched dpa' bo dgon pa zer ba'i sa char slob grwa zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i skor skabs de'i slob dge gsang sngags ཿphas gling sku zhabs bkris rnam rgyal lags su bka' 'dri zhus par khong gis byung rim lo rgyus zhib bra gsungs pa gsham gsal/sku zhabs bkra zhis rnam rgyal lags dang / cha phreng ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lags gnyis ma su ri bod kyi btsan gyol slob gar slob sbyong gnang bzhin pa'i skabs slob grwa'i yig tshang nas khyod gnyis bal yul sa khul zhig tu slob dger 'gro dgos pas gnangs nyin ldi lir 'thon dgos gsungs te/byi lo 1 ca1phyi zla 12tshes 1nyin lam rogs gcigadang sbrags nas btang /de dus shes rig las khungs lte ba ldi lir yod pa ltar/ shes rig bka' blon 250

yul rgyur mi tshe gsar pa'i bde sdugakun bde gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan mchog nas bal yul bod gzhung don gcod la 'bul rgyu'i phyag bris dang zhal byang gnang nas byed sgo'i sgor bal yul don gcod nas bka' mngags gnang gi red gsungs/ lam gron 'deng nges gnang nas bal yul du thon/ ka ṣṭha man ḍūr 'byor 'bral don gcod sku ngo zhing gsar blo bzang dge legs mchog mjal te ldi li shes rig las khyangs nas stsal ba'i bka' yig phul/ sdod gnas a saṅga sol sa khul shar pa ho kral zer ba rgyus ston gnang /rgya gar nas bal yul du slob grwa 'dzugs par yong lugs brjod na bal yul gzhung gis 'gog rgyu'i nyen kha yod pas skad cha 'dri mkhan byung na/slob phrug yin/gnas sgor la yong ba yin/rgya gar la phyir log byed mkhan yin zhes brjod dgos bka' phebs ltar bod mi su 'phrad la bka' yol de rang gnang /don gcod la thengs 'ga' shas ngo bcar zhus kyang / phar tsam ring 'di byed bka' gsal ma byung stabs de'i ring nye 'kho(ra gnas chen khag mjal/nyin shas rjes sku ngo blo bzang dge legs mchog gis khyod gnyis nas gcig skyid grong sa mtshams dang / gcig gnya' nang sa mtshams su 'gro dgos gsungs par ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lags nas nged gnyis kha 'thor mi dgos par sa cha gcig rang la gtong rogs zhus par de don zhal bzhes kyis gnya' nang sa mtshams su 'gro rgyur gtan 'khel gnang ste/ don gcod 251

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/skya ngo mchog nas khong gnyis 'jo wa la khel du sen dze zhir slob grwar pha dar yo ran mchog la ngo spyod mtshams sbyor mdzod/ bod mi skyabs bcol bar rogs ram gyi ched du btsugs pa'i tshogs chung gi gtso 'dzin pha dar sa ran mchog nas dge gon gyi phogs mi rer zla rer hin sgor 1ཿ re brtsis bal sgor 1caXre gnang rgyu zhal bzhes sngon yod thog yig chas nyo rgyu phyag dngul yang gnang 'dug khong gnyis kyis ka bla man ḍū nas dbyin ji'i slob deb dang / bris deb/ zha smyug pan sil/rdo sam/ sa smyug sogs nyos/bod yig klog deb ni khrom nas nyo rgyu med pa ma zad don gcod khang nas kyang gnang mi 'dug /nag spang gnyis rjes sor grong gseb kyi zhing bzo bar bzo mngags gnang / dge rgan gyi phogs zla ba rdzogs mtshams so sor bal yul don gcod khang brgyud nas slob grwa ma thor bar du chad med gnang 'dugadus tshes nges pa zugs dran ma sos kyang phyi lo 1741phyi zla 12pa'i zla mjug tsam la don gcod khang nas sa gnas bod mi'i mgo 'dzin la stsal ba'i ngo sgod bka' yig khyer nas nee pa li'i ku li gnyis glas te rkang bgrod kyis phal cher nyin gsum tsam la/ tsa'u ta ra'i rdzong khongs yang la kor zer ba'i grong gseb tu 'byor/ don gcod kyi bka' mngags ltar sa gnas bod mi'i mgo byed ngag dbang dpal ldan lags kyi bzhugs gnas su bskyod nas ngo sprod phyag bris phul/ khong bza' tshang gnyis kyis rang khyim du slebs pa lta 252

yul gyar mi tshe gsar ba'i bde sdugabu'i sne len gzab gzab gnang rjes grong gseb kha thor du gnas pa'i mi mang rnams la rgya gar nas dge gon gnyis 'byor skor dang / slob grwa 'dzugs phyogs brda skyel dang / bod bal sa mtshams ta to pa ni dang thag nye'i ri rgyud grong gseb dpa' bo dgon pa zhes pa'i shar pa'i dgon pa zhig yod pa'i mgo byed gtso bo kri ka bla mar sa cha der slob grwa btsugs chog pa'i bka' yol sngon tshud nas zhus yod pa dang / ngag dbang dpal ldan lags kyi phyag rogs su gnya' nang pa'i mi drag kha shas yod pa'i ming ni da lta thugs dran sos kyi mi 'dug /dge rgan gnyis ni phyogs der rgyus mnga' gang yang med pas khong rnam pas lam ston gnang ba de rang thog shar bskyod byas pa yin gsungs kyi 'dug/nyin shas rjes ngag dbang dpal ldan lags dang /khong gi bu bgres pa rnam rgyal rdo je lags/slob rgyag bu gcig dang bu mo gsum bcas yang la ko nas nyin gcig rkang bgrod kyis dpa' bo dgon par 'byor/ dus mtshungs yang la ko dang /jur spug/sa lang sga ri/sbag khang /mar me/lco sne sgang /thang zhing sogs grong gseb khag nas/ pha ma dang phru gu rnams kyang 'byor/ phyi lo 10 2 phyi zla dang po'i tshes shar la dpa' bo dgon pa'i tshogs khang nang du khyal der yod pa'i gnya' nang pa'i mi drag dang pha ma bu phrug ngo 'dzoms kyis slob grwa dbya 'byed kyi mdzad sgo stabs bde zhig gnang / de'i skabs dge rgan gnyis nas gsung bshad mdor bsdus re gnang ste/ khong dge rgan gnyis 253

7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi shes rig las khungs nas sa gnas su slob grwa 'dzugs par gtong gnang mdzad pa dang / da lta'i char gang ci'i gnas stangs skyo yang tshang mas mnyam rub hur thag byas na 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i thugs rjes rim pas dka' ngal sel zhing yar rgyas yong gi red ces gsungs/ de nas 'dzin grwa tshogs yul dpa' bo dgon pa'i sgo 'phyor g.yar po gnang 'dug par ltar/ g.yas g.yon phyogs gnyis su 'dzin grwa mtho dman gyi dbye ba med par sde tshan khag gnyis byas nas tshogs/slob phrug pho mo khyon bsdoms bzhi bcu sgor yod pa'i khongs su che ba lo 17tsam dang /chung sgos lo catsam byung zhing /rgan pa'i khrod du bod yig 'bri klog shes mkhan 'ga' shas byung yod kyang dbyin ji tshang mas bslab myong med cing /bkris rnam rgyal lags nas bod yig dang ang rtsis bslabs pa dang / ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lags nas dbyin ji slob 'khrid gnang / bod yig klog deb med tsang /chung ba rnams la ka kha slob rgyu dang /che ba rnams la dag yig dang sum cu pa slob rgyu phru gu so so'i shes tshad dang bsdun gyin nag spang la bris nas bris deb nang bshu ru bcug nas sbyangs/ dge rgan gnyis nas ma su ri'i bod kyi btsan byol slob grwa'i 'gro stangs ltar byas nas snga dro rang sbyong zin rjes zhal 'don dang /de rjes lus rtsal stabs bde zhig byas nas bod kyi rgyal glu btang nas snga dro 'dzin grwa tshogs thengs gnyis dang /nyin gung rgyab la 254

yul gyar mi tshe gsar ba'i bde sduga'adzin grwa tshogs thengs gnyis tshogs rjes rang sbyong byed rgyu/ res gza' nyi mar dgung seng hril po dang /lhag par nyin byed dgung seng byas/ma su ri slob grwa'i lugs srol ltar zla rer yig tshad thengs re btang nas yang thob snyan tho ka bla man skyur 'gro mkhan nam byung mdun bal yul don gcod khang la sbyan zhur phyal 'dugaslob phrug gi 'tsho ba rang khyangs pha ma so sos bskyal ba ma gtogs rogs ram byung mi 'dug/dge slob tshang ma dpa' bo dgon pa'i nye 'khor shar pa'i khang pa 'ga' shas nang khang gla byas nas bzhugs/ phru gu rgan pa'i khrod du yul gzhas rkang bro glu gzhas shes mkhan sku(da pa'i thog/skabs shig lha sa ba kha btags dkar po zer ba'i gzhon pa zhig slebs 'dug khong ni zlos gar shes mkhan zhig yin pa ltar ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lags nas re bskul gnang ste/ dbus kyi gzhas dang zhabs 〈sna 'ga' shas bslabs/ 'khrab chas med pa ma gtogs slob grwa der zlos gar gyi sgrig 'dzugs chung chung zhig kyang chags/ phru gu'i pha ma rnams gzhung zhen dang sems shugs che zhing / dge rgan gnyis 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog la 'char phul phyag rtags phebs tshul bal yul don gcod nas mgo mang la stsal ba'i bka' yig la gsal ba ltar tshang mas brtsi mthong dang gus bkur ha cang chen po zhus 'dugangag dbang dpal ldan lags kyi bu bgres pa rnam rgyal rdo rje lags dge rgan 255

le tshan bcu drug pa/slob grwa thor nas rgya gar du 'byor ba dang / drag po'i slob sbyong / ku lu lam bakhro'i gnya' nang brgya sgog bcas kyi sgor/1)slob grwa thor nas rgya gar du 'byor ba/bal bod sa mtshams su gnas 'khod gnya' nang mgo mang rnams kyi 'dod pa pha ma phru gu rnams kha 'thor mi dgos par sa gnas 'os pa zhig la gzhis tshugs dang slob grwa'i rogs ram yong ba'i re ba chen bo byas kyang /de dus gnas yul gyi sa gnas la 'kho ra lam med pa dang / sa mtshams yin stabs rogs ram 'thob thabs bral/ mi mang rnams rang yul bod nas khyer ba'i dngul dngos bran bu yod ba nyin re bzhin rdzogs bzhin pa dang 'tsho ba'i yong khyangs gzhan gang yang med rkyen gnas stangs de mur khungs 'khyol thub thabs med stabs/ mgo mang rnams tshogs 'du tshogs te rogs ram tshogs pas lta skyong thub pa'i sa cha zhig la gzhis chags phugs 'pher zub thabs su bal yul rgyal sa ka tā man skyur 'gro rgyu'i gros 'chams kyis phyi lo 1743zla dang po'i nang ngag dbang dpal ldan lags sogs 'go byed kha shas dang dge rgan gnyis bcas skabs de'i bal yul bod gzhung don gcod 257

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/sku ngo rtse mgron ye shes lhun grub mchog gi mdun du bcar nas gnas lugs zhib phra snyan seng zhus/ slob thug dang pha ma gzhan rnams kyang snga ning gis ka kṣa man ḍūr rim bzhin 'byor/ sku ngo ye shes lhun 'grub mchog dang ngag dbang dpal ldan lags/ rnam rgyal rdo rje lags skusnags gnya' nang gi 'go byed gtso drag kha shas dang dge rgan gnyis bcas/ san dze zhir slo ba grwar pha dar yo ran sku mdun du bcar nas/ da phan pha dar mchog nas rogs ram gnang ba bka' drin zhin tu che/ da cha dpa' bo dbo na par pha ma dang phru gu'i 'tsho ba khungs 'khyol thabs mi 'dug pas sa cha legs pa zhig tu gzhis chags thub pa'i blosags ram skyabs 'jug sku1nga ba zhus/ skabs der pha dar yo ran ni bal yul nang bod mi skyabs bcol bar rogs ram gyi ched du (sa/༷971brdung ba (1007116༷ masakhung63thang ṣā 116900ba171 khukhu) zhetha/ pa'i dmig bsal tshogs chung gi gtso 'dzin yin pa ltar/ khong gis phyag bris gcig bskur nas snye ra wa (2111 te ) zhes par 'a〈sna darshasnas gsungs/pha dar mchog gis rgya gar ba the skyel mosna kra'i las khungs nas krag 'khor 'ga' shas glas nas sa kra 'a〈sna sa skusnad mtshams nyin gcig gi sar bskyal/de nas rkang bgrod kyis phal cher bdun drag gcig lhag tsam la snye ra war 'byor/ der slo dang sgog ra'i khyal nas bod mi phon che zhig 'byor yod pa rgya gar du 'gro mkhan red 'dug kyang phyi lo 1 can lo'i rgya dkar nag gi 258

rgya gar du 'byor ba dang /drag po'i slob sbyong /ku lu lam bakhra'i gnya' nang brgya sgogaskor/dmag 'khrug rjes su bal yul sa mtshams nas rgya gar nang bod mi sku nga rgyur bkag 'gog gi khrims gzhi lag bstar gyis 'a〈sna ma thub bar lus 'dug /der skyob gso'i las khungs zhig yod 'dug pa'i 'go byed la pha dar mo ran gyi phyag bris de phul nas gzhis chags kyi rogs ram dgos tshul zhus par ngos len gnang mi 'dug par brten/ thog ma'i dmigs yul gzhis chags yin yang 'char gzhi 'gyur nas da cha bod mi sbyi mtshungs rgya gar du 'gro dgos chags/ skyob gso'i las khungs de nas bod ba tshang mar bza' bca'i rogs ram gnang 'dug /phyogs derayun ring tsam lus/ sa mtshams gzhan zhig nas bsgor te gsang stabs kyis dha ram sa lar bang chen btang nas snyan zhu phul bar bod gzhung nang srid las khungs nas ldi li 7sku tshab don gcod brgyud rgya gar gzhung la bka' yol gnang bar gsan bzhes bka' drin chen pos bsu len dang ri li'i 'grim 'grul gyi gra sgrig rgya gar gzhung gis gnang nas pa ṭan ko ṭi bar du bskyal/ der bod gzhung gi sne len las byed btsugs yod pa ltar khong tshos bod mi gon pa rnams lam bzo dang / phru gu rnams dang ra zur gsog slob grwar btang / zur gsog slob grwa nas rim bzhin ḍal la ho'o si dang / pan cha ma ri/ ma su ri bcas par bod mi btsan byol ba'i slob grwar btang ba bcas so//259

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/2)drag po'i slob sbyong /gong du ji ltar 'khod pa bzhin gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi bu phrug mang dag cig slob grwar btsud bzhes gnang yang / kun gling rtse'i ngag dbang phun tshogs dang /khral rnying dkon mchog rang grol/ko gnas nor bu rgya mtsho/jo jo ngag dbang rdo rje/ thugs rje lha khang blo bzang rdo rje/ slo la'i bsod nams phun tshogs/ sgrom dkar ngag dbang chos 'byor/ rdzong dga' bkris rnam rgyal sku gas bod yig shes tshad gang legs 1snag dbyin yig kyang phran bu shes pa'i na gzhon mang bo slob lo brgal te gnas skabs tsher ḍūn dmag sgar du 'gro dgos byung sku1da cing / dmag sgar de'i ming ni dmigs bsal sa mtshams kyi dbyang sde 'am/ (59khukhu ma stu10ba 1khu baX khung) yang na dmag gi ang rtags 22yin pa ltar btsan byol bod mi'i spyi tshogs nang cawan ṭi kru (22) zhes 'bod kyin yod/bo nga bzhin a yi ṭi snyi mi /bzuX 11637 207837 2011khung (1 1 2 2) zhes pa'i dmag mi'i sgrig 'dzugs gzhan pa zhig kyang gsar 'dzugs gnang sku da pa ltar/ dmag sgar de gnyis kyi nang skyabs bcol snga da mi na gzhon chig khri lhag tsam gsar bcug gnang ba'i khongs su gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi na gzhon mang po snga rjes sgrogs zhugs byas te/ dmag 'thab kyi sbyong brdar dang / dbyin hin skad yig sogs slob sbyong go skabs gang legs thob pa'i 260

rgya gar du 'byor ba dang /drag po'i slob sbyong /ku lu lam bakhro'i gnya' nang brgya thog skor/thog phogs thob kyi mthun rkyenabazang po byung bar brten skabs der nang mi dang pha ma spunamached rnams la 'tsho gos kyi rogs skyor byed thub pa'i phan rlabs chen po byung ba dang / rjes su'ang dmag sgar 'grim pa'i bod mi na gzhon mang che bas lung pa'i skad yig dang khrims lugs shes nas 'tsho gos la ha cang grung po chags thub pa byung yod/3)ku lu lam bakhro'i gnya' nang brgya sgogami caX nas 'go btsams te bod gzhung gis btsan byol du gyar ba'i bod mi stong phrag mang po'i 'tsho bo sa rgya gar gyi hi ma cal mnga' sde'i sa gnas cam pa dang / sim la/ ku lu bcas par lam bakhro'i las khongs su bkod sgrig gnang sku(da pa ltar/ 1643 'o(ra bal yul nas 'a〈snar ba'i gnya' nang pa rnams ku lu sa khul du btang ste/gnya' nang brgya sgog zer ba'i sgrog 'dzugs zhig byung ba de yi brgya dpon a khu ngag dbang dpal ldan lags dang / skad bsgyur cho sa grags lags nas gnang / bcu dathesgon gyi 〈snangs su sku gnas dngos grub rdo rje dang / lo lo bkris rdo rje/ jo jo tshe ring rdo rje/ rmo la'i dbang rgyal/ rang 'khor lhag pa bkris/'od bsam dga' rab/sku ra stod tshong dpon dbang 'dus rgyal therdzo bcas nas byas 'dugaphyi lo mi caXnas 1774bar ku lu ma na li dang /man ḍi/'jo sgo na gar/261

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/rkang ra/ cam pa/ sim la sogs kyi gzhung lam g.yas g.yon du bod mi stong phrag mang poras gur phub nas tsho khag so sor lam bzor rgyugs nas bsdad pa de dag gi gnas stangs ni ha cang skyobo yin zhing /hi ma cal gyi ri rgyud la dbyar kha zla ba gsum gyi ring char thod che bas ras gur gyis char thigs mi 'gog pa dang / dgun kha grang ngar che ba'i thog (282)bī ḍab lu ḍi zer ba'i mnga' sde gzhung gi ngal rtsol las khungs kyi lta rtog 'og las ka nyin gang byas kyang skyes bar las tshonyin rer sgor 2khoX dang / bud med la sgor 2 re 'am sa cha 'ga' shas la 2/paṇalas thob kyin med/mi mang yongs rdzogs bod nas gsar 'byor la song phyogs gcig nas skad brda mi 'phrod pa dang / gnyis nas 'phrod bsten gyi mthun rkyen dkon pas nad mnar 'chi skyon mang po byung yang / stabs legs gzhig la bod gzhung gabaka' drin la brten nas slob loson pa'i grugu yongs sdu'ogs gzhung 'ayin 11ba lha/khag la tshud pa ma zad/pha mar yang mtshams rer gos phogs dang /bza' bca'i skyob gso/sman bces kyi rogs ram bcas 1snab/ brgya darngo(na ngag dbang dpal ldan lags mi caca 'o1ra dha ram sa lar gnas rdzoganang rjes gnya' nang brgya sgog gi brgya dbon 'gan 'khyar lo lo rdo rje lags nas gnang /bcu dpon gyi 'gan 'khyar lding dpon spen pa dang /rta mgrin tshe ring /spang ring skal bzang phyan tshogs/bkris don grub/rong shar dga' phrug tshe ring /yon nor bu bcas nas byas 'dug/262

le tshan bcu bdun pa/'jo wa la khel bzo gzhis/ ti ri su li lam bzo/ sud dzar lan ḍi'i gzhis chags bcas kyi sgor/1)'a1rngo wa la khel gzhis chags/phyi lo 1 caX lor bal yul nang gi bod mi'i ched rgyal spyi'i rgya gram dmar po'i rogs ram 'og 'jo wa la khel du rum gdan bzo grwa dang / gzhis chags gsar 'dzugs gnang ba ltar/ smyug khang gi rum gdan bzo grwa'i nang mang mkhan 'brug pa dang / tshong 'dus byang pa'i sbun 'khor/ gnas dbyangs dang dngul bzo ba'i spun phrug 'khor bcas kyis gtsos pas gnya' nang yul mi mang po bal las dang / rum gdan 'thag las kyi las grwar 'dzul nas 'tsho gos dka' sel thub pa'i dge mtshan byung 'dug kyang byings gzhi mang por phyogs gcig nas las ka med pa dang / gnyis su sdod sa nges gtan med par 'jo wa la khel sbyan gzigs gling ga'i mdun thang du lha khang gi mtha' 'khor dang / gnas sgor ba'i mgron khang khag la ras kyi bcad brgyab ste 'tshang ga lhag zhig byas nas sdod pa'i khongs su bur sras pa'i spun nye shag rtsa skal bzang khyim dud dang / dga' nye chu steng pa khyim tshang gis gtsos pas 263

gnya' nang pa khyim dud mang po bcas phan tshun byas nas bsnad pa'ang dran/skabs der 'jo wa la khel gzhis khongs su yod pa'i bod mi yongs rdzogs kyi 'thung chu rgyang ring sbyan gzigs gling kha'i mdun thang nas len dgos kyin 'dug2)ti ri su li'i chu mdzod dang lam bzo/phyi lo 1 ca3 lor rgya gar gzhung gi rogs ram 'og rgyal sa ka ṣṭha man ḍū nas skyid grong gi sa mtshams bar 'khor lam gsar bzo dang / glog khang chu mdzod bcas gsar rgyag 'go btsugs 'dug pa ltar/ bal yul sku tshab don gcod khang nas rgya gar gzhung tshab khang du 'brel ba zhus te/ lam bzo dang :(ga khang gsar rgyag gi las ka btsal te mtha' mtshams mi mang rnams bal sa ti ri su li'am chum chad zer ba'i lung gzhung du bsdu rub kyis sgrig 'dzugs bzos pa'i khongs gnya' nang pa'i brgya sgog dang skyid grong ba'i brgya sgog zer ba sogs las mi'i ru khag cha bgos gnang ba ltar/ngos kyi zhang po rig 'dzin rdo rje lags sogs nas gnya' nang brgya 'og gi 'go khrid byas/las mi mang che ba gnya' nang pa dang skyid grong ba sha stag la song yul skad mi deshes pa'i dka' ngal ma byung yang / rgya gar gyi hi ma cal mnga' sde dang mi 'dra bar sta ri su li'i lung gzhung ha cang tsha ba che rkyen bod mi gon gzhon mang po 264

'jo wa la khel bzo gzhis/sta ri su li lam bzo/sud dzar lan ḍi'i gzhis chags sgor/nad mnar dus min 'chi skyon byung ba'i khongs su gnya' nang pa mang po 'das grongs su gyur te/ mu mthud sdug sgom ma thub par zla shas rjes rang gnas su phyir log bya dgos byung 'dug10ca2nas 1044bar gnya' skyid rong gsum gtso gyur bod kyi mtha' mtshams sa khyal du rgya mi zhi drag mang po btang 'byor skusnad kyang / kha tshar ba rnams wabyud la snung 'brel mu mthud byed du bcug ste/mkhar steng bstan 'phel bu spun dang / tshe brtan rgyal po bu sbun/ skal bzang 'bar smon bu sbun bcas nas 'gram du tshong las byed mgo btsugs pa dang / jo ang nor bus kyang lha sa dang gzhis rtser bskyod de tshong don lam stongs 'tsho gos sra brtan du gyur 'dug /'on kyang gnya' nang gi bal po'i khongs su lha sar tshong 'brel yod pa dngul bzo pa lags kyi bu te ji man shākya dang / kun tsa lags bcas 'ga' shas tsam las/ de byings rnams bod du dus 'gyur byung rjes gnya' nang du tshong las med par bal yul nang rang rang gi lung par sdod dgos byung ste/'tsho gos nyams gud phyin pa'i thog ye rang dang mchod rten gyi dngul bzo ba dang / sku 'dra lugs bzhengs pa rnams la'ang sngar bzhin las ka med par 'tsho gos la do phog chen bo byung 'dug /skabs der bal yul rgyal sa mnga' khul du bod dgon gsum las med pa ni/ 'phags zhing dbu rtse'i dgon pa dang /lha sa'i mu stag tshong khang zog bdag nas bzhengs pa'i mu cig dgon pa/265

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/mchod rten bya rung kha sgor du sog po bla mas gsar bzhengs dga' ldan chos 'phel gling bcas yin zhing / bya rung kha sgor gyi mtha' 'khor yongs rdzogs yul mi'i sa zhing yin pa dang / rgyal sa dang mchod rten gyi dbar la'ang sa lhag rdo lhag gi mchod rten dang gu lang dbang phyug chen po'i lha khang gi nye 'khor grong tsho chung chung gnyis ma gtogs de min sa zhing dang / smyug ma'i zhing sdong gis khengs nas bsdad 'dug3)sud dzor lan ḍi'i gzhis chags/phyi lo mi ca3 lor sud si rgya gram dmar po'i tshogs pa nas bod mi gang 'tshams su dzar len ḍir gzhis chags su len rgyu'i ched 'jo wa la khel ba1sto gzhis mi mang la gsal bsgrags byas kyang / ming 1sna 'bul mkhan ma byung stabs rogs tshogs nas skabs de'i bal yul don gcod rtse mgron ye shes lhun grub lags su 'brel ba zhus te/ su dzor lan ḍi lung pa yar thon skyid po yin ba dang / 'tsho gos kyi dka' ngal med pa sogs 'grel bshad yong ba'i re 'dun zhus par de don gnang yang / phyi gling gi lung par chos med pa dang / 'byung 'gyur rgya gar bal yul dang /bod du phyir log thub rgyu ma red ces bshad nas ming tho 'bul mkhan ma byung stabs sud si'i sku tshab nas/sngon du don gcod khyed rang gi spun mched nang mi 'ga' shas kyis tho brgyab na 266
