'jo wa la khel bzo gzhis/sta ri su li lam bzo/sud dzar lan ḍi'i gzhis chags sgor/gzhan pa tshos mig dbe yar lta byas te/ 'gro 'dod byed rgyu red ces u tshugs byas kyang don gcod kyi sku mched nang 'khor nas kyang 'gro 'dod yod mkhan byung mi 'dug/can kyang sud si'i sku tshab nas mu mthud go bskon 'bod skul byas mthar ming tho 'bul mkhan 'ga' shas byung ba'i khongs su gnya' nang pa gnas dbyangs padma rdo rje nang mi dang /rnyed pa pa sangs pha bu/blo bzang bkris nang mi bcas kyi thog bur sras pa ngag dbang blo bzang lags nas rang nyid dang / bza' zla tshul khrims sgrol ma/ gcung po dkar chung lags bcas kyi ming tho phul nas gnya' nang pa tsho khag gcig 1644 lor sud dzar lan ḍi'i gzhis khongs su thon yod/sud dzar lan ḍir 'byor ba'i bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho gos mdun lam mi smon rang skyid byung bar brten 10caca nas 'go brtsams te btsan byol bod mi'i khongs nas tshud thabs byed mkhan mang po byung sku da/ rgya gram dmar po nas skabs zhig sngon 'byor bod mi'i nang mi dang spun mched zla bsgril gang thub byas pa'i khongs su nga tsho pha bu rnams kyang gcen po ngag dbang blo bzang gis ming tho phul te sgug tho gsum pa'i nang tshud kyang phyi lo 107༷ tham pa'i lor sud mi'i gzhis chags kyi ming the'i khongs su ma su ri sogs nas bod mi 'byor ldan dang yar thon pa sha stag tshud pa rgya gram dmar pos shes tshor gyis bkag ste/ khong snu'i mnyam du nyam chung mang por zhor dungs thebs pa 267

nas bzung sud si rgya gram dmar po dang bod gzhung gnyis pos kyis mi 'gro rnams ku lu lam bakhro'i khongs nas 'dems sgrug gnang rgyur gtan 'bebs byung ste/ 'tsho gos kyi dka' ngal yod pa mang po blangs pa'i khongs su gnya' nang sbang ring skal bzang phun tshogs nang mi dang / ko gnas nang mi/ phyogs gsham rgyal po nang mi bcas snga rjes rim 'dzor tshud 'dug 1043 lor bu tshab tu 'byor ba rnams rtsis pas da lta'i char sud si'i gzhis khongs su gnya' nang ba mi grangs brgya lhag tsam sku1da pa bcas sku //

le tshan bathersha brgyad pa/mi smon rang skyid kyi 'tsho ba dang /phyi nang shes yon/gzhung dmangs kyi sri zhu bcas kyi skor/1)mi smon rang skyid kyi 'tsho ba/ku lu'i nang lam bzor bsnad pa'i gnya' nang yul mi'i khongs nas 'ga' shas dha ram sa la dang / sim la/ 37 ri sa gzhis chags/ mosnan sgo gzhis chags bcas su snga rjes rim 'dzar gnas 〈sna byas 'gros mang che bas 1077 bar mu mthud ku lu khul du bsdad/ mthar bod gzhung gi bkod sgrig gzhir bzung rshasna li snyal woston ldan gli gzhis chags su gnas 〈sna byas/ gzhis chags de'i sgrig khongs su gnya' nang pa khyim dud bzhi bcu tsam yod pa de dag gi 'tsho bosnas gnas stangs gang legs 'tshed pa ma zad/ dha ram sa la dang /rdor gling /khel hor/tse( ri sa/yon sgo sogs rgya gar gyi sa khyal gzhan khag tu yod pa rnams kyang zhing las dang / o su'i stod gyon su ṭar nyo tshong /za khang dang tshong khang 'dzin skyong sogs 'tsho thabs sna tshogs kyi slo nas gnas stangs ha cang yag rngo( chags sku(da/ mang che bas bal yul rgyal sa ka 3 man ḍū'i lung gasgongs nang gtan sdod byas par lo shas ring 'tsho gos

gnya' nang snung 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gnas mal gang cir dka' ngal byung yang / thabs shes skusnad rgu byas 'bras rum 'thag gtso gyur bzo grwa'i bdag po dang / phyir tshong ma rtsa'i bdag po/mgron khang dang tshong khang / yul mi'i slob grwa dang sman khang sogs kyi khang bdag /yo ṭa sogs phyi dngos nang 'dren tshong tshogs kyi bdag bo/dngul khang gi ma rtsa'i bdag po/ bzo bkod phul du byung ba'i sdod khang che legs dang rin gong che ba'i mo ṭa sogs ma rtsa'i bdag por gyur pa mang po skusgod pa ma zad/ nye ba'i char gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi na gzhon mang po snga rjes rim 'dzor a rir 'byor nas phyi lo 2ཿ bar gtan sdod lags khyer thob zin pa mi grangs 47༷ lhag tsam yod pa'i thog 3༷༷ tsam gyis khe na ḍar skyabs bcol zhus te/ khyon mi grangs /༷༷ lhag tsam byang a me ri ku'i nang gzhis chags byed bzhin pa de dag dang sud dzar lan ḍi sogs 〈sna rab tu skusnad pa mi grangs 13༷ tsam bcas kyi 'tsho gos dang / bu phrug gi shes 〈snan mdun lam ni 'od stong ldan par ngos 'dzin byed chog pa zhig red/2)phyi nang shes yon dang /gzhung dmangs kyi sri zhu/rgya gar dang /bal yul/sud dzar lan ḍi/dbyin yul/pha ren si/si ben/ho lenaḍi/ nyi hong / khe na ḍa/ a ri bcas par gtan gzhi byas pa de lnga'i gnya' nang yul mi'i bu phrug mtho rim slob grwa thon pa 470 tsam yod pa'i khongs 270

mi smon rang skyid kyi 'tsho ba dang /phyi nang shes yon/gzhung dmangs kyi sri zhu bcas kyi sgor/su hin di dang /༷na ji/nee pa li/sud si/ jar man/phe ren chi/si ben ni zhi/nyi hong bcas rgyal khab gzhan gyi skad yig dang las rigs sna tshogs shes pa mang bo dang / dge bshes rgyugs thon dam bca' bzhag zin pa dang bla sbrul bsdoms bcu grangs/gzhung zhabs las 'khur zhus dang zhu bzhin pa mang po'i khongs su khrims dbon dang / rang dbang sde tshan gyi dbu 'dzin/ tshogs drung /phyi rgyal sku tshab don gcod/lhan khang gi drung che/7gong sa mchog gi chogi zhabs dang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi mchod dpon/ blos gar dbu 'dzin/ bzo gzhis dbya 'dzin/slob grwa'i dbya 'dzin dang dge gon/mnyam sbrel 'gan 'dzin/drung yig dang rtsis pa/pha tshab ma tshab/gzhis chags kyi sbyi mi/sa gnas gros tshogs kyi 'thus mi dang rang bden tshogs 'thus/ gzhon nu dang bud med lhan tshogs kyi 'gan 'dzin tshogs mi/su dzor lan ḍi dang /a ri/khe na ḍa sogs su sa gnas bod mi'i sbyi tshogs kyi 'gan 'dzin tshogs mi/ gzhan yang dgon pa'i mkhan po/lo tsā ba/gso rig em rje dang phyi sman 'og ṭar/sman las nar si/rlung 'phrin rgyang bsrings las byed/ dmag dpon/ khrims rtsod pa/ 'grim 'grul las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin/ phyi rgyal dngul khang dang tshong tshogs sna tshogs kyi 'gan 'dzin las byed/ mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs kyi las byed/'phrul las 'char 'god pa/bzo skrun las byed/nam mi'u ṭar sogs kyi ched las pa/gzhan yang phyi nang lag shes mkhas pa gnad yod mang bo byung yod/271

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/phyi lo 1'tshotham pa'i lor rgya nag gzhung nas mi grangs zhib bsher byas pa'i rtsa 'dzin yig cha'i nang / da lta'i gnya' nang rdzong khyon yongs la mtho rim slob grwa thon pa pho 1༷dang /mo 2bsdoms 12yod ces bshad pa'i grangs 'bor la gzhigs na btsan byol du yod pa'i de lnga'i gnya' nang yul mi kher rkyang gi khongs su mtho slob thon ba 4ཿ lhag tsam yod pa de ni ngo mtshar skye 'os pa zhig red/ gal te dgu mtsho dang /phu ri/nas lung /zur mtsho/sgo rong /sman khab stod smad sogs phyis su gnya' nang rdzong khongs su bcug pa'i mi 'bor cha tshang rtsis na/ da lta'i char btsan byol du yod pa'i gnya' nang yul mi'i bu rgyag gi khongs su mtho slob thon pa'i grangs 'bor 47༷ lhag tsam dang dam bca' bzhag zin pa'i bla sgrul dge bshes 2༷tsam yod nges red/sngar yul mi gang zhig yar lam ma1snang la dang / mar lam rta le ma'i zam pa brgal nas yul phyogs gzhan du phyin na/ dmigs bsal rnam dpyod gsal ston thub tshul gnya' nang pa'i rgan rabs kyi gsung rgyun du skusnad pa de ni da cha bden par ngos 'dzin byed chog pa zhig red/ skad yig dang yul srol homs gzhis tha dad can gyi phyi rgyal yul khag nang skyabs bcol du gyar dbo sa byung yang / 'dzom gling skyabs bcasnal ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba gnas stangs yar thon phun sum tshogs pa 'di 'dra chags thub pa 7spong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i bka' drin nyag cig yin par brten tshang mas bkrin 272
sku smon rang skyid kyi 'tsho ba dang /phyi nang shes yon/gzhung dmangs kyi sri zhu ba kyis 'di phyi'i blang dor bka' slob snying bcangs kyis rnga mnyam 'degs zhu bzhin pa bcas 31//

le tshan bcu dgu pa/byes 'khod gnya' nang skyid sdug gi sgor/1)gnya' nang skyid sdugabal yul nang gtan gzhi byas pa'i gnya' nang pa rnams kyis 1744 tsam nas mgo brtsams te lo ltar bod zla 7tshes 17'dzam gling sbyi bsangs nyin sngar srol ra hu lha gsol mtshon dod mchod rten rnam gsum dang /rkaṭa thim bhu/la lhan khel chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi mchod rten/de bzhin glang ri lung bstan dang yang le thod gang rung du lo 'khor res mos kyis kha dog lnga ldan dar phreng sgrengs 'dzugs zhu ba dang chabs cig mi mang 'du 'dzoms kyis lha gsol gzab rgyas zhus rjes/ 'jo wa la khel sbyan gzigs gling rka'i mdun du nyin gung gsol ston bshams nas spro skyid gtong ba'i lam lugs zhig byung bar rgan gcasnan tshang mas dga' mo sa chen snga byas par brten 107༷ tham pa nas sgrog 'dzugs zhig tu gyur/lo shas ring gnyer pa res mos kyis 'gan 'khur byas pa dang / rjes su gnyer pa mi bcu 'khor res yod mus thog lo gnyis re'i mtshams tshogs gtso gon gzhon gnyis re mang tshogs nas 'dems bsgo byas te/mgo mang thun mong nas 7gong sa mchog gi 7sku phyu'i zhabs rim 274

byes 'khod gnya' nang skyid sdug gi sgor/la dmigs nas lo ltar bka' 'gyur dag tshar re dang /skabs babs sbyi rim zhu sgo 'thus tshang thog /bod mi'i tshogs skyid gzhan dang dpyang pa mnyam gzhib kyis chos srid las don gang sar phyar gru mnyam 'degs dang / skyid sdug mi mang gi khongs su nad mnar 'chi skyon dka' ngal byung rigs la rogs phan lta rtog gang yong byed bzhin yod/a ri'i gnya' nang skyid sdug /bod mi sbyi mtshungs gnya' nang pa na gzhon mang po a rir rim 'byor gtan sdod byed mkhan lo re bzhin 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin par brten/ phan tshun gcig phan gcig grogs skyid sdug mnyam myong thog 7sku tshab don gcod khang dang sa gnas bod rigs sbyi mthun tshogs pa'i dbu 'og bod sbyi'i las don gang sar phyar gru mnyam 'degs zhu rgyu dang /bal yul gnya' nang skyid sdug gis gtsos pas yul mi gon rabs rnams la 'brel ba zhus te/ rang gi thun sang ma yin pa'i goms srol spyi dang lhag par gnya' nang 〈snad smad bar gsum gyi yul gzhas khag gon ngag gzhon 'jags yun gnas thub pa'i dmigs yul bzang po bzung ste/ gzhung pa bkris tshe ring dang /lo lo ngag dbang mgon po/bur sras pa bstan 'dzin chos sgron/ gnas dbyangs bkra zhis sgrol ma/ dar gling phun tshogs rgyal mtshan/ chu 'thag pa nor bu bzang po/ bur sras pa bstan 'dzin bde skyid/ 'gram pa bkra zhis gan ci shar pa bcas na gzhon brgyad nas dang blangs kyis phyi lo 2༷༷ 275

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/zla 1༷ tshes palta nyin gnya' nang stod sman bar gsum gyi yul mi nyis brgya lhag tsam grong khyer khya yin si'i 'a56༷bcanang el sar ku 'o 216170510zhes pa'i tshogs khang du mgron 'bod kyis spro skyid go sgrog gra rten legs sgrigs byung ba dang chabs cig mang tshogs la rgo bsdur spyi mos byung ba bzhin a ri'i gnya' nang skyid sdug ces pa zhig gsar du tshugs thub pa dang / gong gsal mi brgyad nas 'otho gcig gi ring rgyun las thengs dang po'i las khur zhu rgyu gtan 'khel byung bar bkra zhis bde legs zhu rgyu nas gzengs su thon pa'i las ceten sne mang gi kho ngas nas gal gnad che ba gsum tsam 'di mnyam 'bri bska(da bgyis pa gsham gsal/2)rig gzhung gces 'dzin/le tshan brgyad pa'i nang ji ltar 'khod pa bzhin lo ngo brgya phrag 'ga' shas nang dar ba'i gnya' nang pa'i glu gzhas ni thun yong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig yin pa ltar/ de dag rtsa brlag tu mi 'gro ba'i ched bod gzhung zlos gar tshogs pa'i nyams zhib 'gan 'dzin rta bsam sbyin pa dngos grub dang /zlos dge tshe rdo rje lags ched mngags bal yul du bsus te/ na man ḍū'i lung ga〈snangs nang gnas 1snad gnya' nang yul gyi gzhas pa gzhas ma gos 'khogs rnams dang / rol cha ba/ de bzhin skyid sdug gi 'brel yod mi sna 276

byes 'khod gnya' nang skyid sdug gi sgor/bcas nas 'gan 'khur rkang len gyis gzhas dang zhabs dre sna grangs 37tsam nang sbyong byas te/ sgra 'jug 'khor lo gsar 'don zhus pa ma zad/ rgan ngag gzhon 'jags mi nyams gong 'phel sku nga rgyur dmigs te/ gzhas tshig rnams yig thog tu phab nas 'gro gron rang khongs mi snas zhal 'debs ga /nga ste/ bod gzhung zlos gar tshogs pa nas gnya' nang pa'i yul gzhas phyogs bsdebs/ zer pa'i deb chung gsar 'don rogs ram gnang ba ma zad/'khrab gzhas le'u gnyis tsam blos gar tshogs pa'i gzhas sna'i khongs su bcug ste bod mi'i gzhis sgar khag la 'khrab ston byas rkyen da cha bod mi'i sbyi tshogs nang dar khyab 'gro bzhin pa dper na/ 244 dang / 2༷༷7/ 2༷༷ so sor rgya gar nang gzhis chags khag cig dang / su dzar lan ḍi/ a ri'i grong khyer ni'u yog dang /sen pha ren si si ko/me ḍi san/ boṭa lenanyi/sgo si nyon bcas pa'i sa gnas bod mi sbyi mthun tshogs pa'i bod yig slob phrug dang /chol gsum zlos gar tshogs pa sogs nas do snang chen pos sbyangs te lo gsar dang 'khrungs skar dus chen gyi mdzad sgo'i skabs 'khrab ston byed thub pa'i dge mtshan byung yod/pha mes kyi rig gzhung bzang po nyams pa slar gso'i ched skyid sdug nas 'gro gron nar gtong gis rang khongs gzhon skyes rnams la gzhas dang zhabs gro gang mang bslabs te/ shes mkhan dang do snang byed mkhan je mang du 'gro 277

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/mus yin pa ma zad/ 43 man skyur lo ltar 7gong sa mchog gi 'khrungs skar dus chen nyin tshogs skyid gzhan gyi rig gzhung 'khrab ston ru khag gi mnyam du yul gzhas gzigs 'bul zhu mus thog2༷༷7lor stod pa'i skyid sdug sbyi mgrin nas yongs 'dzin gling sbrul rin po cher brtan bzhugs phul ba'i dga' ston gyi skabs su'ang gnya' nang yul gzhas dha ram sa lar gzigs 'bul gra rten legs sgrig byung yod/3)'char 'phar rten bzhengs/bod ljongs mtha' dbus kun tu rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa dang / 'gro kun bde ba/ bye brag bod mi'i bden don myur du 'grub pa dang dad ldan skye bo kun gyi las sgrib byang zhing / tshogs dang bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing mchog 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon sbyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog gi dbus ris med skyes chen dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams kyi sku'i gsang gsum la gegs dang bar chad kyi dri mas ma be|sa par zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing / mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag bde blag tu 'grub phyir byes 'khod gnya' nang mi mang sbyi mgrin nas ma skul dang ba'i sgo nas 'phags shing rang byung mchod rten chen po'i nub ngos ri 'dabs gling skor du bde gshegs mchod rten 278

byes 'khod gnya' nang skyid sdug gi sgor/rnam brgyad dang / bka' gdams mchod rten bcas kyi mtho tshad phi ṭi 27 re dang / rnam rgyal mchod rten zhabs ri rgya khyon phi ṭi 37 can/ 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i gzungs sngags yig drug ma'i lag 'khor 231 dang ma ṇi'i kun dga' ra ba'i nang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku brnyan bris ma zhal grangs 231 ba〈snar lam dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs legs grub zin par rang khongs mi mang gtso gyur dad ldan gtong phod can gyi sbyin bdag rnams kyis dngul dngos zhal 'debs byung ba sgor 3272༷༷༷/ dang skyid sdug gi kha bsnon sgor 12jiX/ bsdoms bal sgor 34ཿ༷༷༷/ 'bum sum cu so bzhi mig sman mig thog tu mjug gtsang gnad smin zhus pa'i skor zhib phra mkhyen 'dod yod rigs nas bod nee dbyin gsum gyi yi ger 'khod pa'i smon byang rdo lhab ma ṇi'i kun dga' rwa ba'i gyang ldebs su sbyar nas yod par thugs zhib nges gnang zhu/gong bzhin phyi lo 1670lor gnya' nang 'phel rgyas gling gi dge 'dun pa rnams thog mar btsan byol du phebs skabs rten dngos rtsa chen rnams dge 'dun bgres pa rnams kyis rgyab tu 'khur nas gdan 'dren zhus te/ 'dus mang rnams sa mtshams 〈snang gseb rim brgyud bal yul 'phags pa zhing kun du phebs nas dbo na pa phyag btab mdzad pa'i skabs gnya' nang skyid sdug gis mthun 'gyur gang yong zhus/ mi mang nas zhal 'debs 'bor chen 279

phul ba dang chabs cig ar las dang blang zhus pa ma zad/ rten gtso thub dbang dang /spyan ras gzigs phyag stong sbyan stong /gu ru snang srid zil gnon/jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bcas pa'i snang brnyan che khag kyang dge slong blo bzang dpal ldan dang /tshong 'dus byang ba/mkhar steng bstan 'phel/bur sras pa ngag dbang slo bzang bcas nas dad sbyin zhus pa sogs tshang mas rkang 'gro lag 'don mnyam rub zhus yod/phyogs mtshungs bod du gu yangs phran bu byung ba'i gnas stangs dang bsdun nas skyid sdug gi tshogs mi jo dar rgyas dang / bkra shes dung drug /chu 'thag 'phrin las/chu 'thag blo bzang / chu steng bkris/rdo legs dbang rgyal/stong padma bcas nas rang khongs mi mang la dge skul zhus te/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che na bza' glegs zhing rang bsgrigs dang / mchod chas rol yo/sbub/dung /rgya gling /ting /mchod kong /maṇḍal/chu zangs sogs bal yul nas 'or 'dren gyis tshong 'dus grong khyer nang gzhis lus mi mang la rtsis 'bul zhu thub pa byung yod/4)brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul/ bod bstan srid mi rigs dang bcas pa'i 'bral phugs bde rtsa ni 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i 7sku phywa mdzad 'phrin kho nar rag lus yod bas 280

gang gi bka' drin cha shas tsam gzhal thub pa'i smon 'dun dang / phyin chad kyang tshe rabs rjes 'dzin yong ba'i gsol 'debs zhu slad byes 'gyor gnya' nang mi mang ngo yod rnams nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mdon chen por brtan bzhugs 7zhabs brtan zhig bstar 'bul zhu rgyur 〈snas mthun gyis 7snyan seng zhus par bka' bzhes byung ste/1670zla 3tshes 1/bod rgyal lo 212cabod zla 2tshes 1gza' skar 'byung 'grod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin bzhugs sgar dha ram sa la'i theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang gi rten mchog sbyan sngar mchod sbyin sna lnga stong tshar 'bul bshams thog /rnam grwa dge 'dun 'dus mang nas nyin 7 ring tshe dpag med 'chi med lha lnga'i sgo nas sku yi tshe sgrub gnad smin sngon du btang ste mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog dang 'grel ba'i brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan gsol ba 'debs pa'i dbu bzhugs su rnam rgyal grwa tshang mkhan po bya do rin po che mchog nas maṇḍal bshad 'bul zhib cha snyan sgon mdzod de brtan bzhugs gzab rgyas bstar 'bul zhus/skabs der bal yul dang /ko li lhal gzhis kem/ dha ram sa la/ ston sgo/ ḍal hor skusnags sa gnas skusna skusna nas gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gyi mi mang ngo bcar ci yod la pho brang du dmigs bsal dgyes brtse'i mjal kha dang bka' sle ba stsal ba bcas tshang ma skal bzang dga' bde'i dpal la longs spyod byed rgyu'i go skabs byung ba ni dus dang rnam pa 281

'a la 4 ri //rtse dzo rna ne ri ne ri ne ri la tshotsho mikun tu dga' sgam byad ga pa zhag yan zhang /brtan bzhugs kya rgyu gran sbya dang / lhag par sku gsung thugs rten dang dngul chas bslu yon zhus rin/dngul rkyang gi 'bul ba/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang sogs nas 7sku yi tshe sgrub gnad smin zhus pa'i phyag gron/ bla sprul dge 'dun tshogs yongs la sku 'gyed/gzhan yang lam gron dang bdal gla sogs 'gro gron khyon bsdoms sgor 2167712/jiX'abum nyer gcig dang brgyad khri lnga stong bdun brgya bcu gnyis dang bad brgyad cu song ba'i dmigs rten du bal yul dang /rda sa/ko li ghal/yon sgo/sud si/byang a ri sogs nas rang khongs mi mang gis zhal 'debs sgor 1caX7021/༷༷byung thog skyid sdug gi ma rtsa nas sgor 770701/jiXbasnan te las don thog mtha' bar gsum 'byor dngos rjes gtsang gra rten legs sgrig byung yod/brtan bzhugs kyi skyabs the'i ngo bshus cha tshang zhig gnya' nang mi mang gi dran rten ched 'di mnyam bkod pa ga ma gsal/bco〉༅//rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang gsum yon tan gyi rgya mtsho gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs/lhar bcas srid zhi'i rnam 'dren/'jig rten zhi ba'i ded dpon chen po/bsil ldan gangs ri'i 282stongs kyi mgon po dam pa/srid pa khams gsum gyi zag pa bag chags dang

byes 'khod gnya' nang skyid sdug gi sgor/bcas pa rtsad nas 'joms pa la mnga' dbang bsgyur zhing /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis mchod 'os 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi 7zhabs pad phan bde'i 'dod rgu yid bzhin 'jo ba'i khri 'phang ma' mas drung du/sgo gsum gus 'bangs byes 'byor gnas 'khod gnya' nang mi mang thun mong nas rab gus dang ba chen pos gnas lnga sa la btud de lha phyag grangs myed dang bcas gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa'i snying po/ yongs rdzogs thub bstan chos kyi srid la bka' yi 'khor los 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po/ mkhas grub bye ba'i zur phud/ rlabs chen 'phrin las nyin byed bye ba'i 'od kyis nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon kun 'gengs par mdzad pa'i skyabs mgon zugs rje'i gter chen gang nyid ni/ gzhal du mi spyod pa'i bskal pa du ma'i sngon rol nas khams gsum du gtogs pa'i 'gro ba nyam thag rnams kyi ngang tshul la shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po dang / lhag bsam gyis drangs pa'i smon pa sems bskyed kyis bla na med pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub las slar ldog pa med pa'i go cha bgos shing / rdzogs byang de yang bden bzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i blo goms pa las 'byung bar gzigs nas bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du rlabs chen rgyal sras kyi spyod pa sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gi tshul la go sgrub 'jug sgrub sogs sgrub pa bzhi'i nyams len 283

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/las mi 'da' bar bslabs cing / mthar spang rtogs khyad par gsum ldan gyi bde bshegs 'od zer kun 'phags dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal por mngon sangs rgyas zin na'ang /ji skad du/mdo sde phal po che las//byang chub rgya mtsho rab brnyes gyur nas kyang / /sems can rgya mtsho rab tu smin bya'i phyir/ byang chub sems bskyed rgya mtsho ston mdzad cing / /mi 'grib spyod pa rgya mtsho dus kun ston/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi rnam 'phrul de 'dra 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mu mtha' med pa'i sems can rnams kyi khams dang skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du nam mkhas gar khyab tu bkod pa mtha' yas pa chu zla dang gzugs brnyan bzhin du ston par mdzad pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas rnams ni/ji skad du/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis mkhyen/ /sa gzhi yi ni lci ba'i tshad/ /mtha' yas nyid kyis shes par 'gyur//zhes pa ltar gzhan gyis brjod mi zhus/rgyal khab 'dra min gyi gros tshogs dang / mgo 'khrid che phra du mas bod don rgyab skyor gyi gros chod dang / gang gi dgongs pa'i lam ston dag la bsngags brjod gus bkur gyi sgra dbyangs rnam par bsgrags/mgon bo zugs rje can gang nyid nas snyigs lnga'i dus 'dir phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mdzad 'phrin thams cad bdag gir bzhes te bdag cag bod 'bangs tsam du ma zad rigs dang phyogs su ma phye ba'i 'dzom gling sa chen po 284

byes 'khod gnya' nang skyid sdug rdziltasgor/'dir 'khod pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs thams cad la phan pa dang zhi bder 'god pa'i mdzad tshul lhag bsam rnam dasad ldan pa'i skye bo dag gis tshul bzhin rtogs nas 'dzam gling nang snyan grags can gyi no wel zhi bde'i gzengs rtags kyis mtshon che rgyu du mas zhi bde'i ded dpon chen por mang bkur gyi mnga' gsol dang gsol bzhin pa ni drang bden dang / 'dzom gling zhi bde thob pa'i rgyal kha rlabs che'i bkrin sbyi dang / bye brag nyam thag gzhung dmangs gzhis byes kun gyi ring nas snying du brnag pa'i 'dod don bod ljongs rang dbang gi bden mtha' gsal min dang / bstan 'gro sbyi dang lhag par bod 'bangs rnams kyi 'phral yun bde sdug cir 'gyur skyabs mgon chen po gang gi sku tshe mdzad 'phrin kho nar rag lus par brten thugs rje'i bdag nyid 7bo|nga sa 7skyabs mabo|na chen the ma31ga sku tshe zhabs pad bskal ba rgya mtshor brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba'i slad da lam bod rgyal lo 212cazla 2tshes migaza' skar 'byung 'phrod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin bzhugs sgar dha ram sa la'i theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang gi rten mchog sbyan sngar mchod sbyin sna lnga stong tshar 'bul bsgoms thog rnam grwa dge 'dun 'dus mang nas nyin 7 ring tshe dpag med 'chi med lha lnga'i sgo nas sku yi tshe sgrub gnad smin sngon du btang ste mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan gaskusnal ba 'debs pa'i dbu bzhugs su rnam grwa mkhan rin po 285

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/che mchog nas maṇḍal bshad 'bul zhib cha snyan sgron mdzod de rab dkar lha gos kyis btegs pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pas sne drangs sku'i rten du tshe lha rnam gsum gser zangs las bskrun pa sku tshad in ji bcu gnyis can na bza' rang 'grigs/ rje rin bo che yab sras gsum gyi sku brnyan gser zangs las bskrun pa in ji bcu gnyis can na bza' rang 'grigs gcigarje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gser zangs las bskrun pa in ji bcu gnyis can na bza' rang 'grigs gcig /ston pa thugs rje can gyi snang brnyan gser zangs las bsgrun pa in ji drug can na bza' rang 'grigs gcig /spyan ras gzigs kyi snang brnyan gser zangs las bskrun pa zhin ji drug can na bza' rang 'grigs gcig /rje btsun sgrol ma'i snang brnyan gser zangs las bskrun pa na bza' rang 'grigs gcig /rje btsun sgrol dkar gyi snang brnyan gser zangs las bskrun pa na bza' rang 'grigs in ji bcu gnyis gcig /tshe dpag med kyi snang brnyan gser zangs las bskrun pa na bza' rang 'grigs in ji bcu dgu can gcig /sbyan ras gzigs kyi snang brnyan in ji 17 can gcig /sgrol dkar gyi sku brnyan in ji 14 can gcig /gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi sku brnyan zhin ji / can gcig /ston pa'i sku brnyan gcig /gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi zhal thang gcig /dpal ldan lha mo gtso 'khor gsum ldan gyi skya brnyan zhin ji 14 can gcig /tshe dpag 286

byes 'alta da gnya' nang skyid sdug gi 〈snar/med sku gser zangs in ji mi na bza' rang 'grigs gcig /ston pa'i sku gser zangs las grub pa in ji / can gnyis/ ston pa'i sku na bza' rang 'grigs in ji cacan gcig/sbyan ras gzigs sku na bza' rang 'grigs in ji ca can gcig /rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku na bza' rang 'grigs in ji cacan gcig/tshe dpag med sku na bza' rang 'grigs in ji /can gcigagaser zangs sku tshe dpag med in ji / can gnyis/ zhal thang gcig /tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan in ji 12 can gcig /gsung rten tshe mdo thegs bam pod 17mdo sde bskal bzang bod 7lam rim pod gcig/yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum pod 14 rje rin po che'i gsung 'bul pod 1/ thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten gser zangs las bskrun pa g.yu byur gyi phra rgyan spel ma in ji 17 can gcig /bkra shis don grub nas sgrol dkar gyi sku zhin ji miXcan gcig bcas sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang /dngul gyi maṇḍal gser tshags 'bur 'don bkra zhis rtags brgyad can to la brgya dang nyi shu rtsa drug dang dmar ril 7༷can gcig/dngul gyi tshe bum to la 72gser tshag can gcig /dngul gyi mchod kong gser tshags 'bur thon bkra zhis rtags brgyad 〈snad pa bum bzo zhal mchod rang 'grigs skusnad pa to la brgya dang bco lnga dang dmar ril ji can gcig /dngul gyi mchod ting gser tshags 'bur thon bkris rtags brgyad yod pa to la 22༷ yod pa gcig287

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/dngul gyi bum pa gser tshags 'bur thon na bza' dang kha rgyan rang 'grigs to la so gnyis dang phyed ka yod pa gcig /dngul gyi mchod kong rnying ma to la bcu tsam yod pa gcig /dngul gyi tshe bum to la bcu yod gcig /dngul gyi tshe bum to la 27 can gcig /dngul gyi mchod kong to la 22 can gcigagaser to la byed/ dngul gyi mchod kong to la 14 can gcig /dngul gyi mchod kong to la 7/can gcig/dngul gyi mchod kong to la 37can gcigagaser gyi a 'o(nga 〈sna la gnyis dang byed ka byas pa g.yu ldan gcig/gser gyi tshig kheb to la 1 dang byed ka rdo nag khra can gcig /dngul gyi mchod kong to la 7༷ can gcig /dngul gyi mchod kong to la 73 can gcig /dngul gyi mchod kong to la 71 can gcig /dngul gyi ting bdun tshar to la 7༷ can gcig/dngul gyi mchod kong to la 44can gcig/dngul gyi mchod kong to la 27 re byas gser tshag can gnyis/ yang dngul gyi mchod kong gnyis/dngul to la 47dang sga ram ca7yod pa'i bum pa gser tshag can gcigangag dbang rnam rgyal khyim tshang nas gser rkelte la bzhi bcu zhe gcig las grub pa'i mchod kong gcig /dngul bum to la 71 dang phyed ka can gcig la gser tshag a na 14zla ba rgyal mtshan nas gser gyi mchodi rshasnang to la 2༷can gcig bcas dang / dbu pan dang sku chos sogs na bza' nyer sbyad cha tshang /rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i 'khor lo/dung dkar/bkris rtags brgyad/rgyal 288

byes 'kho da gnya' nang skyid sdug gi rgo ra/srid sna bdun/khri chas cha tshang /gos chen bra yug dngul thum sgor 7༷re skusnad pa grangs 7༷ hin sgor 717777 me tog khog ma grangs 21 sa gdan tshos gzhi ser smug mdud pa brgya can si kuyar mi ṭar ca can gcigabod kyi gro ma dang bod tshwa bcas do gcigasgos do 1'bras do 2ci ni do 3bzhes rdal do 4thing 'bras skam bo 'dra min shog sgam cagro do ming do 1mar wabyu 1bcas skusna skusnar sne 'arāsnags mjal dar gyis brgyan te skyabs snya(ga pa byes 'byor gnya' nang mi mang thun mong nas dad gus chen bo kun nas blangs te 'bul lam zhus pa lags na/ 'bul dacasas pad rtsa ltar phra rung / lhag bsam dad gus bcos min gyi kun bzang mchod sprin du dgongs nas dgyes bzhes thugs rje che ba dang / slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa ni grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i gsung las/kye ma skye 'gro'i bde skyid ni//'phel 'grib khyod la rag lus na/ /skal pa phyi mtha'i bar du yang / /tshe la dbang ba'i skur bzhengs zhigaces gsungs pa bzhin skyabs mabo na dam pa ma〈snag nyid bdag cag snyigs 'gro'i bsod dman ngan spyod la thugs skyo bsun gyi rnam pa mi bzhes par brtse chen thugs bskyed kyi go cha btsan pos ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar du zhabs zung rdo rje chos bdun gyi rang bzhin du 'tsho zhing gzhes nas skye 'gro spyi dang / yang sgos bod ljongs rang dbang gtsang ma'i bden mtha' myur du gsal te choso srid lugs zung dpal sku na la dga' bder spyod pa dang /gus 289

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/'bangs pa rnams kyi slo gsum bya ba mtha' dag 7skyabs mgon chen po gang gi lugs zung bzhed don bka' bzhin bsgrub rgyu'i dam bca' snying dbyas su bkod pa lags na de ltar yid bzhin du 'grub pas mtshon tshe rabs kun tu mgon po gang gis mnyes bzhin rjes su bzung ste rgyal thabs mngon gyur bcas kyi skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan legs 'bul gyi 'bul tho snyan zhur phyag bcas/phul//brtan bzhugs nyin 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen bo mchog pho brang nas theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du tshogs phebs bkrin che ba'i skabs gnya' nang mi mang nas phebs lam gyi g.yas gasku na du spos sne zhu ba dang chabs cig gus bsu'i glu gzhas phul ba gsham gsal//thams cad mkhyen pa mjal sku1nga bsam pa ma byung //thams cad mkhyen pa gser khri'i steng nas mjal byung //bkra la nyis pa shog /g.yang la chags pa sgog/yar la 'bul rgyu maṇḍal sku gsung thugs rten//mar la zhu rgyu byin rlabs bdud rtsi ril bu/290

byes 'khod gnya' nang skyid sdug gi skor//bkra la zhis pa shog/g.yang la chags pa shog/byin rlabs chen po rang gi yul du 'khyer nas//rang yul skyid pa'i dgon gzhis phyogs la log 'gro/bkra la this pa shog/g.yang la chags pa shog/bag chags bzang bo mi yi yul du bzhag nas//gtam la snyan po rang gi yul du 'khyer 'gro/bkra la zhis pa sgog/g.yang la chags pa shog///

le tshan nyi shu pa/g.yer ma zhing sku gas bal yul gyi sa mtshams grong gseb mi sna'i sgor/g.yer ma thing zer ba'i grong gseb ni bal bod sa mtshams kyi ri 'dabs thig tu chags yod/nga tsho btsan byol du 'byor skabs yul mi'i gtso drag kun tsa bla ma zer ba zhig 'dug/grong pa nyi shu tsam yod pa tshang ma khong gi spun tsha zha stag red/ grong gseb 'di'i ri mgor de snga gorṣa'i dmag sgar chags shul mtha' 'khor rdo rtsigs kyi 'dzing rags yod pa ches brjid nyams dod la bsra zhing brtan pa gnyis 'dug /yul mi'i sgod sgros la/ gor bod dmag 'khrug skabs g.yer ma zhing nas me sgrogs 'phangs te bod sa 'gram du dar phyog dkar po zhes pa'i khyim tshang la phog skyon byung ba dang / skabs zhig bod dmag mang po bal sar 'dzul te g.yer ma zhing gi ri rgyab tu yun ring sdod dus gor dmag gis 'thung chur dug btab ste bod dmag mang po zhi skyon byung bas na/sa cha der deng sang yang bod zhi sa zer gyin 'dugagayer ma zhing gi yul mi rnams dpa' bo dgon pa zer ba'i grong gseb nas mched par grags/ mi thog 'ga' shas gong du bod pa yin yang skabs der rta mang gi rus khungs su brtsi bzhin 'dug /rgyun gtan 'tsho ba so nam 292

zhing las la bcol/khong tsho'i yul skad ni bod skad kyi cha shas la song zla ba re gnyis ga ba na rang res kyang cha tshang go thub/ lung pa der yul mi rnams kyis phyag mchod byed sa lha khang zhig 'dug pa der cho ga cha tshang bod skad thog 'don pa ma zad/ dung rgya rnga rol 'bud dkrol yang dar srol chen bo 'dugadapa' bo dgon pa dang /mar be/g.yer ma zhing /nan tha li/sgrag sgang /sgog chen/ thang zhing / sa lang sga ri/ rkang glang / chang zhing / 'jur spug /tang tha li/dpa' tang tha li/ sgom thang sogs sun ko thi chu rgyud kyi g.yas g.yon ri 'dabs su chags pa'i rta mang rus rgyud kyi yul mi mang che ba gzugs stobs dang gdong dbyibs bzang la sha mdog kyang khams dwangs 'dug /rnam kun 'tsho ba ngal rtsol la bcol dgos pa dang / zas gos gnyis phongs mdor na mi rabs mang po rkang lham gyon myong med par brten/mang che ba'i rkang mthil la ser kha grog rong ltar gas nas khrag ral 'dzar 'dzor 'gro dgos pa'i rma kha gso thabs su chil lu me la bzhus nas tsha po tsha rkyang rma kha'i nang sdug srol ya nga'i gnas stangs de ltar 'dug kyang / rgyun du chog shes che la snang ba skyid pa/rgyun mkho'i me zhing sgrug rgyu dang sgo phyugs kyi rtswa brnga rgyu/za 'bru sogs rgyab 'khur khyer nas ri gzar gyen thur mang por bgrod pa'i skabs snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i yul gzhas skad gsang mthon pos btang pa rgyang ring nas go thos kyis sems la dga' spro'i tshor ba 'gog med du ster zhing / dus 293

ston la mnyam 'dzom byed pa'i skabs sgor gzhas dang / pho mo phan tshun mdza' glu gtong res byed pa'i goms srol yang bzang po 'dug khong tsho'i gzhas tshig nang phyis su rong skad kyi lhad skyon phran bu yod pa las de min rang re'i yul gzhas dang khyad par mi 'dug/dpe mtshon gnyis tsam 'bri 'god bgyis pa ba/shaca/ ba/thega'//g.yer ma zhing dang / dpa' bo dgon ba sogs sa mtshams yul mi'i glu ba/zhathag//mched grogs pha ri'i sked la//sto na bha ri lo//nga ni tshur ri'i sked la//swo na bha ri lo//las dang las 'phro yod na//swo na bha ri lo//gser gyi zam pa rkyangs sgog/sku na bha ri 'ebyu//swo na bha ri zer ba ni rne pā li'i skad du gser gyi zhing kha zhes par go/a gsar mar nan ser krong krong //dpung pa sig sig mgo skusnam skusnam//sgon ḍi zas na mngar dro dro//thug pa zung na khag stag stag/a gsar ni rne pā li'i skad la mar kun smin dus kyi zla ba'i ming la go/〉( rang yi las dga' ba//snang gsal mar me yag294

g.yer ma zhing sogs bal yul gyi sa mtshams grong gseb mi sna'i sgor//steng phyogs lha la mi 'dug/snang gsal mar me yag/lha rgyal dbang the brgya byin//snang gsal mar me yag/'o ra'i phyogs la mnyes song //snang gsal mar spe yagakhyim dud drag zhan ji 'dra zhig yin rung mar kun gyi pags pas lhas pa'i rtswa gdan si ku ṭi zer ba sgor sgor dang / gong mtshungs rtswa gdan dkyus ring bed spyod byed/ ca dngos brtsi mthongs che ba rnams zegs ma zer ba'i smyug lhas sgam stod re zung nang nyar tshags byed pa las/ ngos rnams skyabs bcol du 'byor ba'i skabs kho tsho'i nang du shing sgam dang lcags sgam mthong ma myong /zhing las dang 'grul bzhud skabs smyug ma dang zhing gi lo mas bzos pa'i char gdugs (sgum ) zer ba lag pas 'ju ma dgos par mgo la gyon rgyu yod pa de dag la rgyab 'khur dang lus stod cha tshang khebs pa'i khyad chos 'dugakhyad mtshar zhig la phru gu ma gtogs mi rgan pa'i ming nas ma smretes par/mi de'i phru gu gon sgos kyis ming bed spyod bya gin 'dug pa dper na/ khyim tshang gang zhig gi phru gu gon sgos kyi ming la pa sangs zer gyin yod na/ nang gi pha la/pa sangs 65 pha dang /ma la pa sangs 55 ma 11 11 la pa sangs mes mes/rmo mo la pa sangs i bi zhes 'bod kyi 'dugagrangs ka brtsi ba'i skabs/ mi nas 2༷ tham pa bar ma gtogs de 295

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/rjes bgrang srol med la/ bgrang thub mkhan yang mi 'dug /grangs 2༷ tham pa la/ khal gcig zer/ 22 la khal gcig dang gnyis/ 27 la khal gcig dang lnga/ 30 tham pa la khal gcig dang byed ka/ 1ཿ tham pa la khal lnga zer gyin 'dug 'di la zhib skabs 1070gong bod mi'i sbyi tshogs nang 'bo bre'i tshad gzhi'i nang bre nyi shu tham pa la gtan tshig kha ru'i khal gcig dang / 'bru ru'i khal gnyis zhes pa ltar bod kyi nā mtshams 〈sna mosna/ 'bras 'brug shar mophan sdusags mtha' mtshams mang che bar snga mo'i brda rnying ngam grangs 'dren brtsi stangs rnying pa zhig rang 'jags bsdad pa zhig red snyam lags/gnyen sgrig skabs spun mched nang khul 'byung thabs gtsor 'don byed/ kha rgyun la'ang a zhang bu po mi la ma sgor zer nas pha ma sbun phrug nang khul chang sa rgyag rgyur dga' 'dems byed kyin 'dug /bu po rnams mna' mar 'gro dgos pa dang / khyim tshang gcig la bu mang po yod na rgan rim bzhin chang sa rgyab rjes khyim nas thon te skyid sdug rang sor gyes/ ma khang dang pha ma'i sa skal rnams bu tha la sprod srol 'dugand rims las thar thabs su nang du bon po bsus nas bya de'i sko bcad pa'i dmar mchod byed pa'i thog sgo nga dang sgo thal gang rung lag tu bzung nas nad pa'i lus la 'phur te/gnod pa dang na tsha phyir 'don gyi gto bcos byed pa 296

de la bon po'i shur bzhud zer/ mi thi byung dus phung por lha rdzas stod snye dang rigs lnga g.yogs te/ dung rgya rnga rol dang bcas dur sar skyel 'dren gyis mer bsregs btang pa'i rus lhag dang bur thal gyi steng du mchod rten dbang la khru bdun brgyad yod pa re bzhengs dgos pa dang /de rjes dge ba gtong ba zhes yul mi rnams maX na posnar bos nas zas lha na byed 〈snal sku da pa ltar dbyal phongs kyi rigs la rang med gzhan 'tshol dgos pa'i dka' ngal chen po 'dug/mi zhi byung rjes nyin zhas ring dgong dro sa rub kyi mtshams su dga' nye rnams ngu 〈snags su skusnang nas/ bud med gon gzhon lnga drug mnyam du tshogs te chu tshod gnyis gsum ring gzhin po'i ming nas smos te/ nged cag bzhag nas steng 〈snags lha yi yul du gshegs sdusang zer ba skusnags chig bzang gi smre sngags gdangs dbyangs dang bcas bton nas ngu 'bod byed pa de ni rang res sems gso byed pa 'dra mtshungs yin bzo 'dugaganya' nang dang sa 'brel bal sa'i ri rgyud grong gseb mang che bar yul mi sbyi thog nas bdag dbang byas pa'i lha khang re dang ṭi ka bla ma zer ba re re 'dug/rgyun du tshes bcu nyer lnga'i srol rgyun dang /mi zhi nad mnar skabs chos phyogs kyi byed sgo spel srol bzang po 'dug /sbyir bal yul gyi mtha' mtshams su gnas pa'i mi rigs gu rung dang /rta mang /ra ye/gcang pa/shar pa zer ba de dag gi sgyusgrog ma'i 'byung khungs 〈snad yin pa bal the da mkhas pa 297

mang pos sgod kyin yod cing / lhag par gu rung dang rta mang gnyis kyi pha mes rnams sngar chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku dus kyi dmag mi yin par grags zhing /gu rung zer ba ni sgo srung gi sgra zur chag pa las byung ba dang /de bzhin rta mang zer ba yang rta dmag gi sgra zur chag pa las byung ba ma zad/gcang pa zer ba de tsho yang gtsang nas 'ong pa'i mi rigs zhig yin par rong skad du gtsang zhes 'a〈snad sgra ma dag par gcang pa zhes 1snags pa rgyu mtshan yang dag yin par snyam mosna//shar pa rnams ni/ bal yul gyi byang phyogs deng sang jo yo glang ma zhes 'bod pa bod kyi lo rgyus thog gangs rgyal sa mthon mthing zhes ri rtse lnga pa ming gzhan tshe ring mched lnga'i nye 'dabs su gzhis chags nas mi 'o1 sum brgya lhag tsam las skusnang med ba de yang bka' zur stag lha phun tshogs bkris kyis brtsams pa mi che'i byung ba brjod pa zhes pa'i nang /shar pa rnams ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i stod tsam la sog po jun gar gyi dmag dpung bod dbus gtsang khams gsum du lhags skabs mi nyag dbus gtsang phyogs su gnas sgos te rim bzhin jo mo glang ma'i ri rgyud kyi sgo ngos su gzhis chags pa yin zhing / khong tsho bod kyi shar phyogs nas yong bar brten shar pa zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di thogs pa dang /phyi lo 1/3༷lo bod gzhung gis bkod pa'i lcags stag zhib gzhung nang du shel dkar rdzong khongs kyi shar khyam bu ba 'don nyi shu 298

sgor zhes gsal ba ltar/ sngar shar pa rnams bod gzhung gi mnga' 'og bston med yin zhes 'khod 'dug /'di dang phyogs mtshungs wa lung dang / snye shang /yol yo/nub ri/ rtsum/dol bo/ mu gum/ yangs ri sogs kyang de snga bod kyi chab 'bangs yin par grags/wa lung dang dol po sogs su de snga bod gzhung gis mgo pa bsgo 'dzugs gnang sgol yod pa ma zad/ gong gsal sa cha sbyi byings la yul mi phan tshun nang khul rtsod rnyog byung ba'i skabs bar 'dum byed po bod gzhung nas gtong srol yod pa yul mi rgan rabs rnams la sgod rgyu 'dug/dus da lta'ang gong gsal sa khul khag dang /glo bcas pa'i yul mi'i skad yig dang goms srol cha tshang bod rigs sbyi mtshungs yin pa'i gnas stangs kun shes la song 'dir zhib gleng zhu rgyu min/sun ko zhi gtsang chu'i g.yas g.yon du chags pa'i nee pā li'i grong gseb mi mang gi rgyun gtan 'tsho ba zhing las yin pa ltar/ bod du dus 'gyur ma byung bar 'bras dang /gro/mar kun/bu ram/sba ci/zhing tog sogs thon khungs gang yod gnya' nang du tshong bsgyur gyis 'tsho ba bskyal yang /177'alo'i rjes su bod la tshong 'thab byed sa med par 'tsho gos la do phog dka' ngal che bar brten na gzhon mang po rgya gar du lam bzor bskyod mgo tshugs/ 'on kyang 1677 lo nas bzung bal yul rgyal sa'i nang bod mi'i lag shes rum thag 'phel rgyas je cher 'gro ba'i skabs khul de'i na gzhon mang po rum thag gi 299

las grwar 'dzul nas 'tsho gos kyi gnas stangs dang rig gzhung chas gos bcas par 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba ma zad/ bu phrug gang 'tsham bod ba'i dgon pa khag la grwa par 'dzul nas nang chos slob sbyong byas pa sogs kyi shugs rkyen la brten nas phyi lo 20ཿlo'i rjes su g.yer ma thing sogs gong gsal grong gseb khag la bud med rnams kyis bod bzo gya med dang / skyes pa rnams kyis gos zung / rgan byis tshang mas rkang lham yang gyon mgo tshugs pa ma zad/ g.yer ma zhing sogs grong gseb 'ga' shas kyi nang yul spyi'i lha khang yang nyams bzo byas pa dang /bod kyi rig gzhung la dga' zhen che ru song nas khong tsho'i rus rgyud kyang zhar pa yin zhes tsañtsa ta ra rdzong sde'i las khungs su rta mang nas shar par ming sgyur byed mgo tshugs 'dug pa bcas so//

kha skong dang po/༄༅༅//rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/rwa lotsā ba'i rnam thar gyi skor la go 'jo rag mgomachog sprul thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya marā'i 87ril96 gsung las/ra 'o1tsu'i rnam thar gsar pa yab gzhis spar ma de nang ma dag pa mang ste/ra 'o(dang 3snad ldem bskyed rim zhus rtsal 'gran rab zer ba de'ang rdzun te/ra yodang mar pa dus mnyam ste rab gangs can gyi 1snangs su bka' dang bstan bathershas sdugags kyi glegs bam spar gzhi ji ltar yod pa rnams nas dkar chag sbar thor phyogs tsam du bkod pa phan bde'i pad tshal 'byed pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//sgog ldeb 3canaminang /gzim yab gzhis glang mdun du/rwa lo rtswa ba rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar la173 zhes gsal/mthu stobs dbang rgyag rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba'i rnam par thar pa kun khyab snyan pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs skusna//rwa'i brje ye shes seng gis bkod pa/rnam thar dngos gzhir dbe ring thog ldeb 171bzhugs pa dang /par byang du'ang /rnam thar 'di nyid sngon chad bar du ma 'khod cing /bris dpe'ang dkon gzhis da lam 7rgyal mchog sku greng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yab gzhis glang mdun pa nas bstan 'gror phan bde'i slad du dad gdung sgro ba chen pos mtshams sbyar ste mthun pa'i cha rkyen spel te shing sbrul 147lo gsar bskrun thog par 'di yab gzhis dge legs bde skyid rab brtan du bzhugs/ zhes gsal/ ༷

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/byung dang po'i mgo zin tsam dang / rgod ldem rab byung drug pa'i me glang la 'khyungs pas drug cu sgor tsho lnga tsam bar du 'gyang pas dus mi 'grigs/'ga' zhig gis ra 'o1sum brgya bzhugs skad kyis zer na/'jigs byed brgyud pa sman mchod nang /ra rdo je grags nas/ra chos rab sogs brgyud pa lnga drug song ba na rje rin po che rab byung drug par byon pa de lta na/rje dang ra lodus mnyam na rjes ra yodangos las mi gsan par bar du brgyud pa de tsam 'gyang don ci yod/ ra bod rnying pa sogs khungs thub kyi 'epha rgyus rnams su med pa'i gtam/ ra lo'i che brjod lta bu mang po 'dug pa'i rjes 'jug spro ba bskyed phyir snyan ngag rab brtags lta bu yin byas na cung drag na las/ sngon gyi gtam rgyud phyogs med kyi chos 'byung yig tshang rnam thar shes pas mthong na khrel dgod gting nas 'chor zhing / rdzun gyis 'jig rten bslu ba'i rang mtshang gsal yang / deng sang gi skye bo ngo tsha mi shes pas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che la'ang rang bzos slad mang po btang na/ 'di rigs la sgos ci dgos/ rdzun ham can de tshos ci dgar smra ba la ci bya med do/ /rgyal po khyod kyi yul du ni/ /'di 'dra'i rang bzo byung gyur na//bstan pa spyil gnod pa dang /kho rang la'ang cis mi gnod/zhes pa dang 'dra'o/2/zhes gsal/ des na 'altasan 〈snan dpal 'atre1ra lhun grub (1561—1637) zhabs lha rag mabe| ma35ga sbrul bka' 'bum/ wa da ya pa/ bee la rshasnab mis/ grub dbang pad nor rin po che'i sbar ma/1 /7dbyin ji'i sgog grangs ca47/rgyacaji302

kha sgong dang po/rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/kyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal gzhin rje'i gshed sgor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i chos 'byung gdul bya'i re 'dod sgong ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 'phreng ba las rwa lotsā ba'i rnam thar dang / rwa lo tsā ba'i rnam thar dang rwa lugs sam rwa bod du grags pa rnams kun mkhyen casna nang tā ra na thas (1575—1635) mdzad pa'i rgyud rgyal gzhin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa yid ches ngo mtshar gnyis nang ji ltar gsal ba rnams wa ga 〈snan dang yig tshogs la ma 'dzems par tshang mas mkhyen 31gas nyams zhib ched bde bar 'be|da par byasna(//'jam dpal gzhin rje'i gshed skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i chos 'byung gdul bya'i re 'dod sgong ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 'phreng ba las/ rwa lhatshogardo 1 grag khagani/ gtsang stod snye nam snang yul du rje mar pa lo tstsha las sku cung gzhon par 'khrungs/ 'khrungs nas 'otshe phyed tsam sku nga nas yum gyi bang du bzhugs pa'i tshe lha mo re ma tis phu thung nang du khyer nas zla ba gnyis kyi bar du dbyas gtsang dang khams mi nyag gi bar gyi sa thams cad bstan/ 'di dag thams cad khyed kyi gdul bya'i zhing du 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan mdzad/ slar yum gyi bang du bskyal nas mi lo lnga tsam song ba'i tshod kyi sku chen po zhig tu byin gyis brlabs/ 'bri blo ga 31gas rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/dus phyis rab tu byung zhing bsten par rdzogs/de nas bal yul du byon zhing bal po thugs rje chen po la gtso bor bsten cing / de dang rje ṭwāṃ ro ba'i 303

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/dngos slob mkhas pa chen po bradzñā ra ta des bal po thugs rje chen po la gsungs/ de la rwa los legs par gsan cing mkhyen pa ni 'di lta ste/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang saṃ bhu ṭa dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang rgyud mngon spyod bla ma dang he ru ka sngon byung dang / kun spyod dang phag po sngon byung dang nag po chos drug dang bde mchog lu yī pa'i sgor gyi gdams pa du ma dang / khyad par du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa dang te'u lo'i tog pa dang / de dag gi 'grel pa man ngag dang bcas pa dang gzhin rje'i gshed dgra nag gi sgor dang gdong drug gi sgor dang mtshan brjod rtsa 'grel dang / phag yo zhal gnyis ma'i sgor dang sgom gyi gdams ngag dang /par bu dang mabo na chung la 31gas pa 〈snag ser gyi gdams pa dang bcas pa mkhyen/bal wa'i pan grub gzhan yang du ma la cesas mang du gsan/de nas rgya gar du byon pas chu bo gang ga'i 'gram du rnal 'byor pa gsum gzhin rje'i 'khrul 'khoter la sgrub pa byed 'dug pas gasku1ga byas te gdams pa phyag len dang bcas pa bslabs bas mthu stobs zhus pa phul du byung zhes bod kyi grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis gsung ngo //gong du smos pa'i gzhung de dag la gzhi 'gyur/ kha cig 'gyur bcos te zhu chen gyi lo klo ba mdzad/khyad par du rdo rje 'jigs byed dang dgra nag dang gdong drug gi rgyud rgya gzhung rnams bsgyur te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ de dag 304

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/gi yig cha mdzad pa la rwa lo'i gsung nas/ le'u bco brgyad kun gyi gzhi//rgyud kyi rgyal po ston pas gsungs//de'i grogs su rtog pa gsum//bsngags pa'i mtshon char ston pas gsungs/ /sgrub thabs dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis/ /mdzad pa de la gtso bor bzung / /'khrul 'khor gsal byed bu sgri//lus dang snying 'dra'i man ngag yod/ kha cig gsar 'gyur kha cig bcos//zhes gsungs te dgra nag gi skor bsgyur tshul dang / de'i gdams pa lo tstsha bas mdzod tshul ni/ rgyud kyi chings bla ma dwa lo smos mdzad pa/ rgyud kyi yig sna chen po rgyud kyi rnam bshad bsdus pa bla ma rnams kyi gsung bsdur te sbyi bshad dang / chos bzhi 'chi med nas rnam bshad kyi bar rnams la zin bris chen mo mdzad/ char dbab pa nas lha dang klu'i bu po dgug pa'i bar gyi gdams pa gser zhun ma dang 'dra ba'i man ngag las 'gro zab mo zhes pa dang / dpal 'dzin gyi rgya gzhung la brten nas nag po'i sgrub thabs chen mo dang /yig sna du ma dpal 'dzin gyi dkyil chog gi rjes su 'brangs te/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi dbang chog dang / yang dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi bsdus don/ sgrub thabs bsdus don/ rnam bshad kyi bsdus don snga ma ni sku gshegs khar ldan rdzong du mdzad/ dgra nag gi sgor dwa los mdzad pa 'di dag tu nges te/bla ma dwa lo'i gsung las/ rgyud kyi chings te khog ston yin/ /yig sna lus kyi rnam bshad yin/ /bla ma'i gsung bsdur phran tshegs rnams/ /ma bo bgegs 305

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams ba/sel gdams ngag yin/ /dpal 'dzin mdzad pa'i gdams ngag la/ /gsal byed tsam gyi yi ge byas/ /lha ro'i phyag len dpal 'dzin gsung / /de brten dbang bskur gong ma la//yig sna bdud rtsi'i bum pa brtsams//chos bzhi 'chi med bdud rtsi dang //mig sman sgrub pa'i gtam rgyud dang //bsrung 'khor kha sbyor dbye ba rnams/ /las sgrub 'khor 'o phyi ma dang / /rgyas btab bla ma'i bzhed pa dang //bla ma'i zhal bsdur gtor ma dang //sa 'og dgug pa'i gtam rgyud dang //bla ma rnams kyi zhal bsdur dang / /he ru ka yi rnam bshad dang / /bar do'i byang chub sems bshad dang / /klu yi rnam par bshad rnams dang / /bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin du/ /zin bris byas nas bla ma la/ /gzigs pa phul te dag par gtugs//mnyes nas de tsug yin zhes gsungs/las phran ni/ char dbab klu yi nad gtong thabs/ /sbrul bzung gos dang mabosna nad zhing / /chu 'gags khyams dang gros langs bsgrub/ /'phags pa 'dzom bu li sgrub dang //yum bzhi'i las tshogs sgrub pa dang //mig sman ril bu rkang mgyogs dang / /mkha' spyod thod pa sgrub pa dang / /sa 'og mkha' spyod mi snang dang / /ral gcig su kka se sgrub dang / /lha dang klu yi bu po dgug /man ngag gser zhun 'di dag rnams/ /rgyud kyi snying 'dra bla ma'i gsung / /bod kyi banades yi ger bkod/ /bla ma nyid la gzigs su phul/ /nor 'khrul dngos grub mi 'byung bas/ /lhag chad e 'dug lan gsum zhus/ /rkang thag sbangs 306

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/nas lan gsum byin/ /bla ma'i gsung nas bu zhes gsungs/ /nor 'khrul mi 'dug lan gsum gsungs//zhes gsungs/gdong drug gi skor la rgyud sdom pa gsum pa lo tstsha bas mdzod pa'i bsdus don mngon rtogs 'jug pa dag byed dang dbang chog bdud rtsi'i bum chung rnams dwa lo nyid kyis mdzod de/ lo tstsha ba'i gsungs las/ bshad rgyud sdom gsum ldan pa sku1da/ /dka' ba'i gnad daklol yig sna byas/ /bsdus don gsal ba'i sgron me byas/ /masngani rtogs 'jug pa dag byed byas/ /dbang chog bdud rtsi'i bum chung byas/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di las gzhan dwa pa rnams kyi gdong drug gi yig cha mdzad de/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgya gzhung sgor bsgyur bshad la rtsa ba'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa/ te'u lo'i rtog pa dkyil chog a yo gha badzras mdzad pa/ des mdzod pa'i sbyin sreg /des mdzod pa'i sgrub thabs/tshogs 'khor ratna a ka ra shārnyi pas mdzod pa/ te'u lo'i rtog pa'i sgrub thabs shrī bha dras mdzad pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa de dag bla ma bha 3snas mdzad pa thams cad bsgyur te bla ma'i gsung las/ snying po'i rgyud mchog rtog bdun sku da/ /las mkhan te'u le'i rtog pa yod//don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa yi//sgrub thabs dkyil chog sbyin sreg yod/ /dī paṃ ka ra'i sbyin sreg yod/ /ratna a kur shu yis/ /mdzod pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod//bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum yod/kha cig gsar 307

gnya' nang tsong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/'gyur kha cig bcos//zhes gsungs/de dag la lo tstsha bas yig sna mdzad tshul ni/ rtog bdun gyi nag 'grel dka' 'grel man ngag bcud thigs bsnyen sgrub las gzhin sbrel ba/lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs yid bzhin gter mdzod/gtso bo'i sgrub thabs sdu med snang ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs khams gsum za byed/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs dri med chu rgyun/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen don bsdus/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mi mthun kun sel/rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg 'dod pa kun 'phel/dbang gi spyin sreg gnad kyi lcags kyu/ drag po'i sbyin sreg dgra bgegs kun 'dul/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i dug dbang ma bya rgyas pa/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de rnams mdzad de nyid kyi zhal nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun la/ /gzhan 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen brtsams/ /dka' 'grel phyogs mthong 'ben la gtad//bcud kyi thigs bas phog par bsnun//gsod pa'i mtshon de snying la gab/ khar brgyud yi ger ma bkod do/ /bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud yod/ /mngon rtogs rim pa lnga yang yod/ /las bzhi'i sbyin sreg cho ga yod//smin byed dkyil chog yig sna yod/ /dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yod//'di dag rnams ni mi legs na'ang //ban chung rwa yi lugs su snang //nga yi rjes 'brangs thams cad kyis/ /bcos bslad ma byed nyams su longs/308

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar//bcos na dngos grub ga la thob//'di ru ma bsdus yi ge'i tshogs//legs na'ang gzhan gyis sbyar ba min/ /'di yis nyes na'ang gzhan du min/ /gzhan gyi legs na'ang 'di ru min/ /phyogs 'dzin che zhing man ngag bsre/ /rang dang slothob ma phung ba'i rgyu/ /man ngag ma grub lha la 'khangs/ /de 'dra 〈snar la lam 'di brten/ /zhes gsungs pas rje btsun rwa los dngos su mdzad pa la de dag las med do//rdzogs rim gyi skor la rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi man ngag /mtshan ma rgyu ba'i man ngag /mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi man ngag dang gsum ni lo tstsha ba'i gsung rgyun la gzhi byas nas rwa chos rab kyis yi ger bkod pa yin no/ /de rnams paṇḍi ta 'ba' zhig gi chos dang bsres pa yin pas zhin tu legs te 'bre shes rab 'bar gyi zhal nas/ bod du bsgyur ba'i chos la dge bshes dwa lo tstsha ba'i chos las zhe zhim pa med de/ paṇḍi ta mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa lon zhing bod chos kyi bsre bslad med pas so zhes gsungs/ 'phrin las phun tshogs pas 'khor yang lha btsun sngon po la sogs pa mi che dgu dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang 'ga' lha nga can nam mkha' dang zhang tshe chung nam mkha' dang /bu chab 'dul 'dzin dang gnyags rig pa dang /'bre shes rab 'bar dang 'ben dkon no rdo rje dang / rog sngon pa ba dang zhu bka' gdams pa dang /mtha' bzhi ba so thang pa dang / rtag pa kha che dang dpyal lo tstsha ba kun dga' rdo

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/rje dang zhang thang bsag pa dang / zhang gtsang 'od dang sgang ind+ra dang snar nyi ma dang / ba reg thos pa dga' dang lha rje dba' dang bran phu ba rin chen grags dang /glan rgyam legs dang glan se bo shākya rgyal dang /glan tsaṇḍa dang glan rdor po dang rgya dor po chos grags dang / mar pa bsod rin dang a mes mi nyag dang /rgya dar seng dang byang ran ston pa dang / myang dang rog skyug bsre dang khung po dar ma 'bar dang khyung po phu re dang spa lo tstsha dang / tsha mi bsod nams 'bar dang tsha mi tshul po dang / pur tsaṇḍa dang / zhang dang rwa bsgom rdo rje rgyal po dang /rong ba rgya le dang bla ma brang pa dang gtsang pa yang dag 'bar dang / bla ma mtha' dang dpon kun se dang /tsang tsa ca med dang gzhung gnas ngog mdo sde dang /khya lo tstsha mdo sde 'bar dang / grags dang khya nee tso dang mdo sde grags dang / sgong rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang sgong dge 'dun dang 'dzar dge so dang / mgar a tsa dang snying pa dang lang tsha ston nag dang grol grub pa dang / 'bre kha skyog pa dang skyu ra a skyabs dang /rab g.ye jo sras dang bkre bo phyogs lha dang /ngo khro yon tshul dang dbang dang se rigs dang zur mda' tsha hor po dang / 'di rje sgro phug pa yin pa 'drasnya(//spang gya bla ma dang ma thog byang 'bar la skusnags pa de dus kyi mkhas pa phal che ba dang / khyad par bod la mkhas par grags pa bkre bo mabo na 〈sna rnams sku / /grangs ni gnyal du sam sgo ra'i chos 'khor la dgra nag gi rgyud nyan mi grwa pa btsun pa de'i thog stong dang nyis brgya/ sngags pa de'i thog brgyad 310

kha sgong dang bo/ rje btsun rwa lo rtswa ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/brgya ste nyis stong byung / 'bul ba'i grangs tshad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa tshar re la mi res gser srang re/ nag po'i rgyud dang / gdong drug gi rgyud dang bde mchog gi rgyud brgyad dang nag po'i chos drug dang / lu yī pa dang 'jam dpal dang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rnams kyi bshad pa tshar re la mi re la gser zho re gser chos byas la/ khrigs su ma bcad pa'i 'bul ba la ni grangs med pa byung /'bul ba de dag don ldan du byed pa'i phyag rjes la/rgya gar du bi kra ma la snyi lar gser gyi nyi khri tshar gcig bstan pa ma zhig bar du klog pa'i cha rkyen du gser srang brgya phul/gser gyis bris pa'i brgyad stong pa cha gcig dang sde pa bzhi'i pa'i ta brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la gser gyis bris pa'i sdud pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bstan pa ma zhig bar du klog pa'i cha rkyen la gser srang brgya phul/ bla ma bha ro phyag dum la bka' drin gsab phyogs su gser srang brgya phul/ gser srang gsum bzhi tsam la cha rkyen byas nas ha mu nyis brgya tsam re bsags pa'i tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad btang /bal po zugs rje chen po bod du sbyan drangs nas phyir theg dus gser srang stong brdzangs/ khong ma gshegs bar du 'bul ba thengs sum cu so bdun brdzangs/ bsam yas kyi 'khor sa klu mes dang rba rag tsho chags snang gi me pho khyi'i lo la bsregs te gyang tshun chad 'gyel ba la/ 'ol kha nas shug pa rnams gtsang por gyen la drangs/gyang bzo ba thing bzo ba lcags bzo ba gser bzo ba lha bzo ba sogs 311

bzo bo lnga brgya tsam gyis lo gsum bar du zhig gsos mdzad/ de'i zhabs tog gi lag len ni ston pa rin chen rdo rjes byas/ de dag gi yo byad la khal 'bum tsho gcig song / de'i tshon rtsi'i lhag gis gtsang brang g.yu'i lha khang gi khyams dbu rtse dang bcas pa gsos yun la lo gnyis song / gnyer dwa lo tstsha ba chos rab kyis byas/yo byad la khal khri tsho gcig song /gnas gzhi rnams su zhabs tog mdzad pa la ngur zhig pa la 'bum cha gsum gyis sna drangs 'bul ba mang du mdzad/der bstan pa ma zhig bar du mgron zan gtong ba'i cha rkyen la ljid mnyam gyi khal khri tsho gsum phul/ rje 'da' ba la mdo sdes sna drangs pa'i bu sta brgya mgron zan rgyun gyi cha rkyen khal khri tsho gsum phul/ skyu btang ba la 'bum cha gcig gis sna drangs pa'i bu ti lnga bcu lo re bzhin mgron zan zla ba re'i cha rkyen la khal khri tsho gcig /nyan mtsho ba dang lcang ba la yang de dang mnyam pa rtsal/ yar stong du sgo skyam pa la mdo sdes sna drangs pa'i bu ti brgya tham pa mgron zan thebs khal khri tsho gcig /re thul ba la de dang mnyam pa phul/ sa tshwa 'bum tsho 'bum btab 'bum tsho re la khal bzhi bcu'i cha rkyen du bcad/ klog 'don pa brgya dpe'i nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa 'don pa'i a tsha ra'i mchod gnas drug /bde mchog lu yī pa bsgom pa po re dang bdun rgyun du 'degs pa gnang / gsung rab brgya tshar stong tshar klog pa mdzad/ngog lo tstsha ba chen po la 'bum gyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba dang khri tsho phogs byas 312

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lotsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/pa'i chos 'khor btsugs/ de dang mnyam pa glang ri thang pa la yang phul/ de bzhin du btsan kha bo che la yang de dang mnyam pa phul/ 'di byams choso sde lnga bsgom khrid du 'chad pa la mkhas par grags/rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa la 'bum gyis sna drangs 'bul ba dang brgya bogs kyi chos 'khor btsugs/ de dang mnyam pa jo btsun khyung la/ de dang mnyam pa 'bre shes rab 'bar la/ de dang mnyam pa 'ben la/ de dang mnyam pa blosag casan pa la/ de dang mnyam pa rtag pa kha che la phul te chos 'khor btsugs/ gtam 'di rnams bla ma ye shes seng ges mdzad pa'i rnam thar las bsdus so zhes deb sngon las bshad do//bsam yas kyi zhig gsos mdzad tshul zhib tu bshad na/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis nga yi gtsug lag khang 'di cung zhig zhig pa'i skabs su /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sbrul pa dge slong dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par du 'phags pa zhig gis gso bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa ltar 'khor sas thog drangs lha khang mang po me la bsregs pa/ dus phyis rje btsun rwa lo ma gtogs gzhan gyis gso ba la chos skyong dang gzhi bdag zhin tu gnyan pas gso ma zhus par lus pa la/rwa los ste nam nas kong po yan chad g.yas bsgor dang g.yon bskor byas nas dge 'dun stong phrag phyed dang gnyis rten khyim pa'i sngags pa lnga brgya dang bcas te stong phrag gnyis kyis rgyun du bsgor nas byon te/ 'ol khar phebs pa'i nub mo bsam yas kyi gzhi bdag 313

gnyan mi gnyan brtag pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin gyi me 'od spros pas/ 'on du phebs pa'i dgong mo gzhi bdag gis dkon gnyer la nga la 'jigs pa chen po 'dug pas nga mi sdod zer khong gros/ der dkon gnyer gyis 'jigs pa ci 'ong snyam brtags pa la de nas nyi ma gnyis song ba na/ rwa lo dpon slob stobs dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te phebs/ lha khang thams cad mjal te bstan ba rgyas pa'i 〈snan lam brlabs po che mdzod/dkor mdzod gling du phebs dus gnas kyi bdag po gar song gsungs pa'i zhal ta gcig byung bas rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ der rjes bkug ste gzhi bdag bka' dang dam la btags zhabs tog bsgrub par khas blangs/ lha(la kha nas thing cha thams cad bcad de rgyal pos sgru gas dan byas te me yar ljongs mdar zhing cha rnams gtsang po gyen la ldog ste drangs nas zhal bkod dwa chos rab kyis mdzad/dbya rtse rigs gsum gyi 'khor sas thog drangs pa'i bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi zhig gsos mdzod pa'i thog ma yin pas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sbrul par grags/ rab gnas dang brtan bzhugs rgyas par mdzad pas zhin tu bkra zhis par gyur/ de'i tshon dang dngos chas lhag mas gtsang brang gi zhig gsos mdzad/ bod du byon pa'i lo tstsha ba la chos dang zang zing gi 'byor pa'i stobs 'di dang mnyam pa ma byung zhing / dge ba'i phyag rjes ni rgya gar dang bod gnyis kur bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad 314

kha slong dang bo/ rje btsun rwa lotsā ba chen po 'o rje grags kyi rnam thar/pa la kho bo dpal 'byor lhun grub snying nas rjes su yi rangs par gsol ba 'debs so//thugs rgyud rtags pa'i yon tan gyi bang mdzod du gyur tshul ni/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa mthar phyin te dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon gsum du zhal gzigs/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par yi dam gyi lhas bskur bas thun yong ma yin pa'i bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa la dbang thob cing / zhar la bsad pa dang gso ba gnyis rka'i nus pa la mnga' brnyes te dge ba'i gshes gnyen chen po rnams nang rgyas pa la/ dbal phyag na rdo rje'i grub thob zangs dkar lo tstsha dang rus lo tstsha ba sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bcu gsum dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam dpal gyi zhing du spyan drangs te zhal rgyas byung ba'i lo dus la grongs/ de ltar yang / dar ma mdo sdes sna drangs nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum bsad//dmyal bar skyes kyang 'gyod pa med//ces gsungs skad do//pha tshan rnams kyis thugs dang 'gal ba cher byas pa la brten nas/ snye nam na mosna che'am ste nam red pa'i 〈snang khyer nyis brgya'i mi rnams bkug cing dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du drangs te bskyal/ 'gugs 'dren lan gnyis mdzod de grong khyer nyis brgya brlag bar mdzad/ nyu gu ba rnams kyis zugs dang 'gal ba cher byas pa grong brgya'i mi rnams grong khyer nas phyung zhing thag 315

ring po'i sar bskrad par mdzad/ nyu gu na'i klu btsan gyis sku 'khor rnams dang rta phyugs la gnod pa cher byas pas/ kho gnas pa'i brag ri la thog phab nas brag ri rnams nas dang sran ma tsam du btang nas gtor bas/kho bros nas phyi mig bltas pas mig ya gcig la thog zer phog pas khos sku mdun du yong ste sems can la gnod pa mi byed pa dang / chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob rgyud rnams kyi grogs dan byed pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi sgom pa blangs te bka' bzhin sgrub par dam bcas/da lta yang nyu gu na'i btsan zhar du grags/brag ri thang mar brdal ba'i shul da lta yang mngone mtshan che bar yod/'gro don la g.yas bskor gyis na'i phu nas yar lung gi phur gyon pa'i lam khar yar lha sham po 'khor bcas kyis kha ba nyin mtshan bdun bsdud nas phab pas nag 'jigs sgor gsum gyi rgyud man ngag la zhin tu mkhas ba/rje btsun rang gi rgyal tshab tu bkod dgongs pa'i dge bshes gzhon pa gcig gangs 'khugs nas grongs pa la brten nas/thugs 'ur te sbyin sreg thab tu ting nge 'dzin gyis yar lha sham po 'khor stong phrag 'ga' dang bcas bkug ste bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod do/ /yar lha sham po kho rang slar ting nge 'dzin gyis gsos pas sku mdun du lo bcu drug tsam gyi rnam pa can khye'u g.yu yi smin ma dang dung so 'khor mar yod pa zhig byung ste/ rje btsun lags btsun chung zhig grongs pa la nga'i 'khor rnga gzhang can stong phrag mang po pha 316

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po do rje grags kyi rnam thar/rol tu bsgral na'ang bdag rang slar gsos pa zugs rjes bzung lags/phyin chad sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed pa dang khyad par du dge 'dun la gnod 'tshe mi byed par dam bca' phul te/ khyed btsun chung gzhon pa gcig la de tsam gyi thugs rtsis yod na/ ngas yar lung phu mda' nas btsun chung brgya dang skra phud bzhes pa'i 'bul bar gser zho brgya phyag tu 'bul zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ khos zer ba bzhin yar lung rtsa mda' nas btsun chung rnam dasad can brgya lhag tsam gser casna brgya lhag dang bcas pa byung ste/ mi las lha 'dre khas blangs dang dam bca' la gnas pa 'dug gsung ngo //gel dgongs nas rje pad dkar 'dzin pas/ bskyed rim mthar phyin rdzogs rim mngon du gyur //sdigs mdzub tsam gyis rab brtan lhun po yang / /thal bar byed pa'i nus ldan rdo rje grags/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i zhabs la gasku la ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /g.yu dmar 'bri lci mas thog drangs g.yu 'phreng 'dom gsum ma dang / 'dom bzhi ma skusnad pa sogs dngos dbyad mang po byin nas/ e dwags kong gsum dbyas gtsang thams cad du skye bo ma rungs pa rnams la ri rgya klung rgya bsnams/bston du bzung ba rnams kyang thar bar mdzad de/mdor na chos kyi sbyin pa byams pa'i sbyin pa zang zing gi sbyin pa mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya sems can rnams smin 〈snal lam la 'god par mdzad/ rje btsun dwa los sku tshe de la kong bo yan chad kyi dbus 317

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/gtsang gi sa thams cad dang / bal yul gyi bar gyi gdul bya thams cad la spyir chos mang du gsungs/dgon sde mang du btab/khyad par gzhin rje'i gshed kyi skor rnams 'khor nyis stong tsam la rgyun du gsung par snang bas/ de rnams las 'phel ba ni bgrang bar mi zhus 31//sku che'i smad la skyid sgod kyi stod ldan lung par bzhugs nas 'phrin las skyong bar gnang zhing /ldan mda'i sngon bo gdong gi rtser ldan gsang sngags chos rdzong zhes pa'i sgrub sde mdzad nas/ sku che'i mthar dgra nag gi skor gyi bsdus don gsum mdzad de dgung lo brgya dang brgyad kyi dus ldan rdzong nyid nas mkha' spyod du gshegs/ sku gdung ril po ma nyams pa ldan mda'i mchod rten gyi bum par bzhugs pa me pho spre'u'i lo la sne'u rdzong nas drung chen nam mkha' bzang pos mtshan mo bum nang nas gdan drangs ba gzhung ko la spyan drangs te/'bras spungs kyi yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku 'dra rin bo che'i nang rten la da lta'i bar du ma nyams par bzhugs sku //de nas da lo rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa pho 'brug gi bar la lo nyis brgya dang bcu gsum song / sku gdung ma bzhugs kyang phyi'i mchod rten ni gtsang pos mi 'jig pa sogs ya mtshan par gzhugs sku da do//dwa gnyan gnyis kyi sku che'i smad la skyid sgod stod kyi ldan mda' dang 'brom stod gnyis su bzhugs/ sbyin bdag dang bu slob so sor gyur bas 'dod 318

kha skong dang bo/rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba ོ po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/gtam ༷nga lo rgyus mi mthun pa mang du /da kyang gong du bshad pa nyid tshad mar bya'//rnam thar rgyas pa shes par 'dad na rwa chos dbang dang rwa ye shes seng ge sogs kyis mdzad ba'i rnam thar rgyas pa las shes par bya'o// zhes gsal/ sa lasal sayang rgyud rgyal gzhan rje gshed skar gya chas 'byung rgyas pa yad ches ngo mtshar las/ bla ma bha ro phyag sdum dang /bla ma me tsa ling pa gnyis la/lo tsā shes pa'i slob ma rang yang mang mod kyi/slob ma'i thu bo 'gran gyi do zla med pa ni/rje bam dwa lha gagathordo rje gas ba'o//bla ma de ni la stod gnya' nga sa 'isnam gya yul de' nang tshan snang yul zhes par 'khrungs/ yab na dwa dkon mar ldo rje zhes bya ba/sngags rnying ma ba'i rigs zhig yin/byis pa 4 nga'i ///gle ///sa ri sa skabs ga/dpal lha re ma tī mngon sum du byon nas/nam bza' phu rungs kyi nang du bcug ste/spyir rgyal khams ྾ mang ba zhig bsgor zhing yul gyi bkod pa gzigs/ khyad par mdo khams sgo byang stod smad thams cad 'jam dpal gzhin rje'i gshed skor gyi gla ma brgyud pa'i chos 'byung gdul bya'i re 'dod skong ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 'greng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub 66 zhabs kyis mdzod pa/dha ram sa la/bod ṭwāṃ /bye bye// khang nas ༷༷7lor sbar du skrun/sgog grangs poḥbar las 9

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/bstan/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du de ltar byung / nang mi rnams kyis bu stor bar thag bcad/ de nas dpal lha mos yab yum gnyis kyi khyim du bskyal ba na/zla ba gsum po de'i ring la lo gsum gyi lus skyed byung / lo rgyus rnams bshad pas mi thams cad ngo mtshar che bar byed/phyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus kyang / khams pa'i grwa rigs mang bo 'dus pa la/ khyed kyi yul de ni 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes ri klungs chu zhing grong gi bkod pa sogs phra zhing phra ba thams cad yul so so rang gi mi bas kyang zhib par gsung pa zhig yod/ de nas sku cher skyes nas/re zhig khyim gyi 'tsho chis dang /'grog skyong ba sogs la'ang lo mang rab song / de nas bar skabs su thugs la dad pa 'khrungs te chos grwa 'gar byon nas/ phar phyin dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos thor bu ba yang mang du gsan cing mkhyen la/ de skabs nas bla ma dang / mched grogs gong ma thams cad 'pha byad dang spyod lam dang gus pas mnyes par mdzad/bar skabs su mnyam bar 'jog pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / sgrol ma sogs lhag pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa yang mang du mdzad/ dgyes rdor dang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyang rags pa mkhyen/de dag tu lo mang bo song zhing /bar skabs der grogs dang nye du rnams kyis bskul nas/ 'bre jo bo padma bya ba'i bu mo zhig kyang khyim thab tu bzhes/ snang yul la bsdud sgo re yang yod pa las/ mi ring pa cig na bud med des kyang mi dga' ltas te bor nas/ 'gro rje 320

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun dwa lo tsu ba chen po rwa rje grags kyi rnam thar/rtsad po'i bu 'dzom be zer ba cig gi sar song / gnya' snam yul pa dang / de dag gis ngan 〈snas bshams/ yul pa rnams 'e ga ste dmag byas bkrod bar brtsams pa las/re zhig mkhar la 'bras bas gnod ma thub/de nas nyan tsho gnas rnying gi 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ rgya gar la gshegs par bzhed pa zhig yul der phebs pa dang mjal nas/ khong gi phyag phyi la 'brangs/ bal yul du byon/mthu zhu bar bzhed de/ me tsa ling pa dang / bha ro phyag sdum la nyi ma gcig la chos sne btags/ thog ma nyid du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang bskur zhus/lag len bslabs te bsten pa dang sgrub pa mdzad/'o gcig lhag tsam na zhal gzigs kyi mtshan ma byung / las rnams 'grub nges pa 'dug nas/ bod du 'gro ba'i mi 'ga' la lon bskur te/ 'bro rje rtsad po dang / snang yul pa'i yul pa rnams la zla ba gsum gyi mthu dus btab/ drag po'i 'khor lo bskor bas zla ba gsum gyi nang du snang yul du rims nad sna ka mi 'dra ba mang po dus gcig tu byung / 〈snang brgya tsam skusnad pa gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad stongs/ rtsad po'i bu dang / bud med de gnyis la tshes bcu bzhi'i nam phyed cig 'ur sgra dang bcas te lcags kyi rgyur pa dngos su byung ste/ dpral ba phug nas zhi/ lo de kha'i khongs su rtsad po rang dang / g.yog pho mo drug cu tsam yang thi/rwa nag po'i mthu ba log rta log tu grags/de nas dwa chen pos pu rangs su mnga' bdag rtse lje la/ chos bsgyur ba'i 321

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/mthun rkyen zhur byon/ gser sogs yo byad mang bo rang byung ste/slar yang bal yul du phebs/ rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du dge slong mdzad/ sngar gyi bla ma rnam gnyis dang / gzhan yang rgya bal gyi paṇa grub mang 〈sna bsten/ blo ba dpon zugs rje chen po gsang sngags chos kyi bang mdzod yin pas rtsa ba'i bla ma de la mdzad/bde mchog rtsa rgyud/sa bu ṭi/rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/he ru ka mngon byung / a snyi dha na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud drugagazhin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/'jam dpal mtshan brjod/lū yi smad lnga/ nag po gzhung drug /dkyil chogo bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ sgrub thabs don gsal dang / phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i chos skor sogs rtsal du thon par sbyangs ba mdzad/ mgon nag dang par bu semags gdams ngag phra yo mang bo yang gsan/ gtum yo/ rlung sbyor/ sems 'jog gi sgom sogs zab don mang po'ang gsan/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud zhor nyan du mdzad pa'ang mang po yod gsung / slar yang 'khor lo sdom pa dang / gzhin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa bskyar ma'ang mang du mdzad/bal bor lo1 bco lnga tsam bzhugs/skabs der bod la ma byon kyang / mnga' ris kyi rgyal bo dbang phyug lde la gser slongs kyi pho nya btang ba la/ gser mang du byung bas phal cher bla ma rnams kyi zhabs tog mdzad cing / gdams ngag gi 'gro zhus/ gser lhag ma mang du bsnams nas/rgya gar ma ga dhar byon/zla ba drug tsam bzhugs/rdo rje gdan/bi kra ma zhi la 36322

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba wo po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/tan ta pu ri rnams su mchomad pa rgya cher mdzad/ 1snan lam btab/ na lan da'i lha khang thams cad la yang mchod pa mdzad/ dge 'dun ni mi bzhugs/ dkon gnyer rnams chim par byas/ ma ga dha'i mkhas pa rnams la chos 'brel re tsam gsan pa ni mang du yod par 'dug/dogs gcod kyang mang du mdzad/'on kyang ma ga dhar mchod pa mdzad pa yin/ thugs gnyer rang ma mdzod ces kyang grags te/ yun ring ba rang ma bzhugs pa min pa slob gnyer ni mdzod par shes so/ /de nas dbyar cig pu rangs dang / ya rtser byon/ rgyal bo go gnyis kyang dgyes pas chos 'khor re yang mdzad/de nas las stod la mar byon dus/ sngar gyi dgra rnams lta ci smos/phyogs gtogs tshun chad kyang stongs nas med pas bag zon dgos pa ni gcig kyang med/ mthu bo che de byung zhes thams cad 'jigs 'jigs byed/ rnyed bkur dang chos zhu mkhan tsam ma byung / de nas dbyas gtsang gi gzhung kun la phebs/ mthu chen gyi grags pa la brten nas sku ba31da rgyas/ lha sa bsam yas gnyis su chos 'khor cung zad re yang mdzod/ lo shas song yod par 'dug /paṇḍita spyan drangs na 'gro phan che bar dgongs te/ mnga' ris nas de bar la phyag tu 'a〈snar ba'i rjes bzang rgu phar bsnams nas/ bla ma rnams la tshogs 'khor dang 'bul ba cher mdzad/dī baṃ ka ra rakṣi ta bod du spyan drangs/ grom pa man chad nas 'gro don 'ur 323

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/langs/ dbus kyi sgo byang thams cad dang / gnyal gyi bar du phebs/ chos thams cad gser chos su mdzad de/ rgyud so so'i rgyud mchod/ dbang yan/tshogs 'khor rgyud yon sogs phar bzhag /zhu rten rang la'ang /rdo rje 'jigs byed la gser srang gang / gzhan rnams la gser zho re re bab kyang / zhu ba po mi thob ba tsam byung / paṇḍi tas kyang bod du lo mang bo ma bzhugs 'ga' zhig lo bdun/ kha cig lo lnga zer/ phar phebs dus gser srang stong phrag gcig phyag tu phul/ gla ba la sku gas pa sku byad gzhan rtsis su ma btab/ yar lam la stod du'ang 'gro don cher byung / bal po'i bar du skyel ma mdzad/ de rjes dwa lo chen po sku bsod zhin tu rgyas/ khams stong bu bo yan chad dbyas gtsang kong po/gnyal lor/sgo brag tshun chod du lan mang du phebs/bzhugs yul mthil ni g.yas ru nub mdar mdzad/ bla ma dī baṃ ka ra bal yul du phebs pa'i rjes su sku ma 'das kyi bar la/ snga phyir 'bul chen lan sum cu so bdun bskyal/ 'bul ba re re'i steng du res tsa du zhes bya ba btsun pa nyis brgya tsam bsags pa la/ mchod ston yon bcas re dang / res ha du ste sngags pa nyis brgya tsam bsags pa la tshogs 'khor sku1na bcas re mdzad/ bla ma bha ro phyag sdum la gser srang srang lnga brgya phul/ gzhan yang bka' drin che ba'i bla ma lnga tsam yod pa la'ang / gser srang brgya lhag re phul/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du mchodi pa'i thes la/gser srang brgya phrag re snga phyir lan mang bo dang /bi kra ma 324

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/shrī la/o tanta pu ri/na landa rnams su nyi khri dang /brgyad stong pa/mngon rtogs rgyan dang bcas pa'i 'chad nyan gyi thes dang / chung ba sdud pa 'chad pa'i zes sku gas bstan pa nam gnas bar du rgyal blon la/ zhing sa dang / lha 'bangs 〈snang zhu ba 31gas la/ gser srang brgya tsam nyis brgya tsam 'bul bar btang ba zhin tu mang / bla ma la gus shing zhabs tog che ba'i tshad du bzhag pa yin/de dag ni sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i rgyu rnams gtso bor smos pa'i skabs yin no//'bras bu gtso bor gyur ba'i che ba la/ lung bstan brnyes pa'i che ba cos gsungs ba'i che ba/ byin rlabs zhus mthu'i che ba/ sku bsod nams kyi che ba/mdzad pa phyag rjes kyi che ba'o//dang po ni/sprul pa'i chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang /ā tsarya bo dhi satās chos 'khor chen bo bsam yas la/ma 'ongs pa na me'i gnod pa 'byung ba'i tshe/'jam dpal gyi sbrul pa dge slong zhig gis gso bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de ni/ rje btsun dwa lo 'di yin/ klu mes kyis zhig gsos cung zad mdzad pa nas/ phyi ma'i bar du zhig gsos than thun byed pa mang du byung yang /me'i gnod pa gsos pa 'di kho ni yin no//gnyis pa ni gong du smos pa de rnams las/ sngon bod du gsan ba dang /phyis rgya bal du yang nor nyan tsam mdzad pa'i rigs rnams ye ma gsungs/325

gnya' nang snung 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/rgya bal gyi paṇa grub rnams kyi drung du nan tan nges stag rtsal 'don du mdzad pa rnams kho na gsungs/ lhad med yid chos can byin rlabs dang ldan pa sha stag yin/ dge bshes 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyi gsung nas/ chos cig la dge bshes dwa ba'i chos las zhe kha gzhin pa med/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams 'di skad gsung bya ba las rang bzo dang / bod kyi sra bsre gtan nas med pas so//ces gsung /gsum pa ni/ yi dam 'jam dpal 〈snas pa dang mi lab pa bzhin bzhugs/'khor lo bde mchog dang /rdo rje phag yo dang / 'jam dpal zhi ba'i yang zhal gzigs/ bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal snang can ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog zhus la brtan pa thob/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang / rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la mnga' brnyes/ las kyi gzhin rje dang / lang ma'i bdag po bran du 'khol/ mgon po nag po lcam dral gyis kyang gsung bzhin bsgrub/ dbang bskur tshad la ye shes phebs zhing snang ba bsgyur zhus/ bsam gtan gyi las bzhi yang grub/de lta bu'i rtags ni la stod phyogs su gong du smos pa ltar rtags bstan ba dang /phyis ngan lam yul gyi sri mnga' dang /byang phyir chos gsung pa'i skabs zhig /ngan lam nyu gu sna pa rnams kyis mthu yod med blta 'o zer nas mdzo rta ded/ 'bul skyel ba bcom pa la/ rwa los grong bskrad pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pas/326

kha skong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po ldo rje grags kyi rnam thar/ngan lam 'bar bo la sogs pa 'ga' zhig spyo nas gar song cha med/ zla ba gnyis gsum nas nyu gu sna'i yul ba dang / dge 'dun rgyal sar sgang pa 'khrugs/rgyal sar sgang pa'i rgyab tu klu mes tsho thams cad 'gril nas/nyu gu sna pa grong nyis brgya tsam byang rgyab tu yul dud do//yang skyogs 'dul 'dzin gyi slob brgyud/ skyogs dbang grags zhes bya ba dang po 'dul 'dzin yud tsam byas/phyis dang tshugs can gyi gsang sngags par rlom pa cig gis/ rwa 'o1 'dra mchod rten chag ro yin zer nas bla ma la skur 'debs byed cing / chos 'khor 'gegs pa byung / de la thugs khros te sbyin sreg mdzad/ zhag bdun nas skyogs dbang grags gzer thung btab nas 'das/ lo tsā ba rgyus smon lam grags dang nang rgyas byung ba yang / zla ba drug tsam nas rgyus lo sku 'das/ zangs mar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab gsang ba'i bdag po zhal gzigs/ rnam sras bran du 'khol/ zhes grags zhing zhus mthu dang ldan pa yin yang yin/ me tsa ling pa rje btsun gyis bod la spyan drangs dus/ khong gis me tsa ling pa chen po nyid ro dbyar thang du sbyan drangs/ chos 'khor mdzad pa sogs de dus legs lam du yod kyang /phyis dwa lo sku bsod rgyas pa la/ zangs kur gyis phrag dog gi tshul gyis rwa los chos mkhas bo mi shes zer brnyas pa yang mang du mdzod/ dang po paṇḍi ta kho pas sbyan drangs kyang / chos thams cad ngas bsgyur ba zhe tshe yin zhes 'phya smod mdzad kyin lha 327

sa ra yo cher rwa lo'i chos 'khor dgag pa sogs nang rgyas byung /de'i lo dus la zangs mkhar glo bur du bsnyung nas sku 'das/ gcung po dang nye gnas kyang de nas cang ma lon par zhi'o/ /mar pa lo tswa'i jo sras dar ma mdo sde yang yin te/ rje btsun 'di sgo brag stod smad du 'gro don mdzad pa'i skabs thig /yon bdag shud ke bya ba cig gis gson ston la spyan drangs/ khong ngad tsho dang sngar 'dris kyi skusnan mchod yin pas dar ma mdo sde yang byon/ bla ma 'edze tsā ba las kyang bkur thos che ba tsam byed kyin 'dug skad/ rwa lo'i gsung gis/ chos mkhas na ni ngas kyang khyed la dag pa byin pas chog /de min nged sgo bal du phyin pa'i lo tsā ba yin/ khyed bod ston tsam du ka gda' bas/ sa gcig tu khyed kyi 'gying thabs 'di rang bag min nam/ chos kyi gleng bslang byed dgos gsungs pas/ dar ma mdo sde na re/ nga pha tshe rabs nas sangs rgya ba'i ches byed mkhan yin/ khyed rwa nag po bya ba ngan snags la blo gtod pa dang mi 'dra zer nas/ dngos su gshe zhing ltag lab mdzad thegs song / de nas zla ba gcig tu nye tsam na dar ma mdo sde rnga mo chu 'od kyi ltad mo'i sar rtas brdabs te skad cig la grongs/ 'di la ding sang gi lo rgyus khyab che ba tshon/mar pa bzhugs pa'i dus su yin pa dang / mi la ras pa rta gdong pa yin go ma chod byung ba sogs 'chad kyang / mar pa'i sngon la mdo sde 'das pa min/'di skabs mar pa sku 'das nas 'byu shas song / mi la ras pa tho phyi na 328
