kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po ra 1 grags kyi rnam thar/bzhugs pa med do/ /des na lo rgyus mang po de dag rdzun phal ka sgrigs su shes par bya'o//yang 'brog mi jo sras in dra de/dbyas su nor 'tshol la byon pa gtsang rong gi re dngul gyi chos sder/rwa lo chen po dang 'dzom/chos kyi gleng bslang mdzod pa la/ de na re/ 'obyu tsā ba dang / 'epha tsā ba mi 'dra/ bsgro theng byed dgos med zer bas/ dwa lo thugs khros te/ lo tsā ba dang / lo tsā ba ka cis kyang mi 'dra/gzod blta'o gsung /de nas zla ba gsum nas 'brog mi jo sras khrag tu 'khru ba'i rims nad byung nas dbyas su ka 'das/gcung po jo sras rdo rje yang phyis mi ring bar 'das zer/ yang bla ma lo tsā ba gtsang rong gi g.yung du chos 'khor zhig mdzad kyin yod/der khams pa jo sras rdo rje sra brtan bya ba rnying ma'i ma mo dang /phur ba la mkhas/zhus pa sku da par yang 'dod/gsar ma sku gas mdo sngags gzhan yang ci rigs shes pa zhig skusnad/ des 'dra men srang gang gi tshod tsam phul nas rdo rje 'jigs byed zhus pa la/ bla mas kyang stod brtag pa'i phyir/rdo rje 'jigs byed yin pa ltar mdzad nas/gdong drug gi dbu nas bag tsam gsungs/ chos thun 'ga' zhig song ba na/ rgyud mchod mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du/ bla mas mgur ma la/ khyod kyis gser dang 'dra ba'i 'dra men phul/ /ngas 'jigs byed 'dra ba'i gdong drug bshad/ /ces gsungs pas khodze ma mgu /sang snga smadar khordza casnas chas byed pa la/ grwa pa rnams kyis gros btab kyang ma nyan par 'gro khar kha rdeg byas te rong gi rwa rgan lo 329

gnya' nang tshong 'dus ba'i bya tsha rgyal khams pa/tsā la/ /'jigs byed dud 'gro'i mgo can nyan pa las/ /sman lung gi dbyal ston lo tsā la/ /rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje zhu ba dga'/ /zhes zer gyin song / de nyin chos gral la kho ma byung bas/ ci yin gsung pa na/ grwa pa rnams kyis lo rgyus zhus pas/mi nga la brnyas su btub ste/lha 'di la brnyas su mi btub/'di la brtags ma bstan na mi rung gsung ste de ma thag sbyin sreg mdzad pas/khams pa de yang de'i nang bar tsam rang yin yod par 'dug /sman lung du ma sleb pa la/ lam du khrag skyugs nas thi/ dwa 'o chen pos sman lung gi dbyal 'o( kun dga' ldo rje la 'phrin pa brdzangs te/nga'i grwa pa khyod kyis blo brkus 'dugakhyod spungs bskyed la sgur zhig gsungs bas/ dpyal lo thugs zhin du skrag nas/'bum gser ma gcig gis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang bo bsnams te dag 'tshangs la phebs pas dwa lo chen po'ang dgyes par byung /dpyal los rwa chen po la chos kyang mang du gsan/ zugs dam thang sku cig kyang dpyal la gnang yod par 'dug go/yang bal por bla ma'i phebs skyel la byon ba'i skabs zhig kyang / kri ni jo bo dang / bun jo bo la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod cing / bla ma'i sku dgrar gyur pa mu stegs pa'i bla chen bzhi tsam mngon sbyod drag po'i las kyis bsgral bar gda'/ grags tshod kha skad du/ dar ma macasna sde la sku gas pa/྅te rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum bsgral zhes grags/dang po nas gzungs ma rungs pa'i mi re re gnyis gnyis la bsad 330

kha sgong dang bo/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/bskrad dbye rengs sogs kyis tshar bcad pa la rtsis btab med/lo tsā ba dang dge bshes chos 'khor mdzad pa thams cad/ dwa lo chen po la dgongs pa zhu dgos pa yin par 'dug /mi ma yin gdug pa can tshar gcad pa ni/ ngan lam nyu gu sna'i btsan bya ba sngon slob dpon padma byon dus yib thub pa yin/dam 'og tu ma chud zer ba'i bdud btsan zhin tu rdzu 'phrul che ba chos la gnag pa cig yod/ nye skor der gsang sngags kyi sgrubs pa dang chog gra byed sa med/ dge 'dun mchod na lo nyes gtong ba cig yod zer/tu gu sna'i yul pa rnams kyis dwa lo la sdig gsog byed pa yang des bskul ba yin/ rwa lo chen po byang phyir bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'khor la btsan des cung zad gnod pa byed pa byung bas/ nub gcig gtor ma che ba cig mdzad nas dgongs pa brtad/de'i rgyun la zhag bdun sgrub pa mdzad pas/ zhag lnga pa'i dgong cig/btsan gyi gnas brag dang lha rten la thog smad dgu babs/ brag chad lha rten gar song med/kho thul 'og tu chud de dngos su gzugs bstan/bshags pa phul/dam la bzhag kho'i yul dang 'khor thams cad brlag kho rang yang mig zhar bas khyu gu sna'i btsan zhar du grags/phyin chad chos la gnod pa gcig kyang byed mi thub bo/yang sku che'i smad kyi dus thig yar lungs su lha btsun sngon pos sbyan drangs te chos 'khor mdzad/ de nas gnyal phyogs la phebs par bzhed do/331

/yar la shams bu'i gangs 'gram du bzhugs dus/ shams pos gangs chen po phab ste la bkag grwa pa gcig kyang 'khugs nas zhi ba la/ bla ma'i gsung gis/shams po sdugs pa che mno'am//rwa gon 'o( tsā gis mno'am//'jigs byed zhus pa chung mno'am/ /rwa mtshon rtse sa zad mno'am/ /ces gsungs zhing gangs ri la bdungs stangs mdzad dgongs pa yun ring du brtad pas/ dam thag brdung stangs mdzad sa nas gangs chen bo 'ur/ nam phyed kyi dus thig na/shams po kho rang khye'u dkar bo gcig gi gzugs su byas nas/phyag zhung zhung 'tshal zhing / bdag gi 'khor rnga shang thogs pa stong phrag lnga ni dus gcig tu gum song / da bla ma'i gra pa gcig thi ba la grwa pa brgya dang brgyad kyi yus byed/gser srang brgya dang brgyad kyang 'bul/ bzod pa mdzad de rjes su bzung bar zhu zer/de ma thag yul yang mjam por gyur to/ /dpon slob rnams kyis kyang zhag shas de kur bzhugs/zhag bdun gyi khongs su/yar lungs phu mda' nas/grwa pa byed pa brgya brgyad kyang byung / gser srang brgya rtsa brgyad phyag tu'ang 'byor bas/'dre 'di pa chad la btsan par 'dug gsung /de rjes gnyal du chos 'khor mdzod/ de nas sgo brag ban pa dang / gru shul dang la yag kun du'ang phebs/klu bdud thog 'bar bya ba dang /mdze mo spun lnga zer ba'i klu srin sa gdug pa can yod/ lam la 'gro ba'i mi kun gyis kyang /phyag phul mchod yar byed dgos/ ma byas na cho 'phrul 'bral du 'ong / mtshan 332

kha skong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/mo su yang rgyu 'phrul byed mi zhus/ mngon sum du mi khyer ba'ang mang po yod/deskabs kyang bag ma 'gro ba cig rta thog nas gar song med par sbas te lo gcig gnyis song / dwa lo chen pos phebs lam du de dang nye bar tsha phogs mdzad/ khal ma rnams kho'i gnas kyi tshal gling dang nee thang la btsos pas/kho'i cho 'phrul gyis mdzo gcig thi/ bla ma zugs khros te mdzo sga bcag /sbyin sreg gi yams zhing la phul/ klu bdud pho yo 'khor bcas de ma thag tshig yod par 'dug/sngar sbas pa'i bud med de gson po skyon med du thon/des lo rgyus bshad/klu bdud kho lo tsā ba dpon slob kyis/tsha phogs mdzad pa la'ang nga la phyag mi 'tshal ba zer nas 'khya/phyugs btsos pas zhin tu khros te/ mtshon cha 'phangs/de dud 'gro gcig la phog pa yin/sbyin sreg mdzad par brtsams pa na/ khodze bzhad gad byed 'a〈sna la 〈snags thams cad nas mun nag na bun 'dra ba bstibs/ gang yang ma mthong ba cig la lung pa mes khengs nas de thams cad tshig /de skabs sa rang yang skrag dngangs chen bo byung ste/ de nas gnyid sad pa 'dra ba cig la gang yang mi 'dug zer/de nas mi ring bar gnas de'i chu mig thams cad bskams par gda'/ de dag masna'i pa tsam yin/ chorshasu la bar du gcod pa'i mi ma yin mang po yang btul lo//gsum pa sku bsod nams kyis che ba la/ longs spyod zas nor char bzhin babs/ mi chen so sos zhabs tog byed pa la grangs med/ chosaspenan rnams 333

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/brtsis na yig 'bru re re la gser srang re'i rtsis byung / nam bza' gsang lam ma gtogs sku la snal ma mi 'bri/ de dus rgyun 'brum zhin tu dkon pa'i skabs yin yang / rgyun 'brum bre lnga lnga'i rgyun skyems kha che'i lugs nyin re bzhin du sbyor/rgya bal gyi thing thog mang po mi rnyings pa'i thabs byas te/paṇḍi ta dang / rgyal blon tsong dpon sogs kyis 'bul mkhan yang yang yong ste/ rgya gar gyi zhing thog so ma la rgyun ma 'chad gsol du yod pa sogs/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi rjes su 'di bas bzhes thang che ba med par grags/ dus rgyun gyi 'khor tshogs 'dus pa la/ chos nyan pa po brgya phrag du ma rgyun mi 'chad cing / sngags pa dpe 'grems brgyad brgya dang / btsun pa dpe 'grems stong nyis brgya re yang yang 'dus/ gsang sngags kyi chos grwa la 'di las che ba dus gsum khegs pa yin/sngon chos dar ba'i skabs mdo pa dang sngags pa mi 'dra/ sngags chos la mchedi pa dang yon chen po dgos pas/phal pa cig gis mi 'grub/gzhan sngon dus sngags pa 'du 'tshog che sgos rang mgos khug pa la yang / dus gcig la dbe 'grems bdun brgya las lhag pa ma byung nge te/khyad par phyi 'khor tshogs ni/ mi che ba jo bo rtsad po'i rigs kun dang / zhang sgra chen la sogs pa 'byor ldan kun dang / brang sta dbang phyug grags dang / g.yu thog dar po la sogs pa sman pa chen 〈sna thams cad kyis kyang zhabs la gtugs/ zhang tshes 〈snang ba 334

kha sgong dang po/rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po 'o rje grags kyi rnam thar/dang /'bre chen po dang /'ban dkon mchog rdo rje dang /rtag pa kha che la sogs pa mtshan nyid pa chen po thams cad dang /zhang sang gha dang /gtsang thang 'od po dang / sgang sind+ra dang / snar nyi ma dang / klun rdor po dang / rgya long chos grags dang /rtsangs yang dag 'bar dang /ngog mdo sde dang /rsha rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang /skyur a skyabs dang / ngo khro 〈snan tshul la sogs pa gsar ma ba'i dge bshes thams cad dang / zur hor bo dang / yang keng bla ma dang / byang chub 'bar la sogs pa rnying ma ba chen po rnams dang / pa reg lo tsā ba dang / dbyal lo la sogs pa lo tsā ba mang po ste/ de dus kyi dge bshes dang mi chen phal cher gyis zhabs la gtugs sdu //mcho da gnas gzhan lta casnag /gsung rab gcig 〈sna phyag tu phebs pa la yang / mdo sde yongs rdzogs tshar drug cu dang / 'bum cha nyis brgya lhag pa phyag tu byon pas mtshon/nor rdzas tha mal pa smos kyis ga la lang /slob ma mi chen rnams kyi mtshan dang / skusna sdu1sa zhabs tog byas tshul rnams rgyas par rwa ye shes seng ge'i gsung las shes par bya'o//lnga pa mdzod pa phyag rjes kyi che ba ni/ rgya bal du phyag rjes dge rtsa mdzod tshul gong du smos zin/bod kyi dbang du byas na/chos 'khor bsam yas su rba dang / raka zhi'i sde 'khrugs byung ste/ 'khor sa bar pa dang / brang khang thams cad mes tshig go /de rjes lo sum cu tsam song yang / dkor bdag gnyan cha 335

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/ches pas zhig gasku'os byed mkhan yang med/ rba rag gzhung ma 'dums pas/dgon gnas 'dzin mkhan med par/ dkon gnyer re tsam ma gtogs stongs pa bzhin du gyur/de skabs dwa lo chen bos zhig gsos mdzad par dgongs te/ba lam klag gi phu la phebs pa'i skabs/ dkor bdag dbe mar gyis dkon gnyer la gzugs dngos su bstan te/ sang snangs 'dir 'jigs su rung ba cig yong ba 'dug/'dir sdod pa'i dbang mi 'dug zer nas gros pa dngos su mthong / su yong snyam tsa na/ zhag gsum song nas rwa lo chen bo phebs/ mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas/dkon gnyer la khyod kyi dkor bdag gar song gsungs/de nas dkor bdag kyang blos/ bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad/ 'ol ku'i shug nags chen po zhig bcad de/ zhing rnams gtsang po'i stengs nas yar drangs/thag pas cung zad re 'dren pa ma gtogs/ nya gyen la rgyugs pa bzhin dka' tshegs ye ma byung / bsam yas kyi zhig ga31sa la nas khal 'bum phrag gcig gi rtsis song / dbyar lo gsum la gying ris tshun chod mthar phyin/ rba rag sde pa gnyis la mthun par bsgrigs dam bzhag mang po mdzad nas/ dge 'dun gyi sde sngar bzhin tshugs par mdzad do/ /g.yas ru gtsang 'gram lha khang yang zhin tu gogs thing zhig ral du gyur ba la/ dbya rtse dang 'khyams thams cad la zhig gsos mdzad/ nas khal khri tsho gcig gi rtsis song / de'i dge 'dun 'thor ba yang bsdu bar mdzad/336

kha sgong dang bo/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/sku che'i smad kyi dus cig na/ g.yu me tog spungs pas sna drangs pa'i g.yu byang kho na'i 'phreng ba spe mo che zer ba mkhar thog so lnga pa cig gi dar cog gi rtse nas bzung na sa la 'khyil ba tsam zhig skusnad pa dang / gzhan yang zab yugadar yug/go khrab/stang rtse/mdzo rta sogs dpag tu med pa rnams ni/ngur sgrigabye mda'/ rgyus thang / nyan tsho/ lcang ra/ shar skyam/ ri dngul sogs gtsang gi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams dang / rgyal lha khang sogs dbyas kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la/so sor thes su sbyar nas chos 'chad pa'i thes dang /dge 'dun gyi zhabs sheteg/lha khang gi macesad pa/mtha' na ma〈snan zan gyi bar du bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar cha rkyen du gnang / gzhan yang dge 'dun gyi sde so sor rten gsum dang / sbyi rdzas dang / phyag 'gyed kyi dngos bo btang ba la grangs med/de bzhin du 'bum bcu drug dum rang yang brgya dang bzhi bcu tsam bzhengs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad/ sku drung du rgya gar gyi a tsar paṇḍi ta brgyad stong pa 'don mkhan brgyad re dang / lū yi pa bsgom mkhan re ste/ mchod gnas rgya gar ba dgu re rtag tu 'degs/ bod kyi gsung rab la sher phyogs stong tshar dang / mdo sde brgya tshar lan mang du skusnang / mtha' na tsha tsha rang yang 'bum brag 'bum phrag lo star gyis mdzad/ gson dge mdzad pa la ngog lo tsā ba'i chos 'khor la nas khal khri tsho gcig dang / 'bum gyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba chen po bskyal/ de dang mnyam pa glang ri thang pa dang / btsan kha bo che dang / rgya 337

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/'dul 'dzin rnams la yang mdzad/ rog macani pa pa la sogs pa gzhan yang dge bshes ji snyed pa zhig la chos 'khor btsugs thing 'bul ba mang du mdzad do/ /bla ma lo tsā ba 'di sku tshe yang ring por bzhugs pa zhig ste/ dpal me tsa ling pa sbyan drangs pa'i dus na dgung lo drug cu lhag tsam du phebs par gda'/ de nas 'phrin las mgo rgyas pa yin/ de rjes mi ring ba na/ sdog lo chen po'i 'phrin las kyang mgo tshugs/ ngog 'o sku 'das nas kyang rwa 'ephas 'epha nyi shu lhag par bzhugs/ sku che'i smad 'o mang por gzhan la gshegs bzhud ma mdzad de/ she'u me tog ldan du bzhugs 'dug /dgung lo brgya dang bcu bzhugs bya ba dang / brgya brgyad bzhugs bya ba sku1gas 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug kyang / lo rtsis nges gsal mi gsung ba cig yin pa 'dug pas/sgra ji bzhin bshad dka' na'ang / dgung lo brgya sgor cig bzhugs par nges/bsad pas tshe ring 'grub pa ni/dwa gon lo tswa'i khyad chos yin//gsungs skad/mthar bsnyung ba med par ye shes bo nga 'a〈sna mdzad de sku 'das/ dathe na wa 'o( tsā ba chos rab kyis dge 'dun gyi sde chen bo nyi shu tsam sbyan drangs nas/ sku snad rgya chen po mdzad/ zhag shas nas sku gdung du mngon pa cher ma byung / khru gang tsam yod zer/ cung zad cig ston pa rin chen rdo rjes zhi ba'i thab khung cig tu zhugs la phul/ sgra dang 'od dang / me tog gi char sa gzhi khengs pa byung / sku ldad kyi skul ba skyel ba la/ ston pa rgyal ba zhes bya bas bal yul du phyin te 338

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen bo rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/gser sung brgya bzhig pa'i mchod pa dang / gser srang brgya'i 'dra men gyi rnyed pa phul lo/ /rgya gar bi kra ma dang / rdo rje gdan du de dang phyogs mtshungs pa byas par grags sku1//de ltar na rnam thar lo rgyus mdo tsam mo/ /'dir ma 'dus pa rnams ye shes seng gis mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang / de'i lhan thabs gnyis las shes par bya'o/ /rnam thar gyi yi ge rgyas pa gzhan zhig sngon dus byung zer na'ang /deng sang med par mngon/ spyir yang sngon dus kyi lo tsā ba rnams la/ rnam thar khrigs chags ma chen mo'i rigs khungs dang ldan pa cher mi snang bas/ 'o( rgyus kyi ngo bo 'di tsam yang rgyas pa yin par mngon no/ /phyis kyi kha skad 'khyam 〈sna la/ dwa 'epha dang gnyan 'o( nang rgyas byung zhes kun la grags pa ni mi bden te/ nag po'i rgyud nag tshos bsgyur ba la gnyan gyis bcasnas/ de la dwa 'o(sa bcos pas kyang mtshon/ gnyan 'ordzo dang sngags pa nang rgyas byung ba de ni/bla ma rdo lo tsā ba yin zhes skyo pa'i yig rnyings khungs ma rnams las bshad/de yang gnyan lo rdo lo gnyis bsdud khongs la rtsod pa byung bas/ gnyan lo na re/ nang bar khyod kyi mgo la phur ba rtsa das se ba cig bya yi/ ces lon bskur bas/rdo lo na re/khyod dag ngan sngags 'dras sgos pa yin te 'ong / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la su yis bdo/ khyed rang thobs zhig zer/ rdo los bdung stangs byed kyin yi dam chos skyong bskul bas/ gnyan lo'i zugs kur 339

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/sgog 'bur wo po byung ste/ cang ma lon par grongs zer bar 'dug /rdo lo tsā ba de phyis deng sang grags chung yang kha che laka mi gyi slob ma yin/ chos rnam grangs mang po mi mkhyen/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kho na la chig 'dril mdzad/yi dam gsang yang mi gsang / gzhan la 'chad kyang mi 'chad/ mthu stobs thogs pa med pa cig yod zer ba 'dug /blun pa las kyang ches blun pa ngag zhal bzhi pa dang las gzhin la lha 'dras yod/ bya rog gdong can dang pu ṭa la lha 'dras yod/ phyag drug pa dang / gur zhal la lha 'dras yod zer ba skusnags ni go ba ye ma chags pa'i gtam ste/ shes ldan thams cad khrel ba'i gnas so//spyir ye shes kyi lha 'khrug pa mi srid/sngags mkhan nang rgyas byung yang /yi dam 'khon pa ga la yod/ dber na bod mi cig gi lag tu rgya gar gyi ral gri byung / cig sgos kyi lag tu rgya nag gi ral gri byung nas/ bod mi de gnyis 'thabs kyang / rgya gar rgya nag gnyis la 'khon mi 'ong ba bzhin no/ /nyi ma dbyings su shar pa'i 'od phyogs thams cad du khyab pa ltar/ye shes lha'i rig sngags sems can gyi don la kun tu khyab pa na/ de'i cha shas phra mo tsam re/sngags mkhan gnyis kyis blangs te 'thabs pa la/ ye shes dbyings kyi lha la sgul skyod ga la yod/ 'di yang nan tan du go ba gal che ste/ 'di ma go bas rnam ltaphag ma langs dgu langs zhing / 'chal gtam gyis rgyal khams gangs 340

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen bo rwardo rje grags kyi rnam thar/'dug pa'i phyir ro//da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ rje btsun dwa lo chen po de nyid kyi thugs sras lo tsā ba chos rab ni rong gi she'u spe tog ldan du sku 'khrungs/ yab chos thams cad bum pa gcig nas gcig tu byo ba bzhin du thags su chud/ dwa lo chen po nyid las 'o tsā yang shin tu mkhas par bod yul nyidadu sbyangs/ bla ma chen po'i sku ldad grub nas bal por byon/ paṇḍi ta sa masta shrī la dpal dus kyi 'khoter 'o( gsan/'o( phyed dang lnga tsam na sems 'grel sgor gsum cha lag dang bcas pa la ches mkhas par gyur cing /dus 'khor rgyud 'grel 'gyur dpe snga ma la ma gzigs par rtsa 'gyur mdzad pa zhin tu legs par byung /skabs der bod du phebs/ 'gro don cung zad mdzad nas/ paṇḍi ta sa masto shrī bod du sbyan drangs/ dbyas gtsang kun du phebs/ phar log phebs dus gser srang sum brgya dus gcig tu phul/ skyid grong gi bar du skyel mar phebs/ bla ma'ang dgyes te/ bla ma nyid kyis dam tshig rdor dril dus 'khor lugs dang / bstan skyong 'bum phrag gsum pa'i grog zhu/ brgyad stong pa'i po ti dang bcas pa gnang /yang phyis rgya gar du phebs nas/ paṇḍi ta lnga gī bhā ra grubata la yang zugaphag sto so bdun ma la sogs pa'i chos sgor rnams bsgyur/ nag po chen po'i rgyud mngon byung yang bsgyur zhing dbang dang man ngag blangs/ de skabs he ru ka 341

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/mngon byung / phag mo mngon byung / mgon po mngon byung ste/ mngon byung skor gsum gyi tha snyad kyang byung / gsang sngags kyi lo tsā ba cig la bla ma 'di rang ca/khatheg par ba/ba/theg/de la sras gnyis mnga' ba las/ gcen bo ni rwa ye shes seng ge ste/ de yang dwa 'o chos rab kyi sku'i skusnan tan thams cad par btab pa bzhin mnga' ba yin/ rong khu lung gi se khyim zhes pa'i mkhar cig tu bzhugs/ rwa nub pa bar grags/ de'i sras ni rwa 'bum seng yin te/ de yang bla ma gong ma rnams la mnga' ba'i chos thams cad thugs su chub pa cig byung / ye shes seng ge dang /'bum seng gis kyang rgya bal du khor tsam re gshegs zhing /sgrub thabs thor bu ba sogs chos sna cung zad re 'gyur mdzad/ dwa lo ye shes seng ge dang /rwa lo 'bum seng du yang grags so//de la brgyud pa'i rigs kyi dbon sras brgyud pa'ang ci rigs phyis byung bar du yod par snang yang slob brgyud bzang / rigs brgyud grags chung ngo //dwa lo chos rab kyi sras chung ba ni/dwa dharma seng ge yin te/des she'u me rtog ldan du bzhugs/ de'i sras dkon mchog seng ge /de'i sras shes rab rgyal mtshan yin te/de rnams kyang nus mthu dang ldan zhing /nag po sgor gsum la mkhas ba/'khor lo sgom pa/dus 'khor/phag mo'i chos skor sogs kyang ci rigs pa mnga' ba byung de dag rnams la dwa shar par grags/ dwa shes rab 342

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen wa rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/rgyal mtshan pa'i rjes su/ dwa lcags mkhar ba sogs brgyud pa mang du gyes/slob brgyud la ru mtshams kyi rgya dbang phyug grags pa/ de'i sras rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ de khams su byon/ rgyal thang me long steng du bzhugs/mi nyag dang /dmar khams kyi yul du'ang lan mang du phebs/mthu stobs zhin du che'o/de la khams su slob ma mang /khams pa yon tan 'bum bya bas dbus gtsang du'ang khong gi lugs dar bar byas/ mchod rten dkar po ba sangs rgyas skyabs sogs slob ma mang du byung / des lha btsun bsam yas pa sogs la bshad nas da lta'i bar du dar/ rje btsun 'bum seng la zur du byon pa'i sras blo gros seng ge nas brgyud/ gdung rabs 'ga' re byon 'dug 'gro don che ba rang ma byung ba 'du/ slob brgyud bu chen bzang la mang ba byung / thugs sras kyi gtso bo rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje yin/ mdo sngags thams cad dang / khyad par dus 'khor la mkhas zhing grub pa thob/de'i sras rje shes rab seng ge dang / bla ma a ka ra gnyis kyang dus 'khor dang gzhin rje gshed la mkhas zhing /'jigs mdzad la brten nas zhus pa'ang thob po//rje sher seng nas brgyud pa la/mang mkhar lo tsā ba dang /bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/yang rje sher seng dang /bla ma a ka ra gnyis ka la/skyid ston grags rgyal gyis zhus/de la sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo kun mkhyen chen bos gsan/seng rgyan pa dang /kun mkhyen chen po la 343

zhang 〈snan rgya 〈snar grags pa/ mkhas pa bskusnad nams grags kyis gsan/'dis 'jigs mdzod kyi chos rgya cher spel/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin du grags pa'ang 'di'i slob ma'o//yang rje sher seng la khong rang gi dbon po rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la dbon po bsod nams lhun grub gyis zhus/ de la'ang 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis zhus so/ /yang dwa 'bum seng ge slob ma klog skya dbang phyug grags pa de gzhin rje gshed dang dus 'khor la mkhas pa cig byung / de la ldongs ston shes rab dpal gyis gshed sgor rnams zhus/ ldongs ston des mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mang po mkhyen/ brgyud pa tha dad sna tshogs kyi chos sna bzhugs rgya che zhing thams cad la mkhas pa cig yin yang /nyams len 1sna rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kho na gtso bor bton pas/ dus mthu yang chen po mnga'/ sku bsod che bas bla chen 'phags pa dang / rgyal po go be la'i bla mar song / gzhin rje'i 'khor lo'i skabs sogs 'ga' zhig tu/ snga ma rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos cung zad yod/ khong rang gi sgos kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams sdongs lugs pa zer ba byung / bla chen 'phags bas kyang rwa lugs rtsal 'don mdzad de spel bas/ sngar dkar po rnam gsum gyi dus su mdzad pa'i mal lugs de ni bag la zha ba ltar gyur to//bar skabs su dwa lugs 'di bo dong 'jam ral du grags pa nam mkha' 344

kha skong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/smon lam/'bri khung lo tsā ba mni ka/skyi rong lo tsā ba ngag dbang /gzungs kyi dpal ba/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ bla ma chos dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba/ slob dpon dge ba rgyal mtshan la sogs pas dar rgyas su byas/da lta'i bar du'ang dar ro//kha cig 'di la sa lugs kyi ming 'dogs pa ni 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nyid dang 'gal nyen gda' 'o/ /'dir byung tshul spyi khog tsam bshad pa yin gyi/ brgyud rim so so ba rnams ni brgyud yig las shes par bya'o/ /rwa lugs 'di la dgra gdong gnyis dkyil 'khor re dang / 'jigs mdzad la bcu gsum ma dang /ro langs brgyad bsgor te dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dbang rgyun da lta'i bar du yod do/ 4/ces dang /dzigazhin rje gshed dwa lugs kyi chos sgor la/ phyis bod yul 'di na dwa bod ces grags che bar snang ngo //re zhig 'di'i dkar chag tshigs bcad ma ni 'di yin te/le'u bco brgyad kun gyi gzhi//rgyud kyi rgyal po ston pas gsungs//de yi grogs su rtog pa gsum/ /sngags pa'i mtshon char gsungs pa yin/ /sgrub 4 rgyud rgyal gzhin rje gshed sgor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa yid ches ngo mtshar bzhugs so/ /rje btsun tā ra ṭwāṃ tha'i gsung 'bum bzhugs so/ /bod bcu pa/sa 93750 zu60la rgya 0(ba badzi607 'i khu0sto—6sa ba265ba dzi'iX33 706600skyab dzi la 71ba66khu167tshabasko0(pu 5 032ma nga baji 777ne 5༷/pa pakhu10206136 7670 glu'ab 377415677thal 7565 1984 dbyin ji'i sgog grangs nya 7ca345

thabs dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis/ /mdzad pa 'di la gtso bor bzung //'khrul 'khor gsal byed shuddha shrī/ /lus dang snying 'dra'i man ngag yod/ /ces nag po'i rgya gzhung dang / rgyud kyi spyi chings khog don yin/ /yig sna lus kyi rnam bshad yin//bla ma'i gsung bsdur bran tshegs rnams//ma go gegs sel gdams ngag yin/ /dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad gdams ngag la/ /gsal byed tsam gyi yi ge byas/ /bha ro'i phyag len dpal 'dzin gsung / /de brten dbang bskur gong ma la/ /yig sna bdud rtsi'i bum pa brtsams/ /chos bzhi 'chi med bdud rtsi dang / /mig sman sgrub pa'i gtam rgyud dang / /srung 'khor kha sbyor dbye ba dang / /las sgrub 'khor lo phyi ma dang / /rgyas gdab bla ma'i bzhed pa dang //bla ma'i zhal bsdur gtor ma dang / /sa 'og dgug pa'i gtam rgyud dang / /bla ma rnams kyi zhal bsdur dang / /he ru ka yi rnam bshad dang / /bar do byang chub sems bshad dang //glu yi rnam par bshad rnams dang //bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin du/ /zin bris byas nas bla ma la/ /gzigs pa phul nas dag par gtugs/ /mnyes nas de tsug yin zhes gsung / /char 'bebs lha dbang klu nad gtong / /sbrul bzung gso dang mgo nad zhi/ /chu bgag 'khyams dang ro langs bsgrub/ /'phags ma dzam gu li sgrub thabs/ /yum bzhi la skusnags bsgrub pa dang / /mig sman ril bu rkang mgyogs dang / /mkha' spyod thos pa bsgrub pa dang / /sa 'og mkha' spyod mi snang dang / /ral gcig balko sī bsgrub 346

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/dang / /lha dang klu yi bu yo dgug /man ngag gser zhun 'di dag rnams/ /rgyud kyi snying 'dra bla ma'i gsung / /bod kyi banadhes yi ger bkod/ /bla ma nyid la gzigs pa phul/ /nor 'khrul byung na dngos grub med/ /lhag chad e 'dug lan gsum zhus/ /rkang thag spangs nas lan gsum zhus/ /bla ma'i zhal nas legs zhes 'bod//nor 'khrul mi 'dug lan gsum gsung //ces nag po'i sgor gyi pod yig rnams dang / /bshad rgyud sdoms gsum ldan pa yod/ /dka' ba'i gnas bkrol yig sna byas//don bsdus gsal ba'i sgron me byas//dbang chog bdud rtsi'i bum chung byas/ /ces gdong drug gi bod yig dang / /snying po'i rgyud mchog rtog bdun yod/ /las mkhan te'u lo'i rtog pa yod/ /sgri bha dra yis mdzad pa'i/ /sgrub thabs lo tsās bsgyur ba yod/ /don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ /sgrub thabs dkyil chog sbyin sreg yod/ /dī ba ka ras sbyin sreg yod//ratna ā dar shān ti yis/ /mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod/ /bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum skusgod/ kha cig gsar 'gyur kha cig bcos/ /ces rdo rje 'jigs byed sgor gyi rgya gzhung dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun la/ /nag 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen brtsams/ /rkang 'grel 〈snags ma〈snang 'ben la btad/ /bcud kyi thigs pas phog par bsnun/ /gasku da pa'i mtshon de snying la gnas/kha rgyun yi ger ma bkod do//bsnyen bsgrub dgra srog dbang bsdud skusnad//mngon rtogs rim pa lnga yang yod/ /las bzhi'i sbyin sreg cho ga yod/ /dmar 347

po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yod/ /smon byed dkyil chog yig sna yod/ /ces 'jigs mdzad sgor gyi pod yig rnams so//dpe 'ga' zhig tu/ bsnyen sgrub las gzhin sbrags ma yod/ /ces 'byung /tshig lhug par yang de bzhin 'byung ngo / /'jug tu/ 'di dag rnams ni mi legs na'ang / /ban chung dwa yi lugs su snang / /'di ru ma 'dus yi ge'i tshogs/ /legs na'ang gzhan gyis sbyar ba yin/ /zhes sogs yod cing / nag po'i sgrub thabs dang /dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rnams la/ rwa 'obyu chen pos bsdus don re yod pa/ dkar chag tshigs bcad mar ma chug pa ni/ sku 'da' khar mdzad pas yin/ /cho sa rab kyis yi ge ma mdzad/ ye shes seng gis dgra nag la mngon rtogs dang / dharma seng ges bum dbang gi cho ga'i yi ge byas/ ces pa dang / paṇḍi ta zla ba byed pa'i lugs yod kyang rtsis su mi mdzad ces pa dkar chag tshigs bcad ma'i 'grel pa/ ga gong dpal gyi dgon par/dwa sher rgyal gyis bris gsung ba na yod do/ /'on kyang rwa chos rab kyi nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yig sna dang /ye shes seng ge dang /'bum seng gis kyang de las cung zad 〈snas pa'i yi ge snang bas/ chos rab kyi yig sna gsar pa ma mdzod pa'ang min la/gong du 'khod pa'i yi ge de rnams dkar chag der/rwa lo chen po'i gsung yin tshul brjod mkhas par byung 'dug pas/ bar skabs kyi 348

kha sgong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/mkhas pa rnams dang /phyis kyi sa dge bo gsum sogs rdo rje 'jigs byed pa kun gyis/dwa lo'i gsung yin nges su bzung nas/'ga' zhig yig cha de dag la dgag pa gtong zhing / rwa lo 'gog thub par mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed/ kha cig dad pa tsam gyis rjes su 'brang yod kyi/ bstan bcos de dag gi nang na/rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i gsung rtsom yang ci rigs pa yod par snang zhing /phal cher gsung la slob ma rnams kyis zin bris su byas pa yin pas/ gsung rgyun yin pa'i phyir gsung zhes byas pa yin/ dmigs su dod pa la/ bsnyen sgrub las gzhin sbrags ma ces ba tshigs bcad ma de yin na/ chig sbyo ra ches mi mdzes pa yod pas lo tsā ba'i gsung rtsom ga la yin/yang bsnyen sgrub dgra 〈snag dbang bsdud bya ba lag len khrigs bkod la zer na/ de ni rwa 'e chen po'i gsung la/zhang tshe spong bas zin bris sbyar ba yin par grags pas mtshon/bcud zig che ba yang rwa dharma seng gis mdzad pa dang / yang dgra nag gi yi ge cig na/paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī'i bzhed pa bkod pas kyang gsal/can kyang de dag na bla ma'i gsung bgros 'chugs pa yang cher med la/ gsung rab sbyi dgos dang 'gal ba'i swādzer ba yang cher med pas/ dgag pa byed pa rnams ni mkhas 'dod kha thal ba tsam ma gtogs/don thog tu song ba cang mi snang ngo //mngon rtogs rim pa lnga dang bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog ni/ rwa lo yab sras kyi gsung dngos reg zig cig yod pa dbe ha cang bka' dam pas ma 349

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/'phel ba dang /phyi mo gcig po de yang bla ma dkon mchog seng ge ba'i dus su mes chig nas/ de'i dod du khong nyid kyis brtsams pa'am/ bla ma sher rgyal bas mdzad pa yin/gser bod dod du gser 'dra brtsams//ces pa'i kha skad yod ces/ rwa pa'i bla ma rnams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rnam rgyal gyi gsung las thos so//de bzhin du dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yang //dbang bsdud dang /dug srungs bsdus pa de 'dir bgrod pa yin gyi/ dug srungs rgyas pa 'di ni stod lung bai ror grags pa/rgya gar gyi grub thob bee ro tsa na badzra ces pa la/rwa dharma seng ges gsan pa yin/'di'i lha sku mdog sngon po yin pas/dmar bo mda' gzhu 'grengs pa'i tha snyad kyang mi thob bo//'jigs mdzad bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog chen mo 'di/ rwa lo chen po'i rtsom ba dngos yin na/ 'bum seng ge dkyil chog logs pa 'di mdzad mi dgos pa las/ de'i phyir yang de 'drar rig par bya'o/ /dkar chag tshigs bcad ma de'i don gzhan rnams go sla/ de'i grogs su rtog pa gsum ces pa da lta'i rtog gsum gyi gzhung rang yin/ dkar chag mdzad pa bo rgyud du bzhed pa yang des ga sam/ des na ngor ba rnams rwa pod dwa lo'i gsung rtsom du 'dod bzhin du/rwa ba rnams rtog gsum khas mi len zer ba ni/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi yig sgor de kho na ma gtogs/ dwa pod rdzogs par lan gcig tsam 350

kha skong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsu ba chen po rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar/yang ma bklags zhing /dkar chag tshang ba yang ma bltas pa'i skyon no//gal te mthong na ni/ 'di'i 'grel pa tshig lhug pa na yang / 'khrul 'khor gyi rtog pa/dam rdzas bdud rtsi bza' ba'i rtog pa/ las dang rgyud kyi grogs shes rtog pa gsum bo dngos su bgrangs 'dug kyang / rtog gsum yin pa ma shes pa 'di ni/ ma thos 'dod 〈snan lnga bgrod ma shes pa'i dbe'am/ lag tu sgron me thogs nas me slong du 'gro ba dang 'dra'o//lus dang snying 'dra'i man ngag yod/ /ces pa ni/ buddha shrīs mdzod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi gzhung dngos lus dang 'dra/ de'i gsal byed kyi gzhung chung snying dang 'dra ces pa'i don yin/yig sna lus kyi rnam bshad ces pa rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa'i ṭī ka yin/gzhan rgyud sde'i rnam bshad nas klu'i bshad pa yan chad/yig chung bcu drug yod ba rnams la zin bris chen mor ming 'dogs/ṭī sar ma 'dus pa'i bshad pa'i dogs gcod yin/ char 'bebs nas klu mo dgug pa'i bar la yig chung nyi shu rtsa lnga yod de/las 'phros zab mo zhes ming 'dogs/ ṭī ma'i dkyus la 'brir ma lang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rnams yin/ dpal gyi la skusnags pa rnams dwa pa'i las 'greng chen mosna ces pa yig sna nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam ye da pa sku sdoms pas dgra nag gi 'grel pa gcig tu 'gro ba yod zer ba ni/ yi ge dngos su ma mthong bar ma zad/ rna thos kyang ma dag pa/cane pas pha gnyan byas pa lta bu〉(// 351

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gsod pa'i mtshon ni snying la gnas/ /ces pa ni ha la nag po'i shog gril gsum ste/las skyor dngos dang /sgogs cho ga dang /zhin tu sgogs chog go/kha rgyun yi ger ma bkod ces pas/da dung zhal shes yod pa'i don yin no//mngon rtogs rim pa lnga ni/dpa' gcig phyag gnyis pa/phyag bzhi pa/zhal gsum phyag drug pa/zhal phyag rgyas pa gtso rkyang gi macane rtogs/bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rnams la zer ba yin/las bzhi'i spyin sreg gi cho ga ni/drag po la dgra bgegs kun 'dul zer ba'i yi ge che ba cig yod/zhi ba la tho yig 'bring pa cig yod/dbang drag la tho yig bsdus pa'o/ /de dag las rkang 'grel dang / bcud thig dang / ha la'i re(ga gril dang / bsnyen sgrub las gzhin sbrags ma dang / lag len khrigs bkod rnams ni nang sel na thun mong ma yin pa'i brjod bya gcig tu ma bshad pa cig sgos su bshad pa mang po yod pas/ de dag nges par rtogs na yi ge sbyi khog na zlos pa'i tshul du yod pa rnams mgo mi slongs pa 'gyur ro//de ltar dwa bod du grags pa 'di/ rwa shar pa'i lugs la dkar chag dang bcas pa sku1da pa yin/ nub pa rnams la dkar chag 'dis bsdus pa'i po ti khrigs chags mi mdzad kyang / yig sna phal cher mthun cing / khyad bcos lhag po yang mang po yod do//khulan sha'i man ngag gi sgor rnams kyang /bzlas sngags sogs kyi sgo nas/352

kha slong dang po/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba chen po 'o rje grags kyi rnam thar/gsang 'dus la brten pa'ang yin mod de/ nag po'i rgyud ni gsang 'dus kye rjes su 'brang / de dang cha mthun gdong drug yin/ 'jigs byed kyang phyogs 'dra zhing 'brel can yin pa'i phyir/ gsang 'dus dang 'brel pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ gshed sgor ma yin zer ba gad mo'i gnas yin no/ /cane kyang lha rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis par byed pas/ gsang 'dus kho na'i yang ma yin no//'di nyid kyi yig sgor las kyang / slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la sogs pa/ mkhas grub mang po'i dgongs 'dus yin par bshad/des na rgyud sde gang la sbyar yang rung mod kyi/ gtso bor gzhin rje gshed nag po skor gsum dang 'brel che bar masngani te/zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi las sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched dang mngon spyod kyi las rnams rang nyid kyis sgrub pa la/ pha rol po'i lha'i gnod pa dang / bzlog pa sogs kyi las kyis rang gi las sbyor gnad du mi 'gro ba'i bar chad mang du 'byung ba la srung bzlog 'di nges par gal che zhing pha rol po'i gsang sde 'joms pa dang / byas pa gzhig pa dang /rang gi las gzhan gyis mnan pa 'don pa dang / yang bzlog la sdu gas pa'i ched du 'di dgos pa yin pas/ gzhin rje gshed kyi las tshogs rnams sgrub pa'i rgyab skyor la gal che zhing / snyigs ma'i dus su sngags pa nang rgyas kho na 'byung ba'i phyir/ srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag 'di rnams kyang legs par rtogs par bya'o/ /'di la rwa shar nub kyi man ngag dpe bum so so 353

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/ba gnyis yod do/ /gzhan yang sgrub thabs thor bu ba 'ga' re yod/ mgon nag la mchog sred kyi gzhung la mchan bu dang /man ngag gi yi ge gcig yod/dpal lha yo la srog gi gzer bu'i gzhung mchan bu dang bcas pa dang / man ngag gi yi ge gcig go/lha mgon gyi skor la/ tshu tshun dha ra'i cho ga ltar song /de'i mchan bu dang / las mkhan te lo'i rtog pa dang / de'i man ngag yig chung dang / lha mgon gyi sgrub thabs kā la ka las mdzad pa/ sgrub khog gi yig chung rnams sku da/ las gzhin la chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa dang de'i gsal byed kyi yi ge dang / man ngag gces pa brgyad dang / dmar po'i man ngag spu gri reg gcod che ba dang / rgya ston phyogs la dmar po rigs gnyis kyi sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa re re dang / spu gri reg gcod chung ba dang / gzhan yang phyag mtshan gyi las 〉gis dang / 'khor 'o( rnam gsum dang / yang bzlog gi man ngag gsum sogs man ngag thor bu mang po zhig yod de/ de dag ni dwa lugs kyi skor ro/ 5/zhes gsal 'o(//5 rgyud rgyal gzhin rje gshed sgor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa yid ches ngo mtshar bzhugs so/ /rje btsun tār ṭwāṃ tha'i gsung 'bum bzhugs so/ /pod bcu pa/dbyen ji'i sgog grangs tīcad147354

kha sgong gnyis pa/༄༅༅/ /dwa chen lo tsār phyag bstod bdud sde 'joms pa lha yi gnyi zhes bya ba bzhugs sku //༄༅༅/ /na mo gu ru/'jam dpal dbyangs nyid lnga brgya'i dus//rig sngags 'chang ba chen po'i sku/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /rwa chen lo tsā la phyag 'tshal/ /ldo rje'i sku brnyes rdo rje'i sku/ /rdo rje 'jigs mdzad ldo rje'i rgyal//rdo rje hūṃ gi rdo rje'i sgra/ /rdo rje grags pa la phyag 'tshal/ khams gsum srid gsum thams cad kun/ /gsang gsum phyag rgyas 1(ma mdzad pa/ /brtan gasku1 kun gyi spyi dpal che/khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal//sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje snon po ral gri che/ /smra ba'i seng ge tshugs pa med/ /bdag lta'i gzhin rje 'dzoms mdzad pa//bdag med zil gnon la phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu rtog pa thams cad bcom//kun nas kun tu bzang po'i dpal/ /kun khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas ni/ /bla ma 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal/ /'phags yul mkhas grub thugs kyi bcud//mdo sngags zab dang rgya che'i gter/ /byang phyogs rgyud 'dir thang mar brdal/355

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa//'o( tsā chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs gnyis rgya masnu'i mthar skusnan pas/ /sku mchog mtshan dpe'i me tog mdzes/ /gsung dbyangs chos kyi 'khor lo ldan//skye med zab cing sgos bral thugs/ /'od gsal rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin gshegs dang sems dpa' dang / khro bo'i tshogs dang btsun stor bcas//phrin las mthu lhasnabs gcig bsdus pa/ /dpa' 〈sna chen po la phyag 'tshal//bdud bzhi'i dgra ste bdud kyi gshed//bdud kyi dpyang bcom bdud las rgyal//bdud la rab dpa' bdud kyi bdud/ /bdud 'dul grub pa la phyag 'tshal//rig sngags zhus pa'i snyems 'chang zhing / /dregs ldan rnams kyi zhus rtsal 'grog /ral pa'i do kor rtse mo ni/ /'dar bcas khyod zhabs la phyag 'tshal//'chi med grub pa'i gtsug gi rgyan//'chi med rdo rje'i skur bzhugs nas//'chi med mgon bo kun gzigs zhing //'chi med brnyes pa la phyag 'tshal//de ltar phyag 'tshal bstod pa'i dges/ /dwa chen rdo rje'i gsang gsum gyi/ /byin rlabs bdag gi rgyun zhugs nas/ /srid gsum grong khyer sgrol bar sgog /ces pa'ang me phag zla dgu tshes sum cu la blo gros rgya mtshos bris pa'o/ /the tshom drwa bar zhugs pa yi/ /mchog ldan khyod la mi 'dod pa'i/ kha zas dug can dang 'dra ba'i//bstod bsngags lha yi garnyi sgrogs//11 rdzong sar mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros zhabs kyi bka' 'bum/sde dge'i 7skyabs rje dbe war rin po che'i sbar ma ldeb 'bring /bod ka pa/thog ldeb 173na1—174naca356

mjug bsdu'i gtam tshig gsum nor bu ldog gcigabod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus thog dus rabs bcu pa'i nang bod kyi lha btsan po'i gdung brgyud stod kyi mgon gsum dang /smad kyi sde gsum byung la/de la'ang smad kyi sde gsum gyi khongs mnga' ris smad gung thang khyung rdzong dkar po'i mnga' zhabs yang e yin snyam pa/ 〈snags mtshungs dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang sa hor mchod yon 'brel skabs bod khri sgor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal la stod sgo pa'i khongs su yang cesayod snyam pa/ yul gnya' nang zhes bskal pa sa yi ling tshe/bsgos pa mi yi tshom bu 'di'i shar sgor 'grog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'am go ta wa ri'i 1 gnas dang / brin gyi chu dbar gyi gnas/ gnya' nang gi lhonub tu sbas yul sku(la mosna gangs kyi rwa ba'am sbas yul padma tshal lha dang /glang 'phrang ngam spro 'dre ga la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'i gnas yig rgyas pa/ gsang lam sgrub pa'i gnas chen nyer bzhi'i ya gyal godra wa ri'am/ 'brog la phyi gangs kyi rwa ba'i sngon byung gi tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam rab tu byed pa'i nyung ngu rnam gsal/ 'bri gung 7skyabs mgon chung tshang sku dreng drug pa mgon po 'bri gung pa'i khri rabs so bzhi pa dkon mcho ga bstan 'dzin chos kyi blosna 〈snas 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes 141lor mdzad pa/ la phyi kun rtse'i sbar ma/sgog ldebs 7༷bzhugs/lha sas yul sbyi dang bye brag yol yo gangs ra'i gnas yig bzhugs so/ /mkhan bo nyi ma don grub kyis bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha sgor du 243 lor sbar skrun 357

nang gi ba gam mtho shos bcas kyi dbya tog lta bur gnya' nang chags yod/lhag par du grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan rje btsun mi la ras pa'i (1340—1123)sgrub pa mdzod pa'i gnas phyi nang gsang ba'i thong drug dang /phug chen bzhi'i ya bcas 'di ga'i gangs ri glang ma'i rtsar 'gro tshul gyis 'dir 'byor/shar gyi lu sgor gur gra phub nas gzhis mal bcas/dpon khag rnams gangs rtsar song /zhag nyi shu rtsa grangs zhig bsdad kyang gangs rir 'dzeg ma thub pas 'di khul rdab bsigs gang yang med par gnod med du phyir log ste mkhar rta brgyud song / zhes dang /sgog ldebs 2sgo7ba3 las/ /19221 4zla ba gsum pa nang slar yang dbyin ji'i dpon khag sa heb bcu gsum dang /ku 'i brgya sgor/dos khal sum brgya skor bcas 'byor nas mdun du gur grar zhag gcig bsnad/ lam na sa rgyus shel rdzong sku tshab ding ri gra sgrigs pa'ang slebs/ lha rab cad gasku ga thams cad dang / mthar sbyi khyab sa heb der mjal kha ma btang mthu med yin tshul zer bas lta 'o ga mi gcig dang 'phrad na gzhan kun bdag don mi 'dug kyang / rang nyid nad babs zu bas de'i sang nyin sngags khang mdun gyi g.yab chen du dza nan zer ba sogs sa heb gsum dang / skad bsgyur bcas la mjal kha btang /dpon bo gtso bo des 7gong sa yas phyin gyi sku par cig dang /skyin khab yug gcig kha btags bcas phul/der gasku'ol ja dang casna 'bras btang / gar 'gro dris pas 'dzom bu gling nas gangs ri 'di mtho bas 'di'i rtser sleb na dbyen gzhung nas phogs dang /go sa chen bo yong zer/bdag gis nged kyi lung pa 'di ha cang grang ngar che zhing chos byed las gzhan tshugs par dka' zhing / gnas bdag gnyan pas zab lcag gang che mdzad dbe|sa 31la bas/ zugs rje che/bla ma nas kyang skyabs 'jug dang / nged rnams la be zhing spen ma phran bu sgrugs chog pa mkhyen/359

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/gyal gnya' nang grod pa phyag yang bzhugs su gsol ba'i yul khyad par can zhig yin/gnya' nang zhes pa'i yul ming ni dus rabs bdun pa nas yod pa'i bod cha gzhanaganas nang gi bya ri dwags la gnod pa mi byed/ gri chung ltab gri tsam las mtshon cha'i rigs gtan nas yod ri kun zer nas song rjes 'di nas yul babs sna len sha khog gcig dang / ja sbag gcig gro phye ka to ra gang bcas bskyal bar btang /de nas song bar gangs rtsar sgar chen phogs nas/de nas yar gur gra rim pa bdun rgyab nas yod tshul gleng / zla ba byed gnyis tsam bsnad de gangs rir 'dzegs pa'i rtsol ba lcags phur/lcags thag lcags sder skusnags thabs 'phrul la brten nas zhin tu dka' ngal chen pos 'dzegs pas sa nyeb gnyis rkang lag gangs phyid theb te sngon la song rjes lag mgochad skad 'dug /da dung gzhan rnams kyi dbya btsugs kyis 'dzegs te gangs kyi gsum gcig tsam sleb pa na nyin gcig 'ur sgra dang bcas gangs nyer te mi 'ga' zhig g.yang la zags/sa heb che ba gnyis shrī ba yin nam grangs mi tshes/ g.yog ku li bdun brgyad cig zhi bas 'di gar ngos sar bsngo ba byed dgos zer sbyi khyab sa heb des dngul srang bco lnga btang ba 'byor bas dgos med kyi las la de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong dgos las bsgos la zhin tu snying rje zhing bsngo smon gnad smin byas/ sa zla'i sgrub mchod skabs sa heb lnga dang / ku li mang zhig yong / gar 'chams sogs par btab/ de rjes dpon 'khor tshang ma phyir log gi skyas bteg nas 'dir dgong sdod byas/ sang nyin sde yang du sa heb brgyad dang / g.yog gang yod la mjal kha btang / dzikhyab des kha sngon ku chabadun zhi ba'i bsngozhu ṭam brgya dang da lam shel thong sku tshab la 'bras dang / 'phrul gyi me thab sgam 360

mjug bsdu'i gtam tshig gsum/kyi yul ming rnying pa zhig ste/ mkhas pa lde'us 1241 lor mdzad pa'i rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa las/ dbu rmog btsan zhing chab srid gung du 'degs mkhas dpa' mdzangs 'phrul gyi lha btsan bo srong btsan sgam po'i (617—650)bcas 'bul rgyu btang yod byung ngam zer ba byung zhes yol/ khyed sku snyel ma byung ngam byas pas/nga rang khams bzang /mi kha shas zhi song zer cung zad ngo nongs pa 'dugs zas zhing bkrol gang dang / gser zangs gsar pa'i sgrol ma'i sku zhig byin nas ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i gdul byar gyur pa'i smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor byas/ de nas phyir log 'gro ba na bod srol lta bus zhwa rgyud nas bzhugs bzhugs zer song / de'i rjes gangs rtsar dbyin ji'i bsdad shul rnams su rtsam pa dang / 'bras/ bzhun mar sogs phon che lus sku da tshul go thos kyis choso spug pa'i gzhon pa mi grangs nyi shu sgor 'di ga'i dgon yas mas kyis ma tshor bar mtshan gung gsang stabs su phyin nas nam langs te gangs ri'i rtsar 'byor nyer rdza gseng nas dred bdun thon pa thog mar mi gcig gis mthong /de rjes kun gyis mthong bas dngos chas kyi re ba lta ci 'jigs skrag chen pos phyir bros nas 'di gar ngos sar sku nga )mi zhis pa'i ltas ngan pa dang /bla tshe nyams pa sogs med dam zer bar/deng skabs sbas yul gnas bdag zu ra ba dang / gzhis bdag shar lung skumags ma dga' ba'i 'khrul yin 'dug /rim gro bskang bzhags sogs byas na skyon mi 'dug ces yol/ zhes dang / thog sdebs 2carngub4las/ bde skyid chadaman pa'i skyid lung /mkhar rta tsho dgu) khral 'ul brdab bsigs gang yang med pa zhig byung 'dug rung /de rjes sa spyo(1788)sde zar gor dmag phyir lo ga 'ikhulam 'khel ba dang /loteg smoni 'gas sa gnad zer/ sku gsung zugs rten nyams bzhig byas rkyen 'gong wa sa 361

gnya' nang tshong 'dus pa'i bu tsha rgyal khams pa/rgyudabarlams pa rnams skye rtsod 'khrugs gsod bcom gyis phung sri lang pa'i snga ltas khar/ nye lam dbyin ji gangs 'dzigs gis mtha' mi dbus su lhags pas mi zhis pa'i mtshan ma dang / sdigs dus bsod nams zhan pa'i rang rtags dus 'dzoms ltabu'i bhā log chu brdol dang / lo dgra 'bu srin kha lang sgrubacud gzhes khar/ sa klu'i longs spyod kyi sman dbang lag/hong len zhes pa ri mtsho gangs brag sbub gnas gar yod bsil bur btang nas brkos par brten sa g.yang la zhin tu gnod pa byung 'dug7ces dang / thog ldebs snaran las/ (19331 dus dbang zlog tu med pa zhig gam ji ltar rung de lo nas bzung dbyen ji 'di bzhin glang ma'i gangs rtser bskyod rgyu'i grabs gshom gyis/ sngar lan gsum yong yang gangs rtser bgrod ma zub/ 'di 'o 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par dgongs sgor dang 'brel gam ba nas shel dkar brgyud tshes nyer gnyis la shel rdzong mi sna khag dang / sa heb bco lgaskul chabargya skor dang /dos khal sum brgya sgor bcas 'byor pas/sngar ri khrod sbas lung sa gtsang gnas mtho zhig yin rung / mtha' mi lhags pa'i spyod lam bza' btung sku gas gang sa nas gnas yul sgrub 13da thams cad la lta 'o(ga nyes grib kyi nyam dmas che cher sku nga gnas rung / 7rgyal khab bka' stsal dang dus babs la brten gang yang bcos su ma gyur pas sems slong slong por gyur/ can kyang mtha' ṣpekhrims gtsang bas tshur spyod lam mi mdzes pa mi byed kyang / rang re rnams kyi 'dir snang gi dngos por 'dod sred kyis kha ta byas pas chos lam 'gro'i skyon du gyur 362

deng sang mang che ba ni gnya' lam dang gnya' nang zhes pa 'di gnyis mang bar 'bri bar snang /da dung gnya' nang du stod 'brug gi 7rgyal ba rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje (1189—1258) mchoge dang / 7rgyal ba rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje dang /chos kyi rje dpal ldan sam pa pakṣi'i (1206—1283) dngos slob mnga' ris smad bu tra'am/ phu brag du sku 'khrungs pa grub thob byas rgyan pa rin chen dpal (1230—1369) sogs kyang gnya' nang stod smad du zhabs kyis bcag cing phrin las 'gro don bskyangs myong ba lags/'og min sa la spyod pa'i gdan sa chen po shar sde dge dpal spungs kyi byams mabesnan si tu paṇa chen choso kyi 'byung gnas (1700wa1774)zhabs phyi 'o( 1723 lor gnya' nang du chib bskyod mdzod tshul rang tshul drang bor brjod pa dri bral shel gyi me 'o1nga zhes bya ba las 'di ltar/ de nas brin gyi la brgal 'dras bla mtsho/ dbu thum sbug gangs chen gangs chung rnams brgyud la phyi gangs kyi ra bar 'byor/phyi nyin sgrub sder phyin gnas 'dzin pa rnams kyis ser sbreng gi rnam pa'ang byas/ ras chen phug dang bdud 'dul phug sogs phyi nang dzu sa la0741447rtsalapo5 65 1984 dbyin ji'i the ga grangs 61 snying lcags rgyal/ gzhis rtse'i nub rgyud gnya' lam khul gyi gna' shul 'tshol stegs sgor gyi ngo sprod mdor bsdus/gangs ljongs rig gnas/2༷༷3'don thengs 2lha sa/sgog grangs tsuchung73bar gzigs/365

gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhig byas/sang de stag bzang phyagazil gnon phyag/gzim phyag/lung bstan phyag/dur khrod sbas pa kun gsal rnams mjal/kha sang gi sgrub pa bo de sleb byung ba mdang gnyid 'thug gi skabs 'od gsal ngos zin nas yun ring du mnyam par bzhag rgyu byung zer/ dad pa lhag tu che ba'i khul gyis da res bcad rgya las khyed kyi drung nas chos zhu ba gal che bar 'dug pas cis kyang nas nges don gyi snying po'i gnad gsang 'dom pa'i gdams ngag zhig thugs la 'dog dgos zer byung bar/ gnad longs pa'i gdams ngag 'debs rgyu med kyang shes tshod kyi go don cung zad bshad pas chog smras/de nas brtsams te re zhig rjes su 'brang nas chos than zun bshad pa yin/ de nas rim par bteg nas rje btsun gsar sprul pa'i zhabs rjes dang /rdo ba la gsang rdor bsnun ba'i rjes sogs lam du mjal te rams lding gnam phug gi 'og tsam du bsdad/ phyi nyin yang lam du sgrub phyag dang rang byon sogs mang ba mjal byams khang du bsdad/ de nas sgos phor phug tu rje btsun gyi zhabs rjes mjal/mkha' 'gro'i dar lam brgyud de zur re ma'i la brgal snye nam bkra zhis sgang zhes rje btsun chen po gangs kyi 'jigs pas brdzi ba med bar phebs ste ste nam kyi sbyin bdag rnams phebs bsu 'ong pa dang mjal ba'i gnas der bsdad/ phyi nyin zhwa dmar sku zhabs bal yul nas bod la sbyan 'dren zhus skabs dad 'byor gnyis ma'i sgo nas zhabs phyi thengs pa'i sbyin 367
